bhū: svāheti gārhapatye juhuyāt, bhuva: svāheti dakṣiṇāgnau juhuyāt, sva: svāhetāhavanīye juhuyāt, bhurbhuva:sva: svāhetāhavanīye juhuyāt ' eteṣāṃ vikalpa:, na samuccaya:, vividhairguṇaissamādhānāya prāyaścittatvena vihitatvāt |
ṛg- yaju:- sāmato śreyaprāyaścittārthaṃ niṣiddhācaraṇajanyadoṣaparihārārthaṃ ca teṣāṃ krameṇa vidhānena anyo'nyanirapekṣatvāt |
vi. 12|1|5, ' athaiṣa bhū:' ' iti ekākṣariṣo bhū: |
anayā dhenvā ' gauścāśvaścāśvataraśca ' ityādī gausāmānyātsva bādha: nāśāde:, tataśca dvādaśaśataṃ gāvo dhenava eva dātavyā:, aśādaśva dātavyā eva iti pūrvapakṣa: |
dhenvā ca tayā nikhiladoṣabādha: iti siddhānta: |
yathā ' bhū sattāyām ' ityādi- dhāturhi nijanānātyopasargapratyayasyopapādibhedena nānātvaṃ bhajati, tadyathā bhavatītyatra ' sattāyāṃ maṅgale buddhau nivāse vyāsisaṃpado: |
abhidhyāsau ca śaktau ca prādu- rbhāve gatau ca bhū: |
' ityupāthamedena prabhāvānubhāva- parībhavedādau upasargabhedena bhavanaṃ bhūyate bhavitaityadau pratyayabhedena cārthabheda: pratīyate, tathaimeva brahma upādhi- bhedena nānevāvabhāsate iti |
ayaṃ nyāya: anyā- sādhāraṇadharmasya anyatra āropaviṣayatvāyāṃ pravartate |
sāhasī. 303. bhūsaṃjñakaikāhe aupadeśikadhenudakṣiṇayā āti- deśikadvādaśaśatadakṣiṇayā bādha: |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyadvaṣṭ svāhā nama: ityādau na mantrabheda: |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyadva vaṣaṭ svāhā nama ṛgyaju:- sāmavaṣaṭ svāhā nama: ' ityādau vaṣaṭkārasvāhākāra- namaskārā: pradānārthā:, bhūtādintrayeṇa yathākramamanvayena trimantrītvasaṃbhavāt |

iti prāpte, sāmānyasaṃbandhakāri- pramāṇābhāvena kevalaliṅgena homānāṃ kalpanāyogāt bhūtādyudeśena vaṣaḍādyamekadhanasya stutyarthatvenopapatteśca sudhikaraṇamantrasthasvāhākāravadete'pi na pradānārthā: |

tathāhi, kiṃ dravyaguṇayo: phalabhāvanākaraṇatvamūta dhātvarthasya iti bhāvārthādhikaraṇe ( 2|1|1-4 ) saṃdigdhā dravyaguṇayoreva bhāvanākaraṇatvaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate iti nyāyādityāśaṅkya dhātvarthasyaiva bhāvanākaraṇatvamityuktaṃ tatra iti |
sāhasī. 852. bhūtaṃ dravyaṃ bhavyāṃ kriyāṃ nirvartayati iti kriyāta: adṛṣṭam |
athavā yadyapi yāgo devatāṃ saṃskurvan upakaroti, tathāpi sādhanatāṃ pratipadyamāna āśrayo bhavati, nānyathā |
dupa. 4|1|7|18. svargadestu nāmapadābhidheyatayā siddharūpasya ākhyāta- vācyaṃ sādhyaṃ dhātvarthaṃ prati ' bhūtaṃ bhavyāyopadiśyate ' iti nyāyāttu sādhanatayā guṇatvenāmisaṃrava: |
tathā ca ( 6|1|1|16 ) bhāmatī. 3|2|8|39 brasū. bhūtaṃ bhavyāya kalpate iti nyāya: |

sati tvāsmin iṣṭakāsaṃskāradvārā cayanāṅgatvabodhakavidhau pratipradhānānuvṛtti- nyāyāt agrapradhānayorekakartṛkatvaphalayasiddhiḥ |
sṛṣṭi- padaṃ tu liṅgaprakaraṇaprāptasṛṣṭimantramātrasya gauṇānuvāda iti bhāṣyakāraḥ |
ato mantramātramupadhānānuvādena mantra- viśiṣṭaṃ vā upadhānamiṣṭakāsaṃskārārthatvena vidhīyate |
mantrā hi iṣṭakāprakāśakāstadgrahaṇādiṣvapi prāptisaṃbhavāpadhāne niyamena prāpnuvanti |
'yāṃ vai kāṃcana brāhmaṇavatīmiṣṭakāmānīyātāṃ tāṃ mavyāyāṃ citāvupadadhyāt' iti vacanena pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavatīnāmaṣṭa- kānāṃ madhyamacitisaṃbandhasya vidhānāt |
anyathā tatta- ccityantaraprakaraṇopahāritānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ cayanamahāprakaraṇena sarvacittitsu antimāyāmeva vā niveśāpatteḥ |
tatra ca viśeṣaṇāṃśasya mantrasya vidheyatvāt tattadiṣṭakānāṃ pratyakṣabrāhmaṇavattvasiddhiśca |
sṛṣṭidaṃ paraṃ gauṇyā vṛttyā saptadaśasaṃkhyāka sṛṣṭimantra- param, 'yatsaptadaśeṣṭakā upadadhāti' ityarthavādānusārāt |
tatra caturdaśa sṛṣṭimantrāḥ (1,14,17 iti-) trayaḥ asṛṣṭimantrāḥ iti sṛṣṭibāhulyaṃ guṇo gauṇīvaccinimittam |
bāla. pṛ. 143, bhūmamūlakagauṇyā liṅkasaptavāyamūlikā gauṇī bādhyate, pūrvasyāṃ bahūnāṃ vākyārthānyāyāt itarasyāṃ tadabhāvāt |
kā punarbhūmirābhipretā ? yade- tat mṛdārabdhaṃ dravyāntaraṃ pṛthivīgolakaṃ nāma ! na kṣetramātraṃ mṛttikā vā |
tadyathā bhūmirarthikaḥ bhūmau rathamālikhya śikṣāṃ karoti, saṃgrāme- prāgubhāvo bhaviti |
bāla. pṛ. 132, vā. 3|1|7 pṛ. 860. 'bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvam' iti nyāyaḥ |

) trivṛtaḥ sāṇḍaḥ somakrayaṇaḥ ityatra (prakṛtitaḥ prāteṣu krayasādhaneṣu ) golya- ajātya- jātyoḥ vikalpena prāptaṃ golyasya 'gomithunena krīṇāti' 'ekahāyanā krīṇāti' iti vākyadvayavihitakrayadvaya- sādhanatvāt 'bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvam' iti nyāyena ekahāyanādīnāṃ ajātva- ādyatva- bādhyatā |

krayāntarāṇāṃ tu anayaiva jātyā prasaṅgasiddhiḥ ! kau. 3|1|6|2 pṛ.169. bahavaśca praiṣādyāḥ eko nigadaḥ ; 'tena bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvam' ityapi praiṣārthe adhvaryu- riti pariśeṣāt praiṣe abhīt iti pūrvapakṣaḥ ! vā. 3|8|
daharākaśamahiprapañcasya tadantargatavastupratipatyarthatvāt upāsanārthatvāvaśyaṃ- bhāvena teṣāmanyathāsiddhānaṃ bhūyasāmanugraheṇa tasmi- nyadantaḥ ityādiḥ daharākaśasya anyeṣṭyatāparaṃ ava-
pradhāneṣu sahānuṣṭhīyamāneṣu dharmavirodhe bhūyo'nugraheṇa dharmāṇāmanu- ṣṭhānam |
tatra dharmavipratiṣedhe sati ekādaśā- nāmahamabhiprutaśca vicāryate |
kimeṣu dvādaśāhiko dharmaḥ kartavyaḥ uta agniṣṭuta iti |
nanu siddhametat, codakanāma- dheyayorbalavalaparīkṣyāyāmekāhiko dharmaḥ kartavya ityuktam, 'na vā ṛtvabhidhānādāhikānāmaśabdatvam' iti (7|4| 316) ; tathā siddhaṃ nyāyāntareṇa ākṣipyate |
vipratiṣiddhadharmāṇāmetāṃ agni- ṣṭutaścaikādaśānāṃ cāhnāṃ samavāye etasmin pañcadaśarātre bhūyasāṃmekādaśānāmahnāṃ sadharmatvaṃ syāt |
loke, ekādaśa pradīpeṣ tailvati- saṃpanne'smin gṛhe mahān prakāśo bhavati, viparyaye alpaḥ |
tatra agniṣṭut prathamamahaḥ, tato jyotiḥ, gauḥ, āyuḥ iti tryahaḥ ; pariśiṣṭāni ekādaśāhāni dvādaśāhikāni |
tatra agniṣṭuti āgneyī subrahmaṇyā nāmadheyā prāptā, dvādaśāhi- keṣu tu codakena aindrī, tatra balābalaṃ cintyate |
athavā jyotirgaurāyuḥ iti tryahe nāmnā aindrī prāptā agniṣṭuti ca nāmnaiva āgneyī |
idaṃ bhāṣyakāroktamudāharaṇamakṣiptam--) asmin sūtre pañcadaśarātrāvat anudāharaṇam |
(katham ?) yā tāvat vatsavatīvatparigrahottarakālā subrahmaṇyā, sā prati- divasaṃ kriyate ('tatkālā tvāvateṃ' [1|1|12|124] iti yuktam |
) yathādevataṃ ca (sā kartavyā) āgneyī abhi- ṣṭuti, anyeṣu aindrī |
tatra tāvat saṃśaya eva nāsti (bhedena karaṇāt) avirodhāt |
yā tu ātithyānte upasatsu ca (kriyate), tasyāṃ (tantreṇa kriyamāṇāyāṃ) virodhaḥ (saṃbhāvyate) |
tatrāpi devatāsaṃskārakatvāt nigadasya, yathādevatameva tanbhedaḥ, nāsti tantreocā- raṇam |
yathā nirvāpamantraḥ saṃskārakatvāt pratinivārpa bhidyate, evamayamapi |
tasmāt dve api subrahmaṇye āhā- tavye (ityanudāharaṇam |
) kiṃ tarhi atrodāharaṇam ? yatra pañca yāgāḥ saha codyante phala prati, tatra ca trayāṇāṃ paurṇamāsiko vidhyantaḥ :, dvayordārśikaḥ ; tatra abhimarśa- nājyabhāgamantrayorvirodhaḥ |
) tathāhi- agneye dātre puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet, indrāya pradātre puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ pañcakapālaḥ ; dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpo dhānāḥ prājāpatya iti sapta yāgāḥ |
tatra āgneye puroḍāśe dhānāsu ca āgneyo vidhyantaḥ |
tena āgneyasya paurṇa- māsyāvājyabhāgābhyāṃ na virodhaḥ |

tatra aindre puroḍāśe dadhani ca dārśika vidhyantaḥ :, madhughṛtayośca upāṃśuyājavikāratvāt paurṇa- māsikaḥ, tatra abhimarśanājyabhāgamantrayoḥ virodhaḥ : catu- rhotṛpaddhateoḥ : abhimarśanamantrayoḥ, vārtraghnoḥ : ghṛtanalośca ājyabhāgamantrayorvirodhaḥ ityarthaḥ |
soma-- kiṃ mukhyadharmasyaiva itaratra prasaṅgaḥ, uta bhūyasāṃ dharmasya iti prasaṅgaviśeṣavicārāt saṃgatiḥ |
' āgneyī prathamaṃ cāho virodhānudayāt bali, na vaha- nugrahadaindrī kulārthatayāganītiḥ |
darśa- dharmādeśana prāpta āgneyo, dantimo yataḥ |
bhāṭṭa— kāmyeṣṭikāṇḍe 'amaye dātre puroḍāśamaṣṭā- kapālaṃ nirvapet indrāya pradātre puroḍāśamekādaśapālaṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpo dhānāḥ tatsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyaṃ paśukāmaḥ' iti śrutam |
tatra ādyo'nyaśca dhānāyāḥ āgneyavikāraḥ, sa ubhaya- kālakatvādaviruddhaḥ |
tadiha saptayāgeṣu sahakriyamāṇeṣu ājyabhāgayorvā'nyairhaviṣyantī- mantrāṇām, havirabhibharśane caturhotṛpañcahotṛmantro'tha virodhe mukhyatvenāstrajātavirodhitvāt amāvāsyādharmāḥ |

iti prāpte, mukhyadharmāṃnugrahasya prathamamavagatatvāt bhūyo'nu- grahānurodhena prāptatrādhavidhyā mukhyasyaivopasaṃkhyāsya bādhama- ṅgīkṛtya bhūyo'nugrahasyopakāropajīvitvātgateḥ : paurṇamāsī- vikārāṇāṃ bhūyasāṃ tantritvam, alpānāṃ ca viruddhadharma- viṣaye prasaṅgitavyam |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa 'pañcadaśāhne agniṣṭut prathamamaha- stasya nāmnā agniṣṭuāvikāratvādetadī sutradhavyā |
tadiha satyā- kālīnasutradhavyāhānasya tatchinabhedanena anuṣṭhānāt na kaścidvicāraḥ |

ātithyopasatkālīnasutradhavyā''hasya tu sarvasulabhyai tantritvasya sādhitatvāt virodhaprasaktau bhūyo'nugrahāya aindrī kāryā' ityuktam, tat sutradhavyā- hānasya devatāprakāśanārthatvāt indraprakāśane ca agni- prakāśanarūpahavirsāderabhāvāt medenaivobhayasutradhavyā- karaṇāvagaterapekṣitam |

na caivamabhibharśasyāpi dravyabhedena bhinnā- nuṣṭhānāpatteḥ prasaṅgasiddhavanāpattiḥ; 'āsannāni havīṃṣya- bhimṛśati' iti vacanāntaravihitatvābhibharśanānuvādena tattadvidhiriha 'caturhotrā' ityetābhyāṃ mantrāvidhānenāne- keṣāmapi haviṣāṃ sakṛdabhibharśanasaṃbhave mantramātrāvarodhena tadāvṛttau pramāṇābhāvāt prasaṅgasiddhirupapadyate |
ata evā- saṃbhave yatrābhibharśanāvṛttiḥ tatra sa eva mantra iti na prasaṅgaḥ |
na cā''kāśaśrutipi pañcavāramabhyastā iti bhūyo'nugrahanyāyaḥ : ubhayatrāpi tulyaḥ iti cet, na |
parākramaḥ 6612, bhūyo'nugrahanyāyenāpi ākāre sarvalokagatitvasaṃvatdhasyaiva avāntaratātparyeṇāpi prati- pādyatā |
6612, anurvāvyādhikaraṇe bhūyo'nugraha- nyāyena anurvāvyāpyamahe prāpte yatra sarveṣāṃ tantritvata na gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ, tatra mukhyānugrahanyāyātbādhaḥ : bhūyo'nugrahaḥ |
yatra tu ekastantra itare prasaṅginaḥ iti gṛhyate viśeṣaḥ |
tatraikasya tantram evaṃ dharmāḥ, bahūnāmpi prasa- ṅginaḥ tattvanopajīvitvena svadharmāprayojakatvāt |
viruddhastu nāmaprāptāḥ viruddhā api asuyākātvā ye sarve- ṣāmahatāṃ tantrānuṣṭheyā dharmāḥ te bhūyo'nugrahanyāyena coda- prāpitā evaṃ kartavyāḥ na nāmaprāpitāḥ |
bhūlokasya atrahyāvagamakāntavatśravaṇatadvayantarapakṣā- nusāreṇa tasya pratiṣṭhātvetvena prasiddhe pṛthivīloke eva viśrānteḥ : bhūyo'nugrahanyāyāt |
'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti yajurvede sāmavede ca samānākṣarameva āmānnam |
tatra sāmavede yadāgnāt tat kriyārthe yajurvede ca guṇārthe viparītā veti na niścayaḥ |
yatra bhūyāṃso guṇāḥ samānāḥ tatra tasya kartavyatā codanā syāt |
yatra ca kartavyatā codanā tatra itikartavyatā ākāṅkṣyate |
tathā ca jyotiṣṭomasya yājurvedikatvāt upāṃśuḥ prayogaḥ |
yajurvede jyotiṣṭomaṃ samāmananti— 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
tathā sāmavede'pyeṣa samā- mnātam— 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
sakṛcca kṛtāyāṃ kriyābuddhau dvitīyaṃ guṇārthe śravaṇaṃ bhavati |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ yājurvedikaṃ guṇārtham, uta viparītaṃ iti |

pūrvamantreṇotpattiko vedadhamau viniyoga- vidhivaśenāpyate iti pratipādya idānīṃ pradhānameva yatro- bhayatvena śrūyate, tatra katarasya vedasya saṃbandha uccaiṣṭvādi- dharmā'nuṣṭhātavya iti saṃdehe sati adhikāravākyasya ubhayatrāviśeṣāt yatrotpattistatraivānuṣṭhātavya iti sthite utpattividhiraiva kutreti vicāryate |
na tāvat ekato'nyasya anyatra aṅga- saṅgradhārthaṃ śravaṇam, ubhayatraivāśravaṇāviśeṣatvāt |
yataḥ ekasya nāma vedādhyayanasaṃbhave sati svaśākhā tāvatprathamamadhyā- dhyetavyā |
tena yadetadvā śākhā yena prathamamadhītā sa eva vedastvatto'pyadhika iti śākhā'ntaravedasamuccayo'pi vyavasthaye vikalpa eveti |
yajurvede hi jyotiṣṭomasya dīkṣaṇīyādiketikartavyatā bhūyasī śrūyate, na tathā vedāntare |
sūtraṃ tu ubhayaśruti yatkarma tasyābhayastvenopanirṇaya iti |
tadasya yathābhāṣyaṃ siddhāntahetuṃ vārtikakārapādā nānu- manyante |
yadi hyetattikartavyatotpatyavagatau liṅgaṃ tadā tadalpastvabhayastvayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ ? na hi dhūmatvenāva- dhārito'pyadhīyān dhūma''di nānumāpayati |
tadalpaṃ bahu vā tasya pratīto na viśiṣyate ||
sa tādṛgbahulpo vā vahniṃ gamayati dhruvam ||
jyotiṣṭomasya ca dravyadevataṃ kṛtsnameva yajurvede samāmnāyate |
itaratra vede karmaviśeṣarūpamātramukīrya stotraśastrāmātravidhānāt guṇārthameva śravaṇam |
teṣāṃ prati- vākyaṃ karmatānuvādena na vidhayaḥ śrūyante |
iha tu yādṛśaṃ karmotpattividhivagataṃ tena yadetadatyantare śrudrasya śravaṇa- madhyayanavidhikāritaṃ tasya prayojanam |
sūtraṃ tu dravyadevatādiñcakabhūyastvena yajurveda eva jyoti- ṣṭomasyotpattibhavedyaśravaṇe'pīti sthitam |
bhūyastvenobhayaśruti' ityanena nyāyena yatra yāgaparicāyakadevatādimatā tatraiva yāgavidhiḥ |
athadāmbhyoḥ : ' bhūyastvenobhayaśruti ' iti nyāyena aupānavākyakāṇḍe eva guṇavidhitvāt pradhānavidhirapi |
yasya karmaṇa ekasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ bhūyasāmaṅgānāṃ vidhānam, ' bhūyastveno- bhayaśruti ' iti nyāyena pradhānasyāpi tatraiva vidhānam |
śākhāntare tu svalpāṅgānāmeva vidhānam, tatra karmaṇi
prasaṅgāt kāryasiddheḥ na aṅgabhūte'piṣṭapaśu ādideśikā- 6|170. # yadi tu ubhayatra (vedadvaye mantraḥ) vidhā- |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ parikrayaḥ parikrīyante ṛtvijo yena sattve'pi yasya vastuno bāhulyaṃ tenaiva lokapravādaḥ ityarthaṃ |
sa parikrayaḥ anyāhāryaḥ codakaprāpto'pi some aiṣṭikepu ayaṃ pravartate|
bhṛtatvāt somāryena parikrayeṇa gavādinā oṃ bhūyomantrādhikaraṇam|
oṃ bhṛtiḥ karmakasya ānatyarthaṃ yadīyatai tat|
bhā. 10|2|8|27, tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ bhṛtiḥ bhavati mantrā āmnātāḥ|
phalānurūpyaṃ naiva ñjināṃ ekasmin agne samuccayanyadairītyasyāpi nyāyataulyena |
vacanaṃ tu bhṛtau satyāṃ parimāṇaviśeṣaparaṃ bhavati|
yatra hi pādikamapi aharna labhyate na sā dakṣiṇā mantrākāṅkṣāyāśca vikalpena viniyoge'pi śānte 'tāṃ |

aprāptodravyayoreva prāpti: saṃyoga:, sa ca vibhunorna saṃbhavati |

tathāhi- ākāśātmasaṃyoge, tasaṃyukdravyāntarasaṃyogi- tvāt, ātmasaṃyukdravyasaṃyukpaṭavat ityādi |

tataśca anyatra saṃyoga: kriyā- janyatvena dṛṣṭa:, vibhudravye tu saṃyoge sādhye kāraṇābhāvāt kāryābhāvānumānādvādhitaviṣayatvam |

teṣu saṃdehaḥ kimādhvaryavāḥ uta yājamānāḥ iti |
prakṛtaprayogāntargatatvāt phalasya yājamānatvena kāmanayā api yājamānatvam |
phalaṃ ca prakṛte karmaṇi yathā yajamānasya svargādirūpaṃ asti, tathā ṛtvijāmapi dakṣiṇārūpamastyeva |
yathā ca lakṣaṇāyā tadanuvādakatvam, tathā ṛtvikaphalānu- vādakatvamapi saṃbhavatyeva |
tena samākhyāvagātādhvaryukartṛ- katvānurodhena adhvaryoreva dakṣiṇābhātmakaphalaṃ āyurādi- rūpeṇotsāhanārthamāśāsyate |
tasmāt adhvaryuṇā evaṃjātī- yakā mantrāḥ prayoktavyā iti |
kiñca utsāhajananārthamidamāśāsanam, yajña- mānaphalaṃ cāyantāhaṃ yathācoditānuṣṭhānāsādhyam |
tadā- śāsyamānamutsāhajananaṃ yathācoditaprayogasaṃpattihetuḥ bhūtvā sidhyatīti tadevāśāsanīyam |
ṛtvikaphalaṃ tu yajamāna- vyāpārakaraṇatvena siddhamāśāsanaṃ (na) prayujyate |

yasya tvadṛṣṭārthatā tasya kramānyatve taduccāraṇajādaṣṭapramāṇābhāvāt kramā- nyatvaṃ na yuktamiti niyamārthavattā |
atha niyatapratyā- yanādaṣṭaṃ kalpyeta tat uccāraṇodapapadyate tadadhīnatvā- tpratīyate |
niyamo dṛśyate yathendrāgnī nīlotpalaṃ rājapuruṣaścitrāguḥ niṣkauśāmbiriti, yuktaṃ tatra viṣayabhe''paśabdārthānatvā- narthakyaprasaṅgāt |
ajādyadantaviśeṣaṇatvādinānimitto hi tatra niyataḥ pūrvanipātaḥ syate |
tenāgnīndrī ityasādhu- tvam, puruṣarājaḥ ityanyatvam, kauśāmbibhiḥ ityana- narthakatvam |
yastu agnīndrī iti kvacit prayogaḥ sa cchāndasaḥ, athaivā''ryahaṃtatvasya vivakṣayeti mantavyam |
tadedhārthaparatve sati tadavināśe hi kiñcinnimittaṃ na vidyaḥ |
tena mantra- prasiddhau 'vākyaniyamāt' ityapi sūtram (sūtraikadeśe sūtraśabdaprayogaḥ; grāmaikadeśe 'grāma āyātaḥ' iti prayoga- darśanāt) |
na hi dṛṣṭe'rthe mantrasya dhyānādervā kaścidviśeṣa ityudāhartavyaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- buddhe khalvapi pāṭhādarthe tadimānasamartho mantro bhavati 'agnīndrīn vihara' iti |
sa buddhe hi bodhayet ? atha nūccāraṇaviśeṣārthaḥ, buddhe'pi uccāraṇa- viśeṣo''vakalpate |
vā-- 'na hyavidvān vihito'sti' (3|8|8|8) ityavaśyaṃ tāvadadhītā''styāḥ padārthāḥ prāyeṇa karma- prakramādavagantavyāḥ |
tatra praiṣaḥ piṣṭapeṣaṇanyāyena jñāpa- yitumaśaktanuvan adṛṣṭārtho bhavati |
saṃskārābhivyaktiheturvā pūrvapadārthasamāptiprāpmeva vā bhaviṣyati nārtho mantraiḥ |
tatra yat ucyate saṃskāraviśeṣo bhaviṣyatīti, nāsāva- dṛṣṭānyaḥ saṃbhavati, ataḥ pūrvapakṣapatiḥ |
yadi hi pratīto''pyanyau naiva dṛṣṭaṃ sādhyati tato yattadadūramapi gatvā''vaśyaṃ kalpanīyaṃ taduccāraṇādeva vadabhiti |
na ca tādṛśo''rtho'sti yādṛśaṃ abhidadhati, yathā 'catvāri śṛṅgā' (taiā. 10|10|17) iti |
na hi catuḥśṛṅgaṃ tripādaṃ dviśiraskaṃ sahasraṃ kiñcid yajñasādhanamasti |
tathā 'mā mā hiṃsīḥ' ityasatyāmapi hiṃsāyāṃ kimabhiddhyāt ? |
vā-- na catuḥśṛṅgādi kiñcitkarma tatsaṃbandhi vā prakṛtau vikṛtau vā vidyate |
yadyapi ca guṇāvadena kiñcit syāt tathāpi tadguṇānāmāvān tatsmṛtyā kāryam |
na ca jñāyate kva pradeśe prayujyatāmiti |
'mā mā hiṃsīḥ' 'mā mā saṃtāsam' ityādīni vedividhirvānādiviṣayatvāt 'acetane'rthavandhanāt' ityupyādyudāharaṇam |
bhāṣyam-- acetane arthe khalu arthe nibadhnanti 'oṣadhe trāyasvainam' iti |
abhidhānenopakurvantiḥ evaṃ- jātīyakā oṣadhi paśūnāya pratipādayeyuḥ |
vā-- 'oṣadhe trāyasva', 'śṛṇota grāvāṇaḥ' iti ca saṃbodhana kāryaniyogābhimukhyakaraṇārtham |
na ca paśutrāṇe prātaranu- vākaśravaṇe vā praiṣeṇa pravṛttirupapadyate ityanarthakyamartha- vivakṣayām |
'eko rudro na dvitīyo'vatasthe', 'asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām' iti codāharaṇam |
vā-- dyutvamantarikṣatvaṃ cāditirekānekatvaṃ ca rudrasya vipratiṣiddham |
kathaṃ vā aditirdevatā antarikṣaṃ dyaurvā bhavet |
na ca stutyarthatayā''pi hetudvayaṃ parihartuṃ śakyam |
bhāṣyam-- svādhyāyakāle pūrṇikā (strīsāmānya- nirdeśo'yam) avahanti karoti |
nāsau tena mantreṇa tadabhidhānamabhyasyati akṣarānupūrvyāḥ avadhāraṇe eva yatate |
vā-- svādhyāyādhyayanasya karmāthatvāt yatkarmopya- yojyate tat abhyasitavyam, tathaiva vidvāṃsaḥ santo vṛddhāḥ śiṣyānakṣarāvadhāraṇe eva pravartayanti saṃnihite''pyarye, na tadacanāmyāse |
bhāṣyam-- api ca keṣāñcinmantrāṇāṃ aśakya evārtho veditum |
yathā 'ambyak sā ta indra ṛṣirasme' iti, 'suṇyeva jarbharī turpharītū' iti, 'indraḥ somasya kāṇukā' iti ca |
na ca mantrārthaḥ sattāmātreṇopa- karoti kriyāvelāyāmasmaryamāṇa iti yadekāntena śakyaṃ kartumuccārya tadeva kāryamivadhāryate |
bhāṣyam-- anityasaṃyogaḥ khalvapi bhavet mantreṣu- bhidhānādyeṣu, yathā 'kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭepu gāvaḥ' ('kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭepu gāvo nāśīra duhe na tapanti dharmam |
ā no bhara pramagandasya vedo naicāśākhaṃ maghavan randhayā naḥ |
kīkaṭā nāma janapadāḥ, naicāśākhaṃ nāma nagaram, pramagando rājeta |
yadyabhidhānārthaḥ, prāk pramagandāt nāyaṃ mantro- ''nubhūtapūrva iti gamyate |
vā-- arthaprakāśanapakṣe yasya yo'rthaḥ sa eva tena prakāśyatiyat |
kecit ca anityakarmajñibhūtaiścārthairye- vanto mantrā lakṣyante yathā 'kiṃ te kṛṇvanti kīkaṭepu gāvaḥ' iti |
ayaṃ hi dṛḍhenādhyetṝṇāṃ smaraṇena viśrāmitrā- ''sannaṃ gamyate |
trailokyādhipate yāḥ kīkaṭepu janapadeṣu gāva- stāstatra kiṃ kurvanti |
te hi nāstikāḥ kiṃ kaḍunā iti vadanto na kiñcitkarma anutiṣṭhanti |
ataśca tā nā''śīra (somamiśrārdhaṃ payaḥ) somasaṃskārārthaṃ duhyate, na dharmaṃ (dharmaḥ = tase ghṛte payoniṣepeṇa nisyanditaṃ yat śiṣṭaṃ tat) tapanti na dharmatape payodānena sādhanī- bhavanti |
tasmāt pramagandasya kīkaṭādhipateḥ yat vedaḥ dhanaṃ tadasmākaṃ naicāśākhaṃ nagaramābhara |
athavā asmān prati tat virbhuhi dhāraya poṣaya cetye- tanno maghavan randhayā sādhyatāmākamiti |
yadyetadvivakṣitaṃ tathā sati ādimadartho'bhidhānāt vedasya kṛtrimatvenāprāmāṇyaṃ prasajyate |
bhāṣyam-- aviśiṣṭastu loke prayujyamānānāṃ vede ca padānārthaḥ |
sa yathaiva loke vivakṣitastathaiva vede'pi bhavitumarhati |
uccāra- ṇaṃca na kaṃcicca kartavyam, yadyapūrvāya yathārthaṃ |
yaduktaṃ na deva- tāmirbyājñaiśca saṃlāpe prayojanamastīti |
yaścaivaṃ prasthasya iti brūte sa prasthayati, yathā yaḥ kuru iti brūte sa kārayati |
vā-- yadyapi pradeśāntarasthatvānmantravidhānaṃ na stūyate tathāpi prathanavidhānāttatparocanayā ca sakalaṃ vākyamartha- vat |
nanu ca puroḍāśā- nyānupapattiprāptatvātprathanaṃ na vidhātavyam |
vidhāne tu sati tādṛśaṃ kartavyaṃ yena prathitavyaṃ bhavati |
paṭhyamānaṃ hyadhvaryu- vasamānākhyaṃ labdhvā kartṛviśeṣaṃ nicchati |
yathā 'suṇyeva jabharī turpharītū' ( 'suṇyeva jabharī turpharītū naitaśaiva turpharī pharpharīkā |
udanyajeva jemanā maderu tā me jarāvyacaraṃ marāyu ||
soma-- saṃgatiḥ-- vidhisamabhivyāhṛta-arthavāda- vicārānantaraṃ avasarasaṃgatyā tadasabhivyāhṛtamantra- vicāraḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- mantrāṇāṃ dharmādharmayoḥ prāmāṇyamasti na veti cintāyāṃ na tāvadvidhivena prāmāṇyam, tasya dvitīye nirākaraṇiyamāṇatvāt |
nāpi jñāpakatvena arthavādavat, teṣāṃ hi saṃnihitena vidhinā padaikavākyatvāt yuktaṃ svasamarpitaprāśastyānvita--bhāvanāviṣayakaśabdajñānajanaka- tvam |
mantrāṇāṃ tu dūrasthatvena padaikavākyatvānupapatteḥ na tadvidhayā prāmāṇyasaṃbandhaḥ |
ato'dhikārākhyaprakaraṇadinā avagatalakṣaṇa- bhāvanāyāṃ mantrāṇāṃ uccāraṇamātramadṛṣṭārthaṃ vidhīyate |
ihe saṃbhavatyadṛṣṭakalpanā'nupapatteḥ prayogasama- vetārthasmṛtireva saṃbhavatāṃ mantrāṇāṃ prayojanam |
śakyate tu tatrāpi mantrāḥ arthaprakāśanārthāḥ prakāśanaṃ paramadṛṣṭārthamiti vaktum |
sāṅka tu ṛgakṣaramabhivyaktiyaiva dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanamarthā- bhāve'pyavyāhatam |
na ca mantrāṇāṃ niyamena pāṭhavaiyarthyam, tadbalena mantraireva statantryemiti niyamakalpanāt |
na caivaṃ sāmarthyādeva tatratatra mantrāṇāṃ vini- yogasiddhau punasteṣāṃ kacidviniyogakaraṇaṃ vyarthamiti vācyam |

tathāhi, arthaprāpte abhyādāne vikalpena natūṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ liṅgena prāptyamānānāṃ prāpakapramāṇāt pūrvameva pravṛttena 'tāṃ caturbhirmādatte' iti vacanena mantrasaṃkhyamayaviśiṣṭā- dānabhāvanāyāṃ vihitāyāṃ etadvacanabhāve'pi mantrāṇāṃ ādānasya ca prāptisaṃbhave etadvacanapravṛttilakṣaṇajijñāsāyāṃ samuccayaphalakatvataḥ saṃkhyārūpaguṇātiriti niścīyate |

tathā liṅgādevābhidhāyanāṅgabhūtāśrvaradāne prāptamānasya mantrasya tataḥ pūrvapravṛttena 'imāmagniṃ raśanāmatyasya- śrābhidhānīmādatte' ityanena vacanena mantraviśiṣṭādāne aśrvaradājñātvena vihite pūrvavat phalajijñāsāyāṃ gardabha- raśanāniṣṭitsutpariśeṣaparisaṃkhyā phalam |
na ca phalataḥ parisaṃkhyāyāṃ svārthahāniḥ parārthakalpanaṃ prāptabādha iti traidoṣyam |
aśrvābhidhānīsaṃśrvarapurasvārthasya vidheyatvāt, anyaniṣṭitsuparārthasya arthasiddhatvena akalpanīyatvāt, prāpakapramāṇasyāpravṛttatvā prāptabādhābhāva iti |
eta eva yatra prāpakapramāṇapravṛttattvameva parisaṃkhyāśāstrasya pravṛttiḥ yathā- 'pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' ityādī ragataḥ prāpta- pañcanakhabhakṣaṇe pañcātiriktparisaṃkhyākaraṇaṃ tatraiva tat |
yatrāpi ca śrautau parisaṃkhyā yathā 'nācṛtaṃ vadet' ityādau tatrāpi na tat |
sāmādisarvamantrāsādhāraṇyena tu padārthavidhayā yathā hi śabdabodhe prati kāraṇī- bhūtajñānasyāpi kāraṇatvāt padārtho'pi tathaityapi vaktuṃ śakyate |
ataśca mantraviniyogavidhau mantrāṇāṃ padārtha- tvāt yuktaṃ prāmāṇyamiti |
[ arthavādādhikaraṇe tu ] mantrāṇāmapi prayojanavattvāt prāmāṇyamasti ityetavat siddham |
mantrādhikaraṇe arthavāda- pracodita- mantrasārita - dravyadevatādidhruvanāmāvacchinna- ghātārthabhāvanākhyadharmapramitau arthavādānāṃ prarocakatvena mantrāṇāmapi sārthakatā prāmāṇyaṃ sidhyati |
soma. 1|2|4|42 ) ityatra kalpanā pravāhanīyatayā nitya- brahmayajñavidhividhayatvaṃ prapañcitam |
'amyuka sā te' (ṛsaṃ. 1|169|13) ityasyāmucci, uparitanayāmucci 'tvaṃ na indra taṃ rathi dāḥ' iti śrūyate tadeva anu- pajñena draṣṭavyaṃ iti (vā. pṛ. 167) |
vāla. pṛ. 60. mantrādhikaraṇe cetanapratipādakeṣu mantreṣu tatstutyānāṃ devatānām, acetanapratipādakeṣu tadabhimānidevatānāṃ śabdabodhaḥ, na tu prayoktuḥ |
mantrādhikaraṇe tu arthaprakāśanātparūpatvā- tyādanena mantrāṇāṃ smārakatvayā prāmāṇyaṃ sidhyati iti vyutpāyam |
mantrādhikaraṇe prathana- mantrasyā''dhyayatve'pi prathanasya ādhyaryatvasiddhayarthaṃ prayane vidhiraṅgīkṛtaḥ |
arthābhidhānalakṣaṇadvāra- saṃyogāt mantreṣu ṛtuśeṣatvaṃ mantrādhikaraṇe vyavasthāpitam |
'catvāri śṛṅgā' ityasya tu vivṛti hotṛrājye prayuktasya yo'rthaḥ sa mantrādhikaraṇe vyākhyātaḥ |
'devāśca yābhiyaṃjate dadāti ca' ityādimantrāṇāṃ yacchabdādinā vidhiśaktiḥprativandhāt vidhāyakatvaṃ nāsti iti vidhinantrādhikaraṇe ( 2|1|16 ) uktam |
manotākhyāmiśabde devatāvācinotādapasāmānādhikara- ṇyena lakṣaṇāṅgīkaraṇaṃ ityuktaṃ mantrādhikaraṇe |
mantreṣvapi hi abhyudayakāritvaṃ tanniyamavidhivaiva prameyam, na mantrāṇām |
ata eva mantrāṇāṃ padārthavidhaiva prāmāṇyaṃ ityuktaṃ mantrādhikaraṇe |

yathā ca nāsya vākyasya ( 'yatha- pyanyadevatyaḥ paśuḥ āgneyeva manotā kāryā' ) vāyavyā- dipaśau ūhanīyatvarkatva tasya prakṛtau anyāniyadatvena aprasaktatvāt kintu uktarśanivartakatvameva, tathā mantrā- dhikaraṇe eva prapañcitam |
śaṃsateḥ prayoktṛgataśabdabodhapradhānatve, pūrvapūrvasyāḥ ṛcaḥ arthāvabodhe vyāptacittasya prayoktuḥ, utta- rottarasyāḥ ṛcaḥ sāṃtatyānupapattiḥ ityādi mantrādhikaraṇe avocāma |
śakyārthānuvādakatve api anadhigatasamudāyādibodhakatvena prāmāṇyopapattiḥ mantrādhikaraṇe uktā |
saṃmīlanadi- vidhiṣvapi na bṛhadrathantaradādivivakṣā, kintu tattatpṛṣṭha-
ku. 1|4|17|19 pṛ. 116. mantragatānāṃ padānāṃ mantrādhikaraṇanyāyena prayogakāle arthābhidhāyakatvena vidhyupayogaḥ |

kau. 2|1|32, 'tatsannidhāti- guṇāstathāḥ' ( 1|4|123 ) ityantasyaikasūtratve'pi mantrādhikaraṇapūrvakasūtratvāt ( 'tadarthaśāstrāt-mantrā- rthakathyam' 1|4|131 iti sūtravat ) pratyekaṃ prathamānta- sūtropanyāso vyākhyāsaukaryārthaṃ na virudhyate |
1|4|123| 23. mantrādhikaraṇabhāṣye liṅgaviniyojyamantraprakā- śyasya yajñapatiprayasya puroḍāśaprathanaphalatvaṃ nirākṛtam |
parākamḥ 48|9. arthavādānāṃmantrayathārthaparatvābhāve ' vidhiśabdāśca ' iti mantrādhikaraṇasthaguṇasūtra- virodhaḥ |
mantro hi anuṣṭhānakāle padārtha prakāśanam padārthaśeṣaḥ |
parākamḥ 43|9, mantrānusāreṇa nirākāṅkṣasya vidheḥ saṃkocaḥ indrapītādhikaraṇe nirākṛtaḥ |
bhā. 1|14|19| 53. mantrāntena karmadisinipātaḥ ādhārai darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ |
1|3|12|28. mīko. pṛ. 858 ' ādhārai mantrāntena ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
1|3|12|26-27. mīko. pṛ. 47 ' agnyadhane vasordhārāyām ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
1|3|12|25. mīko. pṛ. 1364 ' karaṇamantreṣu mantrānte karmaprārambhaḥ ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |

mantrābhidheyatvātpattiḥ prasiddhakriyānvayasya ( puruṣasya ) prathamaṃ bhavati, tathāpi prasiddhakriyānvayabhi- dhānasāmarthyābhāvāt mantrasya prasiddhakriyānvayapadābhi- dhāyitvāpattau śrutāṅkatvānupapattyā mantrābhidheyasya
vā. 4|8|17. mantrārthaḥ yatraika eva tatra mantrāvṛttiranarthikā |
bhā. 1|14|12|42, mantrārthaṃ chanurucyate codakaḥ na mantrākṣarāṇi |
arthaparāṇa hi tāni na svarūpa- pradhānāni |
bṛhatī. 1|17|24 pṛ. 270. mantrārthasya yatra nānānatvaṃ mantrasya 'āvṛttirbhavati, yathā aggau lokaṃpraṇāyāḥ |
bhūtaṃ devatājñānaṃ avyaktaliṅgāmyucca devatā- jñānahetutvena arthajñānopāyaḥ |
ārṣajñānasya ' ahaṃ manu- rabhavaṃ sūryaśca ' ityādau asmaddarśanahetutvena arthajñāno- pāyatvam |
asminnadhikaraṇe ' tadarthaśāstrāt ' ityādipañcadaśabhiḥ sūtraiḥ mantrāḥ arthapratyāyakāḥ itye- tāvat avagatam |
mantrārthapratipattiḥ mantraprayokturyā mantraśroturyā ityatra sūtrākṣarataḥ spaṣṭaṃ na nirdhāritam |
tatra anuṣṭhānahetubhūtādeśyamantrārthatvaṃ karaṇamantrāṇāṃ vadanto bhāṣyavārtikādikṛtaḥ mantraprayoktureva mantrajanyaṃ śābda- bodhaṃ manyante |
tattu vayaṃ na mṛgyāmahai kintu śrotu- reva manyāmahai, śābdoccāraṇasya paraṃ pratyeka śābdabodhajana- katvasāmyāt |
nahi svasminneva śābdabodhaṃ vākya- prayogaḥ arthavān bhavati |
vaktuḥ tadarthabodhasya śābda- prayogāt pūrvaṃ avaśyaṃ bhāvitvāt |
sūtrakāro'pi ' aviśiṣṭastu vākyārthaḥ ' ( 1|2|132 ) iti laukikasya vaidikasya ca
vākyasya arthabodhaṃ nirviśeṣaṃ bruvan śrotareva mantrajanyaṃ śābdabodhaṃ abhyupagacchati |
anyathā loke śrotuḥ śābda- bodhaḥ, mantreṣu tu uccārayituḥ iti vairūpyāpatteḥ |
kiñca śrotudeva mantrataḥ śābdabodhaḥ iyayamarthaḥ mantra- gatapadakathyaiva spaṣṭaṃ labhyate |
tathāhi, 'iṣe tvorje tvā' ityayaṃ mantraḥ ghātrācchedanaṃ viniyuktaḥ |
tatra sākṣāttvāt tvāśabdasya saṃvodhaikaviṣayatvāt viniyogabalāt ' śāstre chinadmi ' ityadhyāhāryam |
śāstre iti saṃbodhane prathamā 'saṃbodhane ca' iti vyākaraṇasūtreṇa vihitā |
'iṣe tvā ūrje tvā chinadmi' iti śāstrāṃ jñāpyo'rthaḥ |
śāstrāśabdena hi tadabhimāninī devatā abhadena upacaryate |
tataśca chedanasya tajjñāpanaśca ca tatrānyo na virudhyate |
abhimāninyapadeśastu viśeṣaṇānugatityām ' iti bādarāyaṇasūtre ( 2|1|13 ) tadrāpyādau ca spaṣṭametat |
satyaṃ nirākariṣyate utsūtraṃ bhāṣyakṛtā, na tu sūtrakṛtā |
pratyuta sūtrakārasya devatāvigrahādikaṃ abhimataṃ vārtikā- bhimaṃtaṃ ca iti pāṣṭhayatirvādhikaraṇe prapañcayiṣyate |
loke hi stotā gadyapadyādibhiḥ stutyaṃ stauti |
na ca sāmāni gātuḥ śastrāṇi ca śaṃsituḥ abhitrāsusyetistu- guṇabodhaṃ stotrīyāḥ śastrīyāśca ṛcaḥ śaktuvanti kartum |
kiñca, śastrīyāṇāmuccāṃ sāṃtatyaṃ vihitam ' saṃtata- manvāha ' iti |
pūrvapūrvasyā ṛcaḥ uttaramuttaramardharcaṃ praṇavāntamuktvā aviratameva uttarattarasyā ṛcaḥ pūrvapūrva- mardharcamuktvā viramati iti sāṃtatyalakṣaṇam |

mantrārthasmaraṇasya prayoktṛgatasya anuṣṭhānahetutve ca ādau mantroccāraṇaṃ tataḥ anuṣṭheyārtha- smaraṇaṃ tataḥ anuṣṭhānaṃ iti kramaḥ syāt |
tataśca anuṣṭhe- yārthasmaraṇena vyavahitatvāt kathaṃ mantrāntena karmādisaṃni- pāto ghaṭeta |

na ca evaṃ sati karaṇamantrāṇāṃ adṛṣṭārthatvāpattiḥ |
devatā- gataṃ śābdabodhaṃ ādhāyaiva dṛṣṭārthatvasaṃbhavāt, japāntu- mantrādimantreṣu karmasametānabhidhāyiṣu tathaiva abhyupa- gatatvāt |
na ca śrotṛdevatāgataśābdabodhasya kathaṃ dṛṣṭatvaṃ devatānāmapratyakṣatvāt iti vācyam |
tarhi loke'pi vākyasya parapratyayāyakatayā dṛṣṭānupapatteḥ, parabuddherapratyakṣatvāt |
anumānādinā loke parasmin śābdabodhasya dṛṣṭaṃ iti cet, vede'pi tulyam, devatā- saṃbodhanādi liṅgāt tasya tadupapatteḥ |
evameva tada- dhvaryuḥ devebhyaḥ pratiprocya vahirdadāti |
tāmyāmeva pratiprocyākrāmati ' ' amiṃ hotārāhaṃ taṃ huve iti devebhya eva pratiprocya yajñena yajate ' ' yadāha |
brahmanbrahma medhaṃ bhantsyāmi devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhyāsamiti |
brahmaṇa eva devebhyaḥ prajāpataye pratiprocya aśva medhaṃ badhnāti |
vasīyān bhavati ' ityādivākyaśeṣā api atra anukūlāḥ |
ajñāte cātra vākyaracanāyogāt prayogaḥ arthajñānaṃ nāntarīyakamasti |
mantrāṇāṃ tu apauru- ṣeyatvena nityasiddhatayā tatprayoktṛtparyajñānaṃ nāvaśa- kam |
tathā ca avyutpannasyāpi mantraprayogo na viru- dhyate |
anyutpannapuruṣa- śukasārikādyudīrita - kālidāsā- diracitagadyapadyebhyo vyutpannānāṃ śābdabodhadarśanāt |
tataśca abhimukhībhūtadevadattaniṣṭha yat ghaṭānayana- jñānaṃ tadanukūlaḥ prayoktṛgatavyāpāro vākyārthaḥ |
evaṃ- vidhabodhaśca saṃbodhasya taditareṣāṃ śrotṛṇāṃ prayoktuśca saṃbhāvyamāno'pi na sarveṣāṃ kāryakārī |
prakṛtau yathoptattivacanamarthānāṃ tathottarasyāṃ tatau tatprakṛtitvādyarthe cākāryatvāt 9|1|1|9|
'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapedbrahmavarcasakāmaḥ' iti, 'aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ' iti, 'citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' iti, 'vaiśvadevīṃ sāṃgrahaṇīṃ nirvapedgrāmakāmaḥ' iti |
asti tu prakṛtau nirvāpamantraḥ 'agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi' iti |
asti tu prakṛtau vrīhiliṅgo mantraḥ 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi ghṛtasya dhārayā suśevaṃ kalpa- yāmi |
tasmin sīdāmṛte pratiṣṭhitaṃ trīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasva- mānaḥ |
tattaccaiva vikṛtau codakaprāptaṃ saṃdihyate kimavikāreṇa prayoktavyam, uta ūheneti |
satyam, prakṛtau yathoptattivacanamarthānāṃ kṛtaṃ mantre, tathottarasyāmapi tatau vikṛtau tenaiva mantreṇa vacanaṃ kartavyam, tatprakṛtitvāt |
etāvatārtho'mīṣṭivi- śabdau sūrya nīvāraṃ ca nāmidadhyātām |

tatra ) vākyatvasāmānyācca (yathā ) prayājā- divākyānāṃ ( vidhāyakānāṃ svārthaṃ vidhātuṃ iha ) ati- deśaḥ, evaṃ mantravākyānāmapi ( smaraṇārthamatideśaḥ ) iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
(kutaḥ ?) arthābhidhāyanāya hi śabdavodhakaḥ pravartate, na ( śabdasvarūpe śāstreṇa ) pṛthak ( atideśo- 'sti ) adṛṣṭakalpanābhayāt |
arthātideśaśca ( sākṣāt kārya- siddhayarthatvāt āvaśyakaḥ ) iti |
bhāṣyam— liṅgaṃ svalpayasmincyeva bhavati 'na mātā vardhate na pitā na bhrātā na sakhā' iti |
pratyakṣaṃ ātaraṃ sakhāyaṃ ca vardhamānaṃ paśyāmaḥ |
śabdavṛddhitratiṣedhastu— na bhrātṛśabdo vardhate, na sakhiśabda iti |
yathā 'na bhavantaḥ samājaṃ gacchanti, na bhavantaḥ prekṣakā bhavanti' ityukte, nūnamanye gacchantīti gamyate |
evamihāpi 'na bhrāto- hyate na sakhā' ityukte, nūtamanya ūhyante iti liṅga- darśanam |
bhāṣyam— sthitaṃ tāvadaparyavasitameva, antarā cintāntaraṃ vartitavyate |
tatta mīko. pṛ. 1226 'ūhaḥ raktapadasya 0' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
) tata eva antarāgarbhaṇīyāya bhavati ityanyā sūtraṃ ( sūtradvayaṃ ) varṇyate— 'liṅgadarśanācca, jātinaimittikaṃ yathāsthānam' iti |
bhāṣyam— itaśca padyāmo vikṛtau ūhaḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
kiṃ liṅgaṃ bhavati ? evamāha 'viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ vapānāṃ medaso'nubrūhi' iti |

ūhe akriyamāṇe anarthaparatve agnicchāgaśabdava iva prayujye- yātām |
na ca atraite śabdā vidhīyante, vidhāyakatvābhāvāt |
nanu prayogavacanena vidhāviṣyante, evaṃ tarhi ahyadhārtā doṣaḥ |
āgneye vaikṛte paśāvāmnāyate 'agnaye chāgasya vapāyā medo'nu- brūhi' iti |
api cedamaparaṃ liṅgamīpomīye paśau śrūyate 'yadyekaṃ yūpamupaspṛśet, eṣa te vāyo iti brūyāta |
yadi dvau, eto te vāyu iti |

bahūniti, sarve ime mantrā ekarūpe bhaveyuḥ |
ubhayamapi mā prakṛtī bhūditi niyamaḥ kriyate |

śā-- mantrāṇāmidānīmūhyaścintyate ( prākṛtasyā- vaśiṣṭe mantroha evaidānīṃ cintyate ityarthaḥ ) |
' agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi ' iti ' brīhīṇāṃ medha sumanasyamānaḥ ' ityetau mantrau ki sauryādiṣu nīvārādiṣu ca uhitavyau, uta neti saṃśaye ' prakṛtau yāhaśo mantro'thakena hi tādṛśaḥ |
' prakṛtau yāhaśaṃ rūpaṃ mantrāṇāṃ hi vivakṣitam |

soma-- prathamapāde mantrohanamye eva avāntara- saṃgatilomena sāmīhopadodātaprasaktyā sopodghātaṃ sāmoha- vicāraṃ tatsaṃgatasaṃskārohavicāraṃ ca parisamāpya idānīṃ sa eva mantrohaḥ prastūyate ityanantaryam |
atra pāde (tṛtīye) tu prāyeṇa vacanohāśrityante, prakṛtyūhastu alpadāḥ |

sūtrārthastu- prakṛtau yathā utpattipadayuktatayā mantrā utpannāḥ tatpada- yuktaireva mantraiḥ arthānāmabhidhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tadvikāratvāt uttara- syāmapi tatau vikṛtatvāpi tathaiva abhipadayuktaireva abhi- dhānaṃ kartavyaṃ iti prāptaṃ pakṣaṃ caśabdena nirācaṣṭe |
athai akāryatvāt vaikṛte'rthe yathā''mnāta mantra- prakāśyatvātsambhāvāt iti |
vi-- ' agnīṣomādyo nohā ūhyā vā, nahi coda- nāt |
' ( ' indrāya mahasvate naivāramekādaśakapālam ' ityādau nīvāraviṣaye ūho draṣṭavyaḥ ) |

bhāṭṭa-- ' agnerahaṃ devayajyayā ' ' brīhīṇāṃ medha ' ityādimantreṣu samavetārthatvādityuktena agnīṣomādi- padānāṃ sauryādītyādi dvārā'ntarasaṃbandhanimittayābhāvā- tmakaḥ ūhaḥ siddha eva prokṣaṇādivat |
prakṛtau hi agnīṣomādipadena agnīṣomādīnāṃ lakṣaṇayaiva apūrvasādhanatvena rūpeṇa pratipādanāt sūrya- nīvārādīnāmapi tenaiva rūpeṇa prakāśanopapatteḥ |
ata eva ' pāśān ' iti bahuvacanānta- mantrasya prakṛtāviba ekaprāśikāyāṃ vikṛtāvāpi lakṣaṇayaiva ekatvaprakāśakatvāt nohaḥ |
nahi agnīṣomādipadaṃ śaktyā apūrvasādhanībhūtadravyadevatādiparam, api tu lakṣaṇayaiva ' śakyādanyena rūpeṇa jñāte bhavati lakṣaṇā ' iti nyāyāt |
viśeṣataśca śabdasya devatātvāt, tasya cāmipadena lakṣaṇayaiva pratīteḥ sūryasyaiva pratītisiddhau nohasiddhiḥ |
iti prāpte, satyāpi apūrvasādhanatvasya prakṛtau uddeśyatāvacchedakatve agnīṣomādipadena svaśakti- janyabodhadvārā apūrvasādhanībhūtadravyadevateti saṃskṛtāt ityartho'vagamyate |
ata eva śaklijanyabodho'pi brīhi- tyāgilādiprakāraka eva, na tu apūrvasādhanatvaprakārakaḥ |
liṅgakalpaśrutivākyena tadavacchinnasya uddeśyatve'pi mantrāntargatabrīhyādipade lakṣaṇayā pramāṇābhāvāt |
ata eva tādṛśabodhenāpi prokṣaṇajyādahavat viśeṣya eva dravyadevatādau saṃskāro janyate, na tu uddeśyatāvaccheda- dake'pi apūrvasādhanatve |
ataśca upakārakaprabhāvena dvārasya śaktijanyabodhasya vikṛtau atideśe tatprabhāvena prāpyamāṇasya anyādipadasya sauryādau dvāramidaṃyarthe padāntarakṣepo yukta eva |
ata eva agnīṣomādipadānāṃ aghavātādivat tathaiva rūpeṇa prakṛtau niruktakāryajana- katvena vidhāne'pi tatkāryābhāve iva tatkāryasya tena kartu- maśakyatve'pi yukta eva tasya vikṛtau lopaḥ |
kāryābhāve lopa eva, aśakyatve tu tajanakopāyāntarā'nuṣṭhānamiti |
yattu mkale prakṛtāveva nāvaghātasya tattvena vidheyatā, api tu apūrvasādhanatvāviśeṣopāyatvena, itarathā adṛṣṭā- rthatvāpatteḥ |

ataśca agnyādipadasya svarūpeṇa avivakṣita- tattvāt yukta eva padāntarakṣepa iti, tanna, tathātve prakṛtāveva brīhiparyāyāṇāṃ vidalanādeśa anuṣṭhāne vaiguṇyā- nāpatteḥ, yenaiva rūpeṇa mukhyakāryaṃ prati janakatā, tenaiva rūpeṇa niyamādṛṣṭaṃ pratyapi janakatvaucityācca |
yattu agni- padena śabdarūpadevatāprakāśanārthaṃ lakṣaṇavadyamabhāva iti,
satyāmapi lakṣaṇayāṃ yena śakyavācaka- tvasaṃbandhena prakṛtau śabdalakṣaṇā, na tenaiva saṃbandhena vikṛtau iti dvārabhedāt yuktaḥ padāntarakṣepaḥ |

vastu- tastu, śabdasya devatātve'pi apūrvīyadevatārūpaśabda- vācyatvasaṃbandhena arthasyāpi apūrvasādhanatvāt prakāśya- tvopapatteḥ na mantrāntargatasyādipade śabdalakṣaṇā, iti yukto brīhipade iva padāntarakṣepaḥ |
ata eva sarvaireva tatprāptau ' pūyati vā etadaho'kṣaraṃ yadena- mūhati, tasmādūhaṃ nohet ' iti ṛgkṣarohaparyadāso'pi saṃgacchate |
ata eva tatkāryaprakāśanāthaṃ tatprakāśana- samarthakamantrohaḥ eva kāryo vaidikatvasāmānyāt, tada- saṃbhave laukikavākyohaḥ |
tathā ' anvenaṃ mātā manya- tām ' ityādyagrigupte mātrādindyohe'pite'pi ' na mātā vardhate, na pitā ' ityādi rūpaḥ anyohaliṅgam |
nyāyaprāptatvāt ityukte mantrādhikaraṇakaustubhe, tathāpi nityānuvādaḥ evāyaṃ anya- ohaliṅgam |

na ca ūhasya nyāyasiddhatve vikṛtiviśeṣe ' viśeṣaṃ devānāmullāṇāṃ vapānāṃ medaso'nubrūhi ' ' chāgasya vapāyā medaso'nubrūhi ' ityādimantrapāṭhavaiyarthyam, tasya mantreṣaprāyaścittaprāptiphalakamantratvasiddhayarthatvāt |
' mantrakalpyaḥ pratiṣedho dvividhaḥ, mantragatasyaiva nañyuktavartamānapādeśasya niṣedhakalpanāt niṣedhayukta- vākyāntarakalpanācca |

bāla. pṛ. 143. mantragataṃ ākhyāta na vidhāyakam |
mantragataṃ liṅgaṃ prāptasya dyotakam, codanā- gataṃ prāpakam |
mantragataṃ yajate dadāti iti bhāvaśabdaḥ vidhāyakau na veti vicāre na vidhāyakaḥ, kintu abhidhānavācakaḥ |
mantragatāḥ api vidhā- yakāḥ kvacit dṛśyante ' vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate ' ityādayaḥ |
mantragatasyaiva nañ- yuktavartamānapādeśasya niṣedhakalpanāt mantrakalpyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
mantragatānāṃ brāhmaṇa- gatānāṃ cākhyātaśabdānāṃ yeṣāṃ vidhiśaktirupacchati teṣāmamidhāyakatvam |
mantragatārātyāstathaiva leṭkalpanāt mantrakalpyaḥ vidhiḥ yathā ' vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate ' iti |

yājyānuvākyādisaṃnipyopakāri- mantravyatiriktasya ārādupakāriṇaḥ stotrādeḥ kṛtsnasya mantrajātasya niṣphalatvānnajñātena jyotiṣṭomādyatvāva- sāyāt savanīyādyantarāt stotrādyapi prati ādhāratva- mātratvaṃ savanānām, na tu pradhānatā iti savanīyāditulyatā vaktuṃ śakyā |

mantratastu virodhe syāt prayogopasāmarthyāt tasmādupattideśaḥ saḥ ' ( 5|1|9|16 ) ityasminnadhikaraṇe mantrasya karmakāla.

prayojyatvāt rūpeṇābhidhānenaiva karmaprayoge anuṣṭhāne sāmarthyāt smārakatvāt smṛtikāryatvena cānuṣṭhānasya smṛtikrameṇa kramasya nyāyatvāt mantrabrāhmaṇapāṭhayoḥ virodhe mantrapāṭhakramānurodhena paścādvihitasyāpi āgneyasya prāganuṣṭhānaṃ ityukte, nanu brāhmaṇapāṭhasyāpi tadeva dṛṣṭamanu- ṣṭheyasmaraṇaṃ prayojanaṃ ityāśaṅkya 'utpattideśaḥ saḥ' iti iti sūtravayavena karmotpattimātrārthau brāhmaṇapāṭhaḥ iti vakṣyate |
'utpattideśaḥ saḥ' iti yat sūtrakṛt vakṣyati tat virodhe sati na tu avirodhe'pi |
su. pṛ. 667. ✱ mantratattva virodhe syāt prayogarūpasāma- rthyāt tasmādutpattideśaḥ saḥ |
hautrakāṇḍe āgneyayājān- vākye pūrvamāmnāte, agnīṣomīyayājyānuvākye paścā- dāmnāte, evaṃ ācāryakāṇḍe yājamānakāṇḍe ca |
evaṃ sati brāhmaṇapāṭho vā balīyān mantrapāṭho vā iti vicāre aniyama iti pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nirasya siddhāntāha |
brāhmaṇapāṭhamantrapāṭhayorvirodhe mantraḥ mantra- pāṭhānurodhena anuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
prayogarūpasāmarthyāt prayoge rūpasya mantrarūpasya sāma- rthyāt samavāyāt |
brāhmaṇaṃ tu vidhāya kṛtārthe sati prayoge na samavaiti |
tasmāt saḥ brāhmaṇapāṭhaḥ utpattideśaḥ prayogotpatteḥ deśaḥ pradeśo bhavati |
anuṣṭhāne mantraḥ saṃnikṛṣṭaḥ brāhmaṇaṃ tu viprakṛṣṭam |
tathā ca mantrānusāreṇa āgneyaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādagnīṣomīyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
vā. 2|1|6|31 pṛ. 432. ✱ mantratvaṃ ūhapravacanāmadheyānāmasti vā nāstīti vicāre nāstīti nirṇayaḥ |

vākye ghṛtameva ādhāratvena śrūyate, ('prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte carum' iti-) saptamīvibhaktisaṃyogāt caruśabdasāma- rthyācca |
yathā āditye (aditidevatāke caro) payaḥ adhikaraṇam, tathaihāpyavattivākye (saptamītvāt adhi- karaṇaṃ vratam |
tacca śrapaṇāvasthāyāmeva - arthaśrapaṇātparam- caruśabdasāmarthyāt) tasmāt guṇavākye ghṛtamanuvādaḥ ('tassāt pākāntaraṃ naitadapūrvavidhitaḥ ! pratiprasava- mātraṃ tu lāghavāddiṣṭaṃ param !!') |
śā-- mahāpitṛyajñe śrūyate 'somāya pitumate puro- ḍāśaṃ ṣaṭkapālaṃ nirvapati, pitṛbhyo barhiṣmadbhyo dhānāḥ, pitṛbhyo'miśrāttebhyo'miśrānyāye dugdhe manyatha' iti |
(prābhākaroktaṃ bhāṣyasamarthanaprakāramāha-) ye tvāhuḥ : 'na kramo nāma kaścit guṇaḥ padārthavyatirikta'sti, yasya pṛthakvaṃ vyavasthāpyamaḥ |
tena kevalasya kramasya bādhāsaṃbhavāt tadbhāve padārtho'pi bādhitaḥ, ityavaghāto na kartavyaḥ ityetcirā- karaṇārthaṃ idamadhikaraṇam |
yattu 'viparyayaso nāsti' iti tatrāpyāhuḥ - dhānāsu śrapaṇaṃ kṛtvā avaghātaḥ, prakṛtau ca viparītam, ityasti viparyāsaḥ |
yadi viparyāsaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi avaghātānuṣṭhānam, nahi kramasya pṛthakvaṃ saṃbhavati |
satyam, na tu atra paramārthataḥ kramabādhaḥ |
prakṛtau hi śruteṣveva vrīhiṣu avaghātaḥ kṛtaḥ, atrāpi śrutāstveva dhānāsu avaghātaḥ, iti nāsti kramaviparyayasaḥ |
prakṛtau avaghātāt paraṃ śrapaṇam, iha tu viparītamityetāvatā viparyāsavo- yuktiḥ |
nanu dhānāsvyāṃ hantiḥ kriyamāṇo vighātaṃ (dhānāsvasya) kuryāt, tathā na vighātau bhavati, tathā kurmahe, sakṛdeva anyastamavahananaṃ kriyate, na ca bhaviṣyati vighāta iti |
te eva hi padārthāḥ anyenānyena ca krageṇānuṣṭhātuṃ śakyante, tena kramasya prākṛtasyābhāve'pi padārthā na nivartante |
yattu 'śrapaṇaṃ kṛtvā avaghātaḥ' iti, tat 'pūrvaṃ hanti kṛtvā paścāt pākaḥ' iti bhāṣyāviruddham |
yadapi śrapaṇottarakāle'pi avaghāte viparyāso nāsti, śrute dravye
prakṛtau hi dve dravyaśravaṇe puroḍāśaśravaṇaṃ vrīhiśravaṇaṃ ca |
tatra dhānā devatāsaṃbandhāt puroḍāśakārye vartante, na vrīhikārye |
prakṛtau ca vrīhiviṣayaḥ avaghātaḥ, na puroḍāśaviṣayaḥ, tena dhānāsvapi codakaprāpte vrīhiviṣaye avaghātaḥ, na dhānāvāvyām |
tatra tu kriyamāṇe hantī kramaviparyāsaḥ syādeva |
vastu sakṛdeva avahananiyama iti, tathā sati atrākṛta- kāryamadṛṣṭārthamavahananaṃ syāt |
prakṛtivattu tupavimo- kāryoṣadhavataḥ kriyamāṇe dhānātvaṃ vihanyeta |
sūtrārthastu- arthāt kramaviparyāsai hanterdhanāyārthatvāt tattvaṃ avihataṃ dhānātvameva syāt iti bhāṣyakārapakṣe |
vārtikakārapakṣe tu tattvaṃ peṣaṇasya prākṛtameva syāt havirvaratvāt iti |
vārtikamate tu- 'peṣaṇaṃ nūtanaṃ manye prākṛtaṃ vā, kramānta- rāt |

' bhā-- 'pitṛbhyo barhiṣmadbhyo dhānāḥ : pitṛbhyo'mi- byāttebhyo'bhivānyāye dugdhe manyatha' ityādinā vihite dhānādravyake yāge dhānāvāvyāṃ bharjanottaramavaghātaḥ kartavyo na veti bhāṣyakāreṇa vicāritaḥ |
tasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ, codakena pākāt pūrvameva yathāvatsyāt avaghātavidhānāt bharjanottaraṃ tatprāpteḥ, taduttaramavaghātakaraṇe ca dhānātvaghā- tāpātteḥ : na bharjanottaramavaghātaḥ kāryaḥ |

iti prāpte, loke pūrve kiñcidvedhatānāṃ yavānāṃ bharjanottaraṃ punaravaghāte kṛte eva dhānātvasiddhiḥ prayojanānusāreṇa prākṛtakramaṃ bādhi- tvā'pi 'guṇalope ca mukhyasya' iti nyāyena (10|2| 27|64) bharjanottaramapi prākṛtaḥ sadharmako'vaghātaḥ kartavya eva |
na ca dhānātvavyāghātaḥ, dṛḍhataramusalaprahārā- karaṇena tadanāpatteḥ |
prakṛtau hi haviḥsaṃpādakatvaitadupyartha- mavaghāto yathā haviḥ saṃpadyate tathā kāryaḥ |
eva tadanurodhena bharjanāt pūrvamapi yatkiñcidvaituṣya- saṃpattyarthamavaghātaḥ sadharmakaḥ kārya eva, anyathā lokaprasiddhadhānātvāniṣṭatteḥ |
ata eva āvṛttirapi tadanurodhena na duṣyati |
evaṃvidhaṃ bhāṣyābhiprāyajānataḥ pārthasāratheḥ tadbhūṣaṇāya prayāsa upekṣaṇīya eva |
vārtikakārasya tu na dvivāra- mavahatānāmeva dhānātvam, pūrvameva samyagvituṣīkṛtānāṃ yavānāṃ bharjanaṃ kṛte dhānātvāvyāhateḥ |
ato yathāprakṛtye- vāvaghātasya bharjanāt pūrvamevānuṣṭhānopapatteḥ nātra dhānā udāharaṇamapi tu manyaḥ |
prakṛte ca abhivānyā mṛtavatasā goḥ, tasyā dugdhaṃ vivakṣitam |
tatra bharjitayavataṇḍulānāṃ piṣṭe eva saktu- tvaprasiddherbharjanottarameva peṣaṇaṃ prākṛtakramabādhe'pi haviḥ- saṃpattyarthaṃ peṣaṇasya guṇalopādhikaraṇanyāyenaiva bharjanottaraṃ karaṇopapatteḥ |
na ca kramānyatve padārthānāmanālambam, vyutkrame'pi tādṛśapratyabhijñāyā avaghātāt |
na ca prakṛtau peṣaṇasya pākārthatvam, yeneha bharjanottaraṃ pākā- bhāvāt peṣaṇabhāvaḥ śaṅkyeta |
satyapi puroḍāśapākaṃ prati tatpoṣakatvakte pākapeṣaṇayordvayopi dvitīyayā dravya- saṃskārārthatvāt |
atastathaiva yathaikatra haviḥsaṃpattyarthameva peṣaṇaṃ pākāt pūrvamanuṣṭhitam, tathaiveha saktusaṃpattyarthaṃ pākottaramanuṣṭhāne'pi na kaścidvirodhaḥ |
ata eva prakṛtau peṣaṇapākayoḥ pāṭho'pyanuvāda eva |
ava- ghātastu bhāṣyavārtikāramatayoḥ pūrvoktarītyā manye'pi bharjanottaraṃ pūrvameva vā kāryaḥ |
paripāve tu na nirvāpaprokṣaṇādi, nāvaghātaḥ na vā peṣaṇamityuktameva |
bhā. 10|2|12|4-4. mahāpitṛyajñe, pātraviśeṣapātho- bhāgasruvena parimite vastrahitāyā dhenvā dugdhe piṣṭaṃ prakṣipya manyaḥ kriyate |
vi. 3|4|7. mahāpitṛyajñe manye peṣaṇasya na bādhaḥ |
mahāpitṛyajñe manye bharjanādupattaraṃ sadharmakaṃ peṣaṇādi kartavyam |
ṭup. 10|2|13|474. mahāpitṛyajñe 'ye puroḍāśo dharmāḥ' ityatra vidhiranuvādo veti saṃśayaḥ, anuvāda iti siddhāntaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 9. mahāprakaraṇaṃ pratyakṣaṃ parikalpitāvāntaraprakaraṇāt prabalam |
tena abhiṣekanīyeprakaraṇāt rājasūyaprakaraṇasya prābalyāt 'akṣairdivyati' ityādīnāṃ rājasūyāṅgatvameva |
vāla. pṛ. 9. mahāprakaraṇattu avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ prabalaṃ tena abhikramaṇādeḥ na darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatvam, kintu prayājāṅgatvam |
kau. 3|3|14|4 pṛ. 363. mahāprakaraṇatvāt avāntaraprakaraṇasya balīyastvaṃ abhikramādhi- karaṇe (3|1|10) vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 911. mahāprakaraṇattu balīyasi viniyojakāni yogatvaṃ avāntara- prakaraṇaṃ ekavākyatvaṃ ceti |
vā. 3|4|14|24. mahāprayogavidhiḥ puruṣārthaḥ yathā 'same darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
nimittānāṃ kartavyā ityupapāditā, sā mahābhāṣyakāreṇa na kartavyā iti upavarṣe mahābhāṣyakāra-śabdaprayogaḥ |
mahābhūmiḥ gopadha-rājamārga-jalādyādisahitā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ sādhāraṇaṃ svaṃ iti sārvabhaumo'pi mahābhūmi sarvasdāne dātuṃ na śaknoti viśvajidādau |
yathā mahāmatsyastīraṃ saṃcaran tīrādviṣa eva, na tvibhyo nāpi tena tīrena lipyate, evaṃ ādhyātmikasambandhena dehātmā jāgradādau saṃcaran tasmādbhinna eva, nāpi jāgradādirūpadharmavān vā |
tathā ca śrutiḥ 'mahāmatsya ume kūle saṃcarati, pūrvaṃ cāparaṃ caivamayaṃ puruṣa etān saṃcarati, svapnāntaṃ buddhāntaṃ ca' iti |
'mahāyajñaiśca yajñaiśca brāhmīṃ kriyate tanuḥ' iti manuḥ 2|28 |
na ca mahāvākye sati avāntaravākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavati, padāntarasya vādhanāt, yathā 'noccantamādityamīkṣeta' iti pratiṣedho gamyate mahāvākyāt, avāntaravākyāt īkṣaṇavidhānam |
mahāvākyeṣu yadyapi avāntaravākyāni pramāṇaṃ tathāpi arthāsaṃbhavāt avivakṣite mahāvākye avāntaravākyāśrayaṇam |
mahāvīrasya (mṛnmayapātraviśeṣasya) jyotiṣṭome pravargyāṅgabhūtasya bhedane 'taṃ bhinnamabhimarot yaddhate cidamibhiyaḥ' iti sāmavedavihitasya uccaistvam |
mahāvedyāṃ mantrapūrvakaṃ pravarta havirdhāna-maṇḍape havirdhānālye śakaṭe bhavataḥ |
mahāvrate upagātrīṇāṃ patnīnāṃ atithiṣṭeḥ upagātṛbhiḥ ṛtvigbhiḥ samuccayaḥ, tāthyena ahastasya samuccayaḥ; upadiṣṭaślokādisānnāṃ atithiṣṭegāyatrādi-sāmnāṃ ca samuccayaḥ |
mahāvrate gavāmayanasate upagānakartṛbhiḥ patnībhiḥ ātideśikasāmānupagānakartṛṇāmapi na bādhaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- mahāvrate śrūyate 'tāppyaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte, darbhamayaṃ patnī' iti |
asti tu prakṛtau 'ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhatte' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimahatasya vāsaso nivṛttiḥ, neti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ācchādane tu prākṛtasya vikāraḥ syāt |
kaupīna-mācchādayituṃ prakṛtau klṛptaṃ ca pracchadanaṃ kriyate |
nivartakaṃ bhavati, yadanivartyaṃ na śaknoti niveṣṭum |
nanu kaupīna-pracchādane paridhatte iti bhavati, nānyakāryake |
upavāsaso'pi kārye paridhatte iti bhavati, tadyathā kambalaṃ paridhatte, rauravaṃ paridhatte iti |
tasmādahatasya vāsaso na nivṛttiḥ, samuccayaḥ iti |
bhāṣyam-- samuccayaṃ ca vāsaḥśabdena bahutvavāntena dṛśyate 'vāsāṃsi cārāhī copānahau vimuñcati' iti |
kṛṣṇaviṣāṇā vāsāṃsi vilaṃsayati, tato'dhryuḥ pari-dhatte iti |
tathā ca śāstradīpikāyāṃ vistarādiṣu ca 'tāyeṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte' iti pāṭhaḥ |
bhāṭṭadīpikāyāṃ śambhubhaṭṭena 'tāppyamiti parvagīyaḥ' iti spaṣṭameva uktatvāt |
bhāṭṭa-- svatantre mahāvrate 'tāppyaṃ yajamānaḥ pari-dhatte darbhamayaṃ patnī' iti śrutam |

aprāpi paridhānodeśena tāppyādi-vidhau patnyādiparidhāne'pi tadāpatteḥ yajamānodeśena tadvidhau śayanādāvapi tadāpatterasya tāppyādiviśiṣṭaṃ paridhānameva yajamānādyudeśena vidhīyate, tacca prākṛtamevā-videṣataḥ |
tasya ca prākṛtakāryārthatvenaiva vidhānāt prākṛtasya ahatasya nivṛttiḥ |

na ca prakṛtatvahatasya kaupīnapada-vācyamaglācchādane viniyuktatvāt tatra ca tāppyā-dīnāmayogyatvāt yogyataivopaparidhāna eva tadvideśa- pratīteḥ abhinakāryatvena nāhatanivṛttiriti vācyam, kaupīnācchādane eva paridhātiprayogeṇaparidhāraṇe tāppyādidhāne lakṣaṇapatteḥ |

vastutastu - anyācchā-dane'pi 'paristṛṇīta paridhatta vedim' ityādī pari-dadhātiprayogatvāt yadyapi na kaupīnācchādane eva tadvi-dhānam, tathāpi prakṛtāvāpi 'ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhatte' ityanena kaupīnācchādana iva ācāraprātoparibhāgā-cchādane'pyahatavidhānatvāditāvāpi tāppyādirumayaiva vidhā-nādubhayatraivāhatanivṛttiḥ |
iti prāpte, kaupīnācchādane gṛhasthasya kacchādisaṃbhavena tāppyādīnāmapyupari-dhāraṇa eva tāppyādividhipratīterna kaupīnācchādane ahata-nivṛttiḥ |
ata eva nyāyena ācāraprātoparidhāraṇa eva prākṛtāhatanivṛttiprasaktau 'vāsāṃsi vibhraṃśyati' iti pratipattiviśeṣavākye vāsatvabahutvādvākyena samuccayapratīterna tatrāpyahatanivṛttiḥ |
evaṃ ca yadyapi tāppyaṃ kaupīnācchādane'pi kathañcidyogyam, tathāpi vāso-bahutvānuvādatvena tasyāhata samuccayaḥ |
dharmamayasya tu kathampayogyātve'pi paridhāraṇa eva vidhipratītervāsobahu-tvānuvādena tatrāpi samuccayaḥ |

ata eva yatra na vāsobahu-tvānuvādaḥ yathā 'viśvajiti 'avabhṛtādyavastatvaṃ paridhatte' iti śrute tatraivāhatasya : kaupīnācchādane-'yogyatvāt tatrāhatasyātideśaprāptasyāpi nivṛttāvapi upari-dhāraṇe tannivṛttiḥ |
' mahāvrate 'dikṣu dundubhayo nadanti' iti dundubhi-gānam, tatsajātīyaṃ ca kāṇḍavīṇādigānam |
mahāvrate patantya upagāyanti, piccholābhiḥ, kāṇḍavīṇādibhiḥ, āpātalikābhiḥ |
oṃ mahāvrate stotrāntarasādhanībhūtaiḥ ślokādi- sāmabhiḥ prākṛtasāmnāṃ samuccayaḥ ||
bhāṣyam-- mahāvrate śrūyate 'ślokena purastātsadasaḥ stuvate, anuślokena paścātsadasaḥ, kaukṣnena cātvālmave- śyamānaḥ' iti |
santi tu prākṛtāni sāmāniha codakena prāptāni |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ prākṛtānāṃ sāmnāṃ nivṛttiḥ, utānivṛttiḥ samuccaya iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? stuvate iti prakṛtiliṅgasaṃyoge pratyakṣaśrute codakaprāptāni sāmāni nivartyante iti |

yathā 'kautsaṃ bhavati, kāṇvaṃ bhavati, vasiṣṭhasya janitraṃ bhavataḥ, śuddhāśudīye bhavataḥ, bhargyadakṣī bhavataḥ, kaukṣmāni bhavanti' iti śruteṣu codakaprāptāni niva- rtyante, evamihāpi draṣṭavyam |
sāmasu 'ślokena purastātstuvate' ityevamādiśruyamāṇeṣu prākṛtā- nāmavikāraḥ pratīyeta |
arthā- ntareṇa hi saṃbandhaḥ śrūyate 'purastātsadasaḥ stuvate' ityevamādi |
yacca padaṃ kenacit padena saṃbadhyate viśe- paṇatvena, na tat padāntarena saha saṃbandhamarhati saṅkucira- tam |
yathā 'bhāryā rājñaḥ, puruṣo devadattasya' iti bhāryāviśeṣaṇatvenonoccāryamāṇo rājñaḥ iti śabdo na punaḥ puruṣaśabdena saṃbadhyate iti |
evaṃ 'purastātsadasaḥ stuvate' ityanena saṃbadhyamāno na punaḥ 'ślokena stuvate' iti saṃbandhamarhati |
yadi stutau deśasattā vidhīyate, ślokena cetyucyeta, tata upapadyataikaṃ vākyamiti |
yadā tu punardeśasattā vihitā, tadā paripūrṇaṃ vākyam, ślokena cetyetadapi vidhātavyam, tadā punarvidhiprasaṅgo hṛdayamānetavyaḥ |
tasmādanuccārito vā kalpayitavyaḥ, uccāraṇaṃ vā kalpayitavyam |
kathaṃ tarhi ? deśasāmaviśiṣṭā stutiḥ śrutyā vidhīyate |
na caikena kenacit saṃbandhe vihite, paripūrṇaṃ vākye, punaraparaṃ vākyaṃ kalpayitavyaṃ bhavati |
ubhayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭā hi stutiḥ śrutyā yadā vihitā, tadā paripūrṇaṃ vākyam, na tadā punarapareṇa kenacit saṃbandhaḥ kalpayitavyo bhavati, yadarthaṃ kiñcit dihyate |
tasmāt stutyantaramidaṃ vidhīyate, na prākṛtaṃ nivartyate, samuccaya iti |
arthe tvaśrūyamāṇe śeṣatvāt prākṛtasya vikāraḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- atha yadupavarṇitam, yathā 'kautsaṃ bhavati, kāṇvaṃ bhavati, vasiṣṭhasya janitraṃ bhavataḥ' ityeva- mādibhiriva prākṛtānāṃ nivṛttiriti, tatparihartavyam |
atra arthāntaraṃ na śrūyate, prākṛtasyaiva śeṣaḥ śrūyate |
sūtre-- arthāntaraśruteḥ prākṛtastutyapekṣayā stutyantarasaṃyogaśruteḥ prākṛtasāmnāmabādhaḥ ityarthaḥ |

9. bhāṭṭa-- tatraiva 'ślokena purastāt sadasaḥ stuvīta-' ityādinā prākṛtastotrānuvādena ślokākhyasāmamātravidhe- rdeśākhyaguṇāntarasyāpi vidheyatvānupapatteḥ, vākyabhedāpādaka- guṇādeḥ karmāntaratvapratīteḥ, tasya ca upahomanyāyena (5|1|9) adṛṣṭārthatvāt samuccayaḥ : stotrāntaraiḥ |
na ca prākṛtastotrasyaiva atideśataḥ pūrvapravṛttayaikāreṇa guṇadvaya- viśiṣṭāni vidhīyante tena prākṛtasāmnaḥ prākṛtadeśasya ca nivṛttiriti vācyam |
stutidhātoḥ pūrvavihitāvihita- sādhāraṇastotramātratvenātideśataḥ pūrvaṃ prākṛtastotrāṇā- meva viśiṣṭopyāpakābhāvena vidhivaśāt karmāntaratva- pratīteḥ |
gṛhamedhīye 'ājyabhāgau yajati' ityatra tu ājyabhāgapadameva pūrvakarmaṇo viśiṣṭopyāpaka miti viśeṣaḥ |
10. mahāvratagataṃ dharmaṃ saṃvatsarasatre darśayati 'patnya upagāyanti' iti |
mahāvrataprayogapratipādakaṃ āśvalāyananirmitaṃ kalpa- sūtraṃ araṇye'dhīyānā bahucaḥ karturvismaraṇān vedatvena vyavaharanti |
mahīṣī prasavonmukhī mahiṣo madanātura iti nyāyaḥ |
yatra kecit mahāmūrkhā mṛtamlecchādyadhama- jātisthānāni svaskuladevatāni svābhilapitapadāni ca matvā mlecchādyadhamajātinīcayoniprāpyā atiduḥklite- 'pyapi svāmī yācante, tatastasya pratiriti |
tathāhi, taṃ mārīcaṃ prāpya mīrukaṃ daśānanaḥ prāgudājahāra 'sītāmīhe hartumatra me raṇe sahāyo bhavārthakāra |
kuttā rove darda deha kī mīyā~ kahe tuma calo śikāra |
ityatra puroḍāśānādareṇa savanīyamātre māṃsavidhiḥ vadhyate śākyānāmane |
