dvādaśāha ‘anyā tvā pātreṇa samudrasasya prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti prājāpatyaṃ mano'grahaṃ iti śrūyate |
idaṃ mānasaṃ karma mānaso grahaḥ dvādaśāhat ahantaraṃ bhinnaṃ ahaḥ syāt |
‘vāg vai dvādaśāho mano mānasam’ iti dvādaśāhat mānasasya bhedena vyapadeśāt |
kiñca ‘vāg vai dvādaśāhaḥ’ iti vācā dvādaśāhaḥ saṃstutaḥ ; ‘mano mānasam’ iti ca manasā mānasaṃ saṃstutam |
vāṅamanasayorbhedaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tena dvādaśāhamānasayorapi bhedo gamyate |
tasmāt dvādaśāhat mānasaṃ bhinnamahaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tena ca mānasena dvādaśāhasya saṃstavāt dvādaśāhat mānasaṃ ahantaraṃ iti gamyate |
‘vidhūtāni ha vai dvāda- śāhasya gatasani chandāṃsi, tāni mānasena āpyāya- yanti’ |
dvādaśāhasya yāni gatasani chandāṃsi tāni mānasena āpyāyayanti iti bruvan dvādaśāhat mānasaṃ bhinnaṃ darśayati |
tasmāt dvādaśāhat mānasaṃ ahantaraṃ iti pūrvapakṣe hetvantaramuktam |
prājāpatyaṃ mānaso grahaḥ dvādaśāhamapi dvādaśāhadahantaraṃ āha |
‘patnīḥ saṃyājya prājña udetya mānasāya prasarpanti’ iti patnīsaṃyājāt param ahantaraṃ paraṇa- stāt mānasasya codanā bhavati |
dvādaśāhasyaiva guṇatve tu patnī- saṃyājebhyaḥ prāk syāt |
prājāpatyaṃ mānaso grahaḥ dvādaśāhamapi san dvāda- śāhat ahantaraṃ iti pūrvapakṣeṇa ukte siddhāntitaḥ śaṅkā |
nanu evaṃ trayodaśa ahuḥ dvādaśāha iti saṃjñā nopapadyate |
pakṣe trayodaśāhatvapade- 'pi saṃkhyā saṃkhyāviśeṣavācakapadaghaṭito dvādaśāhaśabdaḥ karmaṇāmadheyatvāt upapadyate |
yathā atirātraḥ sahasramāni ‘atirātreṇa sahasrādhyena yajeta’ iti sahasrādhike'pi sahasraśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ |
tasmāt mānasaṃ dvādaśāhat ahantaraṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
mānaso grahaḥ dvādaśāhamapi dvādaśāhadahantaraṃ iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhāntayati |
mānaso grahaḥ ahardvagaṃ daśamasya ahaḥ syāt na anyadahaḥ |
‘anyā tvā pātreṇa samudrasasya prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi iti prājāpatyaṃ mano'grahaṃ’ iti daśamahargrahakīyā eṣā |
aṅguvat, yathā aśvadāmī vidhīyamānau yasmin karmaṇi bhavataḥ |
tattrāpī grahamāsyau iti vijñāyate na karmāntare tadvat |
‘eṣa vai daśamasyāho visargo yanmānasam’ eṣa daśamasya visargaḥ |
antaḥ yanmānasaṃ iti bruvan anto'yaṃ daśamasya na svatantra- metat karma iti daśamasya ahaḥ visargasya vacanaṃ darśayati |

‘daśame'hani mānasāya prasarpanti’, ‘daśame'hani sārparājñīmṛgbhiḥ stuvanti’ iti daśame ahani iti tadguṇaśāstrāt tasya daśamasyāhaḥ guṇasya śāstrāt mānaso grahaḥ daśamasyāho'ṅgaṃ nāhantaraṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- dvādaśāha iti dvādaśasaṃkhyāyāḥ sāmañjasyācca mānaso grahaḥ daśamasyāho'ṅgaṃ iti |
mānasasya aharantaratve tu trayodaśa dvādaśāha iti saṃkhyāvacanaṃ asamañjasaṃ syāt |
bhāṣyam-- dvādaśāhaikādaśinebhyaḥ paśubhyaḥ ahaḥ atireke ādhikye sati ekasya ahaḥ adhikasya bhāvāt, dvayo- rahorabhāvāt mānasaṃ na aharantaraṃ iti vijñāyate |
ahar tatpakṣe trayo- daśatvāt paśūnāṃ caikādaśatvāt |
'yaḥ paśuratiricyate sa aindrāgnaḥ kāryaḥ' iti ekādaśinīṃ dvādaśāha vidhāya vidyatāṃ tasyāṃ ekādaśatirekaṃ darśayati |
ekasyātirekaṃ bruvan dvādaśa etānya- hāni iti gamayati |
tasmāt mānasaṃ daśamāṅgaṃ na karmā- ntaramiti siddhāntaḥ |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣaṇā 'mānasasaharantaraṃ medena vyapa- deśāt' (10|6|13|4) iti 'tena ca mānasena dvādaśāhasya saṃstavāt bhedaḥ' (10|6|13|5) iti ca, tatrottaramāha siddhāntī |
aṅgena samudāyasya stuteryapa- deśaṃ avipratiṣiddhaṃ manyāmaha |
antarvedi mithunau saṃbhavataḥ; tenaiva mithunān yanti' iti samudāyasyopamamihādha tadvayava- bhūtasya mahāvratasya dharmeṇa anujighṛkṣan samudāyasya a- yavadharmeṇa stutiṃ darśayati |
loke'pi 'dīrghaḥ keśaḥ śobhano devadattaḥ' iti avayavadharmeṇa avayavī saṃstūyate |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣaṇā 'aharantācca pareṇa codanā' (10|6|13|6) iti, tatrā'ha siddhāntī |
'patnīḥ saṃyājyā prājña udetya mānasāya prasarpanti' iti vacanāt daśamasyāhaḥ adantatvāt tadantatvābhāvaḥ patnīsaṃyājānta- tvābhāvaḥ |
dvādaśāhikānāmahāṃ sāmānyena patnīsaṃyājā- ntā, viśeṣeṇa tu daśamasyāho mānasāntā ucyate |
tasmāt mānasaṃ daśamasyāho'ṅgaṃ na dvādaśāhadaharantaraṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
tatra 'dvādaśāhasya itarasāni chandāṃsi, tāni mānasenā''- pyāyanti' iti mānasena dvādaśāhastutiḥ |
'eṣa vai daśamasyāho visargo yanmānasam' iti visargoktiḥ |
bhāṣyam-- dvādaśāhe śrūyate 'anayā tvā pātreṇa samudrasya prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmīti prājāpatyaṃ manomahaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ mānasamadvādaśāhada- rantaraṃ uta ahardvayamiti |
tāni nirācikīrṣan ācārya upanyasyati 'mānasasaharantaraṃ syāt' iti |
katham ? 'vāgvai dvādaśāho mano mānasam' iti dvādaśāhāntaraṃ mānasaṃ vyapadiśati, 'vāgvai dvādaśāhaḥ' iti vāksaṃstavāt, 'mano mānasam' iti ca manaḥ saṃstavāt |
yathā vākya- bhedo'yaṃ vastuto''vagamyate evametadapi dvādaśāha- mānasayoḥ |
ataḥ pṛthakve sati medena vyapadeśo bhavati, nānyathā |
katham ? 'vidhṛtāni ha vai dvādaśāhasya gatarasāni chandāṃsi, tāni mānasenā''- pyāyanti' iti |
dvādaśāhasya yāni gatarasāni chandāṃsi tāni mānasenā''pyāyanti iti bruvan bhinnaṃ dvādaśāhad darśayati |
na hi tenaiva ātmanā tasya saṃstutirbhavati |
tadvadihāpi dvāda- śāho mānasena stūyate iti saṃstavādbhedo'bhimyate iti |
kutaḥ ? dvādaśāhikādaharantātpareṇa codyate 'patnīḥ saṃyājyā prājña udetya mānasāya prasarpanti' iti |
tadyadi dvādaśāhika- syāho guṇavidhirbhaved dvādaśāhikī patnīsaṃyājāntā syāt |
atha aharantaraṃ bhavati, tato dvādaśāhikānāmayaṃ dharmo nānyasyeti na doṣo bhaviṣyati |
kimidaṃ pari- codanā ? nanvevaṃ dvādaśāhaḥ iti trayodaśahaḥ su nopa- padyate |
yadā pramāṇāntareṇa śabdaḥ etā- vatyarthe prayukta iti gamyate, tadā saṃkhyāsaṃnikarṣāt trayo- daśasu guṇatvayā prayogaḥ setsyati |
yathā 'atirātraḥ sahasramāni', 'atirātreṇa sahasrasādhyena yajeta' iti adhike'pi sahasre sahasraśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ, tadvadihāpyadhike bhaviṣyati |
yāvanti karmāṇītyuktya prayuktastattvāt vācaka iti niścīyate |
sarvāṇi prakaraṇādīkṛtya prayogāt sarveṣāṃ vācako bhaviṣyati na doṣaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- daśamasyāho guṇasya vidhiḥ syāt, nāharantaracodanā |
katham ? evaṃ tāvat śrūyate 'anayā tvā pātreṇa samudrasya prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmīti prājāpatyaṃ manomahaṃ gṛhṇāmīti' iti |
'yaistu dravyaṃ vikīryate guṇastatra' (2|1| 318) karma na pradhānamiti |
yathā aṃśadvayamī vidhīya- māno na karma bhinnaḥ |
yasmin karmaṇi bhavatastatrāparau grahābhyāsāviti vijñāyate, na karmāttare iti |
evamalītyeva aṣṭānumānaprasaṅkalpanā bhaviṣyati, prakṛtasaṃnyacca, nāprakṛtamakriyā kriyāntaram |
daśamavisargavacanaṃ hi bhavati 'eṣa vai daśamasyāho visargo yanmānasam' iti |
eṣa daśamasya visargaḥ, antaḥ mānasamiti bruvan anto''yama- ntavato daśamasya, na svatantrametat darśayati |
katham ? evaṃ guṇaśāstraṃ yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati 'daśame'hani mānasāya prasarpanti' iti, 'daśame'hani sārparājñīmaṃṅgibhiḥ stuvanti' iti |
daśamasyāhaḥ pradhānabhāvena nirdeśāt, grahasya ādheya- bhāvena, tattvo'sya guṇo'yaṃ daśamasya, nārthāntaramiti gamyate |
bhāṣyam-- yadi ca guṇo'yam, evaṃ saṃkhyā sama- ñjasā bhaviṣyati dvādaśāha iti |
itarathā trayodaśasu dvāda- śāha ityasamañjasaṃ saṃkhyāvacanaṃ syāt |
kutaḥ ? tatra hi pramāṇāntareṇa saṃkhyaivāvagamyādhike sahasraśabdo gauṇyā vṛttyā prayukta iti niścīyate |
na tviha saṃkhyātirikte pramāṇamasti, yena gauṇyaṃ vṛttirāśrī- yeta |
tadapi grahasaṃskāravidhānādgrahame'hani yāgābhyāsaṃ vidhatte, na karmāntaramiti samadhigamyata |
evaṃ cet, naitapratyakṣa- vacanamahantaraprakalpakam, nānyatpramāṇāntaraṃ prāpakam, yena saṃlyeye'tirikte dravyaprayoga ityavasyama |
yadapi karmagaṇa- nāmadheyatvāt prakaraṇavaśena tāvatāmaṅgīkaraṇāt nāmadheya- rūpeṇa vā vṛttirbhaviṣyatīti |
dvādaśa etāni karmāpyahobhiḥ parimitānyekatra samāhṛtānyanena rūpeṇa tatkarmagaṇasya nāmadheyam, na varṇānupūrvyāmeti |
tathā hi 'sarveṣveva karmanāmedhyeyasambandheyanāvāda- bhūto nāmaśabdo vartate, na laukikārthatiraskāreṇa pari- bhāṣāmātreṇa buddhiguṇavat |
yathā agnihotraṃ śyenaḥ jyoti- ṣṭomaḥ iti |
katham ? 'yaḥ paśutirityete sa aindrāmaḥ kāryaḥ' iti ekā- darśini dvādaśāha vidhāya viddhatāyāmekatirekaṃ darśa- yati |
yadi trayodaśāhāni syuḥ dvayorabhāvaḥ syāt, naikasyeti |
bhāṣyam-- asmin sūtre dvayoḥ sūtrayoḥ parihāra ucyate |
antarvaidi mithunaṃ saṃbhavastatenaiva mithunānna yanti' iti samudāyopamabhidhāya tadavayavabhūtasya mahāvratasya dharmagaṇu- jighṛkṣan samudāyasyavayavadharmeṇa saṃstūyate eveti |
yathā dīrghaḥ keśaḥ śobhano devadatta iti |
tadadihāpi dvādaśāhaḥ saṃsthā- viṣyata iti na doṣaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- yaduktam, yadyahantarametat, evaṃ dvāda- śāhadharmadhaillakṣaṇyaṃ mānasasattā yuktā bhaviṣyati, na tada- ṅgatve |
viśeṣeṇa tu daśamasyāho mānasasāntatocyate 'patnīḥ saṃyājya prājña udetya mānasaya prasarpanti' iti |
soma-- madhvaśanasya satradvādaśāhadve'pi māna- sasya na dvādaśāhatvamityanyatā saṃgatiḥ |
prayo- janam-- vikṛtiṣu daśarātraprabhṛtau mānasasyāpravṛttiḥ pūrva- pakṣe |
' bhāṭṭa-- dvādaśāhike daśame'hani 'prājāpatyaṃ mānasaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti śrutam |

uta daśamasuyājñatvena grahaṇāntaramācavidhiḥ iti cintāyām, 'vānnai dvādaśāho mano mānasam' iti bhedyavyapadeśāt 'vidhṛtāni vai dvādaśāhasya gatarasāni chandāṃsi tāni mānasainā''pyāyayanti' iti māna- sena dvādaśāhasthāpyāyanavacanena medānumānādaharantaravidhiṃ manyante |
grahaṇavidhāyakasyāsya yāgāntaravidhāyakatve pramāṇābhāvāt dvādaśāhapadasya rūḍhatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvācca tatraiva grahaṇāntaravidhiḥ |
ata eva daśame'hani 'mānasaya prasarpanti eva vai daśamasyāho visargo yanmānasam' ityā- diliṅgāñyapapadyante |
kiñca viddhatāṃ paśvekādaśinīṃ vidhāya 'atha yaḥ paśuratirecyate sa aindrāmaḥ kāryaḥ' ityekasyaiva paśuratirekaṃ darśayati na dvayoḥ |
saṃyājya mānasaya prasarpanti' iti mānasasya tadbahirbhā- vagatiḥ, sā patnīsaṃyājāntasya sāmānyavihitatvāt dadmāhravyatiriktaviṣayatvopapatternirastā |
ato vikṛtiṣu daśarātre pravartamāne daśamāhatvena mānasagrahasyāpi pravṛttiḥ, aharantaratve bāgha ityadhyāyasaṃgatiḥ |
6|8|1|13, mānva- rṇikī devatā ādhāre 'indra ūrdhvo'dhvara ityādhāra- māghārayati' iti |
mānvarṇikadevatākalpanā ādhārādiṣu kriyā- tmakatvāt mantrākāṅkṣāyāṃ vacanaviniyogavaśācca bhavati |
vā. 2|2|13 pṛ. 479. mānvarṇikadravyakalpanāyāṃ api gauravam, 'udbhidā yajeta' ityādau |
vā. 1|4|1|12. mānyānāṃ viprādīnāmanimantraṇe bhojanādyarthā- gamanaṃ na bhavati |
snehātiśayena tu pūjyānāṃ anima- ntritānāmapi svayameva bhoktumāgamanaṃ dṛṣṭam |
vi. 10|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3. māyāvādī nāmarūpaprapañca asadvācaṃ prati- jānīte |
ratnākaraḥ pṛ. 365. māyikā guṇā vāstavaṃ nirguṇatvaṃ na vighnantīti nyāyaḥ |
yathā satyakāmādiguṇā apāṇi- pāda iti prakṛtinirguṇatvamīśvarasya na nivārayantīti bhāvaḥ |
sāhasī. 141. mārutaḥ kalamāpaḥ 'ekādaśineṣu aṣṭamaḥ paśuḥ aśvamedhe jyotiṣṭome ca |
bhā. 9|1|2|15|63, mārutī meṣī dakṣiṇavihāre havistadarthe varuṇapradhāseṣu abhimanthanādeḥ punarvidhiḥ cāturmāsyeṣu |
7|1|1|29, mārutī sākṣā dakṣiṇe vihāre kartavyā varuṇapradhāseṣu |
9|1|2|139, mārutīmeva dakṣiṇavihāre āsādayati iti lakṣaṇayā yāgacodanā bhavati |
1|1|2|139. mārutī- meva (āmiṣkāṃ) pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasmin vihāre āsādayati varuṇapradhāseṣu, tatra pṛthagjñānuṣṭhānam |
1|1|2|136-43. 'mārutī pṛśnim' iti rājasūye paśuḥ pṛthakḥ alpatanuḥ |
vi. 4|4|10. mārutāḥ bhede prayājādīnāṃ bhedena kriyā varuṇapradhāseṣu |
vāla. pṛ. 120. mārutyarthaṃ dakṣiṇavihāre pṛthagjñānuṣṭhānaṃ cātu- rmāsyeṣu varuṇapradhāseṣu |
tāmradhanā pāṣāṇena hantumīhate yate iti bhāvaḥ |
sāhasī. 737. mālyaṃ kasya vicitrapuṣpacitaṃ prītyai na saṃjñāyate' iti nyāyaḥ |
6|3| 6120. mīko. pṛ. 2977 ' pratinidhirvaṃ prati-ṣiddhasya. ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
māṣāpākasaṃbaṃdho na kevalaṃ varkaurvāṇaiḥ kintu sarveṣāmeva |
varkaurvanoktistu stutyārthā ' iti ha smāha varkaurvāṇaḥ : māṣāneva mahā~ pacata, na vā eteṣāṃ havi-rgṛhṇāti ' iti |
vastutastu māṣaḥ pāko na kasyāpi, āraṇyāśanasya tu stutireṣā |
vi. 6|1|22. ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityagnihotraśabdaḥ juhotinā samānadhikatvāt karmaparaḥ |

vi. 7|3|14. ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityagnihotraśabdavat ( agni-hotraśabdo yathā nityāgnihotradharmalakṣakastathā ' yadevādḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ ' iti ) paurṇamāsaśabdaḥ dharmalakṣakaḥ ( iti siddhāntyekadeśī ) |
soma. 5|4|4. ' māsa-magnihotraṃ juhoti ' iti kuṇḍapāyināmayane nityāgnihotrāt karmāntaraṃ vidhīyate, na tu māsaḥ kālo vidhīyate |
ṭup. 7|3|12. ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' iti karmāntaravidhiḥ na māsaguṇavidhiḥ; kuṇḍapāyināmayane |
' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' iti pratyakṣaṃ yāgaḥ kuṇḍapāyināmayane |
saṃkarṣa. 3|1|25. mīko. pṛ. 1465 ' kuṇḍapāyināmayane māsaḥ ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
saṃkarṣa. 3|4|7. ' māsena śūdrobhavati ' ityevamādīni karmanidāvacanāni, athavā varṇatrayakarma-hānipratipādanānyāni iti vaktavyam |
mityuktam, tatpratyakṣatve tasya agnihotraśabdasya prakaraṇā- ntare śravaṇe vidhīyamānadharmāṇāṃ pradeśa: syāt |
' māsa- magnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityādī naimittikāgnihotrācino nāmna: na tāvat karmāntaravācakatvam, anekaśakti- kalpanāpatte: |
davihomatvena codanāliṅgādihābhāvāt nāmātideśābhāve abhedevāttattve pramāṇābhāvena tatpraya- nyāyānupatteśca |
na ca ' yadāhavanīye juhoti ' ityanena agre: prāptatvāt anyadhikaraṇatvena yogopapatti: |

yadi tu nityāgnihotre iva agre: hotraṃ homa iti vyutpattyā adhikaraṇatvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthamaṅgīkṛtya māsāgnihotre'pi yoga ādhīyeta tadāpi pracuraprayogatvāt agnihotrapadasya niruḍha- lakṣaṇayā nityāgnihotre prayogāt tasyāśca śaktitvatvena māsāgnihotre tadasaṃbhavāt gauṇatvamāvaśyakam |
anayaiva diśā ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyām ' ityādī gauṇatvopapādanaṃ draṣṭavyam |
anyathā ' ya iṣvā ' ityā- dinā paurṇamāsīkālakatvaprāpte: |
dadhīkālaprāptāvapi vā ekatra mukhyasya aparatra gauṇatvaniyamāt prasiddhadarśadau niruḍhalakṣaṇā āvaśyakīya eva |
etena gauṇatvābhāve'pi ekanāmatvasāhacaryena codanāliṅgā- deśādeva agnihotradharmalābha: ityapāstam |
na ca tathāpi devatākālādirūpaguṇavidhāyakatvena upapattau gauṇatve pramāṇābhāva: |
tatra vatyartharūpadharmalakṣaṇapūrvakaṃ karmāntare gauṇī iti prāptā: |
tatsiddhisūtrokakaustubhīyā tu gauṇīśānakāryatvācchedamakameva agnihotradharmaviśiṣṭa- karmāntaraśabdabodhatvaṃ ityapi śakyaṃ vaktum |
tatra ca siṃho devadatta itivat pramāṇāntarasiddhādabhedena gauṇatvā- saṃbhave'pi asminneva vākye tadīyadharmaviśiṣṭakarmāntara- vidhānena sādhyasādṛśyena gauṇatvopapatti: |
iti yathāsaṃdarbhaṃ viveka: karaṇīya: ) : ' vājapeyeneṣṭvā bṛhaspatisavena yajeta ' iti bṛhaspatisavyasya aṅgatve karmāntaratvena prasiddhabṛhaspati- savatvābhāvāt tacchabda: anupapanna: |
na ca pūrvoktamāsāgnihotranyāyena ( 2|3|1|24 ) ' āgneyamahakapālaṃ nirvapeda rukkāma: ' ityatra karmāntaratvam, vaiṣamyāt |
iha tu anārambhādhīta- tvena prakaraṇameva tāvaccāsti, kuta: prakaraṇāntaratvam |
dākṣāyaṇayajñe nimittaśrutyā sātyayajñe prasakte āhāravihārādivaśena tadvādhāt jāteṣṭimāsāgni- hotranyāyena paurṇamāsyādyanugrahe'pi sātyasatyātyanta- bādhāyogyāt puna: punaranuṣṭhānāpatti: |

saumikakarmavācinaṃ avabhṛthaśabdaṃ varaṇaprathāprakaraṇe prayuñjāna: ' vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣeṣvāvabhṛthaṃ yanti ' ityāgnāya: māsāgnihotranyāyena saumikadharmātideśan karmāntaraṃ taddharmasaṃyutaṃ vidhatte |
atha ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityatra karmabhedo naiyamikāgnihotratvakarmabhedo veti cintyate |

tatra pūrvapakṣa: ' tisra āhutīrjuhoti ' ityādī ayaṃ nyāya: sthita: ' yatra guṇadvaye anyonyaviruddhe karmotpatti- vākyapātte medādyavadho: anyatarākṣepamantareṇa karmānyo'- nupapannastatra bheda evākṣipyate nāvṛtti: ' iti |
māsā- gnihotravākye ca nāmātideśena parasparaviruddhaṃ sāyaṃprāta:- kāladvayaṃ karmotpattivākyagatamasti |
tena karmabheda evā- kṣipyate ' yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapāla: ' ityatra paurṇamāsamāvā- syākāladvayeneva iti |
nāmātideśena aṅga- tvāccirodhāt abhyāso'pi kāladvayat prāpta eva |
tataśca upāttena abhyāsenaina kāladvayānyopapatte: na karmabhedākṣepa: |
' tisra: āhutīrjuhoti ' ityādi tu naiva kenacicchadena abhyāsa upātta: , yatastatraiva trisaṃkhyā upapannā syāt, atastadupapattau karmabheda evākṣipyate |
athedānīmidaṃ cintyate ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeta ' ityatra ' ājyabhāgāgau yajati ' itivat dvitva- saṃkhyayā karmabhedāt dve karmaṇī yajinā vidhīyete iti tāvadavivādam |
tathā darśaśabdena pūrṇamāsaśabdena ca prākṛtāgneyāditrayasaṃbandhi itikartavyatāyāṃ ekaikena śabdena ekaikasmin karmaṇi atidiśyate ityapyavivādam |
atha parasparaviruddhadravyadevatādirūpetikartavyatāyā: trayaṃ utpatti- vākyagataṃ ekaikasya karmaṇo medākṣipatti na veti cintyam |

tatra pūrvapakṣa: yadyatra ' māsamagnihotraṃ juhoti ' ityevamabhyāsopādānānāsti, tathāpi vidhya- ntādhikaraṇe ( 7|4|2 ) itikartavyatādyasamaccayānnirāsāt yathā saurye prākṛtāgneyakarmabhede'pi tadīyapaurṇamāsamā- vāsyādiviruddhetikartavyatayo: vikalpena atideśa: |

eva- mihāpi vinigamakābhāvāt darśaśabdena pūrṇamāsaśabdena ca tisrastisra itikartavyatā: āgneyāditrayasaṃbandhinya: atidiśyā: vikalpena ekasmin karmaṇi niveśyante iti na karmabheda: ṣoḍhā, kintu dvaidhaveti |

iti- kartavyatāvikalpo'pi evāmedhate nirasta eva, tathāpi ' māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ ' ityatra darśaśabdena pūrṇamāsa- śabdena ca ekaikena lakṣaṇā ityekaśabdopādānāt samuccaya sati āgneyavākyamudrāmudritatvāt ṣaṭkarmāṇi, saurye tu prākṛtāmeyetikartavyatayo: na pratyakṣaikaśabdopādāna- masti, yena samuccaya: , tallakṣaṇa ca karmabheda: syāt , kintu tatra eketikartavyatākāṅkṣāvaśāt śabdakalpanā, eketikartavyatayaiva ca ākāṅkṣā upaśāmyati iti īdṛgeva atideśaka: śabda: kalpyate paurṇamāsāgneyavat daśamiyavadā iti |
evaṃ vāśabdayuktātideśakaśabdakalpa- nāt na prākṛtāmeyetikartavyatayo: samuccaya: , na vā tallakṣaṇat karmabhedamāpatti: iti vaiṣamyam |

nanu iha yathā pūrṇamāsaśabdena darśaśabdena vā karmatrayakarmatrayasaṃbandhīti- kartavyatātrayaṃ lakṣaṇayā atidiśyate, itikartavyatāyāśca yatrayatrasya ekaikaśabdopādānāt samuccayavāgate: ṣaṭ karmāṇi |

evaṃ sānāyyayāgadyena saha prākṛ momāt vaikalpiksya aindrāgnyāpi dravyadevatāpetikartavyatā'pi prakṛtityā darśaśabdena lakṣaṇayā ekaśabdopāccaiva iti saptamamapi karma darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmeva vidhīyate iti paṭ- karmānuṣṭhānaṃ yājñikānāṃ cintyameva |
prakṛtau aindrāgma- vikalpe'pi iha taditikartavyatāyā api ekaśabdopādānena samuccaya vidhānāt |

tatra tu iyān viśeṣa: , prakṛtau aindrāgma: prāk somāt iha tu tadiktāvāpi satrasya somo- tkaratvāt tadaṅgave aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyena ( 12|2| 1|25 ) samaprādhānye tu ' bhūyasāṃ syāt sadharmatvam ' iti nyāyena ( 12|2|1|22 ) somaprāktatvāt iti: |
satyaṃ saptamaṃ karma aindrāgmavikṛtibhūtaṃ sidhyati, tasya tu nityavadanuṣṭhāne darśaśabdānā atidiśya prakṛtiva- ddhāvasya syāt |
tathā ca ekādaśe ( 1|1|2 | 15|16-65 ) ' vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣeṣvāvabhṛthaṃ yanti ' ityatra prakaraṇāttaratvena tatattipatti: artha- karmabhūtasamīkābhavadhruvatvādhakāpatte: ityuktam |
tatra ca aṅgaguṇavirodhanyāyāt aupadeśiko'pi samuccayaḥ ātideśikenāpi vikalpena bādhyate iti prakṛti- vadevānuṣṭhānaṃ siddham |
bāla. pṛ. 89-91. māsāgnihotraśravaṇaṃ kauṇḍapāyināyame prāja- hite'gnī kāryaṃ na śālāmukhīye |
māsādidīkṣākalpasyaiva iṣṭinirmāṇaparyāpta- kālatvāt sāgnicityakau ekādidīkṣāpakṣa na pravartan |

iti prāpte, 'na prājāpatyenāneṣṭvā iṣṭakāḥ kāryet' iti pratiṣedhānupapattyā dīkṣātaḥ pūrvaṃ prājāpatyaśoḥ parato'pi tannirmāṇakālamāha anena sahe aci- rodhāt ekādidīkṣāpakṣāṇāṃ prakṛtitaḥ prāptānāṃ na bādhaḥ |
saṃkarṣe. 2|1|29. māsāyānikaḥ pakṣaḥ (śūnyavādapakṣaḥ) pratyuktaḥ prāgeva nirākṛtaḥ ityarthaḥ |
bhā. 1|1|15 pṛ. 51. māhendra ityādinī catvāri pṛṣṭhastotrāṇi jyoti- ṣṭome |
vi. 3|13, māhendraṃ stotraṃ rājasūyatā- bhiṣecanīye atideśaprāptam |
tasya kāle apakarṣaṇaṃ yaja- mānasyābhiṣekaḥ kriyate |
abhiṣekāt prāk ca videva- nādayaḥ kriyante |
4|4|2, māhendraṃ stotraṃ vājapeye 'rathaghopeṇa māhendrasya stotramupākaroti' 'dundubhi- ghoṣeṇa māhendrasya stotramupākaroti' iti |
10|4|2 varṇakaṃ 2. 'māhendramanuhyante' ityasya māhendrā- dhyavahitakāle atigrāhyā hūyante itthaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
māhendreṇa iṣṭvā atigrāhyān hutvā anuvaṣaṭ kuryāt ityarthaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
saṃkarṣe. 3|3|7. māhendrastotrānantarameva atigrāhyāṇāṃ homaḥ; na tu saha |
saṃkarṣe. 3|3|7. mī.ko. pṛ. 190 'ati- grāhyāṇāṃ māhendrahānantarameva' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
māhendrastotrādīni catvāri pṛṣṭhāni jyotiṣṭome na sarvāṇi ṣaḍapi |
bhā. 7|2|16. māhendrastotropakaraṇasādhanatayā vihitena ratha- dundubhighoṣeṇa prākṛtadharmatvornātho vājapeye |
10|4|11-2 varṇakaṃ 3. māhendrastotrakāle abhiṣekaparva videvanādīnā- mapi tataḥ prāgapakarṣaḥ, rājasūye abhiṣecanīyasomāyāge |
bhā. 5|2|122. mitradāyādādibhyaḥ prītyādinā kriyamāṇe'śradāne nāsti doṣaḥ nāpi prāyaścittam |
su. pṛ. 999. mitravindāyāṃ anārambhīyāt sāmidhenīsādṛśyaṃ niviśate |
vi. 3|6|2. mitravindāyāṃ anārabhya- vihitaṃ (sāmidhenī-) sātādasyaṃ atideśaprāptasādṛśya- vādhena niviśate |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'vārtraghnī paurṇamāsāman- vyate, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti |
idamanuvākyā- catuṣṭayaṃ kiṃ pradhāne niviśate uta ājyabhāgayoḥ iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
vārtraghnībhyāṃ anuvākyābhyāṃ paurṇamāsīkarmaṇaḥ vṛdhanvatībhyāṃ ca amāvāsyākarmaṇaḥ arthena prayojanena na saṃbandhaḥ |
anarthasaṃbandhaḥ; arthena saṃbandhaḥ arthasaṃbandhaḥ na arthasaṃbandhaḥ anarthasaṃbandhaḥ artha- saṃbandhābhāva ityarthaḥ |
'agniṃ vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanat' iti vārtraghnī āgneyī, 'tvaṃ somāsi satpatiḥ' iti vārtraghnī saumī |
'agniḥ praṇena janmanā' iti vṛdhanvatī āgneyī, 'somamībhitvā vayam' iti vṛdhanvatī saumī |
paurṇamāsyāṃ kevalasomābhāvāt amāvāsyāyāṃ tu sarvathaiva somābhāvāt |
iti ājyabhāgayoḥ anuvākyānāṃ viniyogaḥ syāt iti
pradhānasya anuvākyānāṃ ca mithaḥ na artha- saṃbandhaḥ prayojanaprayojanasaṃbandhaḥ liṅgādivāpatteḥ iti kaustubhoktaḥ sūtrārthaḥ sādhīyān |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'vārtraghnī paurṇamāsāman- vyate, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ anuvākyāyugalasya pradhāne niveśaḥ uta ājyabhāgayoḥ iti |
ānarthakyatadaṅgaprasaṅgāt vicāryaṃ pari- samāpya idānīṃ ānarthakyatadanvayavaidharyeṇa prasaṅgāt yathāyogaṃ vyavasthā pratipādyate |
yadyapi paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāśabdau kāle mukhyau, tathāpyanuvākyāyugalasya devatāprakāśakasya kālārthatvā- saṃbhavāt svābhāvādeva yāgayogitvāt lakṣaṇayā yāgapara- tvameva |
tatra kiṃ kramānurodhenājyabhāgaparatvaṃ vādanayoḥ, yadi vā prakaraṇānurodhena pradhānagāparatvam |
tatra prakaraṇasya balīyastvāt krameṇa vācanasaṃbandha eva anuvākyā- dvayasya prakaraṇagṛhītena vākyena pratipāyate |
kiñca, yathā prakaraṇenājyabhāgayoḥ pradhānārthatvaṃ tathā anuvākyāyugalasyopari |
tasmāt ājyabhāgakramaṃ bādhitvā vākyena pradhānārthatva- meva anuvākyānāmiti |
kevalasya somasya prakāśanaṃ mahendrādhikaraṇa- nyāyenaiva na saṃbhavati |
na ca anenaiva vākyena dvitvamapi vidhīyate |
prāpte karmaṇi dvitvasya mantraviśeṣasya ca vidhāne vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt |
' puro'nuvākyāmanvāha ' ityatra tu anekāsāṃ puronuvākyānāṃ kramaprāptatvāt eka- tvamātraṃ vidhīyate iti yuktam |

atra tu mantraviśeṣasyāpi vivakṣāyāṃ vākyabheda eva eteti kiñcitkālavacanatvenopapattau kathaṃ lākṣaṇikamaparaparatvāśrayaṇam ? na ca mantrasya kālā- rthatvāsaṃbhavāt paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyāśabdollekhanayā karmapara- tvamiti vācyam |
ājyabhāgau ca pratipradhānaguṇāvṛttyanyāyena paurṇamāsyāmāvāsyākramasamudāyadvaye āvṛttyā prayoktavyau |
paurṇa- māsyāṃ yāvājyabhāgau tau vṛdhanvadvantamantrakau, amāvāsyāyāṃ yāvājyabhāgau tau vṛdhanvadvantamantrakau proktavyāviti |
ato mukhya- kālārthatvenaiva vākyavopapattau na liṅgakramabādhena lakṣaṇayā pradhānakarmatvasyānarthaṃ yuktam |
tena anuvākyāyugalasya ājyabhāgayoreva niveśa iti siddham |
sūtraṃ tu mithonyonya- manuvakyānāṃ pradhānasya darśapūrṇamāsayorjñābhibhāvena anarthasaṃbandhāt arthasaṃbandhābhāvādityarthaḥ |
tautā. atha agnidevatā bhaviṣyatīti kaścit brūyāt sa vaktavyaḥ ' mithaścānarthasaṃbandhaḥ ' iti |
nahi āgneya- śabdaḥ ' yadāgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ ' iti anuvādo vidhiśca bhavati |
bhā. 2|1|16 pṛ 487. mantrasamā- mnāye aviśeṣapaṭhitasya puronuvākyāyugalasya ājya- bhāgayoḥ kāladvayagatayoḥ anyavyavasthā prāptau tatrovyavasthā- rthatvaṃ tṛtīyāye ' mithaścānarthe ' |

ku. 2|1|13. yadi etayoḥ (ājyabhāgayoḥ) agnī- pomīyāditvat anyadevatākatvamavagataṃ syāt tataḥ vākyena liṅgabādhāyogāt agatvā viśiṣṭalakṣaṇaṃ aṅgīkṛtya gauravamapi ' mithaścānartha ' iti nyāyena āśriyata |
pūrṇamāse anucyate, bṛhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti vākyayoḥ, ājyabhāgayoḥ puronuvākyāvyavasthāpakatvaṃ iti 'mithyārthe' ityatra vakṣyate|
yo hi janitvā dhvaṃsate naitadevaṃ iti saḥ mithyā pratyayaḥ|
na caiṣa (codanāyā avagamyamānaḥ arthaḥ) kālāntare puruṣāntare avasthāntare deśāntare vā viparyaiti|
bhā. 212| 212, ki na khalu amithyājñānasya svarūpam? yasya bādhakaḥ pratyayaḥ vimṛśyamānasyāpi nopapadyate na tat mithyā|
bādhakaṃ hi yatra jñānamucyate 'naitadevaṃ (kintu) mithyājñānam' iti tadanyasaṃprayoge, viparītaṃ tatsaṃprayoge iti|
yadā hi cakṣurādibhirupahataṃ mano bhavati, indriyaṃ vā timirādibhiḥ saukṣmyādibhirbāhyo vā viṣayaḥ, tato mithyājñānam|
tasmācca duṣṭaṃ karaṇam, yatra ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ sa evāsamīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānyaḥ|
sanidrasya manaso daurbalyānnidrā mithyābhāvasya hetuḥ svapnādau|

vā. 3|4|14|23 pṛ. 926. mīmāṃsāḥ anuṣṭhāna niṣpannasyāpi saṃbandhasya abhīmīḥ mīmāṃsakatvamātraṃ vinā yājñikānuṣṭhānamātrāt aviśvasaddhiḥ pratipatteḥ samākhyāvyamlapramāṇarśanaiveyaṃ mīmāṃsāḥ saṃbandhaṃ pratipadyāmahe|
su. pṛ. 1203. mīmāṃsāḥ jñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ svataḥ, aprāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ iti vadanti|
vaidyanāthaḥ 212|12 pṛ. 14. mīmāṃsāḥ nyāyena vedaṃ vyācakṣate|
vā. 31|17|3 pṛ. 701. mīmāṃsāḥ 'vākyārtho lākṣaṇikaḥ' iti vadanti|
ratnamālā. vākyārthanirṇaye pṛ. 101. mīmāṃsāḥ vyapekṣāmātrāśrayiṇaḥ ekāthībhāvaṃ nāmyupagacchanti|
vi. 10|8|12 ṭippaṇī. mīmāṃsāḥ śaktiḥ padārthāntaraṃ iti vadanti|
maṇi. pṛ. 74. mīmāṃsā hi vākyārthavicāre prastute sati|
bāla. pṛ. 7. mīmāṃsakānāṃ rāddhānte savikalpakasyāpi pramāṇatvam|
mīmāṃsakapramādaḥ 'syārthatyāgaḥ, parārthagrahaṇam, prāsatrādhaḥ' iti parisaṃkhyāsu prasiddhaṃ doṣatrayaṃ aprāsa-parisaṃkhyāsu na bhavati kintu prātaparisaṃkhyāsu iti|
su. pṛ. 1404. mīmāṃsakamate arthabhāvaneva kārakaviśiṣṭarūpeṇa vākyārthaḥ|
rasāyanam pṛ. 28, sarve dravya-vidhayo niyamavidhayaḥ iti mīmāṃsakamaryādā|
bāla. pṛ. 20. mīmāṃsā lokādeva pratyakṣānumānādibhiḥ avicchinnasaṃpradāya-paṇḍitavyavahāraiḥ pravṛttā|
nahi kaścidapi prathamameva etāvantaṃ yuktikalāpaṃ upasaṃhartuṃ kṣamaḥ|
vā. 1|3|12. mīmāṃsā samasta-vaidikatarkopasaṃhāramikā vedaśabdavācyā 'vidhirvidheya-starkaśca vedaḥ' ityetasmin darśane sati bhavati|
tena asyāṃ yo nyāyamārgaḥ, tasminsati durjñāte vā vivekāmāvāt na kiñcit jñāyate|
su. pṛ. 130, mīmāṃsāyāḥ nyāyaniṣṭhātvāt prayoganirūpaṇamapyatra itāśakya prayogārtha-tvāśrayasya tasmādye'pi prayogavedyamyaṃ tatra tilpa-ṇīyamityāha|
pṛ. 169. mīmāṃsāyāḥ pūrveṇa adhyāyamad-kena pratyakṣavihitadharmāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ darśapūrṇamāsādīnāṃ iti-kartavyatā cintitā|
tathā ca darśitam 'athāto dharmajijñāsā' sūtramāmidaṃ kṛtam|
tathā ca 'athāto dharmajijñāsā, codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ' iti ca sūtram, 'ko dharmaḥ' kathaṃlakṣaṇaḥ? ityādi bhāṣyaṃ ca na kukavikṛtiriva vedārthaparaṃ vyākhyeyam|
prathama'dhyāye pramāṇam, dvitīye svarūpam, ṣaṣṭhe phalam, itareṣu sādhanaṃ vicāryate iti vivekaḥ|
ūho bādhaśca tantraṃ ca prasaṅgaścoditāḥ kramāt|
caturthe godohanasya puruṣārthaprayuktā anuṣṭhānaṃ na tu kravyarthaprayuktā ityevamādāya|
saptame sāmānyataḥ atideśaḥ pratyakṣavacanena anumitavacanena ca|
navame 'agraye juhu' nirvapāmi' ityatra 'sūryāya juhu' nirvapāmi' ityādiḥ ūhaḥ|
pūrveṇa adhyāyaṣṭakena pratyakṣavihitadharmāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ darśapūrṇamāsādīnāṃ itikartavyatā cintitā|
mīmāṃsāyāṃ dvādaśalakṣaṇyāṃ dharmadharmava jaimininā anuṣṭhānopayogitayā vicārito|

yadyapi dharmādharmau adṛṣṭaviśeṣautmakau, na kriyārūpau, ata eva 'dharmaḥ kṣarati kīrtanāt' ityādī vaiśeṣikatantre ca kriyājanyādṛṣṭe dharmādharmaśabdaprayogaḥ, tathāpi 'dharmastvanuṣṭhitaḥ puṃsām' ityādī tajjanakavihitaniṣṭhākriyāyāmi dharmaśabdaprayoga-prayogāt tanniṣṭhā prādhānyena vicāryate|
yataḥ vidhirna kartavyatāṃ karmaṇaḥ avabodhayati, tasmāt yadyupādīyate
tattat vidheyaṃ iti tantre vyavahāraḥ, na punaḥ yattat kartavyatayā jñāpyate tattat vidheyaṃ iti mīmāṃsāsiddhānte vyavahāraḥ |
' mukhamastīti vaktavyaṃ daśahastā harītakī ' iti nyāyaḥ |
' mukhaṃ vyādāya svapiti ' ityādī samānakartṛka- tvamātre sāmānyādhikaraṇye vā katvāpratyaya lakṣaṇa |
' suptvā mukhaṃ vyādatte ' iti vaiparītyena vodha iti kaścit |
maṇi. pṛ. 164. ' mukhaṃ vyādāya svapiti ' iti katvāpratyayasya samānakartṛkatvamātreṇa upapattiḥ |
na ca yat mukhavyādānāt nidrāṇasya parāddhaḥ kṣaṇāḥ tān vivakṣitvā evam, lokādhīnāva- dhāraṇatvāt dāndārthasambandhasya |
vyādānasya tu purastāt- neṣvapi nidrāṇāṃ kṣaṇeṣu
riti saṃśaye ‘bhūyasāṃ śeṣakāryāṇāṃ mā bhūdalanta- rthānāṃ yājamānānāṃ karaṇenaiva gṛhapateryathatvam |
ekasya vrīhihāsya kiñcidvādhastu satre gṛhapatiḥ kuryāt iti siddhāntaḥ |
‘vrīhyo'pi puroḍāśabhūtā guṇe bādhitavyo nyāyaḥ, na mukhyaḥ |
tadaikalye pradhānasya guṇahāniḥ 1|10|99. mukhyena gauṇaṃ bādhyate, aprāptatvāt |
’ tasāccheṣakāryyanāhatya vrīhibhireva vā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 860. mukhyena samānavidhānaḥ |
soma-- pūrvavadihāpi pratinidhiriti pratyavasthānāt mukhyasya aṅganirvāhasamarthasyāpi pradhāna- |
sūtrārthastu-- ekadeśo'pi puroḍāśamātra- nirvāhasamarthasya sataḥ upādānam ||
samarthavrīhye'pi pratinidhiḥ syāt śeṣakāryādividheḥ vidhirapyekadeśe syāt |
śeṣakāryāṇāṃ luṣyatāṃ deśe avadānamātre'pi nirvartyamāne pratinidhipādeyaḥ |
bhaṭṭa-- yatra tvaśvatthaparimāṇaśeṣakāryyaparyātaiḥ adhivā'rthasya śakyatvādekadeśena nirvartyatārthā- |
puroḍāśatvajātimātrābhivyaktisamarthā vrīhayo labhyante tatra nāmavibhaktatvād guṇamātramitarat tadarthatvāt |
na ca bahūnāṃ śeṣakāryāṇāṃ puroḍāśabhūtānāṃ puroḍāśāṅga- bhāṣyam-- apiceta paśyāvyātaḥ |
tpattiṣṭapuroḍāśāvarodhāt ‘vrīhibhiḥ’ iti tṛtīyā prayoga- śeṣakāryāṇi yadi na śakyāni, nāṅganurodhena pradhānasya |
10|2|27|63. mukhyasya punaḥ prāptau pūrva mukhya- musṛya idaṃ sūtram |
bhāṣyam-- tathā ca anyārthadarśanaṃ api bhavati |
6|3|16|35. mukhyasya saṃskārārhasya lāme saṃskṛte- ‘tadeva yāhak tādṛg hotavyam’ iti |
khadiralābhe kadaraḥ pari- śā-- darśapūrṇamāsayoryadā aśvatthaparimāṇaśeṣakāryya- |
vi. 6|3|17, mukhyasya haviṣo bhyaḥparyāptāḥ puroḍāśajātimātrābhivyaktisamarthā vrīhayo |
6|4|1. ekatra labhyante tadā kiṃ taireva puroḍāśaḥ kartavyaḥ, uta nīvāre- |
paśuniyojanāt mukhyaṃ labhate cet tathāpi mukhya eva kāryasamarthasya sata upādānam ||
ragrālābhye na samarthī, kadaradravyaṃ tu tatsamartham |
śrute khadirādrivye apacarite kadaradi pratinidhi saṃdehaḥ : kimupādeyaṃ khadiradravyamuta kadaradravyamiti |
to'pi pratinidhirna grāhyaḥ kintu mukhya eva khadiro labhya- tatyam |
dhigame mukhyasya adhigame lābhe sati mukhyameva grāhyam |
hi yasmāt tadabhāvāt mukhyābhāvāt pratinidhiḥ āgamaḥ mupādānaṃ dravyaśruti bādhate, atha tenugṛhṇāti |
idānīṃ tu mukhyameva labdhaṃ tatra kiṃ prati- latāmupādānaṃ ubhayaṃ bādhate |
balavat, ato dravyāṇāṃ prayojanaśeṣatvāt dravyābhāve prati- |
bhāṣyam-- atha yatra vinaṣṭe śrute pratinidhimupā- vi-- ‘niyojanānte'pyogyaśrutvadiraḥ kiṃ tadā |
dātuṃ prasthito mukhyamevopalabhate, tatra kiṃ pratinidhimevo- bhavet |
mukhyatvena sa eva syāt, tadarthena hītaraḥ ||
kiṃ tāvatsāma ? prati- [bhaṭṭa idamadhikaraṇaṃ pūrvādhikaraṇe evāntarbhāvitam |
abhāve hi mukhye pradhānayati eva labdhe śeṣakāryalopaḥ kāryaḥ |
soma-- pūrvatra vaikalpikanyāyānavatāre'pi iha tadava- mukhyātikramaḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ ānarthakyena kāraṇena |
sūtrārthastu- mukhyalābhe tadaiva yato mukhyābhāvādamukhyā- ‘mukhyādhigame mukhyamāgamo hi tada- |
vi-- ‘pratinidhyudyame mukhyalābhe tu kiṃ mukhyaṃ khadiralabhyaṃ matvā tatrapratinidhiṃ kadaramupādātuṃ |
’ prasthito madhye mukhyaṃ labhate cet mukhya eva grāhyaḥ, |
bhaṭṭa-- [bhāṣṭe 16-17 adhikaraṇayoḥ : ekamevādhi- kadaraṃ gṛhītvā takṣaṇādiṣu kepucit saṃskāreṣu kṛteṣu prāk |

‘ mukhyādhiāme mukhyamāgamo hi tadabhāvāt ’, ‘ pravṛtte- 'pīti cet ’, ‘ nānarthakatvāt ’ iti sūtrayatamusrapūrva- pakṣatayanirākaraṇārthaṃ sat siddhāntatrayapradarśanārthamiti abhi- karaṇayapradarśakatayā pṛthak pṛthak bhāṣyakārairvyākhyātam |
tatrādyasūtre mukhyālābhe pratinidhipādāne pravṛttasya madhye mukhyālābha: yadā tadā tena mukhyamevopapāttavyamiti siddhānto darśita: |
dvitīyaṃ tu sūtre yadā puna: pratinidhimupādāya kecana saṃskārā: kṛtā: tadanantaramapi mukhyālābhe mukhya- mevopādeyam, na tu saṃskṛto'pi pratinidhipādeya iti siddhānta: |
tṛtīye tu sūtre pratinidhī saṃskārakaraṇānantaraṃ niyojanādirūpapradhānasyāpi siddhijatā tadanantaraṃ mukhya- dravyalābhe'pi na mukhyamupādeyaṃ kintu pratinidhireveti siddhānta: |
sarvatrāpi ca pūrvapakṣa: utsūtra eva draṣṭavya: |
tadā kṛte prayojane śrutamevāgamayitavyamiti pūrvapakṣocaraṃ ‘ nānarthakatvāt ’ iti sūtraṃ prayojanābhāvācca
etadvai daivyaṃ mithu- nam' iti śrūyate |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ brīdevatyasya prathamaṃ dharmo uta puṃdevatyasya iti |
brīdevatyasya hi pūrve yājyānuvākyo: samānnām 'pra ṇo devī sarasvatī' iti |
tasmāt brīdeva- tyasya pūrve dharmāḥ kāryāḥ |
itarathā yeḥ padārthairvyavadhānaṃ sāmarthyādanujñātaṃ tebhyo'dhikairapi vyavadhānaṃ syāt |
saṃnipātiṣvapi dvitīyādiṣu tadeva pravṛttyā niyamasaṃbhavāt na aniyamaḥ |
tatra) śrutyarthapāṭhapravṛttikāṣṭheḥ (krama-) niyamasya abhāvāt prathame padārthe aniyamaḥ |
brīdeva- tyasya prathamaṃ yājyānuvākye, tathaiva prathamaṃ pradānam, tataḥ brīdevatyasya prathamaḥ padārthaḥ (pūrve) ārambha- ṇīyo mukhyakrameṇa |
katham ? sahoditatvāt (anayoḥ : ekaikamātmīyān) ekakṣaṇavyavahitān padārthān apekṣate |
tatra puṃdevatyasya prathamaḥ padārtho yathārabhyate tataḥ (pradhāna- saṃnihito yaḥ padārthaḥ tasyāmbhatve pūrvārddhasya) pravṛttyā ekakṣaṇavyavahitā, brīdevatyasya sa eva padārthaḥ kriyate |

tatra prākū brīdevatyasya pradānāt (pradānānuṣṭhānāt) yaḥ padārthaḥ (avyavahitaḥ) tasmin (prathamapadārtha-) pravṛttyā brīdevatyasya (paścāt) kṛte tato'nantarameva brīdevatyasya (mantra-) pāṭhakrameṇa pradānaṃ prāpnoti |
tatra ekakṣaṇavyavahitā bādhyate yā sahavacanenāpekṣitā, itarasyāpi tābhyāṃ vyavahitau (kṣaṇa- dvayavyavahitau) padārthau, tataḥ pūrvaidāmapi ekakṣaṇavipra- karṣaḥ |
ata āha (bhāṣyakāraḥ) - yeḥ padārthaiḥ vyavadhānaṃ sāmarthyādabhyanu- jñātaṃ tebhyo'dhikairapi vyavadhānaṃ syāt |

yatra hyanekeṣāṃ sāṅgānāṃ pradhānānāṃ sahakartavyatā, tatra prayogavidhinā''ṅgapradhānayoḥ : sāhityā- vagatāvāpi pradhānāntarasāhityānurodhena yāvadanujñātavya- dhānasvīkāre'pi tadadhikyavacane pramāṇābhāvāt pradhāna- pratyāsattigrahyāya mukhyakrameṇāvāde kramanīmam |
ata eva pravṛttau aṅganirūpitapratyāsattigrahyo bījamita, mukhyakrame tu pradhānanirūpitapratyāsattigrahyo bījamiti tayorbhedaḥ, vaiparītyena balābalaṃ ceti vakṣyate |
mukhyakramodāharaṇaṃ ca citrāyāge 'sārasvato bhavata etadvai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ yat sarasvatī sarasvāṃśa' iti vākyavihitapradhānakramataḥ- trivāpakramaḥ |
atra hi dravyasāmānyādhikaraṇyabhāve'pi saṃgrahasāmānyavācinastata 'daivyam' iti vākya- śeṣādevatāparatvopapatteḥ divacanena devatākalpitayāgadvayaṃ vidhīyate |
ata eva na yāgādvaye api sarasvāneva devatā |
na caivamapi sarasvatī ca sarasvāṃśa sarasvatī, sarasvatī devate yayostau iti vyutpattyā ekaikasya brīdevatyatvaṃ kiṃ na syāditi vācyam, ekaikadevatyāyā''nuvākyāpāṭhana ekaikadevatyatvāvagateḥ |
ata eva prājāpatyatvaṃtatipannadevatātvābhāvena mantra- pāṭhakramāt pradhānakrame sati mukhyakrameṇaiva tannirvāpayoḥ kramaḥ |

vastutastu--tulyanyāyatayā pūrvapadārthapravṛtteruttara- padārthapravṛtterapi pūrvapadārthakramaniyamakatvasyoktvā prakṛte ca yājyā'nuvākyādirūpottarapadārthapravṛtteśca nirvāpakramopa- patteryathāpi nedaṃ mukhyakramasyāṅgīmudāharaṇam, tathāpi daghnaḥ pūrvaṃ śālāharaṇādayo dharmāḥ paṭhitāḥ |
paścādāgne- yasya nirvāpadayaḥ, yājyānuvākyayostvo viparītaḥ pāṭhaḥ |
aniyamaprasaktau mukhyakrameṇa āgneyasya prathamamabhidhāraṇaṃ paścādaghna ityādidahaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
mukhyajaghanyayoḥ anyatarasmin loptavye jaghanyo luyeta, mukhyo hyanugrahītavyaḥ |
mukhyadravyalābhe'pi pratinidhinā mukhyakārya- karaṇottaraṃ mukhyaṃ na grāhyam |
citrā- yāge hi caturthapañcamayoḥ sārasvatyoḥ brīdevatyasya yājyā- nuvākyāpāṭhasya prāthamyena brīyāgasya prāthamyaṃ sidhyati |
mukhyavṛttiḥ lakṣaṇayā bādhyate ānarthakyaprati- ghāte viparītau vādho bhavati iti rītayā |
ahīnaśabdasya na hīnaḥ ahīnaḥ iti nañsamāsaṃ svīkṛtya jyotiṣṭomāryatā na yuktā |
sa hi 'ahaḥ laḥ kratusamuhe' iti vyutpādyamānaḥ mukhyaḥ |

yathā muādya- tṛṇādīpīkādyaṃ garbhasthaṃ mṛdu tṛṇaṃ bahiravaraṇakatvā sthitānāṃ mukhyatvaguṇānāṃ vibhajanena samudrīyate tathā ātmā api yuktā anvayavyatirekalakṣaṇāyena śarīra- tritayāt bhraṣṭacaryādisaṃghaṭanasaṃpanneḥ pṛthak kṛtasya para- brahmava jāyate, cidānandarūpatvasya lakṣaṇasyobhayoriviśiṣṭa- tvāt |
uktaṃ ca pañcadaśyām 'yathā muādipikaivamātmā yuktvā samuddhṛtaḥ |
murārimiśrāḥ ghaṭādiśānottaraṃ ghaṭaṃ jānāmi ityādyanusayāyo jāyate, tena ghaṭatvavadviśeṣyatve sati ghaṭatvaprakārakapramāṇāgrahaḥ ityāhuḥ |
tena puṃsārti darśayati 'muṣkarā bhavanti sendriyatvāt' iti |
pūrṇamāseṣṭau āgneyasya amīṣomī- yasya ca puroḍāśārthaṃ brīhīṇāṃ nirvāpaḥ 'caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati' ityuktaḥ |
tatra āgneyārtha ekāṃ muṣṭiṃ nirvapya amīṣomīyārtha ekāṃ muṣṭiḥ nirvatavyā |
evaṃ muṣṭiṣu caturṣu ekena ekena muṣṭinā anusamayaḥ kartavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tathā pūrṇamāseṣṭau āgneyapuroḍāśaśrapaṇārthe aṣṭau kapā- lāni upadhīyante, amīṣomīyasya tu ekādaśakapālāni |
tatrāpi āgneyārthaṃ ekaṃ kapālamupadhāya amīṣomīyārtha ekaṃ kapālamupadhyāt |
amīṣomīyārthaṃ navamādikapālāni tu anyavadhānena upa- dheyāni iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
tathā āgneyasya puroḍāśasya ekaṃ avadānaṃ gṛhītvā amīṣomīyasya ekaṃ grāhyam |
tathā jyotiṣṭome dīkṣāyāṃ yajamānasya netrayorañjanaṃ 'trirāṅkte' ityuktam |
tatra dakṣiṇanetre ekadā añjanaṃ kṛtvā savyanetre ekadā añjanaṃ kartavyam |
tataḥ ubhayo- netrayoḥ dvitīyavāraṃ evaṃ ubhayornetrayoḥ tṛtīyavāraṃ añjanaṃ kāryam |
tathā satrādau anekayajamānakatve sati ekasya yaja- mānasya navanītena sarvāṅgaṃ abhyañjanaṃ kṛtvā tato dvitīyasya yajamānasya tataḥ tṛtīyasya ityādi ekaikenaiva anusamayaḥ |
tathā cāturmāsyādau yajamānasya vapanam 'pratidiśaṃ trirvirvapati' ityuktam |
tatra masta kasya pūrvadigbhāge ekadā vapanam, tato dakṣiṇabhāge ekadā itīrityā catu- rdikṣu tritvaṃ saṃpādanīyam |

tathā darśapūrṇamāsayorādau 'citpatistvā punātu' iti mantreṇa satabhirdabhaiḥ piñjūlaiḥ kaṇṭhādupari 'vākpatistvā punātu' iti kaṇṭhādārabhya nābhiparyantam, 'devastvā savitā punātu' iti nābhimārabhya pādaparyantaṃ punāti |

tadetat pāvanaṃ satrādau anekayajamānakatve sarveṣāṃ yajamānānāṃ prathamataḥ kaṇṭhādupari, tataḥ sarveṣāṃ yajamānānāṃ kaṇṭhādadha- stvāt, tataḥ sarveṣāṃ yajamānānāṃ nāmeradhastāt iti eke- kena anusamayaḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
evaṃ muṣṭiṣu ca kapālānāṃ upadhāne ca avadāneṣu ca añjaneṣu ca abhyañjaneṣu ca vapaneṣu ca pāvaneṣu ca ekena ekena anusamayaḥ kartavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
upā- karaṇādidharmaḥ ekaikaśaḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati tathā muṣṭyādau iti |
sarvāṇi eva anusametavyāni, na tu ekaikam |

muṣṭiścatuṣṭayasya, kapālādyasya, avadānadravyasya, añjanadravyasya, abhyañjanasya ekasya, vapanasya, ekaviṃśatyā darbhapiñjūlaiḥ pāvanasya ca pratyekaṃ ekakāryatvāt ekaṃ kāryaṃ apūrvaṃ yasya tādṛśa- tvāt |
eṣāṃ eteṣāṃ iti vā caturṇāṃ muṣṭīnāṃ tadguṇatvāt ekambhāva- nātvāt |
tasmāt ekena muṣṭinā, ekena kapālopadhānena, ekena avadānena, ekena añjanena, abhyañjanena, ekena pāvanena nānusamayaḥ |
ke. muṣṭiścatuṣṭayaṃ ekaḥ padārthaḥ nirvāpe, darśapūrṇa- māsayoḥ |
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|12. mīko. pṛ. 2377 'nirvāpe muṣṭipari- māṇaṃ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
muṣṭilepena saptadaśarāve caruḥ catuḥsaṃkhyānu- graho vājapeye |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati' iti nirvāpasādhanaṃ muṣṭiḥ saṃkhyā coktā |
atha vājapeye 'sapta- daśaśarāvaḥ naivāraścarmavatī' tatra muṣṭilopo na kartavyaḥ catuḥ- saṃkhyālopastu kartavya iti pūrvapakṣaḥ sūtreṇoktaḥ |
caturo nirvapati muṣṭīn nirvapati iti ca pṛthaganvayaḥ |
tasmānna saṃkhyā- lopaḥ kintu muṣṭilopaḥ kartavyaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ |
saṃkhyā tu codanāṃ prati sāmānyāt tadvikāraḥ saṃyogācca paraṃ śruteḥ |
atha tṛtīyaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ ucyate ubhayalopaḥ iti |
saṃyogācca prati naivāraścaraviddhi prati saṃkhyā saptadaśasaṃkhyā prākṛtacatuḥsaṃkhyāyā vikāraḥ |
kiṃca saṃyogāt dravyamāpakasaṃyogāt paraṃ śarāvadravyaṃ muṣṭervikāraḥ muṣṭerbādhakaḥ |
tathā ca vaikṛta- saṃkhyā prākṛtasaṃkhyā nivartyate vaikṛtaiḥ śarāvaiśca prākṛtā muṣṭayo nivartyante |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati' iti nirvāpasādhanaṃ muṣṭiḥ saṃkhyā coktā |
evaṃ sati muṣṭilopāttu saṃkhyālopo varaḥ syāt tadguṇatvāt muṣṭilopāttu
taṃ naśabdena niṣedhayatya dvitīyaṃ pūrvapakṣa- meva siddhāntamāha |
prakṛtau darśapūrṇamāsayostu saṃskārayogāt nirvāpasaṃskārasaṃbaddhā catuḥsaṃkhyā muṣṭidravyaṃ ca |
yasya hi pratyakṣaśrutena codakaprāptasya kārye abhinirvartyate tat tena nivartyatām |
tasmāt muṣṭilopeḥ kartavyaḥ; catuḥsaṃkhyālopastu na kartavyaḥ |
caturbhiḥ kuḍa- vādibhiḥ śarāvaṃ pūrayitvā tasya nirvāpaḥ kartavyaḥ, puna- reyaṃ punarevaṃ evaṃ saptadaśaśarāvam |

ke. 'muṣṭilopāttu saṃkhyālopastadguṇatvāt syāt' ityatra 'caturo muṣṭīn nirvapati' ityatra catuḥsaṃkhyāyāḥ lakṣitamuṣṭiviśeṣaṇatvāpatteḥ saptadaśaśarāve carau pradhānabhūta- muṣṭyanugrāptau saṃkhyānugraho vakṣyate |
vā. 3|1| 14|24. muṣṭīkaraṇaṃ 'muṣṭīkaroti' iti jyoti- ṣṭome kṛtsnaprakaraṇārtha na tu dīkṣāvedanārtham |
bhā. 3|1| 14|24-25. muṣṭīkaraṇena itaścāpalaṃ nivāritaṃ jyotiṣṭome dīkṣāyām |
yathā, kathaṃ nu khalu musalino māṇavakā gaṅgāṃ nāvatareyuḥ iti |
muhūrtaḥ nabhaścittamabhāgātilaṅghanaphalaḥ sūryā- digatikathanacayaḥ iti kriyātiriktkālabhāvavādinaḥ |
su. pṛ. 170. oṃ mūḍhaṃ mūḍhabhāṣayaiva bodhayediti nyāyaḥ |
yatra kiyā niṣphalā tatrāsya pravṛttiriti bhāva: |
mulāvadhāraṇadvāraiva pauruṣeyavākyeṣu arthaniścaya- pratiṣṭhā iti mūlābhāve jhaṭiti jāto'pi niścayo drāgeva vilīno'tulyatvaṃ bhavati |
mūlocchedalakṣaṇa: bāgha eva aprāptabāgha ityu- cyate |
mūlataḥ śākhāṃ parivāsyopavevaṃ karoti ' iyaṃ pūrvottaralakṣaṇatve kvāpratyayarūpā viniyoktrī śruti:; someśvaramatena |

dup-- megha ityatra catvāraḥ pakṣāḥ, avikāreṇobhayoḥ prayogaḥ, vyavasthā vā dvivacanado devatāyāṃ ekavacana- nigado yajamāne, ubhau vā svāmiparau dvivacanadaḥ patya- pekṣayā, ubhau vā devatāparau saṃjñātāpekṣayā ekavacanada iti |
tatra tṛtīye pakṣe doṣamāha ' utkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt ' iti (36 sūtre), yasya devatāvacanaḥ tasyotkarṣaḥ prāpnoti, ekavacanadausau ekadevateṣu paśuṣu iti |
(pāśyānyaṃ darśayati--) ' yatrāsti pradhānabhūtaḥ prātipadikārthaḥ, tatra guṇabhūtaṃ vacanaṃ nīyate ' iti |
tayoḥ ekavacanadaḥ svāmini prayodyate yeṣāṃ rāmāmnātaḥ |
yeṣāṃ dvivacanadaḥ ; teṣāṃ sa devate vakṣyati |
tasmāt vikṛtau bahīṣu devatāsu dvivacanadaḥ uhena pravartate |
svāmino vaikaśyādutkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt patnyā dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt |
eka eva medhapati- śabdaḥ yasmāt dvivacanam, yasmāt ekavacanaṃ sa eva na svāmidevatovācako bhaviṣyati |
nanu eko'pi medha- patiḥ aparo'pi pratīyate, kathamavācaka iti |
yadā svāminaḥ, tadā medhapataye yo meghaḥ, taṃ medhyā dura upanayata iti saṃbandhaḥ |
yadā devatāvacanaḥ, tadā medha- pataye upanayata medhyā duraḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ |
sa eṣa sakṛ- duccaritaḥ ubhābhyāṃ padābhyāṃ na saṃbandhamutsahate |
atha kimarthaṃ na devatā- vacanaḥ kalpyate ? tathāhi kalpyamāne ekavacanada utkarṣeta ekadevatve kṛtau |
yajamānavacane punaḥ kalpyamāne na dvivacanada utkarṣeta |
devatā tu tadāśīṣṭvāt saṃtrāptatvāt svāminya- narthikā syāt |
' āśāsānā medhapataye megham ' iti devatāyāṃ haviśa- śāstre, medhapatibhyāṃ medhamāśāsānā upanayata tābhyāṃ iti |
sa prāpta eva svāminaṃ meghaḥ kimarthamāśāsyate |
na ca tena nityameva svāmisaṃbandhena prayojanam |
svāmipakṣe vākyārtha eva tāvanna ghaṭate, āśāsānapadānarthakyāt |
api ca yajamānāya medhapataye yo meghaḥ, taṃ medhyā duraḥ yajadvāra upanayata |
na ca medhamanūya kiṃcit vidhīyate iti |
itarāthā (devatāpakṣe) medhyā dura upanayata medhapataye medhaṃ kartuṃ ityevamāśāsānāḥ ityupapanno vākyārthaḥ |
na ca parakīyo devatāyai kartuṃ śakyate ityarthāt yo'yaṃ yajamāna- sveti |
bhāṣyam-- utsṛṣṭaṃ ca yajamānena nāyaṃ mameti |
kaḥ punarasya devatā saṃbandhaḥ, yat tāsuddiśya parigraho'sya tyajyate |
tasmāt yāgāt parārtha dravyaṃ nālītyam, parityajya āste |
ātmapradhānaṃ yat tadātmīyam, na yaṃ prati ātmā guṇabhūtaḥ |
tasmādeva- tayoreva tatra meghaṃ medhapatitvam, bhaktaṃ svāmina iti |
yau hi tau dvau amīpamau tayoragaṇe medhapatiśabdaḥ |
tasmin karmaṇi ekasmai gaṇāya meghamupanayata ityucyate |
tasmāt ekavacanānto gaṇavācī medhapatiśabdo noṣkṛṣyate iti |
yadi dvayāya parikalpitaṃ kiṃcid dravyam, tatra dvayaṃ devatā bhavati |
tasmāt ekavacanānto'pi prakaraṇamabhiniviśate, pūrveṇa ca saha vikalpyate iti |
ayocyate, ekatva- viśiṣṭasya vibhaktiḥ saṃbandhaṃ bravīti iti |
atha saṃbandhaṃ karoti ekatvaṃ ca bravīti, na tena viśinaṣṭi, avivakṣitatvāt atiruddhaṃ bhaviṣyati |
athocyate avivakṣita'pi vacane ekatvasaṃbandhe ekavacanaṃ bhavati nānyatreti, tathā medhapatitaṃ ekatvaṃ asya bhaviṣyati, tataḥ so'nuvadiyate |
śā-- dvivacanaṃ adhiṣṭhānasaṃkhyāvaśāt ekavacanaṃ ca devatāsaṃkhyāvaśāt vikṛtitu uhitavyam |
soma-- ekatve'pi samavetāthyatvāt medha- patiśabdasya anuhaḥ ityucyateḥ |
atra ' paśurye medho yajamāno medhapatiryajamānameva tat svena medhena samarpayati ' (aitrā. 6|16) iti pūrvapakṣaprati- pādanapūrvakam ' atho tvalpāhurvaisya vāca kathyaṃ devatāyai

sa yathaikadevatyaḥ paśuḥ syāt medhapataya iti brūyāt, yadi dvidevatyo medha- patibhyāmiti, yadi bahudevatyo medhapatibhyaḥ ' (aitrā. 6|16-6) ityetareyāmnānaṃ nāstīti kṛtvācintyaṃ ityuktaṃ tantraratne-- medhapatitvaṃ svāmino devatāyāstrayāṇāmapi medhasamavāyāt, sarvatra cādhipatye patiśabdaprayogān triṣu caikavacanasyāyyanigadatvāt sarvāsu vikṛtiṣu avikāra iti |
bhā-- tatraiva praiṣe (agnipraiṣe) ' upanayata medhyā dura āśāsānā medhapatiyāṃ megham ' iti śrutam |
keṣāṃ- cit śāstriṇāṃ ' medhapataye megham ' iti |
tatra na tāvat śālābhedana atra mantrabhedaḥ, ekadeśavailakṣaṇyā'pi śāstrā- ntarādhikaraṇanyāyena (2|4|28-33) pratyabhijñānabalena tadekatvāvagateḥ |
tena medhasya patoḥ patiḥ yajamāno devatā vā arthyaḥ ; na tubhayam |
na ca medhapatitvasya śakyatāvacchedakasya ekatvāt tadavacchidyobhayābhidhāne'pi na doṣa iti vācyam |

tathāhi, yajamānaparatve yajamānāya yo meghaḥ patyuḥ bhogasādhanatvena āsīt taṃ medhyā bhavantaḥ ṛtvijaḥ duraḥ yajadvāraṃ cātvā- lokatarthyam upanayata svakīyadakṣiṇāyajamānasya phalaṃ vā āśāsānāḥ : santaḥ ityarthaḥ |
devatāpakṣe devatāyai medhaṃ patyuṃ āśāsānā medhyā bhavantaḥ taṃ duraḥ prati upanayata ityarthaḥ |
sarvathā vilakṣaṇabodhajanaka- tyānupapatteḥ ekarūpa evārtho vācyaḥ |
na ca bodhadvaya- janakatve sakṛduccaritasya sakṛdarthapratyāyakatvaṃ iti niyama-
tadiha kiṃparatvamiti cintāyām, deva- tāyā vigrahabhāvena svāmitvāparaparyāyatvānupapatte- ryajamānaparatvameva |
na ca tasya ekatvena dvivacanānu- papattiḥ |
vastu- tastu daṃpatyoryāsyadyuttikartṛtvādvibhaktatvāt yajeta itivat eka- vacanam, palīyanamānābhiprāyeṇa ca vasānī itivat dvi- vacanam |
ata eva ekapalliprayoge dvivacanānta eva mantraḥ |
anyatra tu ekavacanānta eva iti nāsminmate vikalpo'pi, iti prāpte, yajamānaparatve paśorāśāsanasya tāvat siddhatvenaiva vaiyarthyam |
dakṣiṇādīnāṃ ca aśrutānāṃ kalpanāt na tadāśāsanamapi saṃbhavati |
ataḥ devasyādi- vyavahārasiddhayarthaṃ devatāyā api svīkārālasyasaṃbandhasya tṛtīye sādhitatvāt samādāya meghapatitvopapatteḥ devatā- paratvameva |
vacanaṃ tu taduktarītyaiva devatātvasya abhī- ṣṭomayoḥ vyāsajyavṛttitvāt ekalopapatteḥ adhiṣṭhānabhedena ca dvilopapatteḥ mamāpyupapannameva |
kartṛtva iva ca deva- tātve'pi meghapatitvaṃ sāmānyādhikaraṇyadeva upapannaṃ iti na kācit kṣatiḥ |
evaṃ ca vikalpo'pi phalamukhatvāt na doṣāya |
oṃ meghapatitvaṃ svāmidevatvasya samavāyāt sarvatra ca prayuktāt tasya cānyāniyatatvāt sarvatraivāvikāraḥ syāt |
agnigṛheṣu ekeṣāṃ śākhinām 'meghapataye megham' iti evamiha |
anyeṣāṃ śākhināṃ tu 'meghapatibhyāṃ megham' iti dvivacanāt |

anayormantrayoḥ paśugaṇe vikṛtiṣu avikāreṇa prayogaḥ, uta dvivacanasya devatāpara ūhaḥ : ekavacanasya tu yajamānaparaḥ, athavā ubhayoryaja- mānapara eva, athavā ubhayordevatāpara ūhaḥ iti vicāre prathama pakṣamāha |
svāmī yajamānaśca agnī- ṣomau devatā ca tasmātsārvasvāmidevatvam |
sarvatra ca deśeṣu ā himavataḥ ā ca kumārībhyaḥ patiśabdasya ādhipatye prayuktatvāt |
tasya ca ekavacanāntameghapatiśabdaghaṭitasya dvivacanāntameghapatiśabdaghaṭitasya ca mantrasya prakṛtau eva anyāniyatatvāt ekavacanena dvivacanena vā trayāṇāṃ meghapatitvaṃ vaktumaśakyatvāt |
tatraiva sati ekatvaṃ dvitvaṃ vā aviśiṣṭatvā prātipadikārthamātreṇa prakṛtau mantrayoḥ prayogasya svīkṛtatvāt vikṛtāvapi tathaiva prayogāt na doṣaḥ |
tasmāt paśugaṇe anūhaiva mantrayoḥ prayogaḥ syāt ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
patiśabdasya ādhipatye sarvatra ca prayuktatvāt, samavāyāt svāmidevatvasya meghapatitvaṃ syāt |
ekavacanāntasya dvivacanāntasya ca mantrasya anyāniyatatvāt prātipadikārthamātravivakṣayā ca sarva- traiva prakṛtau vikṛtau ca mantrayorvikāraḥ syāt |
agnigṛheṣu meghapatiśabdaḥ kvacit ekavacanāntaḥ paṭhitaḥ, kvacit dvivacanāntaḥ meghapatibhyāṃ iti |
tayoravikāreṇa paśugaṇeṣu prayoga iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ uktaḥ, taṃ nirākaroti apivāśabdaḥ |
meghapatiśabdasya dvisamavāye bhaviṣyati svāmini devatādvandve ceti dvayoḥ samavāyaḥ |
yeṣāmekavacanānto meghapatiśabdaḥ teṣāṃ sa svāminamabhipretya syāt |
yeṣāṃ tu dvivacanāntaḥ teṣāṃ agnīṣomau abhipretya syāt |
evaṃ aryānyatve arthayoḥ svāmidevatyoḥ anyatve bhinnatve yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prayogaḥ syāt |

prakṛtau ekavacanāntasya svāmimantrasya prayogaḥ dvivacanāntasya devatādvandvasya prakṛtau prayogaḥ dvivacanāntasya devatādvandvamegha prakṛtau prayogaḥ bahīṣu devatāsu satīṣu ūhena prayogaḥ iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ
svāmyapekṣayā ekavacanāntaḥ devatāpekṣayā dvivacanāntaḥ iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ |
svāmino vailakṣaṇyādutkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt patnyā dvitīyaśabdaḥ syāt |
agnīṣome megha- patiśabdaḥ svāmino bodhakaḥ syāt |
ekavacanāntaḥ yaja- mānaparaḥ dvivacanāntastu devatāparaḥ iti vailakṣaṇyaṃ tu na yuktaṃ aikavacanāt ekasya śabdasya ekasminneva vākye anekārthatvasya anyāyyatvāt |
nanu dvividho'pi meghapatiśabdau devatāpaveva ki na syātāṃ iti cet, ekavacanāntameghapatiśabdasya ekadevatāke vikāre utkarṣaḥ syāt, sa ca prakaraṇaviruddhaḥ |
nanu dvivacanasya kā gatiḥ : svāmiparatve ? ucyate |
dvitīyaśabdaḥ dvivacanaṃ patnyā syāt patnīṃ abhipretya yujyate |
tathā na prakṛtau yajamānamabhipretya meghapataye ityekavacanaṃ palīyajamānau abhipretya meghapatityāṃ iti dvivacanam |
paśugaṇe yatra yajamānavicchinneḥ tatra ūhena tayoḥ pravṛttiḥ : meghapati- śabdaḥ naiva devatāparaḥ iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
devatā tu tadāśīṣṭvāt saṃtrāptatvāt svāminya- narthikā syāt |
tuśabdena tṛtīyaṃ pakṣaṃ nirasya caturthaṃ siddhāntapakṣamāha |
tadāśīṣṭvāt tābhyāṃ devatābhyāṃ āśāsyate haviranena sa mantraḥ tadāśīḥ ; tasya bhāvaḥ tadāśīṣṭvaṃ tasmāt devatāparatvaṃ mantrāmeghapati- śabdasya |
'āśāsānā meghapatityāṃ meghaṃ upanayata meghyā duraḥ' iti |
svāmini tu meghapatiśabdasya svāmi- paratve tu sā āśīḥ anarthikā syāt saṃtrāptatvāt svāminaḥ paśuḥ prāpta eva pūrvamapi, iti punarāśāsanaṃ vyartham |
yat tasmin yajamāne patitvaṃ meghapatitvaṃ tat bhaktyā gauṇyā vṛttyā |
utsargāt 'agnīṣomābhyāmidaṃ mī. ko. 397 na mama' iti yajamānena paśostyāgaḥ kṛto bhavati iti utsargakartṛtvāt guṇāt yajamānasya meghapatitvaṃ syāt |

agnigṛheṣvatameghapatiśabdasya devatāparatve dvivadete dvivadetāke paśugaṇe ekasaṃyuktaḥ ekavacanānto meghapati- śabdaḥ asaṃbhavat na saṃbhavatīti kṛtvā utkṛṣṭyeta meghapati- śabdasya ekadevatāke paśau utkarṣaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt iti yaduktaṃ 'utkarṣo devatāyāṃ syāt' (9|3|12|14) ityatra tat parihartavyam |
agnigṛheṣvatameghapatiśabdaḥ ekaḥ yaḥ agnīṣomayo- rgaṇaḥ tatparaḥ |
samavāyāt tasmin gaṇe meghapati- śabdasya vācakatvena saṃvandhāt |
'āśāsānā meghapataye devatāgaṇāya meghaṃ upanayata' iti ucyate |
tasya gaṇasya ca tallakṣaṇatvāt saḥ ekatvarūpaḥ gaṇaḥ lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tādṛśa- tvāt |
tasmāt ekavacanānto gaṇavācī megha- patiśabdaḥ : ekadevatāke paśau notkarṣaṇīyaḥ |
agnigṛheṣvatameghapatiśabdaḥ dvivacanānto'pi kvacit paṭhyate meghapatibhyāṃ iti |
tasya devatāparatve'pi na virodhaḥ saṃsargāt agnīṣomātmakadevatāgaṇasya |
dvābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭo ekatāṃ yātaḥ tasmāt ekavacanāntaḥ dvivacanānto'pi ca meghapatiśabdaḥ prakaraṇa- meva abhiniviśate |
tasmāt virodhābhāvāt tena dvivacanāntena saha ekavacanāntasya vikalpaḥ syāt prakṛtā- veva |
tatra ekavacane ekatve vivakṣite'pi guṇānapāyāt ekatvasya guṇasya agnīṣomurūpadevatāgaṇe antarbhūte agnī
some ca pratyekaṃ anapāyāt apāyābhāvāt tadvidhayā 'medhyate medhaṃ upanayata' iti vaktuṃ śakyatvāt eka- vacanāntāsyāpi mantrasya prakaraṇāt ūhaḥ |
abhrila- somatvākāreṇa ca dvitvāt dvivacanamapi upapannam |
tassāt devatānusāreṇa vikṛtau medhapaśabdasya ūhaḥ na yajamānānusāreṇa iti siddhāntaḥ |
(0 devatyasya iti supāṭhaḥ :) iti ādyasragatamedhapatvaśabdasya 'svāmino vā0' iyanantarasūtre anupaktasya luptabhāvapratyayasyanuṣaṅgaḥ |
su. pṛ. 647. medhapaśabdasya abhrigupaiśagatasya ekavacanā- ntasya ekādaśinyāṃ bahutvāntena ūhaḥ |
bhā. 9|3| 14|44. mīko. pṛ. 340 'abhrigupaiśagatasya medhapa- śabdasyaikevacanāntasya ekādaśinyāmḥ ' ityatra adhi- kāraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
medhapaśabdasya abhrigupaiśagatasya eka- vacanāntasya bahutvadevate paśau dvivacanāntena vikalpaḥ |
9|3|12|3|42-43. mīko. pṛ. 340 'abhrigupaiśa- gatasya medhapaśabdasyaikavacanāntasya bahutvadevate paśau |
itihāse ca vidhau sati ādimattādoṣo vedasya prasajyate |
astu it cet tathā sati tasyā- prāmāṇyāt medhātitherhi kāṇvāyanasya medhaḥ ityamasiddhaḥ |
amīṣomīyapaśugatābhrigupaiśaḥ prāsmedhapaghaṭitaḥ atirātragatāṃ sārasvatyāṃ medhyāṃ na paṭhanīyaḥ |
tatra paśavaḥ samā- mnātāḥ : 'āgneyaḥ paśupuroḍāśo'labhyaḥ, aindrāgnaḥ paśurūpye, aindro vṛṣṇiḥ ṣoḍaśini, sārasvatī medhya- tirāne' iti |
asti tu amīṣomīye abhrigupaiśaḥ 'upanayata medhyā dura āśaśānā medhapatīyaṃ medham' iti |
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ sārasvatyāṃ medhyāmabhriguvacanaṃ kartavyam, neti |
samānavidhāneṣve paśuṣu, aprāptā sārasvatī meṣī abhriguvacanam |
viśiṣṭhaliṅgo dvyiguvacanena nirdiṣṭaḥ, 'prāsmā agniṃ bharata' iti puṃṣaṣṭhaḥ, strītvaṃ cāsyāḥ |
dup-- caturṣu paśuṣvacanānto'samartha eva prāsmedha- śabdaḥ |
vacanena yathā prātipadikaṃ noktabhūte tathā vākyam : pāśādhikaraṇe (9|3|14) |
strī tu puṃliṅgena na śakyate vaditum |
tasmāt medhyāmabhāvo yuktaḥ, asamavetārtha- tvāditi siddhāntavādī manyate, 'liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśāt' iti |
paśvabhidhānādvā, taddhi codanābhūtaṃ, puṃviṣayaṃ punaḥ paśutvam |
samānaṃ prakaraṇaṃ sarveṣāṃ paśunāmiti kṛtvā cintyate |
tadabhipretya 'prāsmā agniṃ bharata paśavaḥ' iti brūyāt |
striyaṃ puṃśabdo na śaknotya- bhivaditumiti prathama eva pakṣaḥ saṃkīrtitaḥ |
dup-- 'viśeṣo vā tadarthanirdeśāt' iti siddhānta- sūtreṇa prathamasūtrārtha eva smārthate |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, paśusvāmiprāyametadava- nam, eko hi śabdaḥ paśusya ca paśośca, tena prāsme paśava ityabhisaṃbandho bhaviṣyatīti |
asmeśabdo'pi, tayoryat sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tat prati ucyate |
bhāṣyam-- yathoktaṃ syāt abhriguvacanaṃ aprāptā sārasvatī |
yaduktam, paśuśabdasamānādhikaraṇaḥ sarvanāmaśabdaḥ prayo- kṣyate iti, tanna |
uccaritamātro yaḥ padārthaḥ śabdena saṃnihitaḥ, tena saṃśrayate |
atha tasminsati liṅgādisarva- viśeṣaviśiṣṭe rūpeṇa saṃnihite prayujyate |
saṃnidhāne naikena viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭaṃ vyaktimabhidadhuṃ śaknoti |
saṃnidhānāt tatraikaṃ sāmānyaṃ āśrīyate, nānyat kiñcit paśutvādi |
tatrocyamānaṃ paśuśabde, śabdena vyakte- niṣkṛṣṭe paśūtve, 'asmai paśave' iti śakyate saṃbandhaḥ kartum |
kimamīpomīyārthāḥ paśudharmā uta sādhāraṇā ityasminnadhikaraṇe prayojanāya vicāro'yam |
dup-- 'yathoktaṃ vā saṃnidhānāt' iti pūrvapakṣa- vādinā yaduktaṃ tadetena nirākriyate |
uccaritamātraḥ sarvanāmaśabdo yatpadāntareṇa saṃnidhāpyate, tena saha śīghraṃ saṃbadhyate |
na ceha paśuśabda uccaritaḥ, yena saṃbandhaḥ syāt |
'liṅgādisarvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭe rūpeṇa saṃnihite prayujyate' iti ko'rthaḥ : (ādipadena yatpaśuśabdaḥ sa ko'rthaḥ : iti praśnaḥ) |
tacca vidyamānaṃ yadi viparivartate praka- raṇasaṃnihitam |
saṃnidhāne naikena viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭaṃ vyaktimabhidadhuṃ śaknuvanti |
yadyapi strīliṅgamapi saṃnihitaṃ tathāpyasamarthaḥ śabdastatra vartitum, puṃliṅga- tvāt |
uccāryamāṇaḥ paśuśabdaḥ : 'prāsme paśave' iti puṃliṅgena puṃliṅgaśabdaḥ śakyaḥ saṃbandhayitum |
asmin pakṣe vyaktio niṣkṛṣya paśutvam, tena saha saṃbadhyate asmeśabdaḥ; na vyaktyā |

śā-- prakaraṇaviśeṣatvāt 'prāsmā agniṃ bharata' iti ca puṃliṅgaḥ asmeśabdaśca niyataliṅgaśabdatvābhidheya- paśutvābhiprāyeṇa 'prāsme paśave' ityevaṃ striyāmapi upa- patterliṅgavirodhābhāvāt tasmāpi sārasvatībhriguvacanam |
dravyaṃ, tatra prayukto'yaṃ puṃliṅgaṃ vadituṃ kṣamaḥ |
( na ca pāśān iti bahutvavat vimaktivācyaliṅgasya avivakṣayā pravṛttiḥ syāt iti vācyam |

trikaṃ prātipadikārthaḥ iti liṅgasyāpi prāti- padikārthatvāt, vibhaktivikārāṇāṃ sme-ityādīnāṃ tātrā- dīnāṃ ca vācye liṅga iti pakṣe'pi meṣyatirāiktapaśuṣu liṅgasya samavāyena vivakṣāyāṃ saṃbhavantyāmavivakṣākalpa- nasya ayuktatvāt iti bhāvaḥ |

tatra ekapaśukṣe tu teṣāṃ samucitānāṃ sahā- yatvatayā agniguvacanasya pratipadyavācyabhāvena ca itara- padārthatayā vacanamanāhatya pravṛttyavadarthatvāt apravṛtti- śabdena meṣyanabhidhānameva vivakṣitam, na tu sarvottamā pravṛttyabhāvaḥ
‘puṃvanamithune’ (śau.sū. 3|2|2) ityanena strīpuṃsa- samavāye puṃliṅgasyaiva vidhānāt kṛtvācintodāhṛtame'pya- nūhaḥ |
upa- ridhāraṇe paridadhāti iti sahasraśaḥ prayogāt tatra ekasmā eva vatsalatvo vidhānasaṃbhave meṣyadhikaraṇanyāyena eka- vacanalakṣaṇayā anyāyattatvāt uparidhāraṇe eva vatsalatvo vidhānam |
bhāṭṭa. 1|2|1. ‘maitraṃ śvetamālameta, vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇam, apāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca saṃdhāvanakramaḥ’ |
iti asyāṃ vikṛtau jyotiṣṭomīyāmī- yomīyapaśuprakaraṇasthaparāmantrayoḥ ekavacanadvivacanāntyoḥ atideśaḥ |
tatra ca ubhayoryā dibvacanāntatvena vipari- ṇāmaḥ kartavyaḥ |

vi. 9|2|4, ‘maitraṃ śvetamālameta, vāruṇaṃ kṛṣṇam’ iti dvipaśuke dhāge abhigrupame ‘sūrye cakṣurmagyamatāt, vātaṃ prāṇamanvavasjatāt, diśaḥ śrotram’ ityādau cakṣurādiśabde dvivacanāntatvenoho na kartavyaḥ |
maitrāvārhaspatyo yāgaḥ rājasūye ratnināṃ haviṣṣu anyatamaḥ |
tatra ‘svayaṃ kṛtā vedirbhavati, svayaṃ kṛta idhmaḥ’ |
iti udvananādikaṃ na kartavyam, barhistaraṇā- dikaṃ tu kartavyam |
vi. 10|1|9. maitrāyaṇīyānāṃ agniḥ anvārohyeṣu parisamāpyate na sarvasām |
bhā. 2|4|2|0. maitrāyaṇīyānāṃ ‘sa eṣa śraḥ pratigṛhyate’ ityekarūpopakramopasaṃhāravidhinā vispaṣṭameva pratigrahīturvihitamiti gamyate, tathāpi taitti- rīyaśākhāvākyena dāturvihitaḥ |
atha ca guṇāḥ śrūyante ‘ṛtavo vai prayājā samānīya hotavyāḥ’ |
iti bhā. 2|4|1|31. maitrāvaruṇa eva ṛtuyājeṣu preṣān brūyāt |
saṃkarṣa. 2|3|13. mīko. pṛ. 2877 maitrāvaruṇa maitrāvaruṇa eva’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
maitrāvaruṇaḥ preṣe adhvaryuvikāraḥ anuvacaneṣu ca hotṛvikāraḥ |
bhā. 10|7|6|19, maitrāvaruṇaḥ mitrāvaruṇo ‘mitraṃ vayaṃ havāmahe’ iti punarapyadhīte some yajati |
3|2|1|10. maitrāvaruṇaḥ yatra praiṣaśanānuvākyā ca sahocyete tatraiva, na kevalapreṣeṣu kevalānuvacaneṣu ca |
3|7|2|13-44. maitrāvaruṇaḥ sadasi sthitvā preṣyati adhvaryustu uttaravedyāṃ sthitvā |
ayaṃ ardhī dakṣiṇāyā ardhaṃ ṣaḍ gāḥ labhate |
maitrāvaruṇaṃ prati- prakṣyātā dīkṣayati dvādaśāhai dīkṣayatām |
bhā. 12|2|131. ‘maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati’ iyaṃ saṃpradāne caturthī kārakavibhakti- rūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 44, maitrā- varuṇāya daṇḍadānaṃ arthakarma, na pratipattiḥ jyotiṣṭome |
bhāṭṭa. 4|2|6, maitrāvaruṇāya satre sarveṣāṃ daṇḍānāṃ dānam |
10|7|6-19. mīko. pṛ. 119 ‘agnī- pomīye paśau maitrāvaruṇasya’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
maitrāvaruṇasya amīpomīye paśau eka eva bhāgaḥ |
10|7|20-21. mīko. pṛ. 118 ‘agnīpomīye paśau maitrāvaruṇasya eka eva bhāgaḥ’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
maitrāvaruṇasya grahasyaivaṃ śrapaṇaṃ ‘payasā maitrā- varuṇaṃ śrīṇāti’ iti vacanāt |
bhā. 7|2|3|8. maitrāvaruṇau āmiṣyā vaiśvadevyāḥ āmiṣāyāḥ dharmāṇāṃ grāhikā |
varuṇīmāmikāṃ vaśā dakṣiṇā’ itīyaṃ caturthī aveṣṭiḥ rājasūye |
bhāṭṭa. 1|1|4|13. maitrāvaruṇyāmāmikāyāṃ ‘na vājinaṃ pracaranti’ iti niṣedhaḥ |
maitrāvaruṇāmiheṣu śrayaṇādyeṣu payaādiṣu pradeya- dharmā nānuṣṭheyāḥ |
10|1|62-64, kāmasaṃyoge- 'pi aindrāvāyavasa grahasya pāṭhaprāpte sthāne evānuṣṭhānam |
vi. 10|1|17, maitrāvaruṇagrahaḥ jyoti- ṣṭome prātaḥsavane grahate |

na ca prāguttamapi ekameva mānavatvāt bhinnaṃ vakṣupādāya tenaiva pratyahaṃ upāvaharaṇa (ahargaṇe) kartavyamiti vācyam, upāvaharaṇavatsya śrāvastṛ dānavidhānāt tasya ca maitrāvaruṇadaṇḍadānanyāyena grāvastotrīyānuvacanāva- studutsahajanakalane prātyahikatvāttvaṃbhāvāt |
vidyamānāyā evāyaṃ ekadeśasaṃyogaḥ na tu anyataḥ |
maitrāvaruṇapraiṣe savanīyapaśugate ‘ayaṃ yajamānaḥ’ ityatra ‘ayaṃ sutāsutī yajamānaḥ’ iti pāṭhavikāraḥ |

katham ? yo hi dehāt viviktaṃ anantaṃ ajaṃ amaraṃ adaḥ-lamātmānaṃ jānāti, tasya dehasaṃyogaviraktasya pūrvakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalopabhogena kṣayāt tannimitte śarīre patite anāgatānāṃ ca karmaṇāmananuṣṭhānādeva asattvāt dehāntarātutpatteḥ atyantasaṃbandhaḥ śarīreṇa bhavati |
tena niṣpannānāṃ dehānāṃ yaḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ yaśca anutpannānāṃ prāgabhāvaḥ sa mokṣaḥ |
ratnākaraḥ. saṃbandhakṣepa- parihāre 106. mokṣasya dharmaviśeṣasyāpi brāhmaṇapari- vrājakavat medenopādānam |
su. pṛ. 127. ‘mokṣārthī na pravartate tatra kāmyaniṣiddhayoḥ |
’ (ślovā. saṃcandhakṣepaparihāre 110) ityanena nyāyena kāmya- niṣiddhavarjanāt tatphalopabhogāthai śarīrānulattiḥ |
su. pṛ. 329. yaḥ svargaṃ na kāmayate bandhātmakatvāt mokṣārthī tasya karmasvarūpa eva kartavyatā (na phale) |
ṭup. 6|3| 112 pṛ. 1106, mokṣārthinā'pi avaśyaṃ pāpakṣaya eṣitavyaḥ; tasmin (a- )sati mokṣābhāvāt |
vicitra- vāsanāvarośena vicitranīlapītādirūpeṇa pravahato jñānasaṃtā- nasya niḥśeṣavāsanocchedāt nīlapītādivaicitryaṃ hitvā kevalaṃ saṃvinmātramevāvasthānaṃ iti kecit |
avidyā- nirmito hi prapañcaḥ svapnaprapañcavat pragodhenaiva brahmavidyayā avidyāyāṃ vilīnāyāṃ svayameva vilīyate |
tathāhi śrutiḥ ‘yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati taditara itaraṃ paśyati, yatra tvasya sarvamātmaivābhūt tat kena kaṃ paśyet’ iti |
nutpattiḥ ? utpādakyoḥ dharmādharmayoḥ niḥśeṣataḥ parikṣayāt ! rāṣṭraṃ syām' iti rāṣṭrasya bhoktā ityarthaḥ, yathā 'yaḥ |
kāmayeta sarvamidaṃ bhaveyam' iti sarvasya bhoktā bhaveya- |
nanu evaṃ aśeṣadharmakṣayāt mukasya na kiñcit mityarthaḥ, tathā 'ātmā sarvam' iti sarvasyātmā |
sukhaṃ syāt, tataśca apuruṣārthā mokṣaḥ syāt |
nahi dharmajanyo muktasya ānandaḥ, tathā yattu 'yatra hi dvaitamiva bhavati' iti dvaitābhāvasya |
svābhāvikastu ānandaḥ saṃsā- indrajāla-mṛgatoyādiḥ kiyantaṃcit kālaṃ dṛṣṭamapannaḥ |
reṇābhibhūtaḥ san, nirmuktasaṃsārasya abhivyakto bhogyo paścāt vilīno bhogyatāmitavartate, tathā artha śarīre- |
svābhāvikatve ca ānandasya 'ānandaṃ brahma' ndriyaviṣayasyaprapañco'pi asya ātmanaḥ kiyantaṃcit |
nanu sukhābhāve'pi śruti- kālaṃ upabhogyaḥ san paścāt vināśāt anupabhogyo |
rasti 'aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ na priyāpriye spṛśataḥ' iti |
bhavati ityanena sādṛśyena bhrāntaḥ iti upacāreṇocyate, |
satyam, viṣayasukhābhiprāyaṃ tu evaṃjātīyakam, anyathā puruṣāṇāṃ viṣayabhogeṣu ātmānirvartanena muktau abhiruciṃ |
vacanameva duḥkhabhāvābhiprāyaṃ kimiti na vyākhyāyate iti muktau ātmanaḥ advaitatvavacanam, tadapi na |
sukhābhāvavacanānāṃ alpatvāt teṣāmeva anyathā- prapañcasvarūpaniṣedhārtham, kintu sata eva prapañcasya |
ānandaśabdasya duḥkhabhāvaparatve atyantasvārthahāniḥ nahi atra etāvaducyate 'yatra sarvaṃ ātmaivābhūt' |
syāt, sukhaśabdasya tu sāmānyavacanasya viśeṣe'pi iti, kiṃ tarhi ? 'yatra tvasya sarvamātmaiva' iti |
vyākhyāne nāti svārthahāniḥ iti tadeva yuktam |
asyāyamarthaḥ : yatra yasyātmanastathā muktau ityarthaḥ, asya |
nanu vidyamāno'pi ānandaḥ ananubhūyamānaḥ : aki- ātmanaḥ dṛśyatvena darśanasādhanatvena darśanāyatanatvena vā |
na ca yuktam sarvakaraṇasya ānandā- na kiñcit anyat saṃbandhaṃ vidyate, kintu ātmaivāsya |
svaprakāśo'yamānandaḥ : iti cet, sarvaṃ nānyat kiñcit tadā kena kaṃ paśyediti |
nanu tatrāpi ānandasvabhāvaḥ loke yasya na kiñcidapi bāndhavo vittaṃ vā'sti sa |
nahi asukhe evaṃ vadati 'na me kiñcidasti ahameva sarvam' |
(uttaram-) iti tatra saṃbandhavat na kiñcidasti ityetāvadvivakṣitam, |
kimidānīṃ asambhiḥ ātmā svarūpato'nubhūyate ? satya- evaṃ muktau ātmaivātmanaḥ sarvaṃ iti saṃ
na ca tadānīmapi bhavat na tādṛganubhava iti vācyam |
tasya ānandasya 'atrāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ' iti śrutisiddhasvaprakāśatāyā ātmasvarūpānandasya lokasiddha- kāraṇāntarānapekṣatvāt |
'vijñātāraṃ kena vijānīyāt asya sarva- mātmaivābhūt kena kaṃ paśyet' iti na mokṣakāle jñānā- bhāvapratipādakaśrutivibhedatvāt |
ātmanaśca vijñāna- sukhādirūpatvam 'ānandaṃ brahmaṇo vidvān' 'sa eko brahmaṇa ānandaḥ' iti śrutyā bhedapratīteḥ |
'mama na kimapi sukham, kevalaṃ duḥkhameva' ityanubhavāt |
'tā etāḥ aharaharbrahmaloke yanti, aharaharāgacchanti' iti suṣuptimuktayoḥ sādṛśyapratipādakaśrutyā ānandā
mlecchebhyaḥ anyajanapadavāsibhyaḥ āryāvartanivā- sināṃ samīcīnataraḥ ācāro bhavati |
' vā. 1|3|6|10, yastu kathamapi avinaṣṭa eva śabdaḥ mlecchānāmapi prayogaviṣayamāpannaḥ |
tasya ca āryāvarte anādivṛddha- vyavahāraparaṃparayā arye jānanti tat kiṃ teṣāṃ nirākartuṃ śakyate |

ṛju. pṛ. 165. yāni punaḥ anu- papannavedabhāvamānāṃ mlecchādīnāṃ atīndriyārthesmara- ṇāni teṣāṃ mūlakalpanāvelāyāmeva codanā saṃbhāvanāpadaṃ nārūḍhā iti mithyātvahetubhūtatacchutyapariśeṣāt apramāṇa- tvam |
saṃbhāṣitāyāṃ punaścodanāyāṃ kāraṇāntaraniṣedhe kṛte nirmūlatvāt pariśeṣasiddhaṃ codanāmūlatvam |
ananteṣu hi deśeṣu kaḥ siddhaḥ kaveti gamyatām |
' vā. 1|3|4|9 pṛ. 219. mlecchaprasiddho'rthaḥ pikanemādiśabdānāṃ grāhyaḥ, na tu nigamanisktādinā kalpanīyaḥ |
āryāvirodhe āryāsiddhau ca mlecchasiddhirapi ādara- ṇīyā |
vi. 1|16, mlecchaprasiddhyā varāhaśabdasya kṛṣṇakunirarthaḥ, sa na grāhyaḥ |
ārya- prasiddhayā tu sūkara ityartho grāhyaḥ |

1|3|5. mlecchabhāṣā ' na mlecchabhāṣāṃ śikṣeta ' ityevamādisamṛtinusāreṇa himavadvindhyāntarālakṛṣṇamṛgaśca- raṇādyupalakṣitadharmādhikṛtāryāvartanivāsibhyatiriktamarvādi- bhāṣāgatasya mlecchatvalakṣaṇamādhikaraṇāpavādalanāt tena bhāṣaṇaṃ pratiṣidhyate |
yukte ca tasya aśeṣatadīyā- caraṇavat pariharaṇīyatvam |
ya 'yajatiṣu dravyaphalabhoktṛsaṃyogāt' ( 2|3| 5|14) iti nyāyena yāgaṃ vinā dravyadevatātyāgayoḥ |
su. pṛ. 749. yajatiḥ bhāvanāvidhānārthaḥ : 'darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta ' ityādi |
bhā. 1|1|2| 13, yajatiḥ yatra śrūyate tatra ahīnabhūtasya dvāda- śāhasya pravṛttiḥ |
kimarthaṃ tarhi darśapūrṇamāsaśabdaḥ ? nityānuvādamātram ( śrutyarthavidhāna- pakṣe ) |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|14. yajateḥ na vivakṣā guṇa phalakalpanāyām |
maṇi. pṛ. 102. yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karoti nānuyājeṣu ' ayaṃ ṛtvarthaḥ uddeśyaviśeṣaṇaparyyudāsa- vidhiḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 20, yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karoti nānuyājeṣu ' ayaṃ paryudāsavidhiḥ : dṛṣṭārthaḥ |
pṛ. 21. yajatiṣu ' ye yajāmahe ' iti mantraḥ anārabhya- vādena prātaḥ |
tatra anuyājavarjiteṣu yajatiṣu ' ye yajāmahaṃ karoti ' iti paryudāsaḥ na tu vikalpaḥ |

yajatyarthaḥ : ' idaṃ dravyaṃ netṛprabhṛti kasmiścit svakārye viniyogyāmi ' iti saṃkalpa rūpe mānase tyāge, vācika ca na mametiśabdoccāraṇarūpe kṛte'pi hastādinā upādāya kvaciddeśe nikṣepa rūpaṃ kāyikaṃ tyāgaṃ vinā yāgāparyavasānam |
su. pṛ. 1627. yajatyarthasya yat kāryaṃ tat pradhānam |
bhā. 9|1|12|1 varṇaka 2. yajaticodanaḥ somaḥ, davihomāḥ punaḥ juhoti- codanāḥ |
vi. 10|6| 16. yajaticodanāt svāmināṃ ca asiyatapari- māṇatvāt ahīnatvam |
atra sūtre yāgalakṣaṇaṃ ucyate yāgaprayogo vā kathyate |
yajaticodanā yajati yajeta iti yajadhātuḥ dravyaṃ ca devatā ca ' na mama ' iti tyāgarūpā kriyā ca teṣāṃ samāhāraṃ dravyadevatākriyaṃ bravīti, etāvān yāgapadārthaḥ |
yajaticodanāyāḥ samudāye dravyadevatātyāgasamudāye kṛtārtha- tvāt ayaṃtaḥ paripūrṇatvāt |
ke. ' yajaticodanā dravyadevatākriyaṃ samudāye kṛtārtha- tvāt ' ityatra devatoddeśyakastvatyāgo yāgaḥ, sa eva prakṣepahito homaḥ iti vakṣyate |
ku. 3|4|18|4|7. utpannaśiṣṭaguṇavidhau tu utpattivākyasthitamādi- padasya dravyasāmānyaparatve tatpadavaiyarthyāpattiḥ |
taddhitārthā- syeti sarvanāmnā ' yajaticodanā dravyadevatākriyaṃ ' iti nyāyena yāgacodanāmātreṇa ca dravyasāmānyalābhāt |
' āgneyo'ṣṭākapālo bhavati ' ' vaiśvadevyāmiṣkā ' ityādau dravyadevatāsaṃbhavāmātreṇa juhoteraśravaṇādāra- pyotsargādāvica tyāgamātraṃ kṛtārthaṃ nāhūtiḥ |

iti prāpte, yajaterdevapūjādānātyataravācitvena devatā gandhādibhi- rijyate, viprādya dīyate ityādau ca tyajyamānadravyasya prakṣepāntāpratīterdevatāvigrahabhāvena parasvatvamātrayānu- tapāvatyasyaiva prakṣepaḥ |
ata eva ' madhye'marājyāhutīḥ paścāhutīḥ puroḍāśāhutīśca juhoti ' iti śrutirupādyate |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|1. yajaticodanotpattiṣu punaḥ siddhayoḥ tyāga- devatoddeśayoḥ juhotiḥ pravartamānaḥ prakṣepamātravacano vijñāyate |
vā. 3|4|14|4|1 pṛ. 986. yajaticodanatve sati aharguṇāsādhyatvamahīna- tvam |
yajati-dadāti-juhoti-ityādibhyaḥ yajyādya- rthaśca gamyate bhāvayediti ca |
yajatipadyāsāt karmabhedaḥ ' samidho yajati, tanūnapātaṃ yajati ' ityādī |
yajatiśabdavācyameva dharmaṃ samānanti ' yajena yajñamajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan ' iti |
bhā. 1|1|2|12. ' yajanīye'hni somaśceda vāruṇyāṃ diśi dṛśyate |
bāla. pṛ. 30. yajamānaḥ : eka eva jyotiṣṭome |
vi. 3|1| 14, ' yajamānaḥ ekakapālaḥ ' ityatra ekakapālasya yajamānaśabdatve stutiḥ, na tu yajamānaśabdo nāmadheyaṃ nāpi guṇavidhiḥ |
yajamānaḥ gṛhapatireva satre śukrāntarambhādiyājamānakartā, na yaḥ ko'pi |
bhā. 9|3|16|20. yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ ' iti samā- nnāyate |
tatra kimatra guṇavidhiḥ kimarthavādaḥ iti sandehe evaṃjātīyakaḥ arthavādaḥ na vidhiḥ |
iti siddhāntaḥ ( ' yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ ' iti yajamānaśabdaḥ prastarasya stāvakaḥ, ubhayoḥ karmasādhakatvāt ) |
10|4|7|12-15. yajamāna: yatra guṇabhūto vidhīyate, tatra yena kenacit yajamānena sa vidhiḥ sidhyati, yathā ‘yajamāna-saṃmitaudumbarī bhavati’ ‘śukraṃ yajamāno'nvārabhate’ iti|
bhā. 9|1|13|40, ‘yajamāno yūpaḥ’ iti tatra guṇa-vidhiḥ arthavādaḥ iti saṃdehaḥ|
vi. 5|2|5. ‘yajamāno vā ekakapāleṣu vaiśvānaryāṃ ca vapāyām’ ityādinā avadānena yajamānasya maraṇamuktam|
saṃkarṣa. 2|2|16. yājamānāneva padārthān parikriyādīn kurvan yajate ityucyate yajamānaḥ|
yajamānena karmasu tyāgaḥ svayaṃ kartavyaḥ; itarat ṛtvigdvārā|
yajamānena brīhimayaṃ saṃkalpya na yavamayo dātavyaḥ: ‘nādṛtaṃ vadet’ iti niṣedhāt|
vā. 3|4|14|13 pṛ. 143. ‘yajamānena aratnineva’ iti vacanāt yūpadeḥ pañcāratnivādapi yajamānasya aratnineva|
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|19. yajamānena sāṅkakarmaṇi tyāgamātraṃ kartavyam, itarat sarvamṛtvigbhiḥ kartavyam, tadarthameva teṣāṃ parikrītatvāt|
sākṣāt paraṃparayā ca yajamānasyaiva sarvakartṛtvāt phalabhoktṛtvaṃ yajamānasya na viruddham|
3|17|8. yathe dakṣiṇā yajamānena vibhajya yasya yāvān bhāga ābhanati svayameva tasya tāvān kalpayitavyaḥ, na pariṣadā|
bhā. 10|3|12|150. yathaiva adhvaryuṇā padārthāḥ kartavyāḥ tathaiva yajamānena pramādārthaṃ pratyavekṣitavyāḥ|
vā. 3|8|7|17, yajamānāt bhakṣo nāpanīyate hotṛḥ yājyāpanaye'pi jyotiṣṭome ṛtugrahāyeṣu yajamānasya svayaṃjyāyāpākṣe|
3|12|8|144-46. yajamānasya anumantraṇaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ dvādaśānāṃ karmaṇāṃ madhye keṣucit|
bāla. pṛ. 97. yajamānasya aiṣṭikeṣu iḍādibhakṣāḥ santyeva jyotiṣṭome|
vi. 12|1|15. yajamānasya jyotiṣṭome ṛtugrahāyeṣu svayaṃjyāyāpākṣe vaṣaṭkāranimittaḥ asti bhakṣaḥ|
satre anyatamayajamānamaraṇe tatsthāne niyuktaḥ pratinidhireva yadyapi tasya yajamānadharmavat tathāpi na tasya satraphala-bhāktvam|
vā. 3|8|1|27, yajamānasya proṣita-syāpi dravyatyāgena upapadyate yajamānatvam|
3|8|326-28. yajamānasya yāni karmāṇi tānyanuṣṭhātumeva parikrītā ṛtvijaḥ|
vi. 3|8|10. yajamānasya yājyāyāḥ pakṣadvayaṃ vihitam, hotre pratyarpaṇaṃ svayaṃ voccāraṇaṃ jyotiṣṭome ṛtugrahāyeṣu|
vā. 3|12|8|144. yajamānasya somavamane somendracaruḥ prāyaścittaṃ na tu ṛtvijāmapi (yajamānasomapānasyāpattau somendracaruḥ)|
bhā. 3|8|2|14. sāyaṃ home kṛte yadā yajamānasya kadācidāpad bhavati tadā
vā. 2|4|16 pṛ. 508. yajamānādhvaryubhyāmubhābhyām ‘vājasya mā0’ iti mantro darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ paṭhanīyaḥ|
vi. 3|8|8. yajamānādhvaryubhyāmi ‘bhadram’ iti mantroktaṃ phalaṃ jyotiṣṭome upareveṣu|
vi. 3|8|16. yajamānādhvaryubhayaprayojyo ‘vājasya mā0’ iti mantraḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ|
bhā. 3|8|13|26. yajamānāvekṣitana patyavekṣitena cājyena homa ucyate|
saṃkarṣa. 3|4|2. yajamāna-ṛtvigbhayagāmi-phalavidhiḥ mantraḥ ‘kimatra, bhadraṃ tatrau saha’ iti|
bāla. pṛ. 63. yajamānaikatvaṃ jyotiṣṭomādau, yajamānadvitvaṃ kulāya-yajñe, yajamānabahutvaṃ satre|
vi. 3|8|10. yajamānagaṇakṛte karmaṇi ‘yajamānasaṃmitaudumbarī bhavati’ iti audumbarīsamānaṃ ekenaiva yajamānena na sarvaiḥ|
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|10. mīko. pṛ. 34 ‘amicayane citimāneṣu’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|

paraṃ tantraratne 'liṅgadarśanāccetisūtramākṣi- pati' ityavatāritatvāt saḥ asmin sūtre āvaśyakaḥ iti pratibhāti |
] ( 'liṅgadarśanācca' iti sūtramākṣi- pati ) caturdaśa trayodaśa iti ubhayatra ( pūrvapakṣe siddhā- nte ca ) tulyam |

upattitvākyavibhena ( puroḍāśādi- ) dravyeṇa bādhitatvāt ( sphyādīni ) karmāntaraṃ ( kalpayanti ) ityasya vākyasya karmāntarameva pūrvapakṣe vidheyaṃ ) āpa- tati iti ( liṅga- ) darśanaṃ ( upapannamiti |
na hi dravyasaṃyoga- mātreṇa ( devatāntareṇa ) karmāntaraṃ bhavati |
'caturdaśat juhoti' iti prākaraṇikepu sarvahomeṣu caturvattam ( vihitam ) |
tatraitāni daśa daśa dravyāṇi itaretyuktāni homasādhanāni ( na hīhiya- vacirepāṇi, sahavidhānāt ) |
tatraiṣāṃ pratidravyaṃ dravya- dāne gṛhyamāṇe bahūni caturvattāni bhavanti |
tadyadi ekasmād gṛhyeta, itareṣāṃ sādhanatvaṃ hīyeta |
( yadi tadanugraheṇa sarvebhyo gṛhyītvā hūyeta tata ekatvaṃ hīyeta ) |
tasmāt tatsatpatte abhya- syate yāgaḥ : ekaikena caturvattena |
yathā sāṃnāyye dve caturvatte ( gṛhītvā sakṛddhomaḥ |
tatra karmabhedādanyena saha pradāne sakṛt kriyamāṇe, itaradapi ( pradānaṃ ) ātmīyaṃ caturvattaṃ vivekena gṛhṇāti, itaradapi vive- kena tatra caturvattavidhāto nāsti |
iha tu ekatvāt karmaṇaḥ saha kriyamāṇe caturvattavidhātabhayādabhyasyate somayāgavat |
śā - 'sphyaśca kapālāni ca' ityanukramya 'etāni vai daśa yajñāyudhāni' iti śrutam |
tenāvagamyate yathaiṣa ārambhaḥ , sa iḍāyā mantra iti |
tanmadhyapatitaśca, upahūtā manuṣyā ityevamādiḥ , yajñapati vardhān ityantaḥ |
yajamānaṃ tu protsāhayituṃ vaditavya iti nāsti vākyam |
na ca sāmarthyamātreṇa vākyādate viniyogā bhavanti |
tasmādiyaṃ vacanavyaktiḥ , upahūtā manuṣyā ye yajñapatiṃ vardhayituṃ samarthā iti |
tatra yajñapati- viśiṣṭā vṛddhirvaktavyeti, ekasminni yajamāne kīrtite bhavati viśeṣaṇakāryam |
yathā yatra yajamāno guṇabhūto vidhīyate, tatra yena kenaciñjamānena sa vidhiḥ sidhyati |
ḍup- 'yajñapatiṃ vardhān' iti vṛddhā saha yajñapateḥ iḍāpadamanedyasya pratyakṣavākyatayā, iḍyā saha parokṣā iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
'sa yo haivaṃ vidāniḍā carati' ityanena iḍyā caritavyamiti vidhīyate |
adhvaryuśabdāvabhyāḥ sarve ṛtvijo lakṣaṇyā, 'upahūtā manuṣyāḥ' iti ta evocyante |
ye yajñamanti rakṣanti, ye ca yajñapati vardhayituṃ kṣamāstāha manuṣyā upahūtāḥ |

śā-- 'upahūtā manuṣyā ye yajñapatiṃ vardhān' iti ki etat yajñapativṛddhiprakāśane protsāhanakaraṇena tatsaṃsakārārthe sat anekayajamānakeṣu karmasu uditavyam, uta iḍāstulyathau yajñapatiśabdo noditavya iti (tadarthe ca kiṃ yajñapatiśabdābhidheyayajamānasaṃskārārthamidam, uta
vākyāccaiva balava- lliṅgama, dṛṣṭaṃ ceha prayojanam |
na pṛthag bhavituṃ śaktamataḥ stutyarthatā varam |
yacchabdena ca pārārthyaṃ vṛddheḥ śrutyā vidhī- yate |
soma- prakṛtau lākṣaṇikasyāpi dhānyaśabdasya yadi ūhaḥ, tadā kimu vaktavyaṃ prakṛtau mukhyasya yajñapati- śabdasya ityuktānāṃ saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrārthastu- codite- 'pi yajñapatiśabde parārthatvāt iḍāstulyatvāt avikāraḥ nohaḥ syāt |
yatra parārthatayā yajamāno vidhīyate 'śuklaṃ yajamāno'nvārabhate' ityādī, tatra yathā ekanāpi tatsiddhiḥ, evamihāpi ekayajamānavṛddhiprakāśa- nenāpi stutisiddhirti |
' pratyakṣaśrutyā kṛtano mantraḥ iḍopahāne viniyuktaḥ, iti nāsti satre ūhaḥ |
'dainyā adhyarvaya upahūtā upahūtā manuṣyā ya imaṃ yajamānaṃ ye yajñapatiṃ vardhayituṃ pravṛttāvuhya' ityādi |
tatra satre yajñapatiśabde nahavacanāttenohitavyo na iti cintāyām, na tāvadasametārthavattvādanūhaḥ : yajñapateḥ tadvṛddhaśca manuṣya- rūpādhupadavākyaṛtvikartṛkāḥ karmaṇi samavetatvāt |

na cāsya iḍopahānevākyapadakavākyatayā tadarthatvavāgmāt yajñapativṛddhiprakāśanārthatvābhāvena satyapi samavetārthatve parārthatvādūhaḥ; liṅgena mantragatavākyasya 'syonaṃ te' ititat vācena yajñapativṛddhirthatvopapatteḥ |

havaṃ vidāna iḍyā pracarati' iti vidhāya 'atha pratipadyate iḍopahūtopahūtāsmau iḍāhayatāmiḍopahṛte- tyāha' iti brāhmaṇavākyena pratīkagrahaṇena kṛtsnasya nigadasyeopāhāne viniyogāt tatsahakṛtena mantragata- vākyena mantraliṅgasyaiva bādha iti vācyam, brāhmaṇa- vākyena yāvadāpastasya viniyogapattī pratīkagrahaṇe pramāṇābhāvāt |
astu vā viniyogāntarakalpanāgaurava- bhiyā pratyakṣavākyenaiva pratīkagrahaṇe samastaviniyoga- kalpanam |
ata eva 'syonaṃ te' ityādī pratyakṣavini- yojakavākyābhāvāt apekṣitaviniyogādatrakalpane'pi na kṣatiḥ |
kiñca 'ye yajñapatiṃ vardhān' ityādau vacchabda- calādeva yajñapativṛddhikartṛṇāṃ manuṣyarūpaṛtvijamāpāhāna- karmatvaṃ pratīyate |
ata eva 'syonaṃ te' ityatrāpi yadi pūrvārthaṃ yacchabdaḥ syāt, tadā syādeva tatraikavākyatā, na tvetadastītyato mantramedo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ |
tathāpi prathanaśeṣabhūtasyāpi ' ūru te yajñapatiḥ prathatām ' iti mantrasyānupraṅgayajñapatiprotsāhanāhartavyatvāt tathā- tvopapatteḥ |
na hi protsā- hanāyeṣu ' āyadāṃ agne'syāyume dehi ' ityādiṣu satre nohaḥ : āvṛttirvā |
ataśca yadyapi nedaṃ prathamaphalam, tathāpi ānuṣaṅgikaprotsāhanāmātreṇohatya ihāpi iḍopā- hānaśeṣabhūtasyāpyasya mantrasyānupraṅgayajñapatiprotsāhanārtha- tvād ūhopapattirityeva |

vastutastu praharaṇādipratāpa- prastarapratipādakapadaikavākyatāpannasya ' āyurāśāste ' ityādeḥ praharaṇaphalapratipādakatvāt yathā satre ūha iti pratyudāharaṇasūtre vakṣyate tathā ihāpi iḍopāhānājñasyāpi iḍopāhānapadaikavākyatāpannasyāpi asya iḍopahānaphala- pratipādakatvāt yukta eva satre ūhaḥ |
na hi tṛtīyā- nirdiṣṭa eva mantravarṇikaṃ phalaṃ nānyatreti niyame pramāṇa- masti, sthānādiviniyuktasyāpi mantrasya devatākalpa- katvavat phalakalpakatve'pi bādhakābhāvāt |
na ca apekṣitakalpakatve'pi yatra iḍopahānādeḥ iḍāsaṃskārārtha- tvena kṛtārthatā, tatra vinā tṛtīyāṃ na phalakalpakatvamiti

vācyam, tṛtīyākhyale'pi praharaṇapratipādyaprastarapratipāda- katayā sūktavākyapratipādakatvena māntravarṇikadevatāmātra- kalpanena vā tṛtīyāvagatakṛtatvanirvahāpatteḥ 'idaṃ dyāvā' iti padānāmiva āyurādipadānāmi sāvakatvenopapatteḥ : phalakalpakatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
iti itikaraṇaviniyuktaphale phala- kalpakatvat iḍopahāne'pi itikaraṇaviniyuktatvāt phalakalpakatvopapatteśca |

na ca evamapi evamādisyale sarvatraiva yajñapatedeyatvasya tadviśeṣaṇasyaivādervastvastaḥ avivakṣitatvena prakāśanānarhatvāt sarvathopapattau ca 'grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭi' itivat prātipadikenaiva pratīyupapatteḥ, prakṛtau sādhutvārthasyaikavacanasya kathaṃ vikutāvuha iti vācyam, prakṛtau avivakṣitatvāpi adhikārthatvasyopacārakalpamātra tāvat sadbhāvāt tāvattaiva ekavacanena ekatvaprakāśanopa- pattau sādhutvārthatvakalpane pramāṇābhāvāt |
iti prāpte, na tāvat yajñapativṛddhiprāhānaphalam, iḍābhakṣaṇa- tvena kṛtārthasya svarasataḥ phalānapekṣatvāt |

evaṃ satyapi yadi tṛtīyā ' tikaraṇena vā kriyā prati viniyogaḥ syāt, tataḥ kriyākaraṇaṃ mantrasya sakalasya kriyā- prakāśanadvāreṇa, iti prathamastathāt kriyāprakāśakatvameva, tadasaṃbhave tatsaṃbandhaprastaraprakāśakatvam, tasyāpyasaṃbhave mantraprakāśayasya anapekṣitasyāpi kriyāsaṃbhakatvam |
tatra ca vinagamanāvirāhāt yathaiva sūktavākyapratipādyamantra- devatāyāḥ kalpyam, tathā āyurādepi phalasya |
yatra tu sarvathā asaṃbhavastatra 'idaṃ dyāvā' ityādau agamyā stāvakatvamiṣṭameva |
agnaye ca diśā 'mamāme' ityādī varcaḥprabhṛtīnāmapi phalatvaṃ bodhyam |

ata eva kaustu- bhoktīyatra yatra prathamamantrādau netikaraṇena viniyogaḥ, api tu liṅgādeva saḥ, tatra 'prathasa ' iti bhāgasya prathanaprakāśakatvena prayojanavattvāme avaśiṣṭabhāgasya protsāhanastavakatvādinaiva tadekavākyatvopapattau na prathana- phalakalpakatvam, liṅgenadeśe'pi prayojanalābhe sakalasya
tatrāpi tu liṅgavaśāt phalakalpakatvāṅgīkāre nātīva kācidanupapattiḥ; paraṃtu tatra kriyānvayatvaṃ phalasya liṅgavaśāt pratīyate yathā prathamamantrādau |
prakṛte tu prathamaṃ tāvacca iti- karaṇena kriyāṃ prati viniyogaḥ 'atha pratipadyate ityāha' ityādinā mantroccāraṇasyaiva iḍābhakṣaṇāṅgatvena vidheyatvāt |
astu vā brūjādeśatvādāhaśabdasya uktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭe- pāhānaprakāśanasyaiva iḍābhakṣaṇāṅgatvena vidhiḥ |
sarvathā nopāhānaṃ nāma kiñcidasti kriyāṅgam, yatphala yajñapati- buddhirbhavet |
vastutastu satyapyupāhānasya bhakṣaṇāṅgatve na tatphalatvaṃ yajñapatibuddheratra mantre pratīyate, yena mantravarṇikaphalakalpanā śaṅkhayeta |
śāstreṇa tatra śabdasyāsāmañjasyaṃ vrataduho viprayogaḥ kṛtaḥ, ‘ghṛta- vrato bhavataḥ’ iti|
ekadravyaviparyīyāṃ ‘yajamānasya vratayuktvāmāśire duhanti’ iti, ṛtapethe codakena prāpyate|
tasmādiha ākasmikaṃ śabdasyāsāmañjasyaṃ bhavatīti dhāraṇameva pātrāṇām|
yaduktaṃ pātrairarthaḥ kriyate yajamānasya saṃskāraḥ iti, tanna|
kiṃ tarhi? pratipatti- reṣāṃ pātrāṇāṃ agninā ca yajamānaśarīre|
