karaṇapratiyogitvaṃ api pradhāne eva na tu sāṅge |
ata eva eva nimittasyāpi viniyogavidhāveva anvayaḥ |
ata eva aṅgānyapi pradhānasya etaduttarakālīna eva, tasya pradhānagataphalatvajñāna- dhīnatvāt |

tatra tu ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ - yat kāmye vidhyākṣipta- sādhanatvajñānottarameva aṅgaviniyogaḥ; nitye tu vidhi- saha-kṛtanimittāśrita -pralayayājanakākaraṇapratiyogitvajñāne jāte'pi nāṅgānvayaḥ, anapekṣitatvāt |
api tu tadu- ttaraṃ pradhānakaraṇakabhāvanāyāḥ bhādhyāpekṣāyāṃ pūrvakṛta- pāpakṣayasya bhādhyatve avagatame saḥ |
atra hi pāpakṣayasya bhādhyatvaṃ nityasthale 'dharmeṇa pāpa- mapanudati' ityādivākyebhyaḥ pratīyate |
' tathā cokte śava- tirgatikarmā kambojeṣveva dṛṣṭo vikārapannāmārthaḥ prayujyate śavamiti mṛtaśarīrābhidhānādityādi |
('śavatirgatikarmā kambojeṣveva bhāṣyate ... vikāramasya āryeṣu bhāṣyate ' śavaḥ ' iti " iti nirukte 2|2 |
) vahava eva hi dhātavo nāmadantāśca pradeśeṣvarthabhedeṣu vyavasthitā dṛśyante tasmāt samā iyaṃ abhidhāne vipratipattiḥ syāt |
evaṃ ca vikṛtiṣu keṣāṃcidaryānāṃ sādhāraṇaśabda- vācyatvāt prakṛtyādiva adhikṛtaprayogādāryādonugrahī- pyate |
yavaśabdo yadi dīrghaśūkeṣu, sādṛśyāt priyaṅguṣu bhaviṣyati, yadi priyaṅguṣu, sādṛśyāt yaveṣu |
kiṃ sādṛśyam ? pūrvasyasya kṣīṇe bhavanti dīrghaśūkāḥ priyaṅguṣvatastayoḥ sādṛśyam |
kaḥ punaratra niścayaḥ ? yaḥ śāstrasthānāṃ sa śabdārthaḥ |

tatra ṛtuyājeṣu śrūyate 'yaja- mānasya yājyā soḍabhipreṣyati, hotaretadyajeti, svayaṃ vā nidhāya yajati' iti |
yadā svayaṃ yajati, tadā saṃdehaḥ kimasya bhakṣo'sti, nāstīti |
tāśca yadyapi samākhyāyā hotṛprayojyā eva, tathāpyatra yajamānasadasyānāmetatprayogāthaṃ varaṇam |
tatra yajamānayājyāyāṃ pakṣadvayaṃ vihitam, hotṛ ca prayopaṇaṃ svayaṃ voccāraṇam |
yadā svayaṃ samuccārayati tadā saṃdehaḥ kiṃ vaṣaṭkāro hotrā kartavyaḥ, tataśca tannimittabhakṣaṇamapi hotaiva kartavyam, uta yajamānenaiveti |
pūrvapakṣastu-yājyā hi hotṛḥ sakāśādacyanenāpanītā, na tu vaṣaṭkāramakṣo |
na ca yājyāpanayenaiva vaṣaṭkāra- bhakṣayorapanayaḥ, tayoḥ yājyāto'rthāntaratvāt |
tena yathā yājyāpanaye'pyathāntarabhūtaṃ pravaraśabdābhidheyaṃ varaṇaṃ nāpanīyate, tathā vaṣaṭkārabhakṣāvapīti |
ayamabhiprāyaḥ: bhavedevaṃ yadi yājyāpanaye bhakṣaṇakāraṇa- bhūto vaṣaṭkāro nāpanīyateta |
tathāhi, na tāvat 'yajamānasya yājyā' ityetāvānmātraṃ śrūyate |
asya cāyamarthaḥ:— yājyāṃ ārabhya yāvadyāgo na samāpyate, tāvatparyantaṃ vicchedo na kartavyaḥ |
tadyadi yājyā prayujya viramedyajamānastadā prayataviccheda- meva kuryāt |
tasmāt vaṣaṭkāraprayogasya yajamānakartavya- tvāt tannimittameva bhakṣaṇamapi yajamānenaiva kartavyam |
yacca 'varaṇavat bhakṣaṇamapi nāpanīyate' ityuktam, tada- yuktam |
yato varaṇaṃ khalu hotṛnāpanīyate ityucitameva, tasya ṛtv arthāt arthāt hotarhi pravṛttatvāt |
ato yājyāpanaye sati bhakṣaṇaṃ yajamānenaiva kartavyamiti siddham |
sūtraṃ tu vaṣaṭkāre bhakṣaṇakāraṇasya vaṣaṭkārasya yadhuśagamanāt iti |
jyotiṣṭome prātaḥsavane aindrāgrahagrahāt prāk ṛtugrahāyā bhavanti |
tatra śrūyate 'yajamānasya yājyā, soḍabhipreṣyati hotaretadyajeti, svayaṃ vā nidhāya yajati' iti |
ṛtuyājeṣu antimā yājyā yaja- mānasya bhavati |
paraṃtu yadi yajamānaḥ svayaṃ yājyāṃ paṭhituṃ necchet tadā sa yajamānaḥ hotāraṃ abhi- preṣyati he hotaḥ tvaṃ etadyaja, etāṃ yājyāṃ tvaṃ paṭhati |
yadi vā svayaṃ paṭhitumicchet tadā yajamānaḥ nidhāya hotṛsthāne vidhinā upaviśya yajati yājyāṃ paṭhati iti śrūyate |
evaṃ sati yadā yajamānaḥ svayaṃ yājyāṃ paṭhati tadā vicāraḥ kiṃ yadā hotṛḥ sakāśāt yājyāpanayo bhavati tadā bhakṣo'pi hotṛḥ sakāśāt apanīto bhavati na veti |
hotṛḥ sakāśāt apanaye sati bhakṣaḥ hotṛḥ sakāśāt apanīto na bhavati |
yathā yājyāyāṃ hotṛḥ sakāśāt apanītā- yāmapi pravaro nāpanīyate bhavati tadvat |
tathā ca yaja- mānasya svayaṃ yājyāpāṭhapakṣe yājyāmātraṃ yajamānena paṭha- nīyam, vaṣaṭkāraḥ hotrā paṭhanīyaḥ, vaṣaṭkāranimitto bhakṣaśca hotaiva bhakṣaṇīyaḥ iti |
yājyāpanaye nāpanīta: iti pāṭhe tu yājyāpanayena bhakṣaḥ apanīto na bhavati ityevārthaḥ |
jyotiṣṭome prātaḥsavane aindrāgrahagrahāt prāk ṛtugrahāyā bhavanti |
tāṃ yajamānaḥ svayaṃ vā paṭhati 'hotareta- dyaja' iti hotre vā prayacchati |
tatra yadā yajamānaḥ svayaṃ paṭhati tadā yajamānayājyā hotṛḥ sakāśāt apa- nītā bhavati |
paraṃtu tadā somabhakṣaḥ hotṛḥ sakāśāt apanīto na bhavati, yājyāmātre yajamānena paṭhite'pi vaṣaṭkāraśca somabhakṣaḥ hotreva kartavyo iti yaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ tannidhryarthaḥ vā-śabdaḥ |
yājyāyāṃ hotṛḥ sakāśādapanītāyāṃ tadavinābhūto vaṣaṭkāro'pi hotṛḥ sakāśādapanīto bhavati, vaṣaṭkāranimitto bhakṣo'pi hotṛḥ sakāśāt apanīta eva bhavati |
yo yadya vaṣaṭkāravinābhūtayājyā- pāṭhakaḥ tasyaiva bhakṣo'pi |
kāraṇāgamāt kāraṇasya bhakṣakāraṇasya vaṣaṭkārasya hotṛḥ sakāśāt yajamānaṃ prati āgamāt āgamanāt |
yajamānena yājyāpāṭhe vaṣaṭ- kāro'pi yajamānenaiva paṭhanīyaḥ bhakṣo'pi tenaiva bhakṣaṇīyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā pravaro nāpanīyate hotṛḥ sakāśāt tathā yājyāpa- naye'pi bhakṣo nāpanīyata iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā, tanna |
pravarasya pravṛttatvāt anapāyaḥ na apāyaḥ, na apanayaḥ |
tasya ṛtuyājyāpāṭhakāle kathaṃ apāyaḥ syāt ? tasmāt bhūtakālikatvāt pravaradṛṣṭāntaḥ anupayuktaḥ |

1|4|12-15, yūpasya parimāṇam, vaikṛtadairaśane ekāṃ vihitasthale parivīya itarā yathāvakāśam, iti prāpte, yugapadbhābhyāṃ parivyāṇaṃ prakṛtitvat iti siddhānta: |
hotṛ: kriyamāṇānu mantra: 'yuvā sutrāsā:' iti jyotiṣṭome agnīṣomīye paśau |
mā. 3|8|10|22. yūpasya parivyāṇe, ekādaśinyāṃ 'parivīrasi' iti ādhvaryavamantrasyāvṛtti: |
vā. 3|7|6|3 pṛ. 1083. yūpasya paśvapūrvaprayuktatvameva, na tu jyotiṣṭomaparamāpūrvaprayukta- tvam |
bhā. 10|3|4|18-22. yūpasya yūpayo: yūpānāṃ vā laukike spardhe prāyaścittaṃ mantraviśeṣapāṭhā: |
yathaikaṃ yūpamaspṛṣṭet, 'eṣa te nāyo' iti itsyāt, yadi dvau 'etau te vāyū' iti, yadi bahūn 'ete te vāyava:' iti |
bhāṣṭa. 9|1|3, yūpasya laukike nyadhe prāyaścittaṃ na vaidike ajñocchrayaṇadikālike |
sūtrabhāṣya- svārasyāt yūpakāryāpavargottarameva krato: bahi: prāyaścitta- midaṃ puruṣārtham |
1|3|13. yūpasya viśālatvaṃ paśuniyojana- sthāne eva kāryārthitvāt |
( āpastambasū- 'viśālo yūpa iti yadyacce raśanāyāstadvidhāvam, yadā upari ubhe śākhe aṣṭāśrī saccaśāle svātam' iti |
te ca ekādaśa yūpā: aupavasathye'hanyeva saṃmīyeran prakṛtitvat |
iti prāpte, ajñānāṃ pradhānakālatvāt sadya: suyāyāmeva teṣāṃ saṃmānam |
prakṛtau paśuyantrasya tantrabhūto yūpo'gnīṣomīyapaśarthatvena pūrvairyuva: saṃmito'pyarthavaśanānye vekapātratve'pi paśāvarthatvena pātravibhāgādarśanāt |

ata eva 'agniṣṭamatedahacchyeyuriṣṭhe hi tadaharalpasya- māno bhavati' ityādinā madhyasyayūpasyevocyaṇe deśa- paśālambhaṃ hetukṛta, tena sahāyaṇeṣāṃ kṛte'pi yūpaccha- yaṇe, tattatsaṃskārāṇāṃ pare cavi, pradhānakāle eva karipa- māṇatayā 'tanucchittānāma iva suṣita iyoniccheyu:' iti nindā'''naṃ saṃgacchate |
bhā. 5|2|17. yūpānāṃ bhūyasāṃ parivyāṇe, 'yuvā sutrāsā:' iti hotramantrasya tantrameva nāvṛtti: |
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|16. yūpānāṃ yatra ekādaśinī, tatra yūpāhuti: tantreṇa kartavyā |

sāmidhinye vikṛtikṛto śrutam 'svargaya vā eṣa lokāya cīyate yadaśviryajña ekādaśinī yadaśvekādaśinī minuyādagneyaivana svargalokā- tadarthadattaṃ minuyānna mantreṇa svargalokā- tandardhattāṃ na svarubhi: paśūn vyarthayati iti |
atra prakṛtito yūpaikādaśinyā ekayūpasya ca pakṣata: prāptau yathaikayūpo niyamyate, tarhi pāśukajāhanīvākyanyāyenaiva itaranivṛttiside:, ekādaśinapratiṣedho vyartha: syāt |
aprākṛto vā yūpo vidhīyate iti na yūpaśarīra- ghaṭakātiriktā dharmā bhavanti |

iti prāpte, yadvāvilaṃ- śena niṣedhasya yanna minuyādityanena vidherapi pratīte- rbhāvābhāvayoścaikasmin prayoge asambhavāttadubhayasamā- tiṣyaiva pravartamāno vicchinnāneva yūpāndiśya saṃkhyāmātraṃ vikṛtaṃ vidadhāti |
yūpe-ekayūpe ekādaśa paśavo yathā niyujyante tadā ekasyaiva paśoḥ samajanaṃ pūrvasmin pakṣe, sarveṣāṃ siddhānte |
3|6|178. yūpe paridhisthe, ' paridhiṃ paśuṃ niyuñjīta ' iti guṇavidhiyaṃ na karmāntaram |
jñātvādihetvāt sāmānyavidhyāt paśudharmāṇāṃ madhye agnīṣomasaṃsakārārthaḥ paśupuroḍāśo devatāntare na prāpnoti |
śā-- yasmāt prakṛtau aṅgapradhānārthā barhirdharmāḥ; tasmāt vikṛtāvapi yūpavaṭastaraṇabarhiṣi kartavyaḥ |
iti prāpte, siddhāntasūtram ' tannirdeśastu vikṛtāva- pūrvasthānadhikāraḥ ' iti |
prakṛtau yat barhiḥkāryaṃ tanmayuktā barhidharmāḥ kāryadvāreṇa vikṛtiṃ gacchanti, na svarūpataḥ |
tena prākṛtakāryāsādhane eva dharmāḥ vikṛtau kartavyāḥ |
soma-- anideśaviṣayeyaṃ cintā prasaṅgāt saṃgatā ityāha |
(1 prathamasūtre ) prakṛtau aṅgapradhānārthatvaṃ pūrva- pakṣahetuḥ; prakaraṇāviśeṣāt iti hetuśca prakṛtau aṅga- pradhānārthatvena anvitaḥ |
dharmāṇāṃ prakṛtau kāryaviśeṣa- sādhanārthatvena nirdeśāt apūrvasya aprakṛtakāryasya yūpa- vaṭastaraṇabarhiryupadeśārthādideśaḥ anadhikāraḥ dharmasambandha- bhāvaḥ iti dvitīyasūtrārthaḥ |
ataśca deśapaśāvapi ' barhiṣā yūpavaṭamastṛṇāti ' iti vihite yūpavaṭastaraṇabarhiṣi dākṣiṇā barhidharmā bhaveyuḥ |
iti prāpte, prakṛtau ' barhiṣi haviṣpāsādyati ' iti vacanāt, aṅgapradhāna- sādhāraṇyavirāsādanārthā eva barhiṣi dharmāḥ, na kārya- mātrārthe ityuttarādhikaraṇe vakṣyate |
yadyapi vā paribhoja- nīyādivat prākṛtakāryamātrārthatvaṃ syāt, tathāpi na aprākṛtakārye yūpavaṭastaraṇārthaṃ barhiṣi bhaveyuḥ |
upa- kāradravyabhāvenaiva padārthānāmatideśena vikṛtau aprākṛta- kāryasritakalpanānupapatteḥ |

na hi prakṛtau yena kena- cit saṃbandhena apūrvasaṃjñihaviṣpavacchedakam, yena aprākṛtasyāpi tatsaṃbandhāt dharmagrāhakatvaṃ śakyeta, saṃjñadhaviśeṣagrahakapramāṇabalena tāvadviśeṣaṇādeva praveśena anupasthitasāmānyasya uddeśyatāvacchedakakoṭau aprave- yāt |
na ca tathāpi yūpavaṭastaraṇabhāvanāyāḥ dharmā- kāṅkṣāyāmeva phalavatprasannayāyena ( 3|1|2 ) dharmagrāha- katvam, laukikadharmagrahaṇenāpi ākāṅkṣānivṛttau, upa- deśātideśayorabhāvāt |
phalacamase tu sthānāpatyā bhaktānavadalācca anideśakalpanāmiti viśeṣaḥ |

prāptaṃ ityarthatvāvagateḥ, gamanārthatvācca iṇdhātoḥ, yūpaṃ prāptaṃ yadgamanaṃ tadarthatvasya lṛṭśrutyā avagateḥ gamanasya ca prakṛtau chedanārthatvāt yūpāhūterapi prakṛtau chedano- ddeśyagamanārthatvapratīteḥ lṛṭbalāyā chedābhāvena artha- lopāt yūpāhūteḥ bādha iti vācyam |
prakṛte'pi lṛṭbalāyā yūpasthānāpannatvāt tatprāpyuddeśyagamanasaṃbha- vena chedābhāve'pi yūpāhūterupapatteḥ |
na hi lṛṭbalāyāṃ tatrātinimittakagamanābhāvaḥ, yatra yavakṣetre lṛṭbalā tatra śālākaraṇārtha gamanādavaśyakatvena, tasyaiva tatprāpyuddeśya- katvāt |
'paridhau paśuṃ niyuñjīta' ityatra paridhicche- nārthaṃ gamanasya āvaśyakatvena tatra yūpāhūteḥ bhavanmate āpatteśca |
iti prāpte, na yūpāhūtiḥ paśuniyojana- prayuktā, api tu 'yūpamaccheṣpatā' iti vacanāt yūpa- tvotpādikā chedāditvam |
yūpatvaṃ hi pāriṣadyasyaiva dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasaṃskāragaṇaḥ, samudāyasya samudāyatvaniruktatvena anekaśakti kalpyatvāpatteḥ |
ato lāghavāt āhavanīyā- dipadavadeva ahantarā, tadvidhiśeṣatve vā yūpatvaṃ ityu- ktam, tadapi dīkṣākālakartavyakatipayacchedādidharmajanya- meva, na tu añjanādijanyamapi |
ata eva teṣāṃ yūpa- svarūpe ānarthakyāt agnisāṃmārgādivat apūrvasādhanatva- lakṣaṇayā paśuniyojanārthatvameva ityuktaṃ natrame (5|1|
ato yūpāhūtirapi 'yūpamaccheṣpatā' iti lṛṭśrutyā yūpaprāptiphalakagamanārthā yūpacchedānukūlagamanārthā vā satī yūpatvotpādakatvena |
ata eva yūpāhūtiḥ iti samākhyā'pi upapadyate |
lṛṭbalāyāṃ ca chedādināmarthalepena bādhāt sarvasaṃskārarūpasāmagryabhāvena yūpatvānupapatteḥ arthalopādeva yūpāhūtiḥ |
' yūpolkhaṇe ādhvaryavadhautramantrayoḥ samuccaya eva na vikalpaḥ |
yūpotpattikālaḥ: abhīpomīyapaśau, 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti, krīte vā rājani' na tu paśukāle yūpasyotpattiśca |
yūpopasparśanaṃ laukike eva prāyaścittaṃ na vaidike |
vācaḥ- stomādiṣu tu yūpaikādaśinyā asya nityānuvādatvāt vyākṣamātrāpyeva yūpāntarālāna bhaviṣyanti |
prakṛtau sarva- paśusādhāraṇasya chedanasyaikatvena saṃsthānasyāpi chedana- kāle eva prāptau vacanāt paśukāle tāvanmātratve'pi na tantratā virudhyate |
yūpaikādaśinī catu- rviṃśatiprakramayeyapradeśe yathākṣamātratvālānāṃ ekādaśānāṃ yūpānāṃ mātumātratvāt vyāmamātrāṇi pakṣapucchāni bhavanti iti ca pakṣayordhyāmamātratvavidhānāt |
yūpaikādaśinī yatra vihitā tatra rakṣākṣa- mātrāntaralatā |
yūpaikāda- śinyāṃ agniāditere yūpaḥ dakṣiṇā udak ca mātavyāḥ na prāksaṃsthā |
abhīpomīyaraśanāyāḥ anyakālatvāt ahargaṇe tantre- gopakārakartavye'pi savanīyakālastu ( kālasya ) karmakāla- tvāt pratyahamāvartate |
yūpasya sakṛt paśukāle nityā- tasya punarnityanāsaṃbhave'pi raśanābhiḥ pratidinamekaikayā paridhyāṇasaṃbhavāt |
iti prāpte, yūpāhvasya paridhyāṇasyāpi pūrvādhikaraṇanyāyena chedanakālasya paśukāle utkarṣa'pi tantratā'napāyāt na raśanābhede pramāṇamasti |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ añjanādipadayaiṣu prāpteṣu añjana- nādinā parivyāṇānte anusamayaḥ, na tu añjanādī- nāmekaikena |
'añjanādi yajamāno yūpaṃ nāvasṛjet āpāriṣyāṇāt' iti vacanāt |
ekasmin yūpe samudāyaṃ kṛtvā dvitīye yūpe samu- dāya kartavyaḥ iti |
iti prāpte, yugapadubhābhyāṃ paridhyāṇaṃ prakṛti- vat |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ uparāṇāṃ dairghyena sāmyam, na tiryaktvena |

'urasamitāṃ mituyāt pitṛlokakāmasya, madhyena saṃmitāṃ raśanāsaṃmitāṃ ca manuṣyalokakāmasya, capala- saṃmitāmindriyakāmasya' ityādibhirvacanaiḥ kāmanābhedena ekādaśānāmuparādīnāṃ vidhīyamānaṃ sāmyaṃ parasparaprāya- pāṭhāt ekavidhameva syāt |
iti prāpte, vacanasaṃsthayāya prāyapāṭhamanādṛtyāpi, anyonyavilakṣaṇameva svīkāryam |
tena tadbhedena uparāṇāṃ parimāṇavaiṣamye prāpte dairghyena sāmyaṃ phalāya vidhīyate, na tiryaktvena |
tasya hi 'atṛṇasuparaṃ bhavati' iti takṣaṇa- niṣedhena tadasaṃbhavāt |
madhyabhāgasya tridhyāmaśanāvedhana- parimitatvena dairghyataḥ aikarūpyasya satrādeva tasya raśanayā pṛthutvenaiva sāmyavidhiḥ |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ ekādaśo yūpaḥ upaśayo nāma, nāsau ucchrīyate, kiṃtu sa bhūmāveva śete dakṣiṇataḥ |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ ekādaśapaśuyojanaṃ kāpeyyā paddhatyā ahineṣu utkṛṣyate, itarā paddhatistu prakṛtau |

āgneyasārasvatasaumyapīṣṇavārhaspatyavaiśvadendrāmāruta - aindrāmāsavindrāvaruṇān ekādaśa paśūn vidhāya 'yāmimāṃ prajā āpaśca caranti sā vā yūpaikādaśinī' ityuktvā tato vyatyastapaśūn prakramya 'āgneyamindramiddhita aindra- maindrāmaṃ sārasvataṃ saumyaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ pauṣṇaṃ mārutaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ vāruṇaṃ ca' vidhāya śrutaṃ 'tāmetāṃ kāpeyyā vidustāmetā- matirātracarama āleta ?' iti |
iti prāpte, yāmimāmityanena prakṛtigāmitayā bahukatrkatvena pūrvasyā nirdeśāttatsarasvatyā kāpeyyapadena katipayasaṃmatya'nena, tāmetāmityanenāpi saṃnihitāyā eva parāmarśatkāpeyyā evāhīnapūtarkyam |
yattu kalpasūtraṃ 'āgneyamabhita aindrī' iti, tadaindrāgomayasya nāmaikādaśamelanena nirdeśaka.mitya- vidvattvam |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ daśamaikādaśayorvyatyayaḥ: agni- koṇe daśamaḥ, aiśānakoṇe ekādaśaḥ iti |
yūpeṣṭupadaparvatavidhānādeḥ āgneyakoṇamābhya īśā- nāntā yūpā agnibhadrete daśa saṃbhavāt |

yaṭṭā agniā- dhāradeśasya mukhyasyeterasaṃbhave'pi tatsamīpavartideśa- parityāge mānābhāvāt, tadāsannadeśasya pradhānapaśukrameṇa- paśvinasyāvirodhāya dvitīyaṃ yūpamagniṣṭhādiśonī mītvā, tṛtīyamamiṣṭhāduttarato mituyāt |
etena 'yadāgneyaśca bārhaspatyaśca saumyamabhito bhavataḥ' iti liṅgamupapadyate |
iti prāpte, 'dakṣiṇapavargāḥ paśvo bhavanti' ityāhya vidhānainedānāyāmeyāyakramameṇa paśuniyojane siddhe, tada- dveṣu yūpeṣvapi pradhānasaṃnikarṣalāmena tathaiva samāne prasakte,
tathā ca paśukrameṇaiva naca yūpā mitvā, daśa- masya sthānamatikramya, vedyadhikoṇe daśamaṃ mitvā, tadu- darabhāge ekādaśaṃ minuyāt |
evaṃ sati dvayorevottamo- pottamayoḥ kramoparodhaḥ syāditi bhāṣyakāraḥ |

yadyapi yūpasamānottarameva paśuniyojanapravṛtteḥ, udagaparvagātāme- yādīśānatkrameṇaiva yūpeṣu kṛtvā, paśūna yūpakrameṇaiva nava niyujya, daśamaikādaśayorvyāsane niyojanamapi saṃbhavati, tathāpi 'daśamo'miṣṭhād' ityādi liṅgadarśanā- nuguṇāttathoktam |
tadidaṃ liṅgadarśanaṃ nyāyopadrālitameta- diruddhavacanādalītyaḥ satmakṛtau niveśite, itarattu vikṛ- tyartham |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ pariṇamye 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti hautramantraḥ tantram |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ yūpānāntarāla rathākṣamātram, na tu pramāṇāniyamaḥ, nāpi vedisamitaparimāṇena vikalpaḥ, tatra vedereva vardhanīya- tvāt |
bhāṣyam- jyotiṣṭome yūpaikādaśinī, 'ekādaśa yūpān chinatti' ityanmātā |
asti tu prakṛtāvaya- gomīye paśau yūpāhutiḥ |
sā kiṃ medena kartavyā, uta tantramiti |
yadat nānādevateṣu vasāhomo medena, tadiyamapi medena karta- vyetyarthaḥ |
kutaḥ ? 'yūpasyāntike'mi mathitvā yūpāhutiṃ juhoti' iti śrūyate |
yasyaiva yūpasyāntike na hūyeta tasyaiva tena guṇena varjanaṃ syāt |
kathaṃ jñāyate ? āhavanīya juhotītyutsargā- tsarvahomeṣvāhavanīyaḥ prāptaḥ |
tadapi manthanaṃ prāgvaṃśe karmaṇaḥ pravṛttatvāt prāgvaṃśe prāptam |
tatra ca manthanaṃ vivakṣitamavivakṣita- mantikamiti brūmaḥ |
evaṃ grāhya, 'yūpamācchedyattā hotavyaṃ' na hi dīkṣita- syāmau juhoti, dīkṣitāmau home doṣaṃ manyate iti |
tadubhayamapi tatra na śakya- miti pratiṣidhya tṛtīyaṃ kalpamāha |
tadubhayamapi śakyam, juhotyatha na dīkṣitāmau juhotīti |
tatra yadi yūpasyāntike juhotītyevaṃdikṣitaṃ na manya- nam, tattathā''havanīyameva yūpasyāntike nītvā homaḥ prāpnoti |
atha tu, ami mathitvetyetaddvitīyate tata āhavanīyapratiṣedho bhavati |
tatastatsamarthitaṃ bhavati, juhoti ca, na cā''havanīya juhotīti |
evaṃ sati yayanatike juhoti, na doṣaḥ |
atha kasmāt manthanamātraṃ kṛtvā''havanīya eva na hūyate |
na cāntikadeśāḥ śakyāḥ śāsitum, āpekṣikatvā- dantikasya |
atha pramāṇāntikaṃ śiṣyate, tadā yūpa upa- dahyeta |
na ca śakyaṃ parāntikadeśami- manthanaṃ kartum |
śā-- yūpāhutiḥ yūpaikādaśinyāṃ medena kartavyā uta tantre iti saṃdehe tadantikadeśānāṃ medān vasāhomavat

āpekṣika hi antikadeśe manthanaṃ saṃbhavati, tena yaṃ deśaṃ prāptaḥ yūpasamīpaṃ prāpto'smīti manyate, yatra yūpo dṛṣṭipathaṃ āpadyate, tatra mathanaṃ homaśca, sa ca sarveṣāṃ ekadeśaḥ saṃbhavati iti agrahyamāṇaviśeṣa- tvāt tantram |
ekastā- vat 'yūpamacchedyattā hotavyam' ityanena yūpaprāptisādhana- gamanādeśena, tataḥ pūrvameva gārha āhavanīyaye hotavyamiti |
tatra doṣe- panyāsapūrvakaṃ 'vaiṣṇavīmṛcamanucyācchedyati' iti homā- bhāvapakṣaḥ |
tṛtīyastu 'gamanāttaraṃ yūpasyāntike ami mathitvā juhoti' iti homapakṣa uktaḥ |
iti prāptaṃ - nāntikadeśavidhiḥ, prātakarmātuvādena deśasya, mathanorakālasya ca vidhāne vākyabhedāt |
vastutastu- antikadeśavidhyābhāve mathanasāhava- nīyena saha vikalpaṃ gṛha eva homāpattergamanottaratvasiddhaya- rthamantikadeśasyāpyavaśyavidheyatvāt |

deśakālaviśiṣṭaya- yogavidhānena ca vākyabhedābhāvādantikavidhāne'pi paramā- nitakasya dāhaprasaṅgāsaṃbhavatvāt, yāvatā sāmīpyena yūpadeśa- mahaṃ prāpto'smīti vyavahārastāvat eva sāmīpyasyāntika- padena vivakṣitatvāt tasya caikatve tantratvameva |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ 'vedisaṃmitān viminoti' ityasya rathākṣamānena na vikalpaḥ |
tulyanyāyena 'vedisaṃmitān viminoti' iti vacanā- ntarasyāpyantarālaparatvātsvayaṃbhāvāt ubhayoḥ parimāṇayo- rvikalpaḥ |
iti prāpte, yūpopāṇāṃ yāvantastaryadeśāstā- vadgāvedervibhiraṇīyetyabhiprāyeṇa vacanāntarasyopapatteḥ virodhābhāvādvikalpaḥ |
'ardhamantarvedi bahirvedi' iti lakṣitasya deśa- syāmiśna yūpenākrāntatvādante yūpa aniyamana yatra kāpi nidheyāḥ |
iti prāpte, udagadakṣiṇavistṛtāyā vedeḥ prānte'pi lakṣitadeśa- sthānapāyāt 'tiraścīrminoti' ityādyavighānāt agniṣṭodadakṣiṇapārśvayoraiva mātavyāḥ |
'samaṃ syāt' iti nyāyena lābhe'pi parimāṇaviśeṣe pramāṇā- bhāvādaniyame prāpte, 'rathākṣaṃ vimimīte' ityasyāntarāla- paratayaiva sārthakyāt rathākṣamātrāṇi yūpāttarālāni kāryā- ṇīti |
yūpaikādaśinyādite upaśaye yūpanāmnā yūpasaṃ- skārāṇāṃ nātideśaḥ |
seyaṃ ekādaśinī yeṣāṃ pūrvairyuvareva saṃmatatvelenmātā, tepāmahame'ntyakālatvāt tantre'pyupakārakalatve'pi sutyā- kālikasamānasya pradhānamedāt pratīyadāhavanīyasaṃmārjana- vadāvṛttiḥ syāt |
iti prāpte, prakṛtau sarvapaśu- sādhāraṇasya chedanāderatyakālatvena saṃmānasapi chedana- kāla eva prāpto, vacanāttukāle tāvanmātrasyotkarṣe'pi
agnīṣomīye paśau dīkṣāsu ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ yūpacchedanaṃ agnīṣomapraṇayanādīnī nāpakarṣati |
bhāṣyam— asti darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtike paśau agnīṣomīye vaikṛtaṃ yūpakarma |
tat pratikṛṣyamāṇaṃ arvācīnānyapi agnīṣomapraṇayanādīni pratikarṣanti uta neti saṃśaye, pratikarṣati saṃkrayāditi |
vikṛtau abhyadhikaṃ yat, tat pratikṛṣyamāṇaṃ tato'rvācīnānyapi agnīṣomapraṇayanādīni na pratikarṣamahati |
yadi hi tayoḥ upakārakaḥ syāt, tat tayopakurvataḥ karmo'pasya sāhāyyaṃ kurvan śubhabhūtaḥ syāt |
api ca yūpamātraṃ pratikṛṣya kṛtārthaṃ śabde saumikānāṃ svakramabādho na bhaviṣyati iti |
dupa— agnīṣomapraṇayanottarakālaṃ yūpasya chedanādayaḥ paṭhyamānāḥ vacanenāpakṛṣyamāṇāḥ saumikān nāpakarṣanti |
śā-- yūpacchedanaṃ dīkṣāsu apakṛṣyamāṇaṃ prayājavat ādhārādīn apakarṣati |
soma— pūrvavadihāpi pūrvapadārthasya uttarapadārtho- pasthāpakatva pātaḥ krame sati baddhakramatvāviśeṣāt iti prayavasyānāt saṃgatiḥ |
tadetat sarvaṃ sutyā- dināt prācīne aupavasathye dine prāptam |
tatra yūpa- cchedaḥ dinatrayāt pūrvaṃ dīkṣākāle apakṛṣṭaḥ |
tasmin apakṛṣṭe prayājanyāyena (5|1|12) tadantāhasamūhasya apakarṣaṇāt, praṇayanamapi apakṛṣyatāṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
yūpacchedātkarṣaḥ kiṃ tadante śruta eva vā |

bhāṭṭa-- saumikāgnīṣomapraṇayananantaraṃ 'paścahṛtyā yūpaṃ chinatti' ityutpannaṃ yūpacchedanaṃ 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' ityanenāpakṛṣṭaṃ prayājanyāyena (5|1|12) prāco'pi padārthānāṃ agnīṣomapraṇayanādīn apakarṣati |

iti prāpte, bhinnaprayogavidhiparigṛhītatvena atra pāṭhasya kramāniṣṭhāmāstatvāt mahāprayogavidheśce'pi vā utpatti- vidhivelāyāṃ prayogatvyānatvena kramākāṅkṣātvāt pāṭhasya kramātpatvatvena baddhakramatvābhāvāt dīkṣākāla- vidhivākye ca prayojyatvāgamane tatraiva kramāpekṣatayā bhinnaprayogavidhiparigṛhītairapi somāgnīkṣākālīnapadārthaiḥ pāṭhena kramaklṛpnāt tatraiva samahotṛhomānantaraṃ yūpacchedana- mātraṃ yūpotyādakadharmamātraṃ vā apakṛṣya kāryam |
etena yūpacchedanasya dīkṣānte karaṇaṃ iti keṣāṃciduktaṃ apāstam |
' 18. yūpakarmamātraṃ dīkṣāsu 'yūpaṃ chinatti' iti pratikarṣavidhānāt pratikṛṣyate, na tu agnīṣomapraṇaya- nādīni |
bhā. 1|2|1|128. yūpakārye vidhīyamānā khalevālī, taddharmāṃ labhate |
yūpagaṇe satratirikte añjanādipariṣyāṇānta- kāṇḍasyānusamayam, satre tu yena kenāpi yajamānena dhāraṇa- saṃbhavāt padārthānusamaya eva |
yūpacchedeḥ agnīṣomapraṇayanottaraṃ paṭhito'pi, 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' iti vidhānena dīkṣākāle'pa- kṛṣyate, parantu agnīṣomapraṇayanasya nāpakarṣaḥ |
tasya nomāṅgatvāt yūpacchedya ca paśvaṅgatvān parasparaṃ kramāna- pekṣatvāt yūpacchedyaḥ paśvaṅgam |
bhā. 11|1|12|7|27. yūpacchedanasya paśvaprayoga- vahirbhūtasya dīkṣākālasya paśvaṅgatveya |
yūpadharmāḥ-- dhṛtenāñjanam, ucchrayaṇam, ava- ṭasya samūhanam, yūpamūlasya pari(vṛṃ)haṇam, madhye raśanayā parivāṇaṃ iti |
paraṃtu ye yūparidhauvidheyāviśedhi- nasta eva na viruddhāḥ |
9|1|13|41-43, yūpadharmāḥ nātubhyeśaḥ paridhau svadharmavirodhe sati pāśucāturmāsyeṣu |
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|15. mīko. pṛ. 3260. 'yūpe viśākhe'pi0' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
paridhānārthaṃ ca paridhau yūpadharmāḥ bandhane upakurvanti |
7|3|14|13-34. mīko. pṛ. 348. 'atideśo na upaśaye yūpasaṃskārāṇām' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
yūpanikhanane 'ardhamantarvedi ardha bahirvedi' iti upalakṣitadeśaviśeṣasya vidhānam |
bhāṣyam-- jyotiṣṭome paśavaḥ agnīṣomīyasavanī- yānubandhyāḥ, teṣāṃ yūpaḥ 'lādire badhnāti' 'palāśo badhnāti' 'rohitake badhnāti' iti śrutaḥ |
tatra vicāyate, kiṃ trayāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ medena yūpaḥ, athavā tantra- miti |
agnī- ṣomīye tāvat prayogavacanena gṛhyate yūpaḥ; uttarayopi codakena prāpyate |
kiṃ tarhi ? pṛtha- kāle, 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti, krīte vā rābani' iti |
tato'tyamānasya na gṛhyate viśeṣo'sai paśukanyāya yūpa- ḍyamase neti |
bhāṣyam-- ekaṃ yūpaṃ trayāṇāmapi paśūnāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ darśayati |
savanīye paśau 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya' iti trivṛtā parivīyaṃ vidadhāti |
yadi nānā yūpa bhaveyustataḥ pūrvasya yūpasya yūpāntare codakena prāpte trivṛtā parivāṇaṃ na vidhātavyaṃ bhavet |
atha tantraṃ yūpaḥ, tataḥ saṃskārā api tantrāmītyeva parivītyasya kṛta- yatvāta punaḥ savanīye parivāṇaṃ na prāpnoti |
śā-- jyotiṣṭome agnīṣomīye paśau upadiṣṭo yūpaḥ; savanīyānubandhayostu atidiṣṭaḥ |
sa kiṃ trayāṇāmapi paśūnāṃ tantram, uta pratipaśu bhedena yūpa iti |
tadartha- midaṃ vicāryate, 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' iti kiṃ agnīṣomīyapaśyāpakarṣaṃ, uta sarvapaśūnāmiti |
adhvarakalpāyāṃ hi prathamanirvāpāpakarṣe santi pradhānakālavādyo niyamavidhānaṃ labhyate, iti tasyaivāpakarṣaḥ samāśritaḥ |
atra tu agnīṣomīyayūpa- karṣe'pi asti pradhānakālavādyaḥ |
tasmāt aviśeṣāt sarvayūpakarṣe sati akarmakālatvāt agnīṣomīyaviśeṣo yūpaḥ sarvaiṣāṃ tantram |
soma-- ādhānavat viśeṣagrahaṇābhāvāt iha na tantratvaṃ ityucyate : saṃgatiḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- jyotiṣṭome'gnīṣomīye upadiṣṭo yūpaḥ, sava- nīyānubandhayostvatidiṣṭaḥ |

sa kiṃ trayāṇāmapi tantraṃ uta bhedeneti cintāyām, 'dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti' ityanena vihitasya dīkṣākālasya yūpacchedanodeśena vidhānādud- diśya ca prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇyena yūpe upadeśāti- deśayoḥ : kramikatvena, gṛhyavat prātikātvaivāpyate- pomīyayūpacchedanasyaiva dīkṣākālavidhiḥ; viśeṣataścādhvara- kalpanāyena (5|1|10) tasyaivopariśritatvāt tasyaiva dīkṣākāle apakarṣa iti tasyāpyaumīyānte apavargāt savanīyādau yūpāntarakaraṇam |
iti prāpte, dīkṣākālaṃ na dīkṣāpūrvamyuktaṃ tadupasthāpakānuṣṭhānasādedyābhāvāt, api tu prakaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomāpakarṣayuktaṃ sat tasmin sākṣāt- veśādyogāt tadīyayūpe niveśite |

vastutastu yūpodeśena vihitasya kālasya dviruktanyāyasahakṛtavyabhicaritakratu- saṃgrahādeva deśārthatvasaṃbhave vāraṇādivat jyotiṣṭomātharva- nupapatterdaikṣa evopadeśe'pi savanīyādāvatideśena tatprāti- saṃbhavāt kālatantratvādeva yūpatantratvam |
avaśyaṃ hi sarvatropadeśādanādi- kālatantratvādeva yūpatantratvaṃ vācyam, anyathā ekasminnapi kāle yūpatrayāpatteḥ |
yūpacchedādikāṃ tu 'guṇalope'pi mukhyasya kriyā syāt' (10|2|1764) iti nyāyāt kāryameva |
ahargaṇeṣu upasatkālīnāṃ subrahmaṇyāhvānaṃ pradhāna- bhedād bhidyate |
yūpapadasya, tadarthasya ca alaukikatve'pi, prasiddhapadasamabhivyāhāreṇa vyutpattiḥ saṃbhavati |
yūpaparivāṇaṃ adhvaryuṇā kriyamāṇaṃ hotā 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti mantreṇānuvadati |
yūpaparivāṇakaraṇamantraḥ hotrā paṭhanīyaḥ : kauṇḍa- pāyināmanye agnīṣomīye paśau |
yūpa- parivāṇe kuṇḍapāyināmanye ādhvaryavaṃ karamantra hotā kuryāt |
kuṇḍapāyināmanye hotṛpuruṣāṇāṃ trayāṇāmapi vacanāt kāryantaravyāpta- tvameva |
yūpaparivāṇārthā raśanā, raśanādharmāśra śrūyante, te sarvārthāḥ : nāgnīṣomīyārthāḥ eva |
yūpamantraḥ yūpaikādaśinyāṃ 'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti hautramantraḥ tantram |
'yuvā suvāsāḥ' iti hautra mantraḥ ekādaśavāraṃ prayoktavyaḥ, pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛtteḥ |
yūpamantrasya agnīṣomīyasaṃvandhanaḥ dīkṣāsu prati- karṣaḥ na tu tato'rvācīnānāmapi agnīṣomapraṇayādīnāṃ saumikānām |
tathā ca śrutiḥ - 'yadekasmin yūpe dve raśane parivyayati, tasmādeko dve jāye vindate, yaccaikāṃ raśanāṃ dvayoryūpayoḥ parivyayati, tasmāccaikā dvau patī vindate' iti (taisaṃ. 6|6|1|2) |
yūpavirohaṇe 'yasya yūpo virohati sa tvāp paśuṃ sāṇḍaṃ chāgaṃ lomaśaṃ piṅgalaṃ vabhruṃ bahurūpamālabheta' iti karma, cikṛtau iva prakṛtāvapi |
'yasya yūpo virohati īśvaraḥ : paramabhitosthāt paśuṃ sāṇḍaṃ chāgaṃ lomaśaṃ piṅgalaṃ vabhruṃ bahurūpamālabheta' iti vihitaṃ chidrayūpe'ṅkurohaṇanimittakaṃ karma vikṛtāveva pravartate |
tāsāṃ hi sutvācchidratvā dīrdhatativāt : prakṛtau dīkṣākāle chinnasyānucchinnasya yūpasyālpena kāle viro- haṇāsaṃbhavāt |
iti prāpte, anucchinnasyāpi yūpasya viro- haṇasaṃbhavāt prakṛtāvapiviruddham |
paśau yūpanikhanane ardhamanta- rvedi ardhe bahirvedi iti upalakṣitadeśaviśeṣasya tridhānam |
bhāṣyam -- asti jyotiṣṭome paśurdīkṣaṇīyo : 'yo dīkṣito yadīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatra yūpaṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'vajro vai yūpo yadantarvedi mino- tyet, yadvahirvedi anavaruddhaḥ syāt ardhamantarvedi mino- tyet tadarthaṃ bahirvedi anavaruddha bhavati na nirdahati' iti |
tatra sandehaḥ, kimantarvedi iti yūpasyābhyantena vedi- rūpadiśyate, uta ardhamantarvedi, ardhaṃ bahirvedi iti deśalakṣaṇārthamucyate iti |
yadi yūpasyārdhasya vedyantarasya ca saṃbandho vivakṣitaḥ, evaṃ vedirdvayoḥ kartavyaḥ, tato yūpasyābhāvena |
atha yasmin deśe mīyamānasyādhaṃ vedyabhyantare, ardhaṃ ca bahiḥ; sa deśa upadiśyate, tato deśalakṣaṇa |
yathā dīkṣādakṣiṇa pradhānasya, tathā yūpasya vediḥ |
tathā yūpo mātavyaḥ, tathā mīyamānasyārdhaṃ vedyabhyantare bhavati |
vā -- 'ardhamantarvedi minotyardhaṃ bahirvedi' iti kimanrtarvededyo yūpasyāntena vidhīyate, atha bahirvedi- deśamiśraṃśadeśamātraṃ lakṣyati |
nanu ca purastāt (cikīrṣayā ca saṃyogān ityasminnadhikaraṇe 3|7|17) sarvārthatvamavasthāya idānīmukte vicāraḥ |
yadi hi vākyasaṃyogāt yūpārthatā bhavet kutastadā kaimadhyavicārāvasare |
kiṃ prāptam ? prakaraṇaṃ bādhitvā yūpasya vākyasaṃyogādvidhumahati |
na cāntarvedideśasya śrauto'rthaṃ na samavaiti yato lakṣaṇā prapadyate |
tasmāt 'iti śakyāmaha' ityapi sāmānyaśāstraṃ yūpaviṣayamevopasaṃhṛtya vedeḥ vyāptatvaṃ pratipadyama|
athavā pūrvvādhikaraṇena sthite sāṅgatyotiṣṭomārthatve kiṃ yūpārthatvamapyasti nāstīti vicāryate|
na tena siddhaṃ yūpārthatvamiti na vicāraṇīyama|
prāpte ca vedi kāryye atideśena prāpnuvatī darśapūrṇamāsikī vediṃ nirā- kṛtya paśvādiṣu saumikī niviśate|
na cedaṃ yūpamānaṃ prākṛtaṃ yato vediṃ lemeta|
tasmātprāpteryūpasya laukikyatha deśabuddhyā antarvediharvā māne prāpte anena vacanenārthasyāntarvedi- niyamyate|
bhāṣyam-- deśamātraṃ vā vediśabdena lakṣyate, na vediyūpaṅgam|
'ardha- mantarvedi minotyardhaṃ bahirvedi' ityetanevākyatayā sā, śāsitatvena yadi deśalakṣaṇā|
atha yūpasyābhāvena vedyā nirdeśaḥ, tato na śāsitavyo vahirvedideśo bhavati|
atha bahirvedi- deśamapi yūpasyābhāvenopadiśeta, vākyaṃ bhidyeta|
tasmā- dyūpasyābhāvena vedyā nirdeśe bahirvedideśaḥ sarvathā na śāsitavyaḥ|
yadi tu deśalakṣaṇā, tato viśiṣṭe deśe lakṣamāṇe avaśyavaktavyo bahirvedideśo bhavati|
anucyamāne, vedyabhyantare yasmin kasmiṃśca pradeśe yūpaḥ iti gamyate|
atha punarvahirvedideśe śrūyamāṇe, yatarasmin deśe mīyamānasyārdhamantarvedi ardhaṃ bahirvedi, sa deśo lakṣyitumiṣyate bhavati|
sa ca bahirvedideśena vinā na śakyate lakṣayitumavaśyaṃ śāsitavyo bhavati|
vā-- ubhābhyāmanrtarvedibahirvedideśabhyāṃ madhyadeśo lakṣyate nājñādvibhāvo vidhīyate|
aṅgāṅgibhāve hi yūpe vā vediṃ bhavedeveti yūpaṅgam, na caikamapyupapadyate, nirā- kāṅkṣatvādadahakalpanādākyabhedaprasaṅgācca|
na tāvat paśu- bandhadhāpūtasya yūpasya vediṃ prati apekṣā'sti|
nāpi kartṛhavistadupakaraṇadhāraṇavyāptāyā vedeḥ sahasrabhāgāṃśa- saṃbandhināpi yūpe apekṣā|
kiṃ cārthe bahirvedītyaśiṣyam, vidhinuvādatvā- sambhavāt tvatpakṣe|
matpakṣe tu dvābhyāṃ vinā deśaviśeṣo- palakṣaṇāsaṃbhavatvāddeśyaṃ śāsitavyametat|
kathaṃ samastasya yūpasyāntarvediharvā māne prāpte 'ardhamantarvedi' iti niya- myate, dvitīyasya arthasya punarapyaniyamaprasaktau|
nanu cārdhasyāntarvedideśaṃmye vihite vidhabhāvādardhāntaraṃ bahirvedi bhaviṣyati|
bhavedevama, yadi nityamantarvedi bahirvedicaiva vā yūpamāne prasakte syāt|
samastantarvedideśe hi sati ardhapunarvacanasāmarthyāt parisaṃkhyāyatesya vahirmāṇaṃ gamyate|
samastasya vā bahireva prasakte ardhasyāvihitamiti tadavasthamardhāntaramantarvedītyeva|
tathā sati cārdhāntaramaniyatatvāt kadācidantarapi prāpno- tīti na vahirbhātaḥ sidhyatīti|
nanu yadi samasta- mantarvedi minoti, tato'rdhamantarvedītyeva vidhinaiva kuryāt|
kathaṃ na karoti, yadyarthaṃ tatrāvattu niyamato'ntarminoti etatrca vihitaṃ netarat pratiṣiddham|
śā-- 'ardhamantarvedi minoti ardhaṃ bahirvedi ityanena yatra mīyamānasya yūpasya ardhamantarvedi bhavati ardhaṃ ca bahirvedi, tatra minuyāt iti
bhā. 1|1|4|8-9, yūpasaṃskārāḥ prokṣaṇa añjanaṃ uccahyaṇaṃ parivāṇaṃ ca |
1|4|15. yūpasthāpane abhīṣomīyapaśau 'ardhamantarvedi, ardha bahiveṃdi' iti laukikadeśa eva vidhīyate na tu saṃskṛtavedibhāge vidhīyate |
vi. 3|7|6. yūpasparśe laukike abhīṣomīye paśau yāgasamā- pyuttaraṃ prāyaścittam |
tvāt kāmanā'pi niyogasiddhau aṅgaṃ itīcchanti, tasyāpi (prābhākarasya) liṅgavivakṣā durvāreva |
atra cāyamaparo viśeṣaḥ, yadatra phalakāmo na śrūyate, phalānyeva caturthyantena nirdiśya tādarthyena karma vidhīyate |
apica, ye yugapat kāmyante, teṣāmanivāryaiva yugapadutpattiḥ syāt |
teṣāṃ codidya- mānānāṃ sāhityaṃ na vivakṣitam |
' yādṛśaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ yādṛśakāryasya nirapekṣasya niṣpādakam, tat ekameva yugapat janayati, yathā mṛtpiṇḍo yugapat ekameva vaṭamutpādayati, nānekam |
vidhirhi cetanapravartanātmakaḥ samīhitasyaiva phalava- mupakalpayati, na paścādisarūpasya |
yeṣvapi yugapat kāmanā, teṣvapi karmaṇo yugapadasambhavāt yaduddiśya yadā prayujyate, tadeva tadā bhavati, nānyat |

yathā hi, ekaphalāni karmāṇi yathāvidhasya phalasya svargasya paśaurvā sādhanatvena coditāni, yugapat ekameva tathāvidhaṃ phalaṃ janayanti, nānekam, itarathā sakṛdeva yāvadiṣṭaphalaṃ siddhaṃ iti na kāmyamekaṃ karma praḥ yujyate, iṣyate ca punaḥ prayogaḥ, tathā ihāpi ekameva yugapat phalam |
na ca sāhityenaiva atra kāmānāṃ phalatvaṃ naikasya iti vācyam |
iha hi mukhyo'pi (sarvebhyo jyotiṣṭomaḥ ityādiḥ) - sarvaśabdaḥ noddeśyasama- paṃkaḥ, sāpekṣatvāt, kiṃtu nirapekṣatvāt kāmaśabda eva |
tataśca grahaṇavat sarvatvasya uddeśyapratītiparyavasānārthatvā- bhāvāt uddeśyaviśeṣaṇatvameva, iti ahekatvavat avi- vakṣitatvāt na sāhityena phalatvamiti |
bhāṭṭa- ekasmin prayoge kiṃ sarvāṇi phalānyupa- cyante, utaikamiti cintāyāṃ sarvatvasyoddeśyatā'vacchedaka- tvena kāryatā'vacchedakatvāt kāraṇena ca tadavacchinnotpatti- niyamāt sarvāṇyutpadyante |
astu vā tacchabdādāviva putra- tvādinevauddeśyatā, sarvatvaṃ ca tadviśeṣaṇatvādavivakṣitam, tathāpyekasmin prayoge kāraṇasattvāt sakalakāryautpattau bādhakābhāvaḥ |
na hyekaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryadvayaṃ notpadyati, e kasmādapi ghaṭādeḥ rūparasakriyādyanekotpattidarśanāt |

ekakāryatā'vacchedakāvacchinnotpattau tadavacchinnatarasyā- nutpattirdarśanāt putrādyantaraṃ notpadyatām, kāryatā'va- cchedakāntarāvanacchinnasya tu paścāderyugapat krameṇa vā utpattau na kiñcidbādhakam |
na ca sarveṣāṃ yugapat sarvasya kāmanāyādāvanutpattiḥ, kāmanāyāḥ karmajatve phalaṃ prati janakatve vā pramāṇābhāvena tadabhāve'pyutpattau bādhakā- bhāvāt |
pravṛttiṃ prati phalecchāyāḥ kāraṇatvādantya- tamapallecchāmātreṇa pravṛttau jātāyāṃ kāraṇasattvena sarvakāryautpattau na kiñcidbādhakam |
ata eva vidhya- vagatasamīhitasādhanatvamapi anyataraphale eva samā- ditatvenopadeśenopapadyate |
na ca sarvaphalotpattau teṣāṃ mokṣatvena mokṣānupapattiḥ |
iti tantrasāroktaṃ yuktam, jñānena tadapūrvāṇāṃ nāśāt |

yadā tu svargavākyavaiyarthyī- patteḥ tasyaiva mukhyaphalatvam, anyeṣāṃ tu 'ekaikasmai kāmāya' ityarthavādāt anye kratavaḥ 'ekaikasmai, artha tu naikasmai eva, kintu sarvebhyo'pītyarthāvagaterānupapatti- kalamiti tantrasāroktamāśrīyate, tadā teṣāṃ kāmanābhāve- 'pyāyurādidavatputrasya na kiñcidbādhakam |
vastutastu svargavākyasyābhyudayaśirastvenaupapatterupapatterarthavādasya ca sādhyasamucāyakatvavat mukhyatvasamucāyakatvasyāpyupapatteridaṃ matamupekṣitāmiti pūrvoktaiveva sarvopapattiḥ |
astu vā akāmyamānasādhanātpattiḥ, tathāpi yatra dvidhāṇāmeva phalānāṃ kāmanā, tatra tāvatāmyutpattiḥ |
na cāyameva siddhānta iti tantrasāroktaṃ yuktam, bhāṣyādidhvakathanenā- pasiddhāntāt |

muddeśyatā'vacchedakam, sarvaśabdasya viśeṣasyākāṅkṣa- tvācca sarvatvamapi, api tu pūrvavākye kāmaśabdāpādānāt tasyaiva sarvanāmanā sarvaśabdena parāmarśān kāmanāviṣaya- tvameveddeśyatā'vacchedakam, kāryatā'vacchedakatvetyāśrīyete, tathāpi yatra samūhalambhanātmaka anekarūpaviṇī kāmanā, tatra tāvatāmyutpattirnivāryate, iti prāpte, uktayuktyā pravṛttiprayojakakāmanāviṣayatvameva uddeśyatā'vacchedakam |
anuṣṭhānottara-bhāvikāmānāviṣayatvavācchinnotpattivāraṇāya pravṛttiprayojakatvaṃ klṛptāyā eva kāmanāyā uddeśyatā'va- cchedakakoṭipraveśārthaṃ pravṛttiprayojaketi kāmanāviśeṣaṇam |

na ca samūhalambhanasthale viṣaya- tāyā vyādyavṛttitvādenotpattiprasaṅgaḥ, samūhalambhanajñāne iva samūhalambhanecchāyāmapi pratyekameva viṣayatvasyā- vaśyakatvāt, itarathā tādṛśakāraṇāt samūhalambhanamātrakro- reva smṛtilanayotpatteravyāpteḥ |
ata eva kāryatā'vacche- dakāvacchinnasyaiva utpattiniyamāt ekamudādibhyo ghaṭāntaranutpattit phalāntarasyāpyutpattiḥ |

pāpakṣayakāmanāyāstu tattvābhāvena pāpa- kṣayakāmanāyāstu tattvābhāvena pāpakṣayotpattividhakāryatā- 'vacchedakāvacchinnatvāt yugapatphalecchikāmyaprayoge pāpa- kṣayeṇa saha svargādiphalotpattāvapi na kṣatiḥ |

ata eva yatra satvānyena trividhipāparameśvarapriyārthatvena tatta- dvidhitvena yajñādyanuṣṭhānam, tatra kāraṇatvena svargādyutpattau prasaktāyāṃ 'tyaktvā karmaphalasaṅgaṃ' ityādismṛtyā phalāntaradvedyasāpi tatrākṣatvena vidhānāt itaraphalābhāva- viśiṣṭavidhividhādereva vā 'akāmaḥ : sarvakāmo vā' ityādinā phalatvābhidhānāt tadupapattiḥ |
yogasiddhayadhikaraṇe (4|1|21|22-24) ṣaḍvidhaphalaṃ aihikāmuṣmikatvena aniyataṃ iti pratipādi- tam |

bāla. pṛ. 86. arthavādopāttaphalakāmau nirvapeta ityevaṃ lāghavena putatvādināṃ dhyāsajyavṛttiphalatvakalpanena pratyekamuddeśyatā- bhāvāt nātra yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyo'pi ! (vaidhānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapeta putre jāte 0) |
kau. 2|4| 12|22. yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyena paryāyeṇaiva phalaprāptiḥ na yugapat |
śrāddhamayūraḥ pṛ. 37 (ghārapure). ekasminneva prayoge pratipradhānādyavṛttitvanyāyena pratyekaṃ phalavadabhāvāt, na yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyenāpi atra (satre) phalasyaikyaṃ śaṅkanīyam |
soma. 6|2|10. kartṛbhedasya medahetorabhāve'pi yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyena phalabhedasya bhedakatvam |
su. pṛ. 912, dhātvartha phalasya yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyena ānantyaniyamā- bhāvaḥ |

pṛ. 686. nanu yadyapi 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityādau āhavanīyādipadavācyaviśeṣo na nirdhāritaḥ, tathāpi tādṛśasthaiva viniyoge avagate tadviśeṣajijñāsāyāṃ 'naktaṃ gārhapatayamādadhāti' ityādikāvyaiḥ pratyekameva ādhā- najanyādṛṣṭaviśiṣṭābhittve āhavanīyādipadānāmava- gate utpattivākyasya- ('amīnanādadhāti' i.) agni- chāndasyāpi pratyekameva tatlakṣyatvāsāyāt ādhānasyāpi yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyena pratyekamevotpādakatvopapattiḥ |
kau. 3|1|7|14. prayoge tu vikalpaḥ: yogasiddhaya- dhikaraṇanyāyena siddhaḥ |
su. pṛ. 541. phalavayārthamapi saubharaṃ yogasiddhayadhikaraṇanyāyena sakṛduccaritaṃ ekasmin prayoge ekameva phalaṃ sādhayati metarat |

'sarvebhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' ityādī putrapaśutvādyane- koddeśyatvāvacchedakatvena sarvatvamekamulakṣaṇīya tadādi- cat sarvaśabdasya putratvapaśutvādineva śaktigrahāt tatprakā- reṇaiva uddeśyatāvagateḥ |
anyathā sarvatvena rūpeṇa eka- phalatvare yogasiddhayadhikaraṇavirodhapatteḥ |
na ca tatra padārthasaṃsaraṇamātram, na śābdabodhaḥ iti |
tadā hi sarveṣāṃ nāmadheyānāṃ saṃkalpādau vikalpenārthatve- |
'pi yadā yannāmadheyena saṃkalpaḥ tadā tasya putrasya tannāma- |
satyapi hāyaṃ śabdaḥ karoti hi’ iti|
tābhyāṃ preṣalavacchedaṃ kuryāt dakṣiṇāvṛtā dakṣiṇataḥ, savyāvṛtā uttarataḥ; dviguṇe prote kuryāt rajjanoḥ antāśca vīdhavāntayoḥ triḥ pradakṣiṇa paryasya ūrdhvagranthi nidhakyai badhnāti |
vājapeye māhendrasto- pākaraṇasādhanatayā vihitena rathadundubhighoṣeṇa prākṛtadharma- mantrayorvāt |
asti vājapeyaḥ; 'śaradi vājapeyena svārājyakāmo yajeta' iti |
vidhiḥ, prakṛtau ca ājñādānākhyopakāraṇe dabhau 'upāva- rtadhvam' iti mantraśca sādhanam |

tadaupadeśikena ratha- ghoṣeṇātideśikasya bādhe avayavabhāvini, kiṃ ratho dravya- svasāmānyāt dabhyaurnivartakaḥ; ghoṣaśca śabdasāmānyāt mantrasya, kiṃ vā rathasya ghoṣa eva dvayornivartakaḥ; iti cintāyām, pūrvapade lakṣaṇaprasaṅgena tatpuruṣasamāsānu- papatterdva eva evāyam |
na ca dvandve'pi itaretarayogadvandve'śravaṇe dvivacanāpatteraikavacanānurodhena samāhāradvandvo vācyaḥ |
tatra ca bahuvrīhivat samāhāre padadvayasya lakṣaṇattervaraṃ tatpuruṣāṅgīkaraṇameveti vācyam |
nahi 'pāṇipādaṃ vādaya (kṣālaya)' ityādī samāhāre nāma viśeṣatayā kaścit pratīyate, anyathā pāṇipādayoḥ samāhāraviśeṣaṇatve vādana (kṣālana) karmatvānupapatteḥ |
tatra ca 'sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavacceti' iti vacanenaikvacanaṃ vaikalpakam |
ata eva, ekavacanā- ntadvandve 'samāhāradvandvaḥ' iti saṃjñākaraṇamapi paribhāṣā- mātrameva |
ataśca dvandve kasyāpi lakṣaṇīyatvābhāvāt tatpuruṣāpekṣayā tasya prayatnatvameva |
yadi paramekavacanasya dvitvādau lakṣaṇodbhāvyeta tathāpi tasya jaghanyatvakathana- niṣṭhātvāt pāṣādhādhikaraṇanyāyena adoṣatayā tatpuruṣāpekṣayā prayatnatvameva |
na cobhayavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ; dvandena paraspara- sahitayoreva karaṇatvavidhānāt |
na ca tathāpi itaretara- yogadvandve parasparasahitayoḥ padadvayalakṣaṇāyā āvaśyaka- tvāt kathaṃ tatsvīkāraḥ; tatra tasya dhavakhadirasaṃsargāvidha- yā''pi bādhopapattyau lakṣaṇayā pramāṇabhāvāt |
dhavasya hi svasahitasyadvitvasattve'saṃrgaṃ karmatve'nvayaḥ; khadirasyāpi tatsahitadhavasattve'saṃrgaṃ karmatve'nvayaḥ |
ataśca rathau dabhyanivartakaḥ : ghoṣaśca mantranivartaka iti siddham |
evaṃ ca ghoṣo nāvadayaṃ rathasyaiveti prayojanam |
aruṇakahāyanau nyāyena parasparaniyamāt kathaṃ na ghoṣo rathasyaiveti vācyam |
yādṛśo'pyadasyasambhavyate hi āgopā- lāṅganaṃ tadarthayoḥ yādṛśo'nyayo''gamyate tādṛśasyaiva tadarthayoranyāntyutpattau pārthikanobhayatriyatvam |
eva aruṇakahāyanau sthale paricchedasyaparicchedakabhāvaḥ etra pārthikanobhayatriyatvaḥ |

ata eva 'pāṇipādaṃ paśya' ityādī siddhānte dvandve itaretarayogasya parasparasāpekṣyeṇa ekānvaya- rūpasya śabdaghoṣe eva bhāsamānatvāt naiva kaścit pārthi- kānyaḥ; na vā nirūpyanirūpakabhāvasya bodhaviṣayatā |
iti prāpte, nāyaṃ dvandvaḥ, sa hi na tāvaditaretarayogaḥ, tathātve dvivacanāpatteḥ |
nāpi samāhāradvandvaḥ; tasya vācakapadā- bhāvena padadvayasyāpi samāhāre lakṣaṇā''patteḥ |
na ca itaretarayogadvandvaḥ eva 'sarvo dvandvo vibhāṣaikavacceti' ityanena vacanena ekavacanasya vaikalpakatvāvidhānāt samāhāradvandve pramāṇabhāva iti vācyam |
'dvaiaikavaccāvo na paṭhitavyo bhavati samāhāraikatvādave tatsiddheḥ' iti mahā- bhāṣyasyaiva jñāpakavidhayā pramāṇatvāt |
idaṃ hi bhāṣyam 'sarvo dvandvaḥ' ityasya pratyākhyānārthaṃ sat samāhārasya eka- vacanāntadvandvasamāse'bhidhānaṃ gamayati |
ataśca anuśāsa- nabalādeva samāhārasya samudāyāparaparyāyasya padadvaye lakṣaṇā bahuvrīhivat |
na ca tatra kriyānvayānupapattiḥ; 'pāṇipādaṃ padaya' ityādī tadupapatteḥ |
'pāṇipādaṃ vādaya (kṣālaya)' ityādau tu samāhāre eva sāmānyādhikaraṇyena anvayaḥ samā- hriyamāṇayorvā punarlakṣaṇeti dhyeyam |
ataśca samāhāra- dvandvasyātajjanyatvāt varamekalakṣaṇāṅgīkāreṇa tatpuruṣā- śravaṇāt rathasyaiva ghoṣaḥ |

vastutastu yadyapi itaretarayoga- dvandve eva ekavacanasya vaikalpikatā, na tu kvāpi dvandve samā- hārasya bhānamityāśrayate tathāpi prakṛte na dvandvaḥ, eka- vacanasya dvitvādau lakṣaṇāyāḥ dvandvapakṣe'pi tulyatvāt |
na ca jaghanyavṛttitvāt tasyā adoṣatvam, ghoṣasya nirūpakasāpekṣatvena apekṣitavidhānalābhāya mukhyalakṣaṇā- pādakatpuruṣāpekṣayā'śravaṇīyātvāt |
yadā hi śrautārtha- tyāgo'pi apekṣitavidhānalābhāya prajāśarepādāvaṅgī- kṛtaḥ, tadā kimu vaktavyamubhayato lakṣaṇasattve ape- kṣitavidhānalābhāya iti |
kiñca itaretarayogadvandve'pi sāhityalakṣaṇayāḥ padadvaye'pi āśrayatvatvāt tatpuruṣaḥ eva yuktaḥ |
na ca tasya saṃsargavidhayā bhānam, tathātve
na ca śabdasāmānyāt mantrasyaiva nivartako- 'stviti vācyam |

sādṛśyasya hi niyāmakapekṣāyāmeva niyāmakatā, prakṛte copakaṇasaṃndhyājñāpanarūpakārya- janakatvena vihito rathaghoṣo yathārthārthavidhānadvārā jñāpa- kasya mantrasya nivartakaḥ, tathaiva karapalavavat jñāpakasya dharmasyāpi nivartakaḥ jñāpanarūpasya kāryasya aupadeśika- janakatvame janakāntarādeśasyaiva akalpanāt |
ata eva 'venurdakṣiṇā' ityādāvapi na sādṛśyasya niyā- makatā |

yattu kaścit bahuvrīhau anyapadārthe niruddhalakṣa- ṇāyām, paṅkajapade'pi pañcāśe niruddhalakṣaṇapatteḥ yoga- rūḍhipravādocchedāpātāt bahuvrīhauvāpi tadeva anyapadārthe śaktiḥ ityupapāditam (aruṇānyāyena), tat paṅkaja- padapratibandhyā śaktyaṅgīkāre samāhāradvandve'pi samāhāre śakyaṅgīkārāpattau rathaghoṣādhikaraṇasiddhāntānupa- pattiprasaṅgāt upekṣitam |
saṃkarṣa. 2|4|28. mīko. pṛ. 3061 "bhuva- nasya pate" ityādayo daśāhutayaḥ rathamukhe syuḥ" ityatra draṣṭavyam |
yathā- rathe niyukte vaḍave, te militvaiva rathaṃ vahataḥ, viyukte tu na śaknuto voḍhum, parasparanehātiśayātkurutaśca haipaṇaṃ tathā prakṛte'pi |
yathā 'yajuryukte rathamadhvarye dadāti' iti rathasya vākyāntareṇa prāptatvāt adhvaraghanāśca avyurbhāge niyamaḥ (evamihāpi) |
rathakāraḥ atraivarṇikaḥ taivarṇiko vā iti matabhedaḥ |
tatra kiñcit taivarṇikebhyo bhinnaṃ jāyantyantaram, na tu śudrāḥ na vaiśyāḥ na kṣatriyāḥ |
kṣatriyāt vaiśyāyāṃ jāto māhiṣyaḥ--māhiṣyo vā ucyate |
saṃkarṣa. 3|4|16. mīko. pṛ. 2388 'niṣādarathakārayorapi āryetaravarṇamasti' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
tadādhānaṃ ca nāmisaṃskārārthaṃ kintu laukikā- gniguṇaṃ svargaphalaṃ svatantrameva pradhānakarma ! ('niṣādaratha- kārogādhānamāgnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau ca niyamete' iti satyāṣāḍhasūtram |
mīmā. ratha- kārasya ṛṣoḥ saudhanvansa nāma anaivarṇikasya āghāne adhikāraḥ |
tatra sandehaḥ kiṃ taivarṇikānāṃ anyatamo rathakāraḥ; āhosvit anaivarṇika iti |
kiṃ prāptam ? ratha- kārasya anaivarṇikasya ādhānametat |
bhāṣyam-- nyāyyo vā syāt taivarṇiko rathakāraḥ rathakarmaṇā viśeṣeṇocyate |
tān prati varṣā ucyamānā api asaṃbandhādānarthakyaṃ prāpnuyuḥ |
bhāṣyam - evaṃ cet paśyasi, nāsti traivarṇiko rathakāraḥ, pratiṣiddhatvāt śilpopajīvitvasyeti |
bhāṣyam - uktametadasmābhiḥ, na nimittārthāni etāni śravaṇītī (2|3|14) |
kimatau yadi na nimittārthāni ? etadato bhavati, prāpnoti |
vasantādi- saṃyukaṃ tat, kathamiva varṣābhiḥ saṃvadheta |
bhāṣyam - na tu sarva eva atraivarṇiko rathakāraḥ |
hīnāstu kiṃcit traivarṇikebhyo jātyantaram, na tu vaidyāḥ, na vaidyāḥ, na kṣatriyāḥ |
mantravarṇe hi bhavati 'saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ suracakṣasaḥ' iti |

bhāṭṭa. 5|4|3. rathakāraśabdasya rathakāriṇa avayavaprasiddhisaṃbhavāt 'māhiṣyeṇa karivyā ca rathakāraḥ prajāyate' iti smṛteśca anulomaviśeṣe 'saudhanvanāstu hīnatvāmmanya-varṇāt pratīyante' ityanena vā nyāyena (6|1|50) 'ṛbhūṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapatevratenādadhāmī'ti rathakārasyā-dadhyāt' ityādhānamantravarṇāt 'saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ' iti va saudhanvanācchabdasamānādhikaraṇasya ṛbhuśabdasya 'taṃ nemimṛbhavo nayanti' iti mantravarṇāt rathakāravipaya-tvaprasiddheḥ 'trātyāt jāyate vaiśyāt sudhanvācārya eva ca |
mārudhaśca vijanmā ca maitraḥ sātaśca eva ca |
' iti sāvātādyaparaparyāye saudhanvanālye jātiviśeṣe, samudāyaprasiddhisaṃbhavāt 'rathakāra ādadhīta' ityatra samudāyaprasiddhivalīyastvābhidhānaṃ yuktam |
cindu. 9|2|8. rathaṃtaraṃ pavamāne karoti viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe |
bhā. 2016|5|14. rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bahiṣpavamāne viśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe |
7|3|148. rathaṃtaraṃ sāma 'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ 0' ityasyāṃ ṛci gāta-vyam |
'abhi tvā śūra' iti bṛhatī yoniḥ; 'na tvāvān anyo0' iti satobṛhatī, tayoḥ prathamanena ṛktrayaṃ bhavati tatra rathaṃtaraṃ gātavyam |
vi. 9|2|6, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma 'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ 0' ityasyāṃ yonau utpa-nnam |
2|2|16, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma 'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ' iti ṛci gīyate |
paraṃtu 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' iti vidhinā 'kayā naścitra ā bhuvat' ityādiṣu kavatīṣu ṛkṣu gīyate |
7|2|6, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma 'abhi tvā śūra nonumaḥ 0' iti tṛce gīyate |
uttarāgranthai tadādhārasya pāṭhāt (uttarā 680-81) tatra prathamā bṛhatī, dvitīyā ca satobṛhatī |
na tu tatra dāśatayisthe utpattikakubhau samānetve |
svarādiviśeṣaṇapūrvīmātrasvarūpaṃ ṛgakṣaravyatiriktaṃ yad-gānam, tasyaiva rathaṃtaraśabdārthasya atideśaḥ; na tu ṛcaḥ atideśaḥ |
7|2|1, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma jyotiṣṭome pṛṣṭhastotre bṛhatā saha vikalpitam |
7|3|13, sāma jyotiṣṭome mādhyaṃdine savane pṛṣṭhastotreṇa prathamam |
9|2|6 varṇaka 2, rathaṃtaraṃ sāma viśvajiti ṣaḍahāt prāptam |
vā. 2|8|22 pṛ. 521. rathaṃtarasya vṛhattvadharmāṇāṃ aviruddhānāṃ samuccayaśca vaiśyastome kaṇvarathaṃtare |
rathaṃtarasya vṛhattvaśca svayonyuttaraprathanena saṃpāditayoḥ kakubhoreva gānaṃ jyotiṣṭome |
9|2|16-28. mīko. pṛ. 1822 jyotiṣṭome bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ 0' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
rathaṃtarasya yoniḥ bṛhatī, 'abhi tvā śūra 0' iti |
bhā. 9|2|16-27. rathaṃtarasya sāmno yoniḥ 'abhi tvā śūra 0' (yoniḥ 233, uttarā 680) iti ṛk |
vi. 10|4|14. rathaṃtare gīyamāne 'abhi tvā śūra ... īśānamasya jagataḥ svardaśam' iti svardaśaśabdoccāraṇakāle eva vīkṣa-ṇam |
svardaśa iti śabdoccāraṇāt prāgeva saṃmīlanam, na tu sarvasmiṃstace saṃmīlanam, iti siddhāntaḥ |
vi. 10|6|12. 'rathaṃtare prastūyamāne saṃmīlayet, bṛhati samudraṃ manasā dhyāyet' ayaṃ varmataḥ vācanikavyavasthā-vidhiḥ śrautaḥ |
prastāvakāle yaccakṣuḥ saṃmīlitaṃ tat svardaśaśabdoccāraṇakāle unmīlayet |
svardaśaṃ prati vīkṣeta na saṃmīlayet ityarthaḥ |
'abhi tvā' ityārabhya 'asya jagataḥ' ityasyoccāraṇaparyantaṃ saṃmīlanaṃ kāryam, 'svardaśa' ityu-ccāryamāṇe tu vīkṣeta na saṃmīlayet |
jyotiṣṭome 'aindravāyavāgrān mahān gṛhṇāti' ityādinā grahāgratā guṇavidhiḥ |
bhāṣyam-- asti jyotiṣṭomaḥ 'jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajeta' iti |
taṃ prakṛtya śrūyate 'yadi ratha-tarasāmā somaḥ syāt, aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇī-yāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrān, aidaṃ jagatsāmā āmraṇāgrān' iti |
tatra saṃdihyate kiṃ grahāgratāviśeṣo jyotiṣṭomasya vidhīyate, uta karmāntarasya rathaṃtarasāmno bṛhatsāmno veti |
yadi rathaṃtarasāmagrahaṇeṇa bṛhatsāmagraha-ṇena ca jyotiṣṭomo'bhidhīyate tatastasya grahāgratāvi-śeṣaḥ |
nanu jyotiṣṭomasyaiveyaṃ evaṃjārtīyako vāda; rathaṃtara-sāmā bṛhatsāmeti |
yadi na kṛtsna-ṛtusaṃyogo bhavet jyotiṣṭomasya vādaḥ |
kathaṃ kṛtsnaṛtusaṃyogo bhavati, kathaṃ vā na kṛtsnaṛtusaṃyoga iti ? yadi rathaṃtarasāmā vā, bṛhatsāmā vā nimittaṃ grahāgratāviśeṣasya, tato na kṛtsnaṛtusaṃyogaḥ |
rathaṃtaraṃ bṛhadvā sāmāsti, tataḥ aindravāyavāgrā śukrā catā, tato jyotiṣṭomasya guṇavidhiḥ |
atha ratha-tarasāmasattā bṛhatsāmasattā vā na nimittam, tataḥ kṛtsnaṛtusaṃyogaḥ |
marthaḥ, yadi rathaṃtarasāma asya viśeṣaṇaṃ kratoriti |
tatrāyamarthaḥ, yadi rathaṃtarameva sāma, bṛhadeva vā, nānyaditi |
tena yadyapi prakaraṇāt jyotiṣṭomasya guṇavidhiriti gamyate, tathāpi tat bādhitvā vākyena rathaṃtarasāmno bṛhatsāmno bhavitumarhati |
nanu yathā jyotiṣṭomo na rathaṃtarasāmā, evamanyo'pi na rathaṃtarasāmā kaścidasti |
karmāntaraṃ rathaṃtarasāmaṃ kalpayati etadvākyam, yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāt, iti |
vidyamānasya nimittārthena evajātīyakaḥ śabdo bhavati, na vidhānāyeti |
yadetat vākyam, yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāditi, atrāvāntaravākyamasti, rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāditi |
na ca rathaṃtarasāmno bṛhatsāmno vā bhāvo nimittatvena śrayamāṇo'pi arthavān bhavati |
tasmiṃśca aviśiṣṭe padadyamidaṃ rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ, syāditi śaknoti rathaṃtarasāmānaṃ kratuṃ vidhātum, yadidantyevam |
athavā, yathaitadravati 'payasā pāṣṭikaṃ bhuñjīta, yadi śāli-bhuñjīta, tatra dadhi upasiñcet' iti |
evaṃjātīyakena vākyena śālibhojanaṃ vihitaṃ bhavati, evamatrāpi vihitaṃ dravyam |
yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāditi |
kathaṃ punaḥ śālibhojanaṃ tena vākyena vihitaṃ bhavati |
vyāsena saṃbandhaḥ kalpyeta, yadi dadhyupasecanamicchet śāli bhuñjīteti |
nanu na khalu, icchetḥ parāṃ liṅgavibhakti upalabhāmahe, sicyaterhi parāṃ samāmananti iti |
sā parā samuccarantī kamereyaṃ gamayati, kāmapravedane hi tāṃ manvāmahe iti ( 'kāmapravedane'kacciti' pā0 3|1|63 svāmiprāyaviccharaṇe gamyamāne liṅ syāt, na tu kacit) |
evamihāpi yadi aindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāt iti, grahītumicchet ityarthaḥ |
nanu evaṃ sati icchāmātra bhavet, na grahātrāviśeṣavidhānam |

yathā asmin laukike vākye 'yadi dadhyupasecanamicchet, śāliṃ bhuñjīta' iti dadhyupasecanasakīrtanāt dadhyupasiktaṃ śāliṃ bhuñjīta iti tena ekavākyatvāt gamyate, eva- matrāpi atrāhatāviśeṣasaṃkīrtanāt tena ekavākyatvāt grahātrāviśeṣo rathaṃtarāsāmā gamyate |
athavā atra 'hetu- hetumatorliṅ' (pā03|1|156) rathaṃtarāsāmā somaḥ aindra- vāyavāgrāṇāṃ grahāṇāṃ hetuḥ kartavyaḥ iti |
tasmāt kṛtsna- kratusaṃyogāt guṇaḥ karmāntaraṃ prayojayet |
api ca pūrveṇa nimi- ttena bhavitavyam, pareṇa naimittakena |
katham ? sati hi nimitte naimittikaṃ bhaviṣyati, nāsati |
yacca bhavi- ṣyat, tanna sat, bhaviṣyacca rathaṃtarāsāma, tat kathaṃ pūrva- kālasya grahātrāviśeṣasya nimittaṃ bhaviṣyati |
api ca niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ jagatasāmā karmāntaram, tatsāmānyāt ita- radapi karmāntaramiti gamyate |
vā - jyotiṣṭome prathamaṃ vṛhadrathaṃtare vaikalpikaṃ pṛṣṭha- sādhanatvena codite |
tataḥ punaḥ śrūyate 'yadi rathaṃtara- sāmā somaḥ syādaindravāyavāgrān grahān gṛhṇīyāt' 'yadi vṛhatsāmā śukrāgrān' iti |
tatra saṃpūrṇaṃ karma śrayamāṇaṃ saṃdihyate kiṃ karmāntaraṃ jyotiṣṭomāt uta tasyaiva grahātrā- viśeṣavidhānaṃ prati, rathaṃtarāvicchannasya nimittārthaṃ śravaṇa- miti |
tata etasiddhayarthamidaṃ vicārayitavyaṃ kimayaṃ kṛtsnakratusaṃyogo rathaṃtarasya, atha sattāmātrasaṃyogaḥ iti |
tasiddhayarthamapi etaccintyanīyaṃ kiṃ ṛtuviśiṣṭaṃ rathaṃtaram, uta rathaṃtaraviśiṣṭaḥ ṛturvihāśrīyate |
nanu ca yadiśabdo- patradhāt iha nimittaṃ pratīyate, tasya ca uddiśyamānatvāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo nāvakalpeta |
bhavennimittārthatva- metasya yadi yāhagayaṃ pratyeṣyate, tādṛśasya kutaścit prāptirvijñāyate |
nimittatvamapi ca yādṛśasyaiva śrūyate, yadi tādṛśo jyotiṣṭomaḥ, tatastasyaiva guṇārthatvena śravaṇamiti saṃga- myate |
yadi tu tādṛk na bhavati, tataḥ tādṛśalya- māpādya nimittakartavyam |
yatsaṃnyatvācca prāṅnimittameva nopajāyate, bhavati tat nimittasyāpi viśeṣaṇam, yathā ārtyadhikaraṇe vakṣyate (bhāṣye) |

kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? prakaraṇāt rathaṃtarasāmatvasya vṛha- tsāmatvasya ca vacanāntareṇa prāpteḥ, yadiśabdena ca prāpya- pekṣatvanimittatvapratīteḥ, grahātrāviśeṣasya ca prayogavaca- nena grahaṇāt, balīyasā ca virodhinā guṇāntareṇa anava- rodhāt, 'tatsannidherguṇāśrayena punaḥśrutiḥ' ityakarmāntara- tvam |
evaṃ siddhāntaṃ prāptaṃ tuśabdena vyāvartya sautraḥ pūrva- pakṣaḥ parigṛhyate karmāntaramiti |
viśeṣaṇa vyavacchettu jyotiṣṭome ca nāsti tat ||
iha ca bahu- vrīhyaindravāyavasya yadiśabdopavacane nimittatvaṃ gamyate na rathaṃtarasattāyāḥ, upasarjanatvāt |
na ca ṛtuviśiṣṭaṃ rathaṃtaramiha pratīyate, yena tadeva nimittaṃ kalpyeta |
na ca tat ṛtunā avacchettuṃ śakyate, anyatrāpi citra- mānatvāt |
evaṃ hi tadavacchidyate, yadi rathaṃtarasyaiva sāmeti, na tu evaṃ saṃbhavati |
tasmādavaśyameva karta- vyam, yadi rathaṃtarameva asya sāmeti |
na ca evamātma- katvaṃ jyotiṣṭomasya anyasya vā avagatam, yannimittaṃ bhavet |
ato nimittaśrutī parityajya tadanyathā'nupa- patyaiva kevalarathaṃtarasāmakarmāntaravicchediḥ adhyavasīyate |
na ca rathaṃtarasāmātraṃ viśe- ṣaṇam, apyāpakatvāt |
dṛśyate vā asau (samāsaḥ) atra, iti pūrvasyātra apratyabhi- jñānam |
atha kasmāt sa eva kevalarathasāmakaḥ pakṣe na kriyate ? na śakyameva kartum |
idaṃ hi ṛtusaṃbandhena śrutam 'ānarthakyāttadaṅgeṣu' ityanena nyāyena stotreṣvava- tarati, gāyatryādīni tu stotreṣu sākṣāt vidhīyante tasmāt balavanti |
ṛtvantare tu pratyakṣaśiṣṭaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ temya- środakaprāptebhyo balavattaraṃ bhavatītyadoṣaḥ |
anyathā hi upasarjanaparatvaṃ lohitoṣṇīṣādivākyavat agatyā parigṛhyeta |
yadi ca grahātrāvidhānena saha eta- dekaṃ vākyam, tatastatrāpi rathaṃtaravidhānaṃ ca, anekatvāt- pūrvabhāvanāvidhinaiva nistīryate |
somaḥ syāditi ca āna- ntaryāt tatkartavyatayaiva vijñāyate, rathaṃtarasāmatvakartavyatā tu vyapahitakalpanenaiva syāt |
idameva bhāṣyakāro darśayati- 'yadi rathaṃtarasāmetyasya ko'rthaḥ ?' ityādinā |
grahātrāviśeṣaśca asya eva kratoḥ vākyena avāntaraprakaraṇena vā bhaviṣyati |
yadyapi mahāvākyeṣu avāntaravākyāni apramāṇam, tathāpi arthasaṃbhavāt avaśiṣṭe mahāvākye avāntara- vākyāśrayaṇāt vidhiśakteḥ atrādhaḥ |
( yadiśabda- ) parityāgāt varaṃ adhyāhṛtya pūraṇam, iti matvā 'athavā yadi roceta' iti darśayati |
tatkartavyatā''- kṣitāyāśca ruceḥ pramāṇavāneva adhyāhāraḥ, iti na khamanīprikāmātraṃ abhihitam |
adhyāhārādapi khapada- vṛttireva vyavahitakalpanā laghīyasī dharmamātrāccāti iti matvā 'yadi śāliṃ bhuñjīta' ityādāhya padāntaraṃ kalpayati |
parastu dṛṣṭāntasya asiddheḥ 'kathaṃ punaḥ ?' iti pṛcchati |
'ityatyena saṃbandhaḥ' ( kalpyeta yadi dadhyupasecana ityādi bhāṣyam ) 'kāmapravedane hi' liṅ icchāṃ pratyāyayati iti siddhāntādhikaraṇam |
tatra eva vākyārtho bhavati 'yadi aindravāyavāgrān grahān grahītumicchet, rathaṃtarāsāmānaṃ kratuṃ kuryāditi |
' tataśca yadiśabdarahitam 'somaḥ syāt' iti padadvayaṃ vidhā- yakama |
'grahān gṛhṇīyāt' ityetat yadyapi avi- dhāyakam, tathāpi icchāśrayatvāt 'yo hi yadi- cchati, sa tat karoti' ityevaṃ vidhiphalaṃ labhyate |
athavā icchāmātrayuktaṃ upāttaṃ grahātratvaṃ 'syāt' iti eva liṅ vidhāsyati |
vinaiva vyapahitakalpanā''pi ayaṃ pakṣo bhavan balavattaraḥ iti manvānaḥ 'athavā- hetuhetumatorliṅ' ityupansyati |
tatra 'somaḥ syāt' iti hetau liṅ, 'gṛhṇīyāt' iti vidhāveva |
tena etaduktaṃ bhavati, rathaṃtarasāma somahetukān aindravāyavā- grān grahān gṛhṇīyāt iti |
na ca akriyamāṇo'sau hetutvaṃ pratipadyate, iti arthāta vihito bhaviṣyati iti |
'somaḥ syāt' iti vidhī anuktamapi ca somasya hetutvaṃ hetumadāśrayatā saṃniveśa bhaviṣyati |
sarvaṃ caitat ave- ṣṭyadhikaraṇasiddhānte eva upayokṣyate iti atra prapañcitam |
na rathaṃtarasattā ca niṣpannā ṛtusa- ttvat |
' prāta:savane hi grahātrā bhavati, mādhyaṃ- dine rathaṃtaram, na cāniṣpannasya nimittatā yuktā |
kāraṇaparyāyatvāt nimittaśabdasya, mama tu naiva kiṃcit nimittam |
jagatasāmā ca jyotiṣṭomaḥ; iti 'jagatasāmni sāmā- bhāvāt' iti vakṣyate |
nanveta- duktaṃ vākyasāmarthyāt kratvantarasya rathaṃtarāsāmno vṛhatsā- maśceti |
punarduṣṭitaṃ anekasāmatvāt jyotiṣṭomasya, viśeṣaṇaṃ rathaṃtareṇa vṛhatā vā na prakalpyate iti |
samavaiti, pṛthagevātiṣṭhate abhi tvā, kyā naḥ iti |
kriyāyā hi gānakriyāyāḥ śabdena abhisaṃbandho bhavet, na |
tīṣu gāyati' iti aṅgabhāvaḥ śakya upadeṣṭum ? śakyaḥ ! |
yathā 'yena karmaṇaitat tatra jayān juhuyāt ' iti |
yadyapi ca sarvatra nimittasya svasattve naimi- |
kiṃ punaḥ prayojanaṃ kavatīnāṃ abhabhavo nirvartayanti |
siddheḥ tadabhāve tadabhāva eva prameyaṃ bodhyam |
yasmāt kriyā śrūyate, kavatīṣu rathaṃtare gāyatīti |
asmin pakṣe doṣaḥ, yat prayojanaṃ kriyāyāḥ kalpayi- |
bhāṣyam-- iti cet paśyasi kavalyajñabhāvena abhi- |
saṃbhavāt arthe kāryaṃ vijñāyate, yathā gāmānaye iti |
iha tu śabde eva kāryaṃ saṃbhavati, nārthe |
tu na jñāyate kimebhiḥ śabdaiḥ ucyate iti |
yadi sa eva nirṇayaḥ, kimartha ākṣepaḥ ? |
yaḥ śabdo yasminnarthe autpattikena saṃbandhena prasiddho na |
nanu gīto satyāṃ bhāvāt gānākhyasya saṃskārakarmaṇo |
naitāvān prayāsaḥ śiṣṭānāṃ phale'bhyupagantuṃ nyāya iti |
atha tu mantrā ete, tataḥ anvahaṃ 'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' |
sāmaśabdena loke abhīdhīyate sāmāmā devadatta iti- |
ekena hi tadā paryāptam, yathā gītiriti |
ca yadi gānaṃ rathaṃtaram, gānaṃ ca bṛhat, idaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ idaṃ |
kṣarāṇāṃ abhijyako nādaḥ kavatīṣu bhāvayituṃ śakyaḥ |
atha ṛṅanāmānyetāni, tata ṛcāṃ medāt vikāra- |
iha 'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyati' ityasya vākyasya dve vacana- |
rathaṃtaraṃ yat, tat kavatīṣu gāyatīti ityaparā |
gāyati' iti kavatīnāṃ vā kāryaṃ abhilavataḥ atidiśye- |
sā'pi na saṃbhavati, na hi kavatīṣu rathaṃtaramasti |
gāyati iti kavatībhiḥ yo'sau'midhīyate, taṃ abhilavataḥ |
kavatīnāṃ ca vibhaktā abhivatījyapi vidyante kavatī- vyapi |
so'sau abhivatīsvaraḥ kavatīṣu sādhāraṇavarṇa- samameto vidyate |
bhāṣyam-- liṅgaṃ ca dṛśyate etasminnarthe, asti rathaṃtaraṃ uttarayoriti |
kiṃ tat liṅgaṃ bhavati ? evamāha, 'rathaṃtaramuttarayorna paśyāmi' iti viśvāmitrastapastepe, 'bṛha- duttarayorna paśyāmi' iti vasiṣṭhaḥ iti |
yacca vidyamānaṃ na dṛśyate taddarśanāya yatnaḥ kriyate, yathā ghaṭaṃ na paśyā- mīti pradīpaṃ karoti, na śaśaviṣāṇaṃ na paśyāmīti |
kutaḥ ? evaṃ sati uttarasya vikāro na kaścit śruto bhavati |
tatra 'rathaṃtaramuttara- yogaryāta' ityetadanuvādamātraṃ apravṛttiviśeṣakaraṃ anartha- kameva āpadyate |
bhāṣyam-- rathaṃtarādīnāṃ ca sāmaśabdānāṃ asāma- ñjasyaṃ syāt 'rathaṃtaramuttarayoḥ', bṛhaduttarayoḥ' iti |
ayaṃ rathaṃtaraśabdo bṛhacchabdo vā svarasya sāmaśabdatve svarasamudāye ānupūrvyā avasthite svaraviśeṣe prayuktaḥ |
sa ekadeśe bhinnānupūrvya ca asa- mañjaso bhavati |
tasmāttattat yuktam, svarasya sāmaśabdaḥ; tasya cānuvāda iti |
atrāha, evaṃ bhavatā sarve pakṣā niṣṭāḥ |
nanu uktaṃ na śakyā ṛcaḥ ṛgantare pradeśaṃ iti |
'kavatīṣu rathaṃtaraṃ gāyatī' ityucyate, na ca śakyate kavatīṣu ratha- taraṃ gātum, tatra deśalakṣaṇā bhavati, kavatīdeśe iti |
yathā agnau tiṣṭhati, kūpe tiṣṭhati iti |
rathaṃtaradharmā vā kavatīṣu rathaṃtarādyena ati- diśyante |
yathā 'rathaṃtaraṃ prastūyamāne pṛthivīṃ manasā dhyāyet' ityevamādayaḥ |
yathā ācārye proṣite ācā- ryānī bhavatāmācāryaḥ iti ācāryāśuśrūṣā ācāryānyā- matidiśyate |
apitu karmaśabdaḥ syādvā'rthaḥ prasiddhagrahaṇa- tvād vikāro haviśiṣṭo'nyaiḥ |
bhāṣyam-- apitu naivaṃ syāt ṛcaḥ sāmaśabdaḥ tasyāśca pradeśaḥ iti, tathā deśalakṣaṇā dharmalakṣaṇā vā āśrayaṇīyā |
tatra gīti- viśiṣṭāṃ ṛci eṣa śabdo dṛṣṭaḥ |
ato nāsti ṛcaḥ śabdena saṃsparśaḥ iti |
ayaṃ ca gāyatīti śabdo gānakriyāyāṃ prasiddhaḥ |
kā punarasau ? śabdasya uccāraṇaviśeṣaḥ; gāyati gānaṃ karoti iti |
yathā āsāāritakaṃ gāyatīti, vardhamānakaṃ gāyati iti |
nanu śabdavacanenāpi samuccāraṇaṃ bhavati, gāthāṃ gāyati, ṛcaṃ gāyati iti |
vipariṇamya tu śabdam, gānena ṛcaṃ saṃskṛtoti iti |
yathā- nipatitena arthena na saṃvadhyate gānaṃ ṛcamiti |
yathā avahantinā vrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulībhāvaḥ, pipiṇā taṇḍulānāṃ piṣṭībhāvaḥ |
tasmāt śabdānāṃ saṃskāro gānākhyo rathaṃtarādibhiḥ śabdai- rucyate |
tasya yonyāṃ prayoge śiṣṭita punaḥ uttaratra na śikṣitavyam |
tāsu akarmakāle prayogaḥ saṃskārakarma- tvena yukto bhavati |
yena odanapāko gṛhītaḥ nāsau adikṣitvā guḍaṃ paktuṃ jānāti |
bhāṣyam--evaṃ ca sāmaśabdānāṃ ṛkśabdānāṃ ca sāmañjasyaṃ bhavati |
kavatī- śabdaḥ ṛca eva vakṣyati, rayaṃtaraśabdaśca sāma |
itarathā kavatīśabde vā deśalakṣaṇā syāt, rayaṃtaraśabde vā dharmalakṣaṇā |

śa--‘kavatīṣu rayaṃtaraṃ gāyati’ ityanena rayaṃtaraśabdena kiṃ kavatīṣu atidiśyate iti parijñānārthaṃ rayaṃtarādiśabdāḥ kiṃ gītiviśiṣṭāṇāṃ ‘abhi tvā śūra notumaḥ’ ityādīnāṃ vācakāḥ uta gītimātrasya iti cintyate |
dvitīyaṃ tu mantralakṣaṇaṃ kurvatā ‘gītiḥ sāma’ iti etāvaduktam, na tu upāditam |
iha tu ati- deśaviṣayasiddhayarthaṃ gītiviṣayatvameva nyāyena dṛḍhīkriyate |
viśiṣṭavacanatve viśeṣaṇībhūtagītyabhidhānasya āvaśyaka- tvāt tadabhidhāne ca tata eva tadavinābhūtāyāṃ ṛci pratipattisiddheḥ, abhidhānaśaktikalpanānupapatteḥ gīti- mātrameṣāṃ abhidheyam |
ataḥ abhidhayāṃ yo gīti- viśeṣaḥ, tasya kavatīṣu atideśaḥ |
soma--gītivacanatvavicārasya atideśārthatvena tanmukhatvena atideśasyaiva vicāryatvāt adhyāyasaṃgatiḥ |
anyathā āyībhāvaprayogakāle smṛtyābhāve sāmno ṛgābhivyañjakatvābhāve adṛṣṭārthatā syāt |
sūtrārthastu--sāmnāḥ abhidhāyakena rayaṃtarādi- śabdena yathāśiṣṭaṃ adhyāpakeḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ yat anuśiṣyate gītiviśiṣṭamantrarūpaṃ tat anatikramya pravṛttiḥ vyavahāraḥ syāditi |
’ bhāṭṭa--prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome abhīvalyamutpannaṃ rayaṃtaraṃ vikṛtiviśeṣe avikāvyādau kavatīṣu kartavyatvena śrūyate ‘kavatīṣu rayaṃtaraṃ gāyati’ ityādinā |
tathā ‘yatronyāṃ gāyati, taduttarayogārthati’ iti ca śrutam |
tatra rayaṃtarādi- śabdānāṃ gītiviśeṣaviśiṣṭāyāṃ ṛci prayogāt viśiṣṭa- vācakatve prāpte, ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyena gītiviśeṣa- mātraṃ vijātīyagītitvamātraṃ vā vācyam |
evaṃ sāmaśabda- syāpi gītimātraṃ gītilamātraṃ vā vācyam, na tu gītiḥ tadviśiṣṭā vā ṛk |
tasyāścintyanyāyena aruṇā- pada iva sati mukhyārthābhāve lakṣaṇayā bodhopapatteḥ |
yadi hi ṛgvācitvaṃ bhavet, tadā ṛci ṛgatīdeśasaṃbhavāt, kavatīśabdaḥ kāryalakṣaṇārthaḥ |
tatkāryaṃ arthaprakāśānaṃ lakṣaṇadinā abhivalyā kuryāt iti kavatī- kāryaṃ ṛgantarasyātideśaḥ |
deśalakṣaṇayo vā kavatīdeśe abhivatī paṭhet iti, jaghanyaṃ rayaṃtarapadaṃ vā taddharmalakṣaṇa- ṇārthaṃ sat taddharmitadeśārthaṃ kavatīṣu saṃmīlanādīn ratha- taradharmīn kuryāt ityarthaḥ |
anye tu bhāṣyasthāḥ pakṣāḥ asaṃbhavaduktikatvāt na likhitāḥ |
siddhānte tu lakṣa- ṇāyāṃ pramāṇābhāvāt ṛcaḥ iha bodhasyaiva abhāvena gītimātrasyaiva kavatīṣu atideśaḥ iti prayojanam |

na ca ‘yadyonyāṃ gāyati’ ityādī yonisaṃbandhitvena rūpeṇa vidheyatvāt atideśalakṣaṇopapatti api ‘kavatīṣu rayaṃtaraṃ gāyati’ ityādī rayaṃtarasyaiva vidheyatāvaccheda- katvāt atideśatvānupapattiḥ iti vācyam |
vastutastu gṛhemedhīye ājya- bhāgavidheḥ atideśatvābhāvāt asyāpi atideśatvābhāve na kācit kṣatiḥ |
lāghavena abhivatīṣu yena rūpeṇa upakārakatvaṃ tenaiva kavatīṣu upakārakatvasvīkāreṇa ūhopa- patteḥ |
rayaṃtarādhikaraṇe viśvaji- dādivat saṃsavādau virodhābhāve nibhisābhāvāt na naimittikā dharmaḥ iti kaustume nirūpitam |
ataśca tatrāniyatā grahyātā, aniyatā ca yā kācit pratipat |
sauryasya bhāṣyakārīya eva rayaṃtarādhikaraṇa- nyāyena āgneyadyavikāratvāt mantradvayaprāptā abhiśardhane nirapekṣasādhanayoḥ samuccayasaṃbhavena vikalpadādyavyavasthā sidhyati |
sāmaśabdo rayaṃtarādiśabda gīti- vācakāḥ’ ityatra draṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyam--sāmānyādudāharaṇam, rayaṃtaraṃ bṛhad vairūpaṃ vairājaṃ śākvaraṃ raivata miti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimakṛtsāmayi gānaṃ kartavyamuta tṛce iti |
yathā svādhyāye gītāni, tathā karmaṇi gātavyāni |
evamāha, aṣṭākṣareṇa prathamāyā ṛcaḥ prastauti, dvayakṣareṇottarayo- riti |
so'bravīt, na vai tvaṃ mamāmasi jāyāle vedo me mahimeti |
te dve bhūlocatuḥ; so'bravīttrivaṃ bhūlocuḥ; so'bravītsaṃbhavāmeti |
tasmā- dekaṃ sāma tṛce kriyate stotrīyam’ iti |
kṛtsne'pi ṛgvede na prathamā nāma kācit ṛgasti, tathā uttare iti |
vyavasthākṛtaṃ prathamātvam, uttaratvamiti prathamāyā ṛco'ṣṭākṣareṇa prastotavyam, dvayakṣareṇa cottarayoriti |
tathā yadyapyanuvādarūpo'yaṃ śabdaḥ, tasmādekaṃ sāma tṛce kriyate stotrīyamiti, tathāpi ṛk- sāmovāca-iti purastādvyādaprarocanayā vidadhātīti gamyate |

śa--santi jyotiṣṭome rayaṃtarādīni stotrīyāṇi sāmāni, tāni kiṃ ekaikasyāṃ ṛci geyāni, uta tṛce iti saṃśaye svādhyāyavelāyāṃ ekasyāṃ ṛci gītatvāt tadvailakṣaṇyāya yajñe api ekasyāṃ bhaveyuḥ; ‘ekaṃ sāma tṛce kriyate’ iti vartamānanirdeśarūpaṃ na vidhikṣamamitye-
'ṛksāmovāca' ityādyarthavāda- vibhāvipratiṣedhākeḥ 'ekaṃ sāma tṛce kriyate' iti vacanāt tṛce gātavyānīti siddhāntaḥ |
yadvā sāmaviṣaye bādhaḥ prādhānyena atra cintyate iti pādāntaratā, pūrvatra vacanamatvāt 'suparṇo'si gāyatracchandāḥ' iti ayayāstvāvyatve api iha yathāstvāvyatvameva ityādyāntarasaṃgatiśca ityāhuḥ |
vastutastu ekāhāhararṇātmakasomayāgaviṣayo bādho'tra nyutvādyate iti pādāntaraṃ bodhyam |
bhāṭṭa-- yonyāmekasyāmevotpannāni sāmāni tasyā- meva karmakāle geyāni, svādhyāyakāle tathaivābhyastatvāt, sāmaviśeṣe tucotpattiveyavyāpatteśca, 'ekaṃ sāma' ityā- destadviṣayatvenānuvādopapatteśca |
na ca kartā pratyāyyamāno vīkṣaṇaliṅgena kalpyate, dṛśeratyantaparatantratvāt |
kartṛvidhānaśca sannayaṃ naiva vīkṣitānā sāmañjasya saṃbandhamupaiti |
ko'sau svartaśaṃ, yaṃ prati vīkṣaṇamupadiṣṭamityavijānanto naiva kriyāmadhyavasyema |
tadevaṃprakāre saṃbandha ājñasyena abhyupagamyamāne na liṅgaṃ na ca vākyamanugṛhyate |
lakṣaṇa- saṃbandhe tu vīkṣaṇasya, etaduccāraṇakāle vīkṣateti bhavati kayācid yuktyā saṃbandhaḥ |
stutisaṃbandhaśca kartṛvidhāna- syāpi sato na virudhyate |
sāmānyādhikāravaśādīśane viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasaṃbandhamabhyupaiti, īśānaṃ svartaśaṃ tataśca iti |

atra yadyapi sākṣāt raśanā śrūyate, kintu 'yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti yūpapariṣyāṇādeva labhyate, tathāpi darbhamayādiśabdānāṃ yaugikatvena pari- ṣyāṇādiśaraṇāviśeṣavacanatvāt bhāṣye raśanā śrūyate ityuktam |
yūpapariṣyāṇa 'yūpaṃ parivyayati' ityanena yathā agnīṣomīye vidhīyate, tathā 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītopaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' ityanena savanīye'pi vihitam |
tena yūpapariṣyāṇādeya ubhayatra raśanāyāḥ prāptatvāt raśanādharmāḥ śrayamāṇāḥ kimagvīṣomīyaraśanāyā eva uta agnīṣomīyasavanīyaśanāyā iti bhavati sandehaḥ |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ - agnīṣomīyasya krame caturdaśyāṃ raśanādharmā darbhamayādayaḥ śrūyante na savanīyasya |
kintu yūpasvarūpasaṃbandhaḥ ānarthakyāt apūrvasādhanalakṣaṇayā śrutyā viniyogo vaktavyaḥ |

tena yathā śrutyā prakaraṇasahāyabhūtayā barhidharmāḥ prakaraṇavarti- barhirmātrāḥ, evaṃ śrutisādhāraye'pi na piṇḍapitṛyajña- barhirmāḥ tathā raśanādharmā api kramasahāyayā śrutyā kramopasthitāgnīṣomīyayūpapariṣyāṇaraśanāyāṃ eveti |
bhavedevaṃ yadyagnīṣomīya- śrutasya 'yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti pariṣyāṇasya trīhiprokṣaṇa- vat yūpadvāreṇa pradhānāpūrvanirvāhatyupayogo bhavet |
kintu yūpasya alaukikatvena aniṣṭatopāyaparimāṇasya sādhanā- pekṣāyaṃ 'yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti dvitīyāśrutyā yūpani- rbutyupayogitvenaiva pariṣyāṇasya yūpārthatvaṃ vijñāyate |
evaṃ savanīye'pi 'upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti dvitīyāśrutyā yūpārthatayā pariṣyāṇaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ sādhāraṇya yūpasyāgnīṣomīya eva niṣpannatvāt |
yadyapi na yūpasvarūpa- nirvṛttyupayukpham, tathāpi svarūpe kāryaṃ copayogyāti- bhavatīta nyāyena yūpakāryapaśuyojanopayuktatvādāti- śayyajanenaivaṃ bhavati |
etacca yūpārthaṃ pariṣyāṇaraśanā- tvāviśeṣāt ubhayaraśanāsādhāraṇā eva bhavanti |
na caiva sati agnīṣomīyayūpasya krameṇa saṃnidhāpitatvāt kramasahāyayā śrutyā tatpariṣyāṇaraśanāyāṃ eva vijñāyate |
prakaraṇasahāyayeva śrutyā barhirdharmā darbhapūrṇāmāsīyabarhirmā iti vācyam |
yato ya eva agnīṣomīyasya yūpaḥ, sa eva savanīyasyāpi |
tena agnīṣomīyayūpapariṣyāṇaraśanāsaṃvidha- tvena vidhīyamānā dharmāḥ savanīye yūpapariṣyāṇaraśanāsaṃ- nvenāpi vihitā bhavanti |
yatsādhāraṇā dharmā iti tathāpi savanīyotpattivākye 'trivṛtā yūpaṃ pari- vīva' ityanuvādo raśanādharmāsādhāraṇyādinā'nupapadya- māno liṅgaṃ bhavati |
tena liṅgadarśanādapi sādhāraṇā raśanādharmā iti siddham |
tenāya- marthaḥ, yadattu grahadharmāḥ savanatrayavartigrahasādhāraṇāḥ, tadvat raśanādharmā api sādhāraṇāḥ |
raśanā ca liṅgadarśanāt ityasya siddhāntavādinā ubhayoḥ pariṣyāṇayoḥ sādhāraṇī raśanā iti parihāro vaktavyaḥ |
(aṣṭādaśāt sūtrāt tulya-śabdo- 'nuvartate) raśanā ca agnīṣomīyasavanīyayoḥ paśroḥ tulyā |
evamāha 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivyaya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupakaroti' iti savanīyapariṣyāṇe raśanāṃ darśayati |
iti prāpte, śrutyā yūpārtha iti sidhyati |
saha dharmeṇa sā yāti krameṇa paśuśeṣatām |
vā. 3|3|7 pṛ. 836. raśanā taddharmāśca yūpadharmā eva, na paśudharmāḥ |
vi. 3|6|10. raśanā (dvitīyā) na paśugrahaṇārthā kintu yūpasaṃskārārthā |
agnīṣradhane (dve) pakṣayūparaśanādha, aha- rgaṇe tantreṇa eva upakurvanti |
saṃkarṣa. 1|4|12. mīko. pṛ. 78 'agniṣṭe raśanā vāsayati' iti raśanāsaṃskāraḥ |
raśanāyā yūpapariṣyāṇa (yūpapari- veṣṭanaṃ) 'parivīrasi' ityādimantreṇa adhvaryuḥ karoti |
vā. 4|4|122 pṛ. 1279. sāgnika- kratau ekayūpe ekādaśapaśūnāṃ niyojane yūpasaṃskārāthāṃ raśanāyāḥ medatvabhāvāt dvairāśyameva |
bhāṣyam -- asti jyotiṣṭome paśuyajñomīyaḥ 'yo dīkṣito yadagnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhate' iti |
tatra raśanā śrūyate raśanādharmāśca 'trivṛd bhavati, darbhamayī bhavati, prapidhānāṃ kartavyā ca' iti |
tatra sandehaḥ kimete dharmāḥ agnīṣomīyaraśanāyāḥ savanīyaśanāyāśca sādhāraṇāḥ uta agnīṣomīyaraśanāyā eveti |
evamāha 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivyaya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupakaroti' iti savanīyapariṣyāṇe raśanāṃ darśayati |
sā yadi sādhāraṇī, tata etadarīna- mavakalpate |
yadi agnīṣomīyāyāḥ, tataḥ aprākṛtāt savanīyapariṣyāṇāt nivarteta |
savanīye ca pariṣyāṇāntaraṃ aprākṛtam, yatra trivṛt dṛśyate |
katham ? 'sa vai āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti |
na sādhāraṇī raśanā, vāsasā pariṣyāṇaṃ prāpnoti |
vā -- agnīṣomīye yūpapariṣyāṇamāmnāya punaḥ sava- nīye 'sa āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā' ityāmnātam, tacca niguṇapunaḥśravaṇāt karmāntaram |
yacca pariṣyāṇadravyam, sā raśanā loke vede ca prasiddhā |
sā ca kimayī kiṃgharmā ca ityapekṣite agnīṣomīyasya sthānanumite prakaraṇe 'trivṛt darbhamayī prapidhānāṃ kartavyā' ityāmnātāt viśeṣaḥ pratīyate, na savanīyapariṣyāṇasya |
nahi savanīyotpattivākye trivṛttvādyanuvādo raśanādharmasādhāraṇā- dinā upapadyate |
kā prāsiriti cettāmāha - vākyasaṃyogāt raśanāmātrasya, sthānādagnīṣomīyasya |
kiṃ tarhi 'yūpaṃ vā tatsaṃsakā- rāt' (4|4|123) iti vakṣyati |
tathā ca agnīṣomīyasthaṃ yūpapariṣyāṇameva ca yūpaikatvāt savanīyasthaṃ yūpapariṣyāṇam |
dravyamapi ca apūrvasādhanamiha pratīyate, na tu darśapūrṇamāsabarhiriva piṇḍapitṛyajñe bhaviṣyati |
soma- pūrvavat kramaprāptasya prakaraṇasyābhāvāt raśanādharmāṇāṃ amīpomīyārthatvaṃ ityusthitaḥ saṃgatiḥ |
ekādaśe (11|1|13-4) yūpasya saumikapaśutve tantratāyā vakṣyamāṇatvāt, savanīyaparivyāṇamapi agnī- pomīyasaṃbandhipūpasaṃjñataṃ bhavati |
sūtrārthastu- sadharmā raśanā ca parivyāṇadvayasyāpi sādhāraṇī |
'tribhṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti' iti savanī- yotpattivākye tribhṛtvadharmayuktaraśanānuvādarūpaliṅgadarśanāt iti |
bhāṭṭa-- paśuniyojanādisaṃjñatvena viniyuktasya yūpasya anuṣṭhānasādedyāt agnīpomīyapūrvasādhanabhūtapaśuniyo- janārthatvam, atideśāt savanīyānubandhyārthatvam |
yadyapi ca yūpa- svarūpe ānarthakyāmnāyaḥ, tathāpi anuvādyasya saṃnihita- gāmitvādeva agnīpomīye niveśaḥ |
teṣāṃ tu medanādyutthāne prāpte dīkṣākāla- syāpi upadeśātideśābhyāṃ vihitasya ekatvāt tantreṇānu- ṣṭhānāt ekasyā eva yūpasyaiḥ sarvopakārakatvaṃ ekādaśe (11|1|13) vakṣyate |
ye ca parivyāṇadayaḥ utpanna- yūpasaṃskārakāḥ teṣāmeva anuṣṭhānasādedyāt atideśābhyāṃ prakṛtivikṛtitvam |
yūpasyaiketaratvāt gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatve'pi ātithyādyarthavādiḥ prokṣaṇanyāyena (12|1|19) prasa- ṅgena kāryasiddheḥ nāvṛttiḥ |
na caivaṃ tanyāyenaiva agniprā- saṃmāgādeḥ dāśapaurṇamāsikasyāpi vikṛtau prasaṅgāpattiḥ |
vrīhiprokṣaṇādivat yatkāryakuṭodeśena yadyapyake- tpattiḥ tatkāryakṛṭā'bhūtadavyutthitagatasaṃskārajanyāhaṣṭa prati tatkāryāntimakāryatvena nāśakatvasya klaptatvena tadanāpatteḥ |
nahi atra agniprāptādeḥ yatkāryakuṭodeśena utpattiḥ tatkārya- kūṭā'ṅgaṃ saṃskāraḥ, saṃmārgasya jyotiṣṭomādyanyatvatvāt |
ataḥ tadvākkijanyahaṣṭatvācchinnaṃ prati taddhyatiyogya- phalībhūtāntimakāryatvena nāśakatvā iti viśiṣṭakāryakāraṇa- bhāvenaiva tatpatiyogighṛttimaphalena nāśaḥ iti vaiṣa-
evaṃ ca parivyāṇaraśanātādarthyamādāyaḥ aupavasathye'hani anuṣṭhīyamānā api, upadeśātideśābhyāṃ tritayopa- kārakāḥ |
savanīya ca 'āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvā upaniṣkramya yūpaṃ parivyayati' iti vidhinā abhyāsāt parivyāṇāntaraṃ vihitam, āśvinottarakālasya pāṭhāt, upaniṣkramasya cārthadeva prāptaḥ |
tadapi ca na prākṛtakāryārtham, prākāśadānavat vidhi- vaiyarthyāpatteḥ |
ata eva tatkāryamahaṣṭaṃ yūpadādyaṃ vā itya- nyadetat |
tadiha raśanā taddharmāśca tribhṛtvadharmabhīyatvādyo nāprākṛtakāryārthatve parivyāṇāntare yūpavaṭvarhirāstaraṇe iva bhavanti |
iti prāpte, utpattivākye tribhṛtvānuvāda- rūpatātparyagrāhakavaśāt lāghavācca prakṛtapūrvasādhanabhūta- yūpaparivyāṇatvameva uddeśyatāvacchedakaṃ na tu vijātīya- yūpaparivyāṇatvam |
tathātve utpattivākye tribhṛtvasyāprāpta- tvena vidhāne gauravāpatteḥ |
