tatra ākāṅkṣāyāḥ pramāṇatve aṅgatva- pramāṇavibhāgāt kopāt pāke samarthasyāpi devadattasya pākākāṅkṣā'bhāve pāke viniyogādarśanena ākāṅkṣāṃ vinā liṅgasya kāpi aviniyojakatvāt sarvatra ākā- ṅkṣāyā eva aṅgatvapramāṇatvāt liṅgaprāmāṇyānā- patteśca |
atha śrutavidhinā prayājaśeṣakaraṇābhidhāraṇasya havi- radeśena vidhau abhidhāraṇe prayājaśeṣasya viniyuktatvena pratipatyākāṅkṣā abhāvāt ārthikavidhikalpanā'- nupapattiḥ |
na ca yathā 'uttarārdhāt sviṣṭakṛte sama- vadyati' ityatra uttarārdhasya apādānatayā guṇatvena vini- yuktasyāpi ārthikavidhikalpanayā pratipādyatvaṃ tathā ihāpi iti vācyam |
tatra tyāgāṃśaṃ prati viniyukta- syāpi uttarārdhasya prakṣepāṃśaprayojanākāṅkṣayā ārthika- vidhikalpanayā prakṣepāṃśaṃ prati pratipādyalopapattāveva prakṛte aṃśabhedābhāve tadanupapatteḥ |
etena (yathā) 'maitrā- varuṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' ityatha daṇḍa'karaṇadāsya maitrāvaruṇoddeśena vidhiḥ |

iti siddhānte dīkṣitadaṇḍasya dīkṣā- bhidhvajakātmanopayuktasya dāne'pi viniyogāsaṃbhavāt śrutavidheḥ daṇḍāntaramyojakatvāt maitrāvaruṇavaraparihārāya ārthikadānapratipattirūpatayā daṇḍasya dānapratipattitvam |
pratipatteśca kāryasaṃkocatvasya kṛṣṇavipāṇāsthale vakṣya- tvāt kāryasaṃkocena dīkṣitadaṇḍaviṣayatvasiddheḥ iti natye- ruktam |

tathā iha abhidhāraṇe viniyuktasya śrutavidheḥ dhāraṇākṣepaśaktikalpanāgauravaparihārāya uttarārdhapratipatyā- kāṅkṣayā ārthikapratipattividheḥ kalpayitvā pratipādyatva- mastu 'doṣo nāmite tvasī' iti nyāyena ārthike pratipattividhī dhāraṇaprayojakatvaśaktikalpya adopatvāt iti nirastam |
tatra samarpaṇamātreṇaiva maitrāvaruṇopakāra- siddheḥ tyāgāṃśena daṇḍapratipattavyatāyāḥ nacaiva uttaratvāt prakṛte tadītarasaṃbhavāt |
vidhi viśeṣaṇavidheḥ āvaśyakatvāt tasyaiva dhāraṇākṣepa- śaktirūpaṇopapattau na śrutavidhau tattvenyanuktagauravāva- kāśāḥ |
maitrāvaruṇāya ityatra tu viśeṣaṇavidhikalpanaṃ laghīyaḥ iti vaiṣamyam |
taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ 'yat dīkṣita- daṇḍaṃ prayacchati' iti pratipattividheḥ śrutatvena tatra tadakalpanāt |

śrutavidhau prayājaśeṣaprakaraṇa- tvasya bhāvanāyāmapyasti'pi yāgārthatābodhasya uttarakālīna- viśeṣaṇavidhyadhīnatvāt tataḥ pūrvaṃ prayājaśeṣīyapratipatyā- kāṅkṣāyā aniṣṭatvaḥ viśeṣaṇavidheriva pratipattividherapi pratipatyākāṅkṣāsahakṛtaliṅgarūpasāmagrīsattvena kalpanopa- patteḥ |
na ca evaṃ viśeṣaṇavidherapi kalpyatvādiṣepeṇa vinigamanāviharaṇāt dhāraṇākṣepaśaktikalpanā'patteḥ daikṣe hṛdayādyabhidhāraṇārtham |
vājapeye prājāpatyapā'bhidhāra- ṇārthaṃ ca śeṣasya dhāraṇīyātvāpattiḥ |
tathā ca pratipatte- reva dhāraṇaprayojakatvopagamena saṃnihitavidhiṣu ca śeṣa- samāptoktiḥ caturthoktā (prayājaśeṣābhidhāraṇanyāye 8| 1144 bhāṭṭa. ) viruddhayeta iti vācyam |
kālāntarīya- havirbhidhāraṇārthaṃ pātrāntaropadānagauravasyaiva vinigama- karatvena pratipattividhereva dhāraṇakṣepatvakalpanena avi- rodha ityāśayena nadhyamatabhyatāsaṃbhavāt |
atra mantraliṅgakalpyaśrutau na lavanatvena lavanasya udde- śyatā, vinā'pi mantraṃ prakārāntareṇa smṛtyā (smṛtyā) lavanasaṃbandhena anarthatvāt, api tu apūrvīyalavana- tvena |
na ca tena rūpeṇa mantratvaṃ saṃbhavati, tasya lavanatvamātreṇa bodhakatvāt |
na ca apūrvīyalava- natvena bodhaṃ vinā anena mantreṇa apūrvīyalavanaṃ prakāśyate' iti niruktoddeśyatā'vacchedakāvacchinna- vācakapadaśrutikalpanaṃ saṃbhavati |
pūrṇamāsasaṃbandhi kiṃcit anena prakāśyate' ityevagate 'kiṃ tat' ityapekṣāyāṃ 'lavanaṃ' iti mantraliṅgataḥ avagamyate |
evaṃ pūvān- mantramantre yāgānumantraṇamiti samākhyāyā 'yāgasāmānyā- pūrvasaṃbandhi kiṃcit anena prakāśyate' itya- vagate 'kiṃ tat' iti apekṣāyāṃ 'pūṣā' iti mantraliṅgā- davagamyate |

yatra tu uddeśyasvarūpe ānarthakyābhāvena apūrvasādhanatvā- dinoddeśyatvaṃ na prakaraṇādyapekṣā yathā arthajñānasya sāma- rthyāt karmānuṣṭhānāttve, tatra liṅgasya sāmānyasaṃbandha- bodhakapramāṇānapekṣatvam |
liṅgasya ca aśabdatvena avidhāyakatvāt vihitatva- ghaṭitaniruktāṅgatvasāmānyasaṃbandhena vidhāyakaśruti- kalpanā'ntaritaprāmāṇyasya anantaritaprāmāṇyaśrutidorba- lyam |

ata eva 'kadācana starīrasi' iti indraprakā- śikāyāḥ ṛcaḥ tāvat liṅgāt indraprakāśanā'rthatvaṃ kalpyate, tāvat 'ainyā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' iti śrutyā gārhapatyopāsthānā'rthatvaṃ ainyādhikaraṇe (3|2|12) nirū- pitam |
na ca upakramasthataditaśrutyā indrajñātvāvagamāt na gārhapatyopāsthānāṅgatvaṃ iti vācyam |

lāghavāt tyajyamānadravyatva-sama niyatā'khaṇḍopādhirūpadevatātva- śaktasya taddhitasya prādhānyena pratipādyatvarūpasaptamī- pādhirūpadevatātve lakṣaṇā''ṅgīkaraṇa prakṛte taddhitasya śrutibhāvāt, indroddeśena vidhī ekaprasaratābhaṅga- patteśca, cayanaprakaraṇapaṭhitena 'ainyā' iti vacanena cayanopayogīndraprakāśakatvena vidhānā'nupapatteḥ |
gārha- patyasya tu sādhanatvena cayanasaṃbandhice'pi cayanasaṃkārya- tvopapattiḥ |
ataśca śaktyā upa-(śaktyupa-) sthitatve- prakāśakatvamādāya 'ainyā' iti saṃjñā'mupāya gauṇa-
sāmarthyasahakṛtatṛtīyāśrutyā gārhapatyaprakāśakatvameva asyā ṛcaḥ iti dhyeyam |
mukhyasāmarthyarūpaliṅgavirodhegauṇa- sāmarthyasya śrutisahayātatve'pi na svato viniyojakatvam |
ata eva darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇapaṭhitasya 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti mantrasya vākyatvaṃ barhirdevasadanatvam, na tu gauṇayā utpalapavitralavanāṅgatvaṃ ityukte te (liṅgādhi- karaṇe 3|2|16) |
liṅgaṃ prakaraṇa vā anugrahītavyaṃ iti na tatpari- cchinne pravṛttirbhavati |
pūvān mantramantrasya prakara- ṇāt prāptaṃ darśapūrṇamāsā'rthatvaṃ laiṅgikena pūṣāṅgatvena bādhyate |
mīmā. liṅgaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavati, (yatra) prakaraṇa- vato'rthasya saṃnidhāne yamarthamāmananti, 'sa tasya sādhana- bhūtaḥ' ityeva gamyate |
kathaṃ khalu uparisthita iti saṃdigdhamāne sāmarthyāt pariniścayaḥ |
bhā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 882. liṅgaṃ pramāṇāntarasiddhasāmānyasaṃbandhasya padārthasya viniyojakam |
mīmā. liṅgaṃ mantreṣu vacanasāmarthyaṃ 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti viniyogākaraṇamuktam |
bhā. 3|1|4|11. liṅgaṃ mantraviniyojakam, mukhye evārthe viniyojakaṃ na gauṇe |
'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti mantraḥ kuśalāvanāṅgaṃ na ulaparāji-lavanāṅgam |
mīmā. liṅgaṃ vākyāt balavat tena 'syonaṃ te '' iti mantrādyoḥ krameṇa sadane sādane cā'nyat darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
vākyasya liṅgaṃ śrutiṃ na kalpayitvā viniyojakatvāt liṅgasya ca śrutimātrakalpanena viniyojakatvāt |
'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ' iti pūrvādhasya sadanā'rthatvaṃ na tu vākyāt sādanā'ṅgatvam |
su. pu. 1111. liṅgaṃ vilambitatvāt śrutyapekṣayā durbalam |
vi. 10|8|8. liṅgaṃ vivakṣitaṃ 'vasante prātarāmeyīṃ kṛṣṇagrīvāmālabhate' ityādi 'garbhiṇīyo
'aśvaḥ ṛṣabhau vṛṣvivaṃtaḥ puruṣaḥ' ityatra ca puṃstvaliṅgaṃ vivakṣitam |
3|1| 7|14 pṛ. 824, liṅgaṃ vaidikāṃ anyārthadarśanarūpaṃ ananyayāsiddhaṃ (pratyakṣaṃ) smṛtyunmitaśrutyapekṣayā prabalam |

(7| 4|3|16) iti sūtreṇa ahaḥsaṃghātatmakasya gavāmaya- nasya ahaḥsaṃghātatmakadvādaśāhakāryāpannatvena nīvārādau trīhidharmavat tadīyadvādaśopasattva-ekādaśinīvihāraprāpteḥ liṅgadvayopapattiḥ iti paramatamuktam |
bhakṣyānuvāke paṭhitānāṃ 'bhakṣe'hi 'tṛcakṣasam', 'hinya me' ityādi- vākyānāṃ samākhyāprāptabhakṣyāṅgatvaṃ liṅgavataḥ grahaṇa- avekṣaṇa-samyagbaraṇāṅgatvairvāthyate |

kāmyājyānuvākyākāṇḍe āmiṣāruṇīṣṭiyājyānu- vākyānantaraṃ saumāraudrīṣṭiyājyānuvākyātaḥ pūrvapaṭhitānāṃ manorṛcāṃ kāmyāgatasaumāraudrīṣṭyasmānāṃ samākhyāprāptaṃ yājyātvādi hailiṅgena sābhimenītvena bādhyate |
bhā. 3|1|7|14, 6| 5|9|32, ṭup. 9|1|3|4. liṅgam, strītvādi- bhāgo hi prāṇidharmātirikte'rthe śabdatanumātreṇa vijñāyate, padvādipu tu artharūpeṇa |
'upahūtaḥ, upahavyasa' iti. krameṇa paṭhitayormantrayoḥ niśrātakrama'nujñāpanānujñe prati yathākramaṃ prasaktamantratvaṃ viparyayaviniyogaṃ kurvatā liṅgena bādhyate |
virodhe sati liṅgena prakaraṇaṃ bādhyate, na caitayorvirodhaḥ |
atra liṅgaśabdena devatāsaṃbandhāt yaugikī śrutirabhidhīyate na sāmarthyamātram |
vā. indro yāto'tisya rājā' ityādeḥ guṇābhidhānārthasya padasamudāyasya guṇākāṅkṣasa
su. pṛ. 662. nātra liṅgaṃ vacanamiva vibhaktyarthaḥ kiṃtu prātipadikārtho liṅgamityuktam (9|1| 9|133) ( 'prātipadikaviśeṣaṇaṃ hi kṣīśadaḥ0 ' ityādinā bhāṣyakāreṇa) |
vā. 3|4|1|131 pṛ. 965. yad buddhau saṃnihitaṃ tat liṅgamityuktam |
vā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 824. sāmarthyaṃ sarva- bhāvānāṃ liṅgamityamidhīyate |
mīmā. sāmānyasaṃbandhe sati avagate liṅgabhavakālaṃ labhate |
ṭup. 10|1|2|1 | 42. liṅgena aṅgatvam - 'barhirdevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti mantrasya labanāṅgatvam |
sa hi mantraḥ lavanaṃ prakāśa- yituṃ samarthaḥ |
pūṣānumantraṇamantrāṇāṃ yāgānumantraṇasamākhyayā yāgasāmānyasaṃbandhe'vagate sāmarthyāt pūṣayāgasaṃbandho'- vagamyate |
tatra krameṇa muṣṭīkaraṇāderdīkṣāṅgatvam, liṅgena tu manasa ekāgrasya sarvakarmasu yogyatvarūpeṇa sarvakarmāṅgatvaṃ sidhyati |
liṅgena dravyanirdeśe sarvapratyayaḥ syālli- ṅgasya sarvagāmitvādādheyat |

'manorṛcaḥ sāmidhenyo bhavanti' iti manuliṅgena dravyasya ṛrūpasya nirdeśe kṛte sati liṅgasya manusaṃbandhasya sarvagāmitvāt sarvāsveva mānavīṣu ṛkṣu vidyamānatvāt sarvapratyayaḥ sarvāsāṃ dāśatayīgatānāṃ mānavīnāmṛcāṃ (59) pratyayaḥ pratyabhijñā syāt |
sarvā eva mānavyaḥ ṛcaḥ sāmidhenyaḥ kāryā ityarthaḥ, na sasadaśaiva |
iti yāvanti āmeyāni sūktāni dāśatayīni taiḥ sarvaiḥ iṣṭakā upadhīyante tadvat |
yāvadarthaṃ vā'rthaśeṣatvādalpena parimāṇaṃ syāt tasmiṃśca liṅgasāmarthyam |

'manorṛcaḥ sāmidhenyo bhavanti' iti na dāśatayī- gatāḥ sarvā eva mānavya ṛca grāhyāḥ kiṃtu arthaśeṣa- tvāt abhisamindhanarūpakāryaśeṣatvāt yāvadarthe apekṣā- nusāreṇa pañcadaśa sadṛśaiva alpena parimāṇaṃ syāt |
alpā eva mānavya ṛco grāhyāḥ na sarvā ityarthaḥ |
tasmin ca alpaparimāṇe ṛksamudāye liṅgasya manu- saṃbandharūpasya sāmarthyaṃ samarthatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ asyeva |
āmeye dṛṣṭānte kṛtsnavidhiḥ kṛtsnānāṃ sūktānāṃ vidhiḥ |
sāmidhenīnāṃ tu parimitatvāt na sarvāsābheva mānavīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ yuktam |
nanu yathā arhaṇe 'ṛjīpamastu prāsyati' iti sarveṣā- mahāṃ yadajīpaṃ tatsarvaṃ aviśeṣāt prāsyate tathā sarvāsāṃ mānavīnāṃ ṛcāṃ sāmidhenītvena grahaṇaṃ syāt iti cet, tatrāha siddhāntī |
ṛjīpasya niṣpāditarasasya somaśeṣasya pradhānatvāt arhaṇe sarvaireva pratipattiḥ avabhṛthe apsu prāsanaṃ syāt |
mānavīṣu sāmidhenīṣu tu abhisamindhana- rūpakāryaśeṣatvāt na sarvāsāṃ grahaṇaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
liṅgena ye mantrā viniyujyante te yādṛśā eva nirjñātastādṛśā eva karmaṇi prayoktavyāḥ, tatra brāhmaṇasya vyāpāra eva nāsti |
ṭup. 12|1|8| 21. liṅgena ye saṃyuktāḥ te apūrvārtha na saṃbhavanti iti mantramānasya pūrvapakṣaḥ 'phaledevatvośca' ityatra (1|1|6|13) |
ratna. 3|1|12. liṅgena liṅgaṃ bādhyate yathā-'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi' iti mantre ubhayo- rarthayoḥ karmasametatvasyārthaprakāśanāsāmarthyam |
bāla. pṛ. 135. liṅgena vākyaṃ arthaviprakarṣāt bādhyate |
vā. 3|1|7|12 pṛ. 1126. liṅgena vidhayanta- niyamo bhavatītyuktam |
ekaḥ śeṣaḥ śrutyā dravā- vadāne itarāvadāne vā'nekena śeṣiṇaḥ prātaḥ, liṅgena dravāvadāne eva niyamanāt śeṣayatte bādhyate |
tathā ekasmin śeṣiṇi dravāvadānādau śrutyaiva suvaḥ, karaṇāttaraṃ cānekaḥ śeṣaḥ prātaḥ tatrālliṅgena suvameva niya- cchatā karaṇāttaraṃ śrautamapi bādhyate |
bāla. pṛ. 180. sarvo hyanārabhyādhīto vākyasaṃbandhena aṅgaṃ viddhate, liṅgena vā kenacidvyabhicāriṇā |
vā. 3|4|8|24 pṛ. 954. liṅgāt etāvadagamyate, 'samarthametat imamarthamabhinirdhartumityum' iti |
bhā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 843, liṅgāt savicikitso bhavati pratyayaḥ, nirvicikitsaḥ śruteḥ |
3|1|7|14 pṛ. 842, liṅgāt kalpatvaṃ liṅgakramamāsanasamudāyo bala- vān |
bhā. 3|1|7|14 pṛ. 823, 9|1|12|37, liṅgāt samākhyāsāpekṣāt samākhyā balavatī |

3|1|7|20. liṅgasya arthaviprakarṣaḥ aindrīviniyogaṃ prati śruti- liṅgayoḥ saha prasthitayoḥ yadā śrutirviniyojakāni akṣa- rāṇi dṛśyante, tadā liṅge smaraṇasamarthāni, tato yāvat teṣāṃ prakaraṇāmānāntyanupapattyā viniyojakāni kalpa- yitumārabhyante tāvaditaraiḥ pratyakṣairviniyogaḥ pratyāyitaḥ |
tasmiṃśca mantro'pi prakaraṇaṃ prati nirākāṅkṣī- mī. ko. 420
śeṣatve tu ekasmin mānasya anyathā'pyupapadyamānatvāt na indrābhidhānaśruti- śeṣiṇi gauṇamukhyasāmarthyena mantradvayamudāhāryam |
kau. kalpanāyāṃ arthāpattiḥ prabhavati, na ca śrutimantareṇa vini- 3|3|7|4 pṛ. 367. yogaḥ |
liṅgādideśāt nāmātideśaḥ prabalaḥ, śīghra- 7|4 pṛ. 830. liṅgasya uhaḥ yathā- 'vasvasi, buddhihetutvāt |
vāla. pṛ. 126. liṅgasya tāvādi- liṅgānumitā śrutiḥ ākāṅkṣāvaśena kriyā- pratyayārthaḥ (bhavati) |
pṛ. 153. bhā. 3|2|120. liṅgasya padamātre paryavasānā- liṅgādhikaraṇam |
paśo puṃstvadi liṅgaṃ viva- yogāt vākyaviniyogātparyavatyam |
tathā ca liṅga- pṛ. 146. liṅgasya vākyāt balīyastvam |
na ca 7|4 pṛ. 833, liṅgasya viniyogasāmarthyama- vivakṣitamidaṃ śrūyate iti bhavati liṅgam |
'strī gauḥ kasya kevalaprayogabhāvāt padāntarasaṃniveḥ avaśyaṃ- somakrayaṇī' iti vacanāt somakrayaṇī ityavivakṣita- bhāvitvāt vākyaṃ antargataprāyameva |
nanu kathaṃ 'mṛgīmānaya' iti na pṛ. 817, liṅgasya śrutimātrānumānāntaritaḥ śrutyarthaḥ |
liṅgaṃ vivakṣitam, vākyārthasya pṛ. 831. liṅgasya śrutivākyaparairviśeṣaiḥ |
tathā ca liṅgaṃ 'garbhiṇyo hānamantre 'ya imaṃ yajñamavān ye ca yajapatiṃ vardhān' bhavanti' iti |
abhidhruvārthe jape viniyogatvam yaduktaṃ 'strī gauḥ somakrayaṇī' iti |
tathā 'prajāpataye puruṣān hastina liṅgasya bādhāt tathā kartuṃ na śakyate |
vispaṣṭo hi vi. 9|1|14. liṅgasya śrutivirodhāt kacit nyāyaḥ ukto liṅgavivakṣāyām |
tasmāt vivakṣitaṃ liṅga- bādhe'pi na sarvatra bādho yuktaḥ |
pṛ. 54, liṅgasya sāmarthyamattvaṃ sāmarthyasya ca śā-- liṅgaṃ tu aliṅge viparītaliṅge vṛkṣādau saṃdigdhā'rthanirṇayamātre vyāpārābhidhānam |
pṛ 1117. maśikādau ca śabdaprayogāt aśabdārtha iti avicakṣa- liṅgānāṃ nānumānatrividhā niścāyakatvaṃ kiṃtu vidhaya- tattvāśaṅkā |
siṃhaḥ siṃhī ityādau ananyathāsiddhaliṅga- ntādhikaraṇakartavyā (7|4|2) upamānavidhayā |
soma. pratītiḥ śabdasya vācakatvaṃ kalpayati iti śabdārthatvāt 8|1|12. liṅgayoḥ virodhe arthābhidhānaśaktirūpaṃ saṃkhyāvat liṅgaṃ vivakṣitam |
liṅgam, parasparavākyatagamanasāmarthyātmakāt liṅgāt vi-- 'na puṃliṅge vivakṣā vā vivakṣā, 'nupa- balīyaḥ |
ādyo, 'nuṣṭhipekṣatvāt saṃkhyāvat tad virodhe mantrāṇāṃ gauṇasāmarthyena gauṇārthā''tve pramakte, mukhya- vivakṣyatām |
liṅgādiprabhavā arthādaprabhavā ca smṛtiḥ liṅgaṃ tu upādeyatamāpi aśabdārthatvādavivakṣitam |
vā. tat prātipadikārthaḥ, siṃhādipadatvāt tadapratīteḥ ; tasya 3|3|14|4 pṛ. 860. liṅgatrayasādhāraṇyena liṅgaviśeṣavyabhicārāt |
nāpi liṅgopadeśaśca tadarthavat' (1|2|14) teṣāṃ pratyayārthaḥ vyabhicārādeva |
nāpi ṭābādinām, sunvi- mantrāṇāṃ arthaḥ yathā asti tathā liṅgopadeśo bhavati iti kārāṇāṃ 'tasmācchaso naḥ puṃsi' ityādinām, ciliṅge sūtravyākhyānam |
su. pṛ. 112. vṛkṣādau viparītaliṅge maśikādau ca prayogeṇa vyabhi- liṅgakramayoḥ upadeśapramāṇatvāt atyantānarthakya- cārādeva |
ataḥ śabdānuśāsanamātramevedam, na liṅgaṃ nāma prasaṅgāt codakāt prāpyam |
soma. 10|7|15. kasyacit śabdasya arthaḥ, iti avivakṣitam |
sutastathādhikaraṇe darśitaḥ prāpte, siṃhaḥ siṃhī ityādi ananyathāsiddhaliṅgapratītiḥ : 'arthena tvapakṛpyeta' iti |
sthitodāharaṇamapi yathā liṅgampi kvacit ṭābādināṃ svīkāraṇāt na kvacicca abhyanujñāpanābhyanujñayoḥ prajñātakramayoḥ : 'upahūta upa- tisrantalādiprātipadikavārāṇāṃ vācyam |
ataśca tat havyasya' ityevaṃ mantrau āmnātau |
tau deśasāmānyāt kaṃcit saṃkhyāvat kacicca prātipadikārthenaiva viva- hyathaiva advatayā prāpnutaḥ : 'upahūtaḥ' ityanuṣṭhāpane kṣitam |
yatra tu bādhaḥ tatra sādhutvāt tacchabdaprayogaḥ |
na tu tathā sāmarthya- maṇḍana-- 'paḍorliṅgaṃ vivakṣyate |
prakaraṇamupādāya ekavākyatvaṃ kalpyate tāvalliṅgena śruti liṅgādhikaraṇam (liṅgena vahirhavanamanyasya kalpayitvā sādhito viniyogaḥ : ityakalpitaliṅgaśruti- mukhye viniyogaḥ |
vā. 3|2|1. vādinoḥ : 'parīrirasi' 'yuvā sutrāsāḥ' iti vā liṅgānusāreṇa bhakṣānvākya grahaṇādau vibhajya abhīgopīyaparipraśnā''tve prāpte liṅgatvasanīyārthadvitīya- viniyogo jyotiṣṭome |
ityādicihvaiścihvaiścāpyupapadyamānānāṃ liṅganirāsārtha etat 'vacanāstyayathārthamaidī syāt' itivat balavattaraśruti- sūtram |
nityasya vyavasthācārāt niyatasya kartuḥ : kṛtaviniyogakalpitaliṅgabādhanena agneyaumīyatvāt |
upalakṣaṇabhūtasya liṅgasya abhāvāt (kartuḥ upalakṣaṇabhūtaṃ evaṃ hi āha 'yadyapyanyadevatyaḥ paśurāgneyyeva manotā yat liṅgaṃ tasya abhāvāt) tadā'pyupapadyamānānupapatteḥ : kāryā' iti |
anayā hi śrutyā liṅgena utkṛṣya- sarvadharmatā |
dvivedatye'pi ekadevatyaiva na kevala- liṅgādibhiḥ pratyakṣaḥ ānumānikānāṃ śrutyādīnāṃ lāgnidevatvena agneyaumīyād uttaraṇīyatvaiya |
yadvā bādhaḥ - yathā kṛṇālipu sāmarthyena brīhīnavahanti ityati- evakāraṃ svadhanādāpanīya yathākramaṃ kāryā eva ityatra deśānumitaśruteḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 146, vā. 3|3|14 saṃyojanā kāryā iti avadhāryate |
vā. 3|3|7|4 pṛ. pṛ. 841. liṅgādeḥ śrutimakalpayitvā svātantryeṇa 836-837. liṅgakramayorvirodhe 'upahūtaḥ upaha- prāmāṇyaṃ nāsti |
vā. 3|2|134. liṅgādīnāṃ vyasya' ityanayoḥ yathākramaṃ pāṭhataḥ praśnaprativacanaśeṣatve śrutyādibhirvādhayogyatā |
‘liṅkramasamākhyānāt kāmyayuktaṃ samāmnānam’ ityatra indrādīnāṃ karmaṇo bahirapi sadbhāvaḥ pratipāditaḥ |
‘indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ’ ‘pracarṣaṇayaḥ’ ‘indrāgnī navatiṃ puraḥ’ ‘śrayadgṛdhram’ ityādyā ṛcaḥ |

brāhmaṇe ca kāmyā iha śrūyante - ‘aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmā’ viyāyuḥ - ‘aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet bhrātṛvyān’ ‘agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapetkāmaḥ’ ‘agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet mapatanamīśrotyan’ ityevamādayaḥ |
tadetā yājyānuvākyāḥ prati saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ yāvatkiñcidindrāgnī karma tatra sarvatrānane aindrāgmena yājyānuvākyāyugalena bhavitavyam, uta etasyāmeva aindrāgmeṣṭau kāmyāyāmiti |
evaṃ sarvatrotsargāpavādābhyāṃ liṅgasya vini- yojakatvaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ liṅgasya viniyojakatvamata pramāṇāntarasāpekṣasyeti tadatra evaṃ viśeṣyacintyate |
atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ - yadyapyatra yenaiva krameṇa aindrāgmā- dīni karmāṇi samāmnātāni tenaiva tadevatyāni kāmyasamākhyāyuktāni kāmyāpurenuvākyāyugalāni api śrūyante |
tathā ca sati krameṇa samākhyayā ca tadvya- tenaiva yājyānuvākyāviniyogo yuktaḥ |
tathāpi liṅgasya kramāt samākhyātaḥ balīyastvāt indrāgnyādiprakāśana- sāmarthyāmliṅgena liṅkramasamākhyāyorbādhitatvāt indrā- gnyādidevatākadharmamātrāṅgatvameva yājyānuvākyānāṃ yukta- miti |
bhavedevaṃ yadi sāmānya- saṃbandhanirapekṣaṃ liṅgaṃ viniyojakaṃ bhavet |
na cāmyāditvarūpe vini- yogaḥ saṃbhavati, caiyarthyaprasaṅgāt |
vā sammatti, tatra tadapekṣasyaiva liṅgasya viniyoja- katvam |
atra tu vākyaprakaraṇayorabhāvādyadi krama- samākhyāpekṣā na bhavet, tadā liṅgasya viniyojakameva na syāt |
tenātra krameṇa yājyānuvākyānāmendrāgnyādi- kāmyeṣṭibhiḥ sāmānyasaṃbandho vakṣyaḥ |
tatra kiṃ kurvanto- 'syāptamiti viśeṣyāpekṣā, tadā khāmibheyasamavetādyamakā- śane viniyujyate |
yatra punaḥ krameṇa sāmānyasaṃbandhe jāte'pyapekṣā, kāryadaśasādhāraṇaṃ hi liṅgaṃ saṃdigdhatvāt kevalaṃ na viniyogasamartham, tatra liṅgamināsiddhaye samākhyāyā'pyāśrayate |
yathā kevalāmidevasya karmaṇaḥ krama āmeyī ṛk paṭhyate |
tasyāśca liṅgena kārya- dravyamavagamyate samidhamānāmiprakāśanaṃ iyamānāmiprakā- śanaṃ ca |
tatra yadi yājyāsamākhyā nāśrayīyeta, tadā prātha- myāt samidhamānāmiprakāśanārthatvameva syāt |
yājyā- samākhyā tu iṣyate anayā itījyānamānadevatāprakāśana- sāmarthye mantrasya kalpyate |
yadyapi abhidhānasāmarthyaṃ na devatāthaṃ, kintu yāgasamanyasādhāraṇābhisrūpamātre |
tathāhi, samākhyākalpitayāgaviṣayasāmarthyānurodhena ijya- mānadevatāprakāśana eva liṅgena viniyujyate |
ataḥ sarvatra sāmānyasaṃbandhapūrvaka eva liṅgaviniyoga iti |
sūtraṃ tu - liṅkramasamākhyābhiḥ kāmyeṣṭisaṃbaddhameva mantra- samāmnānaṃ na sarvatra yātītyarthaḥ |
aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmaḥ : aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet yasya sajātā vīyuḥ : ityādyāḥ kāmyeṣṭayo vihitāḥ |
evaṃ kāmyayājyānu- vākyākāṇḍe ‘indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ’ iti aindrāgnyājyānuvākyāyugalaṃ cāstrātam |
tatra kiṃ yāvat kiñcit aindrāgmaṃ karma tatra sarvatra anenaiva yājyānu- vākyāyugalena aindrāgmena bhavitavyaṃ uta uktāyāṃ prathamāyāṃ- meva aindrāgmeṣṭau idaṃ yugalaṃ anyatra tu anyat iti
vicāre, yena krameṇa aindrāgmādīni karmāṇi āmnātāni tenaiva krameṇa tadevatyāni kāmyasamākhyāyuktāni yājyā- puronuvākyāyugalāni |
tāni kiṃ kramamullaṅghya tadeva- tyakarmamātrārthāni liṅgāt bhavanti uta kenacit prakāreṇa tāsyeva kāmyāsu iṣṭiṣu yathākramaṃ viniyujyante iti vicāre |
liṅkramasamākhyānāt liṅkanugṛhītāt kramāt, liṅkanugṛhītācca samākhyānāt samāmnānaṃ kāmyayājyānuvākyāmantrakāṇḍasamāmnānaṃ kāmya- yuktaṃ kāmyeṣṭyeva yāgeṣu aṅgatayā saṃyuktaṃ syāt |
atha kimarthamubhayamupadiśyate liṅkramāt iti, samākhyānāt iti ca ? asti tatra pāthikṛtīyaṃ prāta- patīyaṃ ca karma |
yadi liṅkramāt ityetāvedocyeta sāmidhenī- kāryeḍapi liṅgena tāsāṃ viniyogaḥ syāt |
atha kimarthaṃ liṅkramau vyapadiśyete sarvā yājyānuvākyākārya eva vini- yujyen tsāmidhenīṣu viniyogo siddho bhavati |
yathā abhidāruṇyā iṣṭaḥ krame atīte somārādaudīnāmāgate manonkaḥ tāḥ sāmidhenīṣu dhāṭyā ityucyante |

ke. agnirudhye purohitaḥ : ṛsaṃ 8|23|16) ityādīnāṃ manonkaḥ ‘pṛyujāḥ : ṛsaṃ. (4|12|5) ‘taṃ savādhaḥ’ (ṛsaṃ. 4|12|6) iti pṛyujājavatauśca yājyāsāmāyāṃ dhāṭitvā liṅgena sāmidhenīkārya viniyoga iti ‘liṅkramasamākhyānāt’ ityatroktam |
arthaprakāśanasāmarthyarūpālliṅgāt svaprakādhyā- rthamātre śeṣatvaṃ mantrasya bhavati na tu tadvārā kṛtaśeṣa- tvamapi kṛtasyeṣṭyābhavena arthaprakāśanasāmarthyānmātrāt kṛtaśeṣatvātsiddheḥ |

ataḥ ṛtunā dvāraviśeṣamantratantrābhyāṃ sāmānyataḥ śeṣaśeṣibhāve siddhe kiṃ dvāraṃ kṛtaśeṣatvaṃ nirvahatīti dvārāpekṣāyāṃ mantraprakādhyārthalakṣaṇa dvārā śeṣatva- mātre liṅgaṃ pramāṇamiti ‘liṅkramasamākhyānāt’ itya- dhikaraṇe nirūpitam |

‘ubhā vāmindrāgnī’ ityādīnāṃ ‘aindrāgmekādaśa- kapālaṃ nirvapet’ ityādī yatra kramasamākhyābhyāṃ sāmānya- saṃbandhaḥ siddhaḥ, tatraiva viniyogo na tu indrāgni- saṃbaddhakarmamātre, sāmānyasaṃbandhasya tatrābhāvāt ityevaṃ liṅkramamādhikaraṇīkam |
‘indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ, pravarṇayaḥ’ ‘indrāgnī navatiṃ puraḥ, śrayadgṛdhram’ ityevādyā ṛcaḥ |

aparā api kāmyā iṣṭayaḥ : ‘aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet prajākāmā’ : ‘aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet bhrātṛ- vyān’ : ‘agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet sakāmaḥ’ : ‘agnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet sapatanamīśrotyan’ ityevamādyāḥ |
tadetā yājyānuvākyāḥ prati saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ yāvatkiñcidindrāgme karma tatra sarvatrānanendrā- gmena yājyānuvākyāyugalena bhavitavyam, utaitasyāmeve- ndrāgmeṣṭau kāmyāyāmiti |
kiṃ tāvatprāptam ? yāvatkiñci- daindrāgmaṃ vaiśvānarauyamīṣṭaumīṣṭaṃ ca, tatra sarvatrānanendrā- gmena yājyānuvākyāyugalena bhavitavyam |
tathāpi kramaṃ samākhyāṃ ca śaknoti liṅgaṃ bādhitumiti |
liṅkramasamākhyānāt tāveva kāmyasyetā yājyānuvākyā iti gamyate |
ya eva hi liṅkramaḥ eṣāṃ karmaṇām, sa evāsyāṃ yājyānuvākyānām |
āsāmucāṃ yājyānuvākyātvameva na vijñāyate, kuto bhidadeśānāṃ karmaṇāṃ yājyānuvākyā bhaviṣyantīti |
yā caiṣāṃ samākhyā, sā kāmyānāmeva yājyānuvākyātva- mācaṣṭe, na sarveṣām |
yadi samākhyā nāssiddhyate yājyānuvākyātvameveṣāṃ na bhavati |
atha kimarthamubhayamupadiśyate liṅgakramāditi samā- khyānāditi ca |
asti tatra pāthikṛtīyaṃ vratapatīyaṃ ca karma |
yadi liṅgakramādityetādevocyeta, sāmidhenī- kārya'pi liṅgena tāsāṃ viniyogaḥ syāt |
sarvā yājyānuvākyākārya eva viniyujyeran, sāmidhenīṣu viniyogo na syāt |
atha punaḥ samākhyānālliṅgakramācca nirgute yājyānuvākyārthaṃ, sāmidhenīṣu viniyogaḥ siddho bhavati |
yathā, āgni- vāruṇyā iṣṭeḥ krame'titaṃ somārādaumanāgate manorṛcaḥ tāḥ sāmidhenīṣu dhyāye ityucyante |
tathā, 'pṛthupājasta sabhāvo' iti dve dhyāye kalpyete |
vā— yena krameṇa-drāmādīni kāmyāni karmāṇyā- mnātāni, tenaiva krameṇa tadevatyāni kāmyasamākhyākāni yājyāpuronuvākyāyugalāni |
tāni kiṃ kramamullaṅghya tadevatyakarmamātrārthāni liṅgādravyanti, uta kenacitka- yeṇa tāstveva kāmyāsviṭṭiṣu yathākramaṃ viniyujyante iti |
tatra liṅgāt sarvārthatve prāpte'gnīdhrate, 'nāsati kratu- saṃbandhe sāmarthyaṃ viniyojakam |
yena ca kratu- saṃbandhastena kāmyārthatā sphuṭā |
yajña- saṃbandhitā tadanuraktadevatāsaṃbandhitā vā naitāvatā vākya- prakaraṇādirahitena śakyopādātum |
na ca jñāyate kvāṃśe viniyoga iti |
tataśca yena yathena saṃbandha iti liṅgāttadevatya- neti vijñāyate |
kathaṃ na sidhyati ? yadā kāmyaṃ yājyākāṇḍamityetayā samākhyāyā kāmyeṣṭiviṣayatvaṃ niyatam |
api ca, yadyapi samākhyā yajñamātrasaṃbandhaṃ kuryāttathāpi baliyatā krameṇa bādhyateca |
athavā kāmyaṃ yājyākāṇḍamityetā- vataiva sarvaṃ siddhamiti manyate |
satyam, aindrādādiṣu liṅgakramamātreṇāpi sidhyet, ṛcāṃ yājyānu- vākyātvādanyathāviniyogāt |
yāni tvāmeyādīni karmāṇi 'āgneye vratapatye' ityevamādicoditāni tatra sthāna- dvayamuccāmiprakāśāne sāmidhenītvaṃ yājyānuvākyātvaṃ ca |
sātdṛśyānmānācca asti sāmidhenīnāṃ dve ṛcau prati apekṣā |
tatra yadi yājyāsamākhyā viniyojikā nāssidhyeta, tataḥ sāmidhenīṣvapi liṅgakramādupapadyate iti |
yadyatreṣṭipirimatā evātyantaṃ tadevalyāśrāgneyam tat eta- devaṃ syāt |
iha tvanyadevatyasya sthānurūpayājyānuvākyā- pūritasya karmaṇaḥ krameṇa yāḥ agneya ṛcaḥ paśyante, tāḥ samākhyā kevalyā viniyujyamānā yājyākāryaṃ viniyu- jyeran |
na cāsti saṃbhavaḥ, vililiṅgatvānnāmyā talliṅgābhyāṃ bādhitatvāt |
liṅgakramamātreṇa punaḥ samākhyāyāṃ nivṛttavyāpārāyāṃ tābhyāṃ viniyoge sati sāmidhenīṣu prayogaḥ siddho bhavati |
taṃ viṣayaṃ darśayati - 'āgnivāvaruṇyā iṣṭeḥ' yājyāpuronuvākye paṭhitvā somārādaumanāgidhanāṃ yājyāpuronuvākyāsthā- gatāsu manorṛcaḥ paṭhyante |
tatrāpi pūrvasyāḥ sāmidhenīkramatikramya yājyāpuronuvākyottara- kālapāṭhāduttarairvipayatvaṃ vijñāyate |
yadi ca kramo nāssidhyeta tato liṅgasamākhyāmātreṇa prathamamendrāmayugalaṃ dvitīyasyāmandrābhyāṃ viniyujyate, dvitīyaṃ ca prathamā-
krame tu sati samākhyātaḥ pūrvataraṃ tena kratusaṃbandha- karaṇāt tatsannikṛṣṭameva liṅgaṃ śrutiṃ kalpayatītyakrama- viniyogaḥ paridṛṣṭo bhavati |
śā — mantrākāṇḍe saṃdehaḥ, kiṃ yatrathana sāmarthya- masti, tatratatra sarvatra viniyoktavyā mantrāḥ kramasamāsthe bādhitvā, uta taddeśena kāmyeṣṭiśceveti |
tadarthaṃ na kiṃ liṅgamapi śrutyāditvat nirapekṣameva viniyojakam, uta ṛtusaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇamapyapekṣya vyāpāraviśeṣadharmāte prāmāṇyamiti |
' svādhyāyavidhivyāpitasya tāvat mantrasya arthavat prayojanena bhavitavyam |
tatra mantra- svarūpādeva dṛṣṭārthasya prakāśako'yam, ato'tra viniyoktavyaḥ |
na na niyogyojanam prakāśanamarthyant iti taddvāreṇa tatsaṃvandhikāpūrvādyarthamapi tata eva gamyate, kimatra pramāṇāntareṇa |
' nahi apekṣitamapi prayojanaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa labdhuṃ śakyam |
na ca gamyatvamātreṇa prayojanaṃ kiṃcit samarthyate |
karma- pūrvasādhanarūpaprakāśanārthatayā tu na ma̭saṃbandhapramāṇamapyada- ntareṇa sāmarthyamātrāt sidhyati |
'guṇā pradibhāgaḥ : ' ityatra tu bhāgaśabdasya yāgavacanatvāt (yāgalakṣa- katvāt) kratusaṃbandhasiddhiḥ |

loke'pi tatsadbhāvāt indrādīnāmapi mantrā- rthevāditāsādibhiḥ karmaṇyevāpi pratīte : (mantrārtha- vādādipu sarvāthīśrava-lokapālatvātsarveṣutetvādinā prati- pādyamānatvena indrādīnāmapi karmaṇe bahirapi saṃbhavāva- gamāt loke saṃbhavo'sti ityarthaḥ |
te ca kāmyeṣṭiśceva, iti tatraiva viniyogaḥ, na karmāntareṣu |
na ca kāmyeṣṭeṣu śaramaṇāpekṣayā eṣāṃ mantrāṇāṃ tatra viniyogaḥ, teṣāmupāyā- ntareṇāpi smṛtisiddheḥ |
yatra tu ekāntataḥ, tatra bhavatyeva sāmarthyamātrādapi tādarthyam, yathā arthajñānasya anuṣṭhānājñatvam |
kramasamākhyābhyāntu kāmyeṣṭiśceva yathākramaṃ yathāsamākhyaṃ ca yājyānuvākyātvena viniyogaḥ |
saṃbhavatāmasaṃbhavatāmapi tāsyeva sāmidhenyādau kramasahitena liṅgena viniyogaḥ |

yathā somārādauṣṭikrame āmnātānāṃ mānavīnāṃmacāṃ pradhānadevatāprakāśanāsamarthe'pi bahutvān, kvacidasaṃbhave yathā 'agnaye rathaudhe' pṛthupājaśamakāpale nirvāpeta' ityetadiṣṭikrame āmnātānāṃ 'kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ' ityādīnām |
kau-- pūrvaṃ śruterjanyapramāṇāpekṣatve nirūpite liṅga- syāpi iha tannirūpaṇāt prāsaṅgikī anantarā saṃgatiḥ |
soma — sūtrārthastu-- tattadihiliṅgānusārikamāt samākhyānācca kāmyeṣṭyaṃ indrādīkāṇḍānmānamiti |
akāmyāpi saṃcāyāṃ yājyāḥ sarvatra sā kṣatiḥ |
na ca indrābhirūpe ānarthakyādapūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇārthe karmāpyapeśeti vācyam |
iti prāpte, ākāṅkṣābhāve yogyatārūpaliṅgasya viniyoja- katvānupapattermantragatayojanākāṅkṣāyāḥ sarvamantrāṇāṃ viniyogena nirākāṅkṣatvāt na liṅga- mātrāt sarvārthatvopapattiḥ |
ataśca vākyaprakaraṇakramādinā sāmānyasaṃbandhabodhakapramāṇena tattadākāṅkṣopapānāt tatta- tkratusaṃbandhasya ca dvāre viśeṣaḥ eva liṅgabādhatvasya |
na ca vācyastaumīyavākyena prakaraṇādivādhaḥ, mantraviśveṣa- viṣayāṇāṃ teṣāṃ mantrapāṭhakālatvedhamantraprayojanākāṅkṣā- velāyāmana
samākhyā yaugikī saṃjñā laukikī vaidikī tathā |
tatra vahnirmantrasya prakaraṇasāpekṣaṃ apūrvasādhana- viśeṣaṇahilatvena viniyogaḥ |
ayaṃ cāparo viśeṣaḥ yadana viniyujyamānasya mantrasya liṅgaviniyogāt prāgeva kenāpi pramāṇena kratusambandho'pekṣitaḥ |
tadabhāve liṅgaviniyoga eva na sambhavatīti liṅgakramasamākhyā- nāditatra pratipāditam |
vākyaviniyogastu śruti- viniyogāvasare eva vivekavacanārthaṃ prapañcitaḥ |

tāvat pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ tato daikṣasya paśoriṣ‌ṭena svābhā- vikākāṅkṣāvirahiṇaḥ prayājādidarśanena darśapūrṇamāsa- vidhvantākāṅkṣaiva kalpyate iti na vikṛtitvaṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā tatprakṛtiviśeṣavicāro ghaṭate |
yadā tāvat svarūpa- mātramālakṣyate tadā nirākāṅkṣatvāt na prakṛti- viśeṣacintā |
yadā tu prayājādidarśanena vikṛtitvaṃ kalpyate tadā prakṛtiviśeṣasyaiva nirṇāyakatvāt cintā- vasaraḥ |

na ca 'paśau ca liṅgadarśanāt' ityatra paśoḥ apūrvvanirākaraṇeṇa pūrvvavatmeva liṅgadarśane sādhyate kimatra kutaściddharmā atidiśyante uta netyetāvadeva vicāryate iti vācyam, adyame viśeṣātideśacintā- kāraṇāt |
na cāsau samāptā yena darvihomavat pūrvvadapūrvva- cintā kriyeta tasmāt viśeṣātideśa eva cintyate |
paśau kiṃ darśapūrṇamāso kriyante uta saumika iti |
siddhānte'pi liṅgasya prāpakatvamākṣipya codanāsāmānyā- dityāha sa ca sāmānyena vikṛtitve siddhe'vakalpate nānyathā |

athaitadoṣaparihārāya liṅgadarśanena tāvaditi- karttavyatāmātrākāṅkṣā kalpyate tataḥ codanāsāmānyādi- deśa iti tarhi prayājādiṣu abhikramaṇaprāyaścittopadeśa- sāmarthyāt ākāṅkṣāparikalpanāt anyatvena saumika- vidhvantaprasaṅga iti samānaḥ paryyanuyogaḥ |
tadetadāvāmyevaṃ parihartavyaṃ na prayājādināma- vyaktatvaṃ yasya hi taddhitena caturthyā mantravarṇana vā devatā nāsti tadyuktam |
yadi tu yasyotpattivākye devatā nāsti, tadarthakaṃ tat upāṃśuyājasyāpyavyaktatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
tasya hi tadartha devatāyāḥ syāditi vicārya 'viṣṇurvā syādautrāsānāt' iti mantravarṇāt devatāsaṃgati vakṣyati |
jyotiṣṭomasyāpi 'aindravāyavaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti taddhitenaiva devatā'bhidhānāt nāvyakttvaṃ syāt |
na yāge devatā taddhitena vidhīyate kintu grahaṇe tasmādadoṣaḥ |

kiṃca asaṃbhavādi na prayājādiṣu saumikadharmātideśaḥ, darśa- pūrṇamāsayorhi sāṅggayoḥ pūrvvapuruṣābhyāyeṣuḥ samāpanaṃ śrutaṃ tatrāpi paritaragaṇādi hastāvenajenādi ca tantraṃ apareṣu revopakramya samāpanīyam |
tatra yadi prayājādiṣu saumikavidhvanto dīkṣaṇīyādiḥ audavasāniyāntaḥ pratyekaṃ atidiśyeta tataḥ tasmin pratyekamanuṣṭhīyamāne pradhānasya kālotkarṣaḥ syāt |
na ca tantreṇa prasaṅgena vā sakṛdanu- ṣṭhānasaṃbhavaḥ |
kālabhedāt tantramadhye vidhānābhāvācca pūrvvaṃ hi prayājāḥ pradhānādadvitīyante paścādanvājāḥ |
na caivaṃ sati tantraṃ bhavati dīkṣaṇīyādiṣu iva aiṣṭikavidhvantasya |
na ca yāvacchakti kānicidaṅgāni vihāya kānicidanutiṣṭheteti viśeṣāparijñānāt śakyate'bhidhātum |
tasmāt anati- deśaḥ prayājādiṣu saumikavidhvantasya, tasmāt asyaivā- vāntaraprakaraṇam |
kathaṃ tarhi videvanādīnāṃ abhiṣecanī- yāṅgatvaṃ neṣyate |
vikṛtayo hi klṛptopakārākāṅkṣāḥ prathamaṃ prākṛtaireva samīpasthaṃ vidhāya saṃbadhyante iti gṛhamedhīyādhikaraṇe bhāṣyakāro vakṣyati |
evaṃ niśārtaparyyavasānasyāpi vikārasya samīpasthāṅga- vaśādaparyevasānaṃ kalpyatathyaṃ tataśca kramo bhavati |
vikṛtiṣvapi yat prākṛtāṅgamathye paṭhitaṃ yathā āmanahoma- stasya prakaraṇe grahaṇam |
videvanādīnāmapi tarhi prākṛtāṅgamathye māhendrastotrakāle anuṣṭhīyamānā prāka- raṇena abhiṣecanīyasyaprasaṅgaḥ |

rājasūya- bhāvanāyāstu pavitrādārabhya kṣatrasya śrutiparyyanto yāgagaṇaḥ svavākyasthena yajinā tantreṇopādāya karaṇatvena samarpita iti yatpavitreya prākṛtamaṅgaṃ yacca kṣatrasya dhruteḥ tatsarvaṃ rājasūyasya prākṛtamaṅgaṃ tanmadhyavarttīni videvanādīni bhavanti prakaraṇasya gocaraḥ |
tasmāt avāntaraprakaraṇā- bhyupagame'pi na kaściddoṣa iti |
tatra bhāvanārthanāmevārādādupakāriṇāṃ kevalaṃ viniyojakaṃ na dravyādīnāṃ nāpi saṃpātinām |
teṣāṃ hi yathāyathaṃ śrutādibhireva viniyogaḥ prakaraṇaṃ tu sahāyamātram |
mantrāṇāmapi na svarūpeṇa prakaraṇagrahaṇaṃ tajanyasya tu vākyārthapratyayasya kriyārūpasya tadapi liṅga-
kāryabhūtaṃ pradhānaṃ apūrvvaṃ liṅgabhidheyaṃ upasarjanī- bhūtasakalapadārthaṃ vākyena pratipādyate iti manyante teṣāṃ mate prayājādīnāṃ darśādyaṅgatā na syāt |
na kāryyamanvaya bhavati nyāyāt prayājāpūrvvaṃ svapradhānabhūtaṃ na prayojanāntaramapekṣate |
anapekṣaṃ ca saṃhitenāpi darśa- pūrṇamāsāpūrvvaṃ saṃgataṃ nāsti |
yattvatra kenaciducyate sādhikārapūrvvasaṃnidhisamāmnā- tāni prayājādivākyāni na drāvāpūrvvāntaramavagamyanti avaghātādivat anuvādātkathaṃ saṃbhavat |
tata ananyaniṣṭhaṃ mantraṃ cāprayojanībhūtaṃ prayojanarūpādhikāravidhyanvayayoga- mityādhikāra
yadi manyeta na sami- dādiṣu prathamaṃ sandehaḥ |
kiṃ tarhi saṃnidhānāt prakṛtāpūrva- mevedamiti bhrāntirbhavati tattatrāvirodhāt grāhakagrahaṇa- miti |
tathāpi pañcādirodhadarśanena tat vyāvartyate yathā pūrvapakṣanyāyena niścita pratipadaḥ prakaraṇagrahaṇe siddhānta- nyāyena śrutivirodhapratibhāse sati tadarthyaṃ vyāvarttate |
kiñca yadi niyogāntaramavaghātādivadapratipattaṃ tataḥ tadvākyagāmi- nāmavahantyādiśabdānāṃ iva prajñājādivākyagatānāmapi yajñādiśabdānāṃ pradhānāpūrvāntasvārthābhidhāyakatvaṃ kiṃ nāmyupagamyate |
tathā sati utpattyāvevyānya- tiriśrītatathā'vagatasya niyogāntaraviṣayatā na syāt |
na hyekaṃ vastu yugapat kārya- dvayasaṃbandhi pratyetuṃ śakyamiti |
idaṃ ca pratīyate niyogān- tare svārthamabhidhātuṃ nāprīyate |
tena yadi niyogāntara- pratipattaṃ tato virodhābhāvāccājiśabdasya samidākyagatasya pradhānāpūrvānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ ahantyāditvaṃ syāt |
atha pratipattaṃ tataḥ śrutivirodhe grāhakagrahaṇamupa- pattiriti seyaṃ ubhayataḥ pāśā rajjumiti |
atha prathamapratipattaṃ apūrvāntare yatraivādhikārāpūrvānvita- svārthābhidhāyitvamapi paścāt niyogāntarāvagatyā bādhyate tato grāhakagrahaṇamapi śrutivirodhatvāt bādhi- tavyam |
yadapi ca na cāvihitamaṅgaṃ bhavatītyetadadṛta- vadanapratiṣedhaṃ adhikṛtya abhihitam |
āradādupakāraka- viṣayakānuvādābhidhāne tu jajñyamānamantravacanādhi- kārāt saṃnipātitavidhayamiti tattvācyamātrālocanenoktam |
anyathā kathaṃ tadutsarge karmāṇītyatrādupakārakamevā- bhipretya puruṣaprayatno'nuvāda iti vadatyeva bhāṣyakāra iti naivaṃ vyākhyātuṃ śakyate |
kathaṃ tarhi vyākhyeyaṃ vini- yogābhiprāyaṃ vidhyabhidhānitaracca prayogābhiprāyaṃ ityeva- metat vyākhyeyam |
na hyasati vidhau samidādīnāṃ aṅgatvaṃ sidhyati |
nanu prakaraṇenāntareṇāpi vidhiṃ śrutyeva sami- dādīnāṃ somādīnāmāvivādyajeta |
iti yajidhvastyatirekeṇa somasya vidhyabhāve'pi tṛtīyayā viniyuktasya pradhānavidhinaiva vidhānam |
evaṃ prajājādīnāmapi prakaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsayorviniyoge sati viśiṣṭapradhānavidhaureva viśeṣabhūtānāṃ prajājādīnāṃ vidhi- siddheḥ nārthaḥ pṛthagvidhānena iti cet |
satyaṃ viśiṣṭa- vidhiḥ viśeṣaṇamāskandati viśeṣaṇatvameva tu natai vidhānāt sidhyati |
sākāṅkṣasya hi sākāṅkṣa viniyogaḥ prakaraṇārthaḥ na ca vidhividhurāṇāmajñānāṃ prayo- janāpekṣā asati samānapadopanītaṃ dhātvarthameva bhāṣyaṃ samāsācca bhāvanāyāḥ parituṣṭatvāt |
vidhyupahitā tu tāvanmātreṇa parituṣyatīti bhavati prayojanāpekṣā |
satyāṃ ca tasyāṃ prakaraṇena darśapūrṇamāsayorviniyogadaṅgatvaṃ prajā- jādīnāṃ sidhyati tasmādattvasiddhayarthameva samidādiṣu vidhinā bhavitavyamiti |
evamaṅgabhūteṣu teṣu viśiṣṭa- pradhānavidhinaiva prayogasiddheḥ tasminnaṃśe aṅgavidhiranuvādo- 'bhidhīyate |
kramastu deśasāmānyalakṣaṇam, sa ca dvividhaḥ pāṭhasādeśya- manuṣṭhānasādeśyamiti |
pūrve tāvat yatrāṅgaliṅgoḥ samāna- deśo pāṭhaḥ, yathā dakṣiṇamagnihotrayājyāsya ca uttaramapi yatra samānamanuṣṭhānaṃ śeṣaśeṣiṇorbhavati yathā dakṣyasya paśoḥ paśudharmāṇāṃ ca |
dvividhenāpi sādeśyena tandhimantrasya paśu- dharmāṇāṃ copādāyā''dīnāṃ gomīye ca viniyogo bhavati |
tathā camasabakṣaṇe hotṛḥ, padārthakaraṇe cādhvaryorviniyoga iti |
yastu vidhyadhyāpāraṃ upādānābhidhānaṃ saptamaṃ pramāṇaṃ viniyoge manyate tayoścaraṃ viniyojakatāvatīti |
na khalu upādānaṃ nāma śeṣapramāṇaṃ saṃbhavati, prameyāsaṃbha- vāt |
etadeva hi tattvādhanarūpatvaṃ yat tadvāreṇa pūrvopatvam |
tathā- vidhārthādeśca vidhīyamānaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ rurvasya dvāradāri- bhāvāvasthitasyāṅgaṃ bhavati |

kathaṃ copādānena ṛtvarthatvaṃ prokṣaṇādeḥ ? yadi mataṃ niyogamadhye tāvat grāhakagrahaṇe- naiva prokṣaṇāderagataṃ tacca karaṇatayā na saṃbhavati pāri- drodhyāt karaṇopakārakatvenaiva tadarthyaṃ nirvahatīti niyoga eva tadanvitaḥ pratipannastasya karaṇopakārakatāṃ kalpayan karaṇedhamarthamākṣipatīti |
tasyāpi hetaveva rūpaṃ bhavatpakṣe prajājādīnāṃ grāhakagrahaṇādāditātparyameva nirvāhyata karaṇatadasaṃbhavāt karaṇopakāradvārakalpanamiti upakārasvarūpameva prākara- ṇikam |
tajjanakatvaṃ tu prajājādīnāmapi aupādānika- meveti cet |
tarhi prajājādeḥ viniyogaḥ prākara- ṇikaḥ syāt |
na hi prakaraṇakalpitopakārajanana- mātreṇa prakaraṇaviniyogaḥ sidhyati |
sarvaidhābheva saṃnipāti- nāmanāmnyādīnāṃ ca aṅgānāṃ tajjanakatvena prakaraṇavini- yogaprasaṅgāt |
nanu asaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇena viniyujyate, saṃyuktaṃ ca prokṣaṇa- miti |
saṃyuktānāmapi dvārāpekṣatvāt tannibandha- tadevaṃ pramāṇaśarīraviśeṣe'pi saṃyuktānāṃ dvāraparikalpaka- mupādānam |
paśvekatvādināmapi śrutyaiva viniyogo jyotiṣṭomādīnā- mapi phalārthatvaṃ vākyādimiti prāgeva carcitam |
atra bhāṣyakṛtā mantrasya ekavākyatāpannamarthaṃ śabdasāmarthyarūpa- liṅgaṃ vyavahṛtaṃ pūrvaliṅgavākyatvā ca aśoka |

bāla.pṛ.1. liṅgavākyavirododāharaṇe 'syonaṃ te sadanaṃ0' ityatra yadyamantraikavākyatvayomanyoḥ pṛthak pṛthak prakāśayitavyatvaṃ karmasamavetī dṛśyate tadā ubhayorapi medena prakāśāpekṣatvāt prakāśyayośca prakāśāpekṣatvāt viniyogasya prasthite sati yasya yatra klṛptaṃ sāmarthyaṃ sa tatra śīghrataraṃ prāpnuvan nānyatra ekavākyatayā netuṃ śakyate, nāpi anyemyastatrāgacchadasyaḥ so'vakāśaṃ dadāti |
vā. 3|3|10|14 pṛ. 822. liṅgaviniyogaḥ idānīṃ prastūyate tṛtīyasya dvitīye pāde |
pṛ. 745, liṅga- viniyogaḥ tṛtīyasya dvitīye upavarṇitaḥ |
liṅgaviniyogatvaṃ nāsti vaidikasya mantra- vyatiriktasya śabdasya |
su. pṛ. 1209. liṅgaviniyogamantraprakaraṇasya yaśapatiprathanasya puroḍāśaprathanaphalatvaṃ nirākṛtaṃ mantrādhikaraṇe bhāṣye |
'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' ityādī liṅga- viśeṣasya puṃliṅgarūpasya nirdeśāt puṃyuktaṃ yajamānatvaṃ aitiśāyanaḥ itistasya yujāpatyaṃ ācāryeḥ mene |
puṃsa eva karmādhikāro na striyāḥ iti aitiśāyanasya matam |
puṃsa eva karmādhikāro na striyāḥ iti pūrvapakṣe hetva- ntaraṃ sūtram |
puṃstvasya vivakṣitatvādeva avi- jñāte garbhe hate doṣaśrutiḥ upapadyate |
puṃso vadhe yajñanāśa eva bhavati iti avijñāta- garbhahantuḥ bhrūṇahatyādoṣaḥ śrūyate |
yadi striyā api yajñā- dhikāraḥ syāt tadā strīvadhe'pi bhrūṇahatyā syāt |
puṃsa eva yajñādhikāro na striyāḥ iti pūrvapakṣa sūtrābhyāṃ prāptaṃ tuśabdena nirasyan siddhāntamāha |
bādarāyaṇaḥ ācāryaḥ jāti karmaṇi adhikṛtāṃ manyate sma |
tasmāt svargakāmapadena pumāniva strī api pratīyata |
jāteḥ manuṣyatvāteḥ arthaḥ amila- pyamāṇaḥ svargaḥ svargecchā vā |
tasya jātyarthaḥ puṃsīva striyāmapi aviśeṣāt svargakāmanāmayāḥ ubhayora- viśiṣṭatvāt ca strī api pratīyata |
tasmāt striyā api karmādhikāraḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

coditatvāt brīpuṃsasādhāraṇyena karmaṇā vihitatvāt yathāśruti svargakāmapadasyānurodhena strītvena puṃstvena vā avijñāte garbhaṃ hate yajñādhikāratvaṃ- puṃsavadhāt bhrūṇahatyā bhavati iti anuvādaḥ nindāti- śāyaḥ |

nanu 'paśumālameta' ityatra yathā puṃstvaṃ ekaṃ ca viśvate tathā 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityatrāpi puṃstvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ syāt iti cet, ucyate 'paśu' ityatra yathāśruti śrutimatikramya puṃstvadi vivakṣeta coditatvāt upādeyatvena vihitatvāt |
prakṛte tu manuṣyatvāteḥ svargakāmāyāśca puṃsīva striyāmapi aviśeṣāt svargakāmaḥ ityatra puṃstvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ na śakyate |
vṛtto tu 'vibhaktyeti cenna' 6|1|3|8 iti pūrvapakṣaṇaḥ śaṅkāsūtram |
'paśunā yajeta' ityatra tṛtīyā yathā ekatvasya puṃstvasya ca vivakṣitatvaṃ tathā svargakāmapade'pi puṃstvaṃ vivakṣaṇīya iti |
tatrottaraṃ dravyatvavattvāt puṃsāṃ syād dravyasaṃyuktaṃ, kraya- vikrayābhyāmdravyatvaṃ strīṇāṃ, dravyaiḥ samānayogi- tvāt |
karmaṇā dravyasādhyatvāt strīṇāṃ ca dravyasaṃyuktatvāt na tāsāṃ karmādhikāraḥ, iti punaḥ pūrvapakṣopanyāsārthaṃ sūtram |
karma hi dravyasaṃyuktaṃ śrūyate 'brīhibhiryajeta' 'tasya dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā' ityādi |
puṃsāṃ dravyatvatvāt dravyasaṃyuktaṃ karma puṃsāmeva syāt |
strīṇāṃ dravyaśūnyatvaṃ tu krayavikrayābhyāṃ hetubhyāṃ sidhyati |
striyo hi pitrā vikrīyante bhartrā ca kriyante |
vikrayaśca śrūyate 'śatamatitaraṃ duhitṛmate dadyāt' (bhartā) 'ārṣe (vivāhe) gomithunaṃ (duhitṛmate dadyāt)' iti |
yathā ca vastrādidravyāṇi krayavikrayābhyāṃ saṃyuktāni tathā striyo'pi dravyaiḥ samānayoginyaḥ |
tathā ca strīṇāṃ kraya- vikrayaviṣayatvāt, dravyaiḥ samānayogitvāt adravyatvam |
krayavikrayaviṣayatvāt strīṇāṃ dravyatvena na tāsāṃ karma iti pūrvapakṣe liṅgapratipādanārthaṃ sūtram |
'yā patyā krītā satī anyaiścarati' ityanyathā arthavāde krītatvasya darśanaṃ strīṇāṃ krayaviṣayatve liṅgam |
kraya- viṣayatvācca adravyatvam, adravyatvācca strīṇāṃ na karma !
strīṇāmadravyatvāt na karmādhikāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣe śaṅkā- nirāsārthaṃ sūtram |
nanu strīṇāṃ dravyatvatvaṃ nāsti, bhaktotsarpanena vā kartanādinā vā yat dhanaṃ tathā upārjyate tena tasyāḥ dravyatvam, dravyatva- tvācca karmādhikāraḥ |
strībhiḥ kartanādinā yat dravyaṃ labhyate tadapi bhartureva |
ata eva 'bhāryā dāsaśca putraśca nirdhanāḥ sarve eva te |
yatte samadhigacchanti yasya te tasya tad dhanam |
strīṇāṃ dravyaśūnyatvāt na karmādhikāraḥ iti sūtraiḥ pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntamāha |
puṃsa iva striyā api phalotsāhasya aviśeṣāt vailakṣaṇyābhāvāt |
varuṇādigrahāṇāṃ sannivandhi bhakṣaṇe amantrakaṃ bhakṣa- mantrarahitatvaṃ syāt |
liṅgaviśeṣanirdeśāt bhakṣamantra indra- pītasya iti somaviśeṣaṇasya nirdeśāt |
aindrāaindrasomagrahāgayāyeṣu anaindrāṇāṃ somagrahāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ amantrakaṃ kartavyaṃ iti prathamaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ pūrvayuktaḥ |
anaindrāṇāṃ amantrakaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ na kiṃtu mitrāvaruṇapītasya itirotyā ūhena samantrakatvaṃ syāt |
hi yasmāt tatprakṛtitvaṃ aindra- pradhānaprakṛtitvaṃ anaindrapradānā
dup. 10|2|17|63 pṛ. 1898, liṅgasaṅkhye sarvatraiva lakṣaṇayā pravartate |
su. pṛ. 958. liṅgasamavāyaḥ gauṇyāḥ vṛtteḥ anyatamo hetuḥ |
'prāṇabhṛta upadadhāti' ityatra liṅgavatāmatvāt tatsama- vāyamātraṃ śabdapravṛttiḥ |
yadyapi ādyamantra eva prāṇa- śabdabhrat nānyaṃ, tathāpi prāṇabhṛt- aprāṇabhṛt- sama- vāyaḥ atra dṛśyate |
tatkaraṇa- mantreṣu 'ayaṃ purobhuvastasya prāṇo bhovāyanaḥ' iti prāṇaśabdaḥ paṭhitaḥ |

adṛṣṭārthatvādyogāt ekavākyopagamanasāmarthyasya śruti- kalpakatvānupapatteḥ kaścinyāyena ca kṛtsnasya bhakṣārthatvā- bhāve'pi bhakṣānuvākasāmarthyopapatteḥ grahaṇābhidhāna- sāmarthyasyāpi samākhyāvirodhābhāvāt śrutikalpakatā yuktā iti grahaṇārthatvaiva anuṣṭheyatvena prakāśyatayā ape- kṣitatvāt taddṛṣṭārthatvopapatteḥ anapekṣitabhakṣastulyatve sati adṛṣṭārthatvāpatteḥ iti 'arthasya coditatvāt' itisūtryāvayavasya ākṛtyā vyākhyā'ntaram|

bhakṣamantraḥ śrūyate- 'bhakṣeha mā''viśa dīrghāyutvāya śantanutvāya rāyaspoṣāya varcase suprajāstvāya, ehi vaso purovaso priyo me hṛdo'śvinostavā bāhubhyāṃ sadhā- sam, nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā deva soma sucakṣā ava khyeṣam|

hinve me gātrā harivo gaṇanme mā vī tītṛpaḥ, śivo me saptarṣīnupatiṣṭhasva mā meḍvā'nābhimati gāḥ, mandrābhibhūtiḥ keturyaśasāṃ vāgjuṣāṇā somasya tanmuca, vasu-madru- rudradravasya ādityadravasya soma deva te mativid: prātaḥsavanasya mādhyandinasya savanasya tṛtīyasya savanasya gāyatracchandasastriṣṭupchandaso jagatīcchandaso'gniṣṭup indra- pītasya narāśaṃsapītasya pitṛpītasya madhumata upahūtasyopa- hūtasya bhakṣayāmi' (taisaṃ. 3|2|15) ityevamādi|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kṛtsna eṣānuvāko bhakṣaṇe viniyojanīyaḥ, uta kaścidya avayavo'nyatrāpi iti|

liṅgasya viniyojakatvaṃ sāmānya- sannavayavāpekṣamiti pratipādanaprasaṅgena śruterapi sāmānya- sannavayavāpekṣaviniyojakatvamiti pratipādyedānīṃ liṅgata eva viśeṣaḥ kiṃ sākṣāccoditatveṣu arthākṣiteṣu liṅgasya viniyojakatvaṃ na veti nirūpyate |

atrāyaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ, yadyapi 'bhakṣeha' ityupakramasya 'sadhyāsam' ityantasya grahaṇārthatvam, 'nṛcakṣasam' ityupakramasya 'avakhyeṣam' ityantasya avakṣepārthatvam, 'hinve me gātrā' ityupakramasya 'mā meḍvā'nābhimati gāḥ' ityantasya samyag jaraṇārthatvam, 'mandrābhibhūtiḥ' ityupakramasya 'bhakṣayāmi' ityantasya bhakṣārthatvaṃ pratī- yate, tathāpi somarasabhakṣaṇasyaiva vihitatvāt liṅgasya vihitaviṣayamantraviniyojakatvāt grahaṇa-avekṣaṇa-samya- gjaraṇānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇākṣapalabdhatvena laiṅgikaviniyogāyogya- tvāt kṛtsna evāyaṃ mantro bhakṣaṇe viniyujyate|
tena upakramopasaṃhārayoḥ bhakṣaṇakīrta- nāt vaiśvānaravākyavat kṛtsnasya anuvākasya eka- vākyatvāt bhakṣānuvākasamākhyānācca kṛtsnasyaiva bhakṣa- ṇārthatvam|
kiñca grahaṇādīnāmarthato lokadṛṣṭyā prāptatvāt laukikyevetikartavyatā yuktā|

ataśca ekavākyatayā, ekopakramopasaṃhāragatabhakṣaṇakīrtana- liṅgāt bhakṣānuvākasamākhyānācca kṛtsna eva mantro bhakṣa- ṇārtha iti prāpte, abhidhīyate- tasya rūpopadeśābhyāmpakaṣo'rthasya codita- tvāt |
ayamprāyaḥ- bhavedevaṃ yadi arthaprāptaviṣaye laiṅgika- viniyogo mantrasya na bhavet|
tathāhi yadyatra grahaṇā- dayo na vidhīyante, tathāpi bhakṣaṇasya grahaṇādinā vinā asaṃbhavāt bhakṣaṇavidhyākṣiptameva grahaṇamavekṣaṇaṃ ca avaśyasthānu- ṣṭheyam|
samyagjaraṇaṃ ca bhakṣaṇasyaiva pratipattirūpasya dravya- bhakṣaṇaparyantasya vidhānāt bhakṣaṇavidhivihitameva yatnāntara- sādhyatvāt pṛthaganuṣṭheyam|
teṣāṃ ca asmṛtānāṃ anuṣṭhānā- saṃbhavāt teṣāmapi vaidikamantravidhisamarthyatayā'nyate- nāsti smṛtihetuvaidikopāyapekṣā|
śaknoti ca bhakṣetathyaṃ mantro grahaṇādīn prakāśayitum|
tena sūktavākyavat yathā- liṅgaṃ grahaṇādiṣu vidhiyaiva mantraḥ prayogocya iti |
tathāhi upakramopasaṃhārairūpadeyavākyatvam, tadanurodhāccasāmarthyasya vākyasya lākṣaṇikasāmarthyarūpaṃ liṅgaṃ kalpanīyam, tato'pi śrutiriti viprakarṣaḥ|
grahaṇābhidhānasāmarthyāt sākṣādeva śrutikalpanamiti sannikarṣābhidhānasāmarthyadeva vibhajya viniyoga iti |
samākhyā ca liṅgāt durbalā laukikī ca ekadeśadvāreṇā- pyupapadyate na kiñcidanupapannam |
sūtraṃ tu- tasya mantrasya bhāgaśo bhakṣādakaṣarpaṇāt liṅgāt grahaṇāderupadiṣṭatvācca kathamabhṛtasyopadiṣṭatvam|
jyotiṣṭome bhakṣānuvākasya yathāliṅgaṃ vibhajya bhakṣaṇādau viniyogaḥ |
bhāṣyam- bhakṣamantraḥ śrūyate 'bhakṣeha mā''viśa dīrghāyutvāya śantanutvāya rāyaspoṣāya varcase suprajāstvāya : ehi vaso purovaso priyo me hṛdo'śvinostavā bāhubhyāṃ sadhyāsam|
nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā deva soma sucakṣā ava khyeṣam|
hinve me gātrā harivo gaṇanme mā vī tītṛpaḥ|
śivo me saptarṣīnu tiprasva mā meḍvā'nābhimati gāḥ|
mandrā- bhibhūtiḥ keturyaśasāṃ vāgjuṣāṇā somasya tanmuca|

vasu- madrudradravasya ādityadravasya soma deva te mati- vidaḥ prātaḥsavanasya mādhyandinasya savanasya tṛtīyasya savanasya gāyatracchandasastriṣṭupchandaso jagatīcchandaso'gniṣṭup indra- pītasya narāśaṃsapītasya pitṛpītasya madhumata upahūtasyopa- hūtasya bhakṣayāmi' ityevamādi|
tatra saṃdehaḥ kiṃ kṛtsna eṣo- 'nuvāko bhakṣaṇe viniyojanīyaḥ, uta kaścidya avayavaḥ anyatrāpi|
kutaḥ ? bhakṣayāmītye śabdo vyakte bhakṣaṇe viniyojanīyaḥ, bhakṣaṇameṣa śaknoti vadituṃ nānyat kiñcit|
nanu 'ehi vaso' ityevamādi 'sadhyāsam' ityevamantaṃ grahaṇaṃ padasamūhena para- sparākāṅkṣaṇā ekārthaṃ vibhinnaṃ bhakṣaṇavākyāt|
'hinve me gātrā harivaḥ' ityeva- mādi ca 'mā meḍvā'nābhimati gāḥ' ityevamantaṃ samyagjaraṇārtham|
kathametat śakyaṃ vadituṃ sarvamidamekaṃ vākyaṃ bhakṣaṇe vini- yujyate iti|
evamapi miyata vākyam, viśeṣaṇa- viśeṣyāṇāṃ yugapadghaṭanāsaṃbhavāt|
viśeṣaṇavacanānāṃ avivakṣitārthatvavacanatā, bhakṣaṇaviśeṣaṇa- paratā ceti lakṣaṇāyā tu gamyate|
yadyapi arthādayaṃ grahaṇādayo bahavo'rthā gamyante na tu sarve īpsitā iti|
prayojanaṃ ca yāvataḥ padasamūhyaikam, tāvadekaṃ vākyam|
nanu ca samākhyā laukikaḥ śabdaḥ, kathaṃ vaidikamantraṃ niyaṃyatīti|
samākhyā saṃnnidhau buddhau saṃnidhimupaneṣyati, prayogavacano vidhāyastīti|
tasmāt kṛtsno'nuvāko bhakṣaṇe vini- yoktavyaḥ iti|
vā- samastanuvākodāharaṇaṃ kāni padāni ka- samaryānīti vakṣyamāṇaviṣayavivekārtham|
tatassamāānādhikaraṇasyaitathā vasubhadrādayo gāyatracchandaḥprabhṛtayaḥ indrapītādayaśca krameṇa yathāsavanaṃ niṣkṛpya prayoktavyāḥ|
idaṃ tu vicā- ryate kiṃ samasto'nuvāko bhakṣaṇe eva viniyoktavyaḥ, uta grahaṇāvekṣaṇasamyagjaraṇe'pya yathāliṅgamiti|

coditatvāt bhakṣyāmipadasya ca tatprakāśanasāmarthyāt, āyātapadasaṃbadhaṃ gṛhītetarapadānāmanānyāgamitvāt 'tata- śrāvacanaṃ teṣāmitarārthaṃ prayujyate' (9|2|11|137) itivat grahaṇādīnāmapi coditamakṣaviśeṣaṇatvena eka- pradhānānāṃ vākyatvāt tatraiva viniyogaḥ ityukte, paricodanā |
yadyapi 'sadhi hiṃsāyām' iti pāṭhāt sadhyāsabhityasya grahaṇārthatā na tripaṣṭā, tathāpi bāhukaruṇa- katvāt nirvapatitat grahaṇapratītiḥ |
yadyapi 'cakṣikṣa vyaktāyāṃ vāci' iti smaryate tathā'pi prayogeṣu prakāśanamātrārthatā gamyate |
tena nṛṣu yaḥ khyātaḥ, sa nṛcakṣāḥ, taṃ avakṣyeyamiti 'cakṣikṣaḥ khyāñ' ityatra śvej ityupasaṃkhyāyate |
'hinva me gātrāṇi', iti samyakpariṇataḥ śaknoti gātrāṇi prīṇayitum, nāmevāsmāttādanmiti sammyañjanā- rthatā |
sarvapyetāni bhakṣaṇasya prāgbhūtaṃ ca vartamānāni viśeṣaṇaṃ bhavanti |
yadyapi ca grahaṇādīnāṃ svaprādhānyāpariṇyāgāt śrautatvācca bhedena prakādhanaṃ yuktam, tathāpi acoditaprakāśane na kiṃcitva phalamastīti coditaśeṣatvameva yuktataram |
sā nāma samākhyā viniyoktrī yuktā, yā vede eva paṭhyate |
bhakṣānuvākasamākhyāyā tu asamāmnānāt kathaṃ viniyokṣyate iti |
' yathaiva vedasya vaktṛdoṣarahitatvāt prāmāṇyam, evaṃ laukikasyāpi padasya anāditvāviśeṣāt |
na hi agnihotrasargādisādhyasādhanabhāvavat anuvākasya apratya- kṣatvam |
sā ca bhakṣyānuvāka ityevaṃ vigrahamāṇā bhakṣaṇasaṃbandhaḥ (dvaḥ) ityevaṃ manasi nidhāpayati |
bhāṣyam - naitadevaṃ kṛtsno'nuvāko bhakṣaṇe vini- yujyate iti |
rūpāt grahaṇavākyaṃ grahaṇe viniyujyeta, ehītyevamādi sadhyāsabhityevamantam |
kutaḥ ? asti hi taiḥ prayo- janam |
grahaṇādivacca rūpeṇa sāmarthyā- (tprakaraṇena) makena liṅgena vākyasya bādhitatvāt |
grahaṇābhidhānasāmarthyena hi śrutimanumāya śīghraṃ viniyogaḥ kriyate |
tato lakṣaṇādvāreṇa bhakṣaṃ prati sāmarthyam, tataḥ śrutyanumānamiti viprakarṣaḥ |
tena bhakṣasya prasaṅgāntareṇa mantrādinā avaruddhatvāt eteṣāmapi ca svayamantraprāptatve apakarṣaḥ |
yadā tāni apyaprakāśitāni naiva śakyante anuṣṭhātum |
tannāma arthaprāptaṃ na prakāśyate, yadevameva vinā prayatnena niṣpadyate |
grahaṇādīni tu sarvāṇi pṛthakprayatnasādhyāni tānyasmṛtāni na śakyante kartumiti avaśyaṃ smartavyāni |
bhakṣavidhirapi tāni anodayitvā na śaknoti svārthamanuṣṭhāpayitumiti tānyapi codayati |
ato mantrasvarūpatvātte codanātte sammyañjana- tanmantrayośca upadeśādeva apakarṣaḥ, arthasyaiva codita- tvāt |
tena yadyapi anudāhṛtatvāt pratyakṣopadeśo'na śakyo vaktuṃ tathāpi adoṣaḥ |
('vi vā eṣa indriyeṇa vīryeṇadhyate yaḥ somaṃ vamati |
vākyasaṃjñe hi neśāte kartuṃ liṅgasya bādhanam |
soma-- pūrvatra sāmānyasaṃbandhothakaprakaraṇena śruti- svārasyabhaṅgavat, ihāpi sāmānyasaṃbandhothakasamākhyā liṅgasvārasyabhaṅga āśrayaṇīyaḥ |
bhaṭṭa-- some 'bhakṣehi mā''viśa' ityādibhakṣā- nuvāka ityevaṃ samākhyāto mantraḥ śrutaḥ |
tatra yastā- vadasyāṃśo bhakṣaṇameva pratipādayati sa tatraiva viniyujyate |

grahaṇāvekṣaṇasamyañjanapratipādakānāṃ tvaṃśānāṃ kiṃ grahaṇā- dāveva viniyogaḥ athavā bhakṣaṇamatraikavākyatayā bhakṣaṇe eva iti cintāyām, grahaṇāderavihitatvena apūrve pratyakṣatvajanakatayā janakatvasyāpi abhāvāt, grahaṇasya arthāta bhakṣādhākatvena pañcāprāptāvāpi 'vāhubhyāṃ sadhyāsam' itya- nenoktasya vāhudvayakaraṇakasya grahaṇasya kathamapyaprāpteḥ, avekṣaṇasya ca bhakṣaṇavākyatvenaiva amāpteḥ, sammyañjara- ṇasya tadanukūlavyāpārasya vā bhakṣottarabhāvitayā bhakṣājana- katvena tepāmapūrvaprayojakatvasyāpi abhāvāt grahaṇātha- rrthatve ānarthakyāpatteḥ, bhakṣaṇamatraikavākyatayā bhakṣārthatva- mevopām |

iti prāpte, grahaṇādipratyakṣavidhyāve'pi samākhyā- sahakṛtāvāntaraprakaraṇena bhakṣaṇasaṃbandhe tattvamantrāṇāmavagate liṅgabalena mānvavarṇikagrahaṇādividhikalpyatayā tatprāptyu- papatteḥ tadarthatvenaiva mantraviniyogopapatteḥ, na svato nirākāṅkṣatvodrekayoḥ : ākhyātapade vākyatayāṃ kathaṃcidekavākyatāṃ parikalpya gauṇyā bhakṣārthatvakalpanām, śaktyaiva vā bhakṣa- viśeṣaṇatvena grahaṇādiprakāśakatvakalpanāmupapattimata |
na caivamapi sammyañjaraṇasya kṛtasādhyatvāt vidhisaṃbhavaḥ, sammyañjaraṇānukūlavyāpārasya āsanaviśeṣaṇasyaiva anuṣṭheyasya vidheyatvāt |
vamanavirekanimittaprāyaścittamānācca sammyañjaraṇaparyantameva bhakṣaṇe pratipattiriti tasya bhakṣopa- yogitā |
vidhyantaḥ saurye syāt iti vicāre vikalpaḥ syāt iti pūrveḥ pakṣaḥ |
'prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti prayājatvacca liṅgasya sarvapradhāna- sādhāraṇatvāt |
saurye karmaṇi dāśapūrṇamāsikapradhāneṣu kathañcit vidhyantaḥ vikalpena syāt iti pūrvapakṣe sūtreṇa prāpte bā- śabdena nirasya siddhāntamāha |
hi yasmāt sauryeḥ vikāraḥ pūrvavaccāpūrvābhihitavidhyanta- tvāt |
saurye yāge dāśapūrṇamāsikaāgneyasyaiva vidhyanto grāhyaḥ ekadevatva
āgne- vaiṣṇavyo vākyena dīkṣyamāṇapadasamabhivyāhāreṇa dīkṣārthaḥ iti |
'somena yakṣyamāṇo'gnimādadhīta' ityatrāpi vākyīyameva ādhānātttarakālasya somāṅgavat abhuti- tyādeva |

yadapi atra tantraratne 'yakṣyamāṇa iti ca dīkṣyamāṇa itivat kriyāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ upapade luṭpratyayaḥ: somena yaṣṭuṃ ityartha' iti tadapi kriyāntarayoge eva luṭ: sādhutvoktidvārā vākyīyavini- yogopapādanārthameveti saṃkṣepaḥ |
yathā 'atha śvo vā vaṭo bhaviṣyati' iti |

evaṃ ca 'darśapūrṇamāsau ārapsyamāno'nvārambhaṇīyāṃ nirvapet' 'somena yakṣyamāṇaḥ ādadhīta' ityādau laḍādeśānaśca sādhāraṇye'pi 'luṭ śeṣe ca' (pā. 3|3|13) iti sūtreṇa vākyasārthakyāya ca adyatanabhaviṣyatvaratvam |
luṭparye'pi paśyatītyādau ayata- nānanyasādhāraṇa bhaviṣyatsāmānye tatraiva (bhāvanāyā- mevānveti ) |
yadi luṭ anadyatane vidhīyamāno luṭpravādhamāna ātmānaṃ na pratilabhate tato vādhetāpi |
tasmāt luṭ anadyatane adyatane ca bhaviṣyati kāle bhavati |
luṭdiniyoktrī śrutiḥ: someśvaramate yathā- 'āgnāvaiṣṇavyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet darśapūrṇamāsāvāra- psyamānaḥ' |
suśabda-apaśabdavivicano- pāyasya prakṛtipratyayavibhāgakalpasya apāramārthikasyaiva lekhāgavacananyāyena vyākaraṇaśāstre vyutpādanābhyupagamaḥ |
acpratyayāhāre yadyapi ekāraḥ paṭhyaḥ tathāpi lakārānubandhasya lakāra- syābhāvāt ajanubandhakeṣu lakāreṣu ekārānubandhakasya leṭ: pañcamatvaṃ lakārānubandhabhūteṣu akṣareṣu ekārasya pañcamatvāt |
yadvā 'dhātusaṃbandhe pratyayāḥ' iti tṛtīye dhātvadhikāre 'kriyāsamabhihāre leṭ' iti leṭ vihitaḥ |
subodhinyanusāreṇa tu ayaṃ svārthaḥ-- upasaṃprāptiḥ gṛhanirrmāṇādiprāptiḥ aśāstrā nirmalā |
śāstraṃ na praka- tyarkaṃ svamūlavedanāmupakaṃ netyarthaḥ |
aprāpte gṛhanirrmāṇādiśaucya- śūnye puruṣe śāstraṃ arthavat saphalam |
[karma ārabdhaṃ samāptanīyameva iti bhāvyotprekṣita ekadeśi- mataṃ na ramaṇīyam |
phalakāme nimitte yāgasya sukhaduḥkhabhāvanāmkasya kaṣṭhā- tmakasya kartavyopadeśānupapattyā tataḥ phalāntarakalpanā- patteśca |
tataśca phalādhinaḥ karmavidhānāt prakṛte karmaṇi vītarāgasya na samāpananiyamaḥ |
pṛ. loke 'gāṃ ānaya' ityādiprayoge padapadārthayor saṃgatirgṛhyate |
vākye tu ākāṅkṣā-yogyatā-saṃnidhi- vaśāt svārthaṃ pratipādayati |
vi. 1|1|7. loke yathā grāmāttarādāgatānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ paryatrikaraṇena adṛṣṭa upa- kāraḥ kriyate ityucyate, loke ca nānupapattiḥ |
bhā. 2|1| 4|12, loke yeṣpyeteṣu prasidvāni padāni, tāni sati saṃbhave tadarthānyeva syumeva ityavagantavyam |
1|2| 2|21. loke hi putrāṇāṃ pitṛdhane samavibhāgo dṛṣṭaḥ |
ṛju. pṛ. 91. 'lokāvagatasāmarthyaḥ śabdo vede'pi bodhakaḥ' iti nyāyena vyutpatyanusārī vedārtho varṇanīyaḥ |
lokaprasiddhipratīkṣe vede yatra ekadeśe'pi jātinimittatā labhyate na tatra punarnimittāntaraśakti- kalpanā saṃbhavati |
'bhāvanātaḥ prāptatvāt 0' iti nyāye mīko. pṛ. 3030 ityatra draṣṭavyam |
yathā iyaṃ gauḥ kretavyā devadattyā, eṣā hi bahukṣīrā, rūpavatyā, anaṣṭaprajā ceti |
tadvat 'audumbaro yūpo bhavati, ūrjasvadurudrayai' ityādau vede'pi bhaviṣyati |
yadyapi saguṇā matsyā bhavanti tathāpi payasā saha na samasyante |
yathā loke ekasminnarthe bahuvacanaṃ na prayu- jyate |
yathā loke kāṣṭhagrāhmabhyo yadīyete, tatra kāṣṭhavāhāḥ svāminā saha paṭhyante |
tebhyaḥ svāmī vibhajya nirdiśati, idaṃ tubhyamidaṃ tubhyaṃ iti |
yathā loke 'dāta devadattasyadattaudīyatām' ityukte samāsādhau vidhīyate, yadetat śataṃ etayoḥ dīyatāmiti |
katham ? dadhyabhāve anyena amalenāpi kāñjikādinā kriyate, tatrāpi ca āmiṣāśabdo bhavati |
loke'pi hi kāṣṭhagrāhmabhyo yadīyete, tadasaṃkīrti- te'pi pari kraye ānamanīyameva bhavati |
'dātavyāṃ dīyatām' iti ekajātī- yānāṃ śataṃ na bhinnajātīyānām |
vā. 1| 3|8|9 pṛ. 226-224, idaṃ mīko. pṛ. 1673 'tricarcārvādhatvādhikaraṇam' iti cindī draṣṭavyam |
bhāṣyam- 'atha gauḥ ityevamādayaḥ śabdāḥ kiṃ ākṛtaḥ pramāṇaṃ uta vyakteḥ iti saṃdehaḥ |
idaṃ tāvat parīkṣyatām, kiṃ eva laukikāḥ śabdāḥ ta eva vaidikāḥ uta anye iti |
yadā ta eva tadāpi kiṃ te evaiyāmarthāḥ ye loke utāne iti saṃśayaḥ |
tatrānye laukikāḥ śabdāḥ anye vaidikāḥ, anye vaiṣāmarthāḥ iti brūmaḥ |
ime laukikāḥ ime vaidikāḥ iti vyapadeśabhedaḥ |
