sarvatra hi vaktṛkramaviṣayyeṇa śrotṛḥ kramo bhavati |
sa hi prathamaṃ tāvat kiñcit viśeṣaṃ vivakṣati tatastasya kenacit viśeṣeṇa vinā abhidhātumaśakteḥ
6|2|4|17-19. mīko. pṛ. 1850 'tasmādhi- karaṇam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
laukikakarmajñānāṃ iyattā pratyakṣeṇa niśrīyate, vaidikakarmajñānāṃ tu śrutvā |
9|3|13|9. mīko. pṛ. 118 'amīpomīye paśo yāgasamāptyantaraṃ.' ityatra draṣṭavyam |

laukikasādhāraṇenākāreṇa śabdasamarpite evā- pūrvapadārtha saṃskārakarmānvayabodhane sati tadanantaraṃ tasyā- pūrvatvāvagatau arthāt saṃskārasya apūrvaviṣayatvaparyava- sānaṃ' ityevaṃ nyāyaḥ 'tate payasi dadhyānayati' ityatrā- jhīkaraṇīyaḥ |
lyap-ktvādeśaḥ viniyoktrī śrutiḥ someśvara- matena yathā- 'tasyāvāramācārya', ityādi |
yathā 'satrādudavasāya pṛṣṭhaśamanīye jyotiṣṭomena sahasradakṣiṇena yajeran' ityatra |
śrotā punaḥ prathamaṃ tāvat dvandvaṃ śṛṇoti, tato viśeṣaṇam, tato viśeṣyam, tataḥ tadupapattathāni vastvantarāṇi prapadyate |
tena yadyapi vaktā pūrvaṃ saṃbandhaṃ ālocitaḥ tathāpi śrotā paścādaivaṃ grahīṣyati |
saṃprati pauruṣeyavākyānāṃ vaktṛjñānānumānavyavadhānenaiva arthapratipādakatvaṃ iti prati- pādyate |
jāyate iti cenna, dyutyupannaśabdoccāraṇe'pi vaktṛprabhiprāya- niśraye'rthābhidhānādarthāttātparyajñānamapi sāmagrītvena kalpyate |

nanu astu vākyamātradanabhidhānam, āptavākyasya doparahitasyārthāvabodhakatvaṃ kimiti nāśrīyate ? naivam, ādhyāyādidoṣarahitamevāptatvaṃ tathābhūtasyāpi anyapara- prayoge dṛśyate, yathā- 'viṣaṃ bhuṅkṣva' ityādau bhojana- nivṛttipare vākye |
tātparyaniścayāt arthaniścayaḥ, tātparyaniścayaśca vaktṛjñānānumānadvāreṇa bhavatīti āptavākyasyaiva liṅgatvamupapannam, viprabhakṣaṇavākye'pi yogyadhārthajñānapūrva- katvādyabhicārāt |

nanu kathaṃ jñānamanumīyate ? na tāvat jñānamātrā- numānam, jñānamātraviśeṣaniścayābhāvādeva anumānavaiyarthya syāt, na tāvat vidhijñānamānumānam, arthenaiva jñānasya viśeṣaḥ, ato'rthaniścayena viśiṣṭajñānānumānaṃ niścaye ca anumānavaiyarthyameveti vaktṛjñānānu- nam ? naivam, vākyaśravaṇe sati abhidhānāt prāgeva padārthaḥ smaryante, smṛtānāṃ ca padārthānāṃ evama- nvetaṃ yogyaṃ naivaṃ iti vimarśaḥ saṃjāyate, ato nyāya- saṃpāditena vimarśena viśiṣṭo'rtho buddhimatthaḥ, tenaiva viśiṣṭajñānānumānam |
nanu vimarśo nāma kīdṛśaḥ ? sa ca pramāṇapramāṇaṃ veti api na vidmaḥ |

ucyate- vimarśastāvat abhidhānāt prāgeva bhavadbhirabhyupakṛtaḥ, itarathā abhihitaiḥ padārthaiḥ viśiṣṭo'rtho jñātuṃ na śakyate, padārthānāmekārthasādhāraṇatvāt kasya viśiṣṭārthasya gamakā bhaveyuḥ ? ākāṅkṣāsaṃnidhiyogyatāyuktārthasya gamakā iti cet, tarhi sa eva vimarśaśabdārtho yuṣmābhirabhya- jīkṛtaḥ |
sa ca pramāṇetikartavyatārūpaḥ na pramāṇamātram, na ca smṛtimātraṃ vā, vimarśānaṅgīkāre ca pratyakṣikaraṇaṃ pūrvapakṣasiddhāntavacanayaktivimarśo na syāt |
'puṃvākye tu visaṃvādaśaṅkayā sā tirohitā' mī. ko. 425.
itarathā phalanirṇayasadbhāve- 'pi prativandhakatvaprasaṅgaḥ, anumānaniścaye ca prasaṅga- stutyaḥ |
nanu evaṃ vyavahārāvasthitatvābhidhaḥ : pauruṣeyavākyebhyo hi vyutpattiḥ, vākyaṃ ca nābhidhāyakam, liṅgamevetyu- ktam |
ato vaktṛjñānānumāna- dvāreṇa arthaniścaya iti siddham |
yathā vakrendraḥ śivena śirasā dhāryate, lokaiśca namasyate iti sarvatra jñeyamiti |
tāśca aśvasya eka- smin pārśve saptadaśa, evamitarapārśve |
itareṣāṃ paśūnāṃ tu trayodaśatrayodaśa ekaikasmin pārśve |
9|4|12|17, vakrikamiḥ gaṇitamidaṃ prayojanam, kutsanaṃ pārśvamuddharitva iti |
vakrikīyatāprakāśanārthe aśvamedhe agrigrathe aśvatparagomṛgāṇāmayaṃ vaiśeṣikamantrākaraṇapakṣe 'paṣṭa- śitīyāṃ vakrayaḥ' iti samāsavacanam |
vakrikīyatāprakāśanārthe agrigrathe paśugaṇe samasta saṃkhyāvacanaṃ kāryaṃ 'dvipañcāśadaśva vakrayaḥ' ityādi |
na ca prathamā- vagataprayojakavyāpārārthatvameva 'vacasaiva kāryati' ityā- divat, tarhi astu iti vācyam |
iti vacanāt tṛtīyāśrutighaṭitā aindrī indrapadaghaṭitā ṛk ayathārthe yathārthe mukhyārthaṃ atikramya gauṇārtheṣa- bhūtā syāt |
nanu aindrayā ṛcā gārhapatyopasthānaṃ 'agninā sidhyati' ityādivat aśakyārthavidhānamanupapannaṃ iti cet, tatrāha |
haviḥśravaṇe- śrutilaghuṇayogāt indraśabdena gārhapatyābhidhānaṃ saṃbha- vati |
saṃbandhasya vācyavācakabhāvasya anāditayā aśākha- hetutvāt śāstrakāryyāsaṃbhavāt |
tasmāt aindrayā ṛcaḥ gārhapatyo- pasthāne viniyogaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |

vacanāt trayathāthyamaindrī syāt ' ityadhikaraṇe ' guṇādvā'pyabhidhānaṃ ' iti guṇasūtreṇa mantragatendraśabdaḥ haviḥśravaṇetyādiguṇayogena gārhapatyaṃ abhidhatte ityevaṃ gauṇasamarthana śrutiviniyogānirvāhasyoktatvāt |
nanu 'yadyameve ca' iti vākye abhidhattetā na vidhīyate, tadā vacanasya jhaṭiti pravṛtteḥ kevalaprajāpatireva devatā syāt |
evaṃ ca 'ami- jyotiḥ' iti mantrasya vacanaviniyuktasya 'vacanāt trayathāthyaṃ' |
iti nyāyena gauṇayā prajāpatikāśaktameva syāt ityameḥ devatātvaṃ mantravarṇato na labdhuṃ śakyaṃ iti cet |
vacanāt trayathāthyamaindrī syāt ' iti yat siddhavat gārhapatyārthatvaṅgīkāreṇa uktam, tan iha sthāpayiṣyāmā- śrutibalīyastvābhiprāyeṇa |
vā. 3|1|7|8 pṛ. 824, vacanāt trayathāthyamaindrī syāt ' ( 3|1|2|13 ) iti viniyogadarśanādevānumīyate śaktiḥ |
'vacanāttrayathāthyathamaindrī syāt' ( 3|1|2|13 ) iti- sūtreṇa 'aindrayā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' itiśrutibalena aindrayā gārhapatyopasthānājñatvaṃ vihitam |
śrutvā'pi aśaktavini- yogāsaṃbhavāt kathaṃ indraśabdena gārhapatyābhidhānam ? itya- pekṣayāṃ guṇayogena iti pūrvāvayavena ('guṇādvā'pyabhidhānaṃ syāt' ityanena ) uktam |

nanu indraśabdasya gārhapatyābhi- dhānāntikapradarśanārthameva etadvacanaṃ kasmānna bhavati ityāśaṅkya, yadyarthasaṃrvasya dhruvadhruvadhārāsavetvena śāstrahetukatvābhāvāt iti 'saṃbandhasya aśāstrahetutvāt ' ityanenoktam |
'vacanāttrayathāthyamaindrī syāt ' ( anyathā pāṭho'yam ) iti tātīyādhikaraṇa- nyāyena vācanikaviniyogabalena ( abhisūryyaprakāśanasāmarthya- yorapi mantrayoḥ ) prajāpatitvakathopapattiḥ |
kulārthaṃ nāma yāgaṃ pratyaya uktaṃ 'etena rājapurohitau sāyujyakāmau yajeyātām' iti |
vacanāt rājapurohitau iti vacanādeva ekasya rājñaḥ dvisaṃyogaḥ purohitābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃyogaḥ syāt |
api vyavahāre ekasya rājñaḥ purohitatvaṃ na saṃbhavati tathāpi vacanāt ekasya dvisaṃyogaḥ purohitadvayasaṃyogaḥ syāt |
dakṣiṇācāreṇa kartavyaṃ iti niyamāt savyahasto na prāpnoti, tathāpi 'añjalinā juhoti' iti vacanāt etasya savyadakṣiṇī dvau pāṇī bhavataḥ tadvat |
tathā ca rājapurohitau ityatra puro- hitaśca purohitaśca purohitau, rājñaḥ purohito rājapurohitau iti samāsaḥ |
kulayāgāye ekasya rājñaḥ dvayoḥ purohitayoḥ adhikāraḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
tasmāt iti sūtrasthaṃ padaṃ tu kāpi nānheti |
'rājapurohitau sāyujyakāmau yajeyātām' iti kulāyāge ekasya rājñaḥ dvau purohitau adhikṛtau iti pūrvapakṣaṃ sūtreṇa prāptaṃ nirasyati |
evaṃ ekasya rājñaḥ puro- hitau dvau iti tu na syāt |
tasmāt purohitaśca puro- hitaśca purohitau, rājñaḥ purohitau iti na samāsaḥ |
tena ca dvayoḥ rājñoḥ yau dvau purohitau, tayoḥ kulāyāgaḥ iti pakṣo'stu iti cet, tatrāha |
'arthābhāvāt naivaṃ syāt' evaṃ tu evamapi na syāt |
nanu rājānau ca tau purohitau ca iti samāsena rājānau santī yau purohitau tayoḥ adhikāraḥ iti cet, na |
rājñaḥ purohitatvarūpasya arthasya abhāvāt evamapi na syāt |
tasmāt rājā ca purohitaśca rājapurohitau iti dvandva eva samāsaḥ svīkāryyaḥ |
iti dvayoḥ kulāyāge sahādhikāraḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
'rājapurohitau sāyujyakāmau yajeyātām' ityatra ekasya rājñaḥ dvau purohitau, dvayoḥ rājñoḥ dvau purohitau, rājau purohitau, iti ca pakṣadvayamapi na saṃbhavatītyāha |
kulāyākyaśeṣe tacchrutena tayoḥ brāhmaṇarājanyayoḥ śrutena phalena saṃbandho na syāt |
arthānāṃ ca vibhaktatvāt, tejaḥ maṃtrato brāhmaṇasya, vīryyasaṃtro rājanyasya ' iti hi arthānāṃ tejovīryyarūpāṇāṃ guṇānāṃ vibhaktatvaṃ śrūyate |
tatra rājā ca purohitaśca iti siddhāntapa eve ucyate |
rājā ca purohitaśca tayoḥ kulāye sahādhikāraḥ |
'rājapurohitau yajeyātām' ityatra ekasya rājñaḥ dvau purohitau kulāyāge sahādhikārau iti pūrvapakṣe 'pāṇivat' iti dṛṣṭānta uktastaṃ vighaṭayati |
'añjalinā juhoti' ityatra ekasya puruṣasya dvau pāṇī (bhavataḥ) iti yaduktaṃ taduktameva |
añjalau karttavye dakṣiṇaḥ pāṇeḥ savyaḥ pāṇiḥ pratyajñabhūtaḥ |
dakṣiṇaḥ pāṇiḥ ajñabhūtaḥ, savyasya tasya pratyajñabhūtaḥ |
anyathā hi asaṃbandhena pratīyate, añjaliṃsaṃbandhaprayatne eva na syāt |
nahi ekena hastena añjalirabhavati, nāpi puruṣa- dvayasya dvābhyāṃ dakṣiṇahastābhyāṃ añjalirbhavati |
iti yuktaṃ tatra ekasya puruṣasya hastadvayagrahaṇam |
rājapurohitau ityatra tu ekasya rājñaḥ purohitadvayagrahaṇe prayojanābhāva uktaḥ |
tasmāt rājā ca purohitaśca iti dvau kulāyāge sahādhikārau iti siddhāntaḥ |
agniṣṭome agnīṣomīye paśau yūpasya añjanādyāḥ pari- vyāṇāḥ padārthāḥ śrūyante |
tatra kiṃ añjanādīnāṃ ekaikena anusamayaḥ uta añjanādinā parivāpā'ntena dharmakāṇḍena anusamayaḥ iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ añjanādi pari- vyāpā'ntaṃ guṇakāṇḍaṃ pratipūpaṃ anusametavyam |
vacanāt 'añjanādi yūpaṃ nāvasṛjet ā parivāpāyāt' itye- tasmāt parivāpā'ntena ekapadārthevāsyāt iti |
yūpaikādaśinyāṃ añjanādiparivyāpā'ntena anusamayaḥ 'añjanādi yajamāno yūpaṃ nāvasṛjet ā parivāpāyāt' iti vacanāt iti siddhānte ukte pūrvapakṣamāha |
apacchedābhāvaḥ anvārambhaḥ uktaḥ saḥ kāraṇāt syāt adhyayoḥ sāhāyyārthaḥ syāt |
upāntare ucchritavye sati ayasajetu ucchrayeṇa kāraṇena |
na tu tena pari- vyānāntā sidhyati |
yathā paśo 'pṛṣadājyena anu- yājān yajati' iti pṛṣadājyadharaṇārthaṃ pātrasya viśuddhi- rbhavati pātramedho bhavati arthāt tathā prakṛte'pi arthāt anavasargaḥ na tu asau niyāmakaḥ |
vṛttau tu kāraṇāt adhyayoḥ sahāyāpekṣārūpakāraṇāt avasargaḥ yajamānātiriktakalpanā syāt |
yajamānakāryaṃ anvārambhe anyaḥ kalpyaḥ syāt iti vyākhyātam |
ava- sargaḥ ityeva ca pāṭho gṛhyeta |
kutūhale'pi padārthā- nusamayabhaṅgāt kāraṇāt atra avasargaḥ syāt iti vyākhyātam |
paraṃtu 'avasargaḥ anvārambhaḥ syāt' iti tatra lekhaḥ |
yūpaikādaśināṃ ajñanādiparidhyānāntena guṇakāṇḍena anusamayaḥ iti siddhānte ukte pūrvapakṣaṇā 'kāraṇād- anavasargaḥ 0' iti sūtreṇa kutaḥ śaṅkāṃ siddhāntī nirasyati |
na padārthānusamayaḥ kintu paridhyānāntena padārthakāṇḍena anusamayaḥ syāt |
anavasargaḥ anvārambhastu na kāraṇāt kintu śabdakṛtatvāt 'yūpaṃ nāvasṛjeta ā yūpaparidhyānāt' iti vacanādeva |
śaknoti hi ṛte'pi yajamānāt adhyayuḥ yūpamucchra- yitum |
itarat yūpasyatvaprāptaṃ prayogavacanaṃ tu nyāya- mātram |
paśau pṛṣa- dājyapātraviśuddhistu arthāt upabhṛtaḥ ājyagrahaṇe vyāpṛtatvāt pṛṣadājyadhāraṇaṇapatteḥ |
'vacanāt samuccayaḥ' (3|6|16|45) iti siddhānte'pi darśanameva agatyā vacanīkṛtya samuccayaṃ vakṣyati |
na te nirmālyātāṃ yānti viniyojyāḥ punaḥ
rathakārasya traivarṇikasya jātiviśeṣasya ādhāne agnyādheye adhikāraḥ prayetavyaḥ; 'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti vacanāt |
asya rathakārakartṛkādhānasya sarvaśeṣatvāt sarveṣāṃ traivarṇikānāṃ ādhānaibhyaḥ avaśiṣṭa- tvāt |
athavā asya rathakārasya sarvebhyaḥ traivarṇikebhyaḥ avaśiṣṭatvāt |
atra rathakāraḥ atrai- varṇika eva iti pūrvapakṣāḥ |
traivarṇikebhyaḥ kiñcit hīnaḥ na tu sarvathā anairvarṇikaḥ iti tu siddhānto bhaviṣyati |
'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti ādhānādhikārī rathakāraḥ atraivarṇikaḥ iti pakṣe sūtreṇa prāpte kaścidāha |
nyāyyaḥ nyāyādapetaḥ karmādhikāranyāyasapannaḥ traivarṇikaḥ eva rathakāraḥ syāt |
traivarṇikasyāpi rathakāraśabdastu karmasaṃyogāt rathanirmāṇa- rūpakarmaṇā saṃyogatvāt |
śūdrasya tu karmasu pratiṣiddha- tvāt na śūdro rathakāraḥ |
tasmāt traivarṇikaḥ kadācit rathakarmakartā rathakāraḥ syāt |
rathakarmasaṃyogaṃ pravṛttinimittaṃ āśritya rathakāraśabdaḥ atra traivarṇikebhyaḥ netavyaḥ iti tadarthaḥ |
pūrvasroktapakṣanirāsārthaḥ tuśabdaḥ : 'varṣāsu ratha- kāra ādadhīta' ityukto rathakāraḥ evaṃ traivarṇikaḥ na syāt |
akarmatvāt traivarṇikasya śilpakarmmaṇyatvāt, 'na jīvavidyujāḥ śilpaḥ' iti niṣedhāt |
yadi traivarṇiko rathakāraḥ syāt tasya varṣā- kālokteḥ ānarthakyaṃ syāt |
'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' ityukto rathakāraḥ traivarṇikabhinnaḥ traivarṇikānāṃ śilpaniṣedhāt iti yaduktaṃ tatrāha |
yadyapi jīvanārthaṃ dvijānāṃ śilpaṃ niṣiddhaṃ tathāpi guṇārthena guṇādhikyāya nānāvidhajñānārjanārthena traivarṇiko- 'pi rathaṃ kuryāt |
āpadi jīvanārthamapi dvijasya ratha- karaṇaṃ syāt |
'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti rathakārasya traivarṇikasyaiva rathakaraṇanimittena varṣāsu ādhānaṃ tasya vidhīyate iti kenacidukte uttaramāha siddhāntī |
'vasante brāhmaṇo'dīnādadhīta, grīṣme rājanyaḥ, śaradi vaidyaḥ' iti śravaṇāni na nimittārthāni kintu prāptāni iti 'cāturvarṇyaviśeṣāt' (6|1|17|25-28) ityadhikaraṇe uktam |
tena 'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti śravaṇaṃ vasyāprāptamādhānaṃ tasyaiva prāpakam |
'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' ityukto rathakāro nāma kaḥ syāt ? ityatra siddhāntamāha |
tasya traivarṇikebhyaḥ kiñcit hīna- tvāt ante niveśaḥ |
mantravarṇāttu rathakāraśabdena saudha- nvanā eva pratīyan |
'ṛbhūṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratenādadhāmi' iti rathakārasyādhānamantraḥ |
'nemiṃ nayanti ṛbhavo yathā' iti mantre ye nemiṃ nayanti te ṛbhavaḥ ityuktam |
'saudhanvanā ṛbhavaḥ' iti mantre ca saudhanvanāparaparyāyā ṛbhavaḥ iti bodhitam |

'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti kiṃ atrayaprasiddhā traivarṇike nāmyatamo rathakāraśabdeno- cyate samudāyaprasiddhā vā anyo jātiśabdaḥ iti sandehe avayavaprasiddhyā rathakāriṇi traivarṇike rathakāraśabdasaṃbha- vāt apaśūdrādhikaraṇa-(6|1|126) pratiṣiddhasya anairva- rṇikasyādhikāro na yuktaḥ |
iti prāpte, samudāya- prasiddhā avayavaprasiddhibādhāt vacanabalena anairvarṇi- kasyaivādhikāraḥ iti vakṣyate |
anyata eva tu samudāyaprasiddhivalīyastva- siddhau nyāyena pratiṣiddhasyāpi anairvarṇikasyaiva vacana- balena adhikāraniścayāt sandehābhāvena rathakārādhikaraṇā- rambho na yujyate |
na cānyatra kvacit samudāyaprasiddhi- balīyastvamutpādanaṃ dṛśyate |
na ca tadavyutpādane vinā pāriśeṣyāmeṇa anairvarṇikasya adhikārasiddhiḥ |

traivarṇi- kasyāpi avayavārthayogena rathakāraśabdavācyatvasaṃbhave vasantādivākyaiḥ tasyādhānaprāptāvapi rathakāratvena nimi- tena varṣākālaādhānārthatayā vacanopapattau avitṛptaḥ anai- rvarṇikasya adhikārakalpanā'nupapatteḥ |

ata eva vacanāt iti mukhyaṃ hetuṃ vyāravyāya ādhānasya asarvaśeṣatvāt ityanena ādhānasaṃvanvitayā sarvebhyaḥ brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyebhyaḥ prāptebhyaḥ anairvarṇikasya pariśiṣṭatvāt 'ayamādhānavidhiḥ' ityevamukto hetuḥ |
'sarvaśeṣa ādhānaṃ' iti bhāṣye caśabdaprayogāt upacaropapattilena vyākhyātaḥ |
su. pṛ. 166. 'atirātrameke prathamamāharanti' iti vacanādeva atirātrasyaikajyotiṣṭomasya prathamamanuṣṭhānam |
vā. 2|3| 3|4. pṛ. 589. vacanātideśaḥ ityatra vacanaṃ dvividhaṃ pratyakṣaśrutaṃ ānumānikaṃ ceti |
vāla. pṛ. 118. vacanānarthakyāt varaṃ padamātrasya lakṣaṇā |
soma. 7|3|8. vacanataḥ bhūtiḥ (tribhiḥ prakāraiḥ bhūtirbhavati, vyāpārataḥ phalato vacanataḥ iti) |
āśitaṃbhavaṃ yad dravyaṃ sā bhūtiḥ, sā dakṣiṇā |
tato'dhikaṃ dakṣiṇātve siddhe vacana- prāmāṇyāt bhavati |
vikṛtau ṛtapeye vacanaprāmāṇyāt alpakaraṇamapi dakṣiṇāyāḥ sthāne vidhīyate somacamasaḥ |
bhā. 10|3|16|14. vacanaprāmāṇyāt pratiṣedho vidhiṃ bādhitvā bhaviṣyati |
bhā. 10|8|3|6. vacanamātrasya ūho yathā- 'chāgasya vapāyā medasa' iti prakṛtau |
vāla. pṛ. 127. vacanavibhaktyorvibhaktiḥ pradhānam, kārakavāci- tvāt |
anyā hi vacanavyaktiḥ vidhīya- mānasya, anyā guṇena saṃbadhyamānasya |
na ca sakṛduccāryamāṇaḥ jñātavat ajñātavat bhavitumarhati |
vacanaśatenāpi nahi indraśabdaḥ śakyo gārhapatyābhidhānasamarthaḥ kartum |
yo hi brūyāt 'udakena dagdhavyam, agninā kledayitavyam' iti kiṃ sa vacanaprayojanasāmarthyamanuvīta |
sāhassī. 775. vajriṇī nāma iṣṭakāḥ adhiśeṣaḥ, na tu citi- śeṣaḥ |
tena tāḥ sannudupadhātāvyāḥ na tu praticiti |
bhā. 5|3|6|15-16. vajriṇī nāma iṣṭakāḥ akaraṇe sāmmātāḥ |
tāsāmapi agnyarthatvāt akhaṇḍatvam, akṛṣṇatvam, bhasmasaṃyogaḥ, iti dharmāḥ kartavyāḥ prakaraṇāt vākyasya balavattvāt |
yadi vaktṛparamparādeśasya mūlabhūto'nubhavo nāsti tadā so'pyetādṛśaḥ, sattve tu vilakṣaṇa iti bodhyam |

'vatsaṃ ālabheta' atra sākṣādviniyuktadohāgnigrahopakārakatvā vatsya ālabhaṃsakāryatvam, tena ālabhanaṃ sākṣādviniyukto- pakārakabhāvanupayogadravyasaṃskārārthaṃ dṛṣṭārtha saṃnipatyopa- kārakaṃ kṛtvārthaṃ pravṛttirūpaṃ vaidikaṃ karma idaṃ ca paśusomādhi- karaṇe bhavadeva |
vatsena varhiṣā ca upalakṣitasya kālasya vidhānaṃ vratārthaṃ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ |
'āśrayaṇe vāsovatsayoḥ : anvāhāryasthānāpacyo- rapi abhighāraṇasya prāpaḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
mīko. pṛ. 853 'āśrayaṇe anvāhārya- sthānāpanne'pi vatse pākasya bādhaḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
mīko. pṛ. 855 'āgrayaṇe dakṣiṇarūpayorvāsovatsayoḥ prākṛtānyāhāryadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vatsāpākaraṇaṃ palāśāśākhācchedanasya prayojakam, na tu prastareṇa saha prahṛtiḥ prayojikā |
5|1|1 prastāvai, vatsāpākaraṇaṃ śākhayā 'yat palāśaśākhayā vatsān- pākaroti' 'śākhayā vatsānapākaroti' |
4|1|2, 3, vatsāpākaraṇaṃ sāṃnāyyadohasādhanam, tadaṅgaṃ ca palāśā- śākhā''haraṇam |
'darśa vatsāpākaraṇakālena vratasaṃyogaḥ asaṃtanyatve'pi' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vatsā- pākaraṇakāle vratamupeyāt darśaṃ vatsātyu- palakṣitakālasya vidhānam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
na tāvat sūtreṇaiva parigṛhītam, yathā 'aveṣṭau yajñasaṃyogāt kratupradhāna- mucyate' (2|3|12|13) iti |
nāpi ca sādhyaṃ prati- jñātaṃ yathā 'agneṣu codanāntaram' (2|3|14|15) iti |
kevalaṃ viśaye saṃśaye prāyadarśanaṃ hetuḥ iti nirdiṣṭa- dyate |
prakṛtaṃ yaji- madetat karma iti tadapi na saṃbadhyamānamiva paśyāmaḥ |
atha kā'tra pratiṣṭhā, kathaṃ saṃdeha iti vaktavyam |
atra bhagavān āha- idama- mudāhṛtya 'vatsamālabheta vatsanikāntā hi paśavaḥ' iti |
imaṃ saṃśayamupanyasyati sma, kiṃ yajimadabhidhāna eṣa āla- bhatiḥ, uta ālambhamātravacanaḥ iti |
tatra ca pūrvapakṣaṃ pratijānīte sma, yajimada- bhidhāna iti |
tathāpi purāṇāṃ ucāvacabuddhidviśeṣānālocya bhavati mandānāṃ sāmānyato dṛṣṭenāpi dṛṣṭā |
na hi manda- viṣeṇa vṛścikenāpi daṣṭo mriyeta, na jātucit kadā'pi tatra cikitsā nā''dareṇa kartavyā bhavet |
ālambhatiḥ asamāmiḥ prāṇigyukto yajimadabhidhāno dṛṣṭaḥ, ayamapi ālabhatiḥ prāṇisaṃyuktaḥ eva, tena ayamapi yajimadacana eveti bhavati kasyacidāśaṅkā |
athavā yajimadabhidhāno dṛṣṭa ālambhatiḥ prāṇisaṃyuktaḥ, tathāyamanuvādo vatsa- vidhānārthaḥ |
tathā ca phalaṃ na kalpayitavyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti |
yatra anyānyapi saṃskārakarmāṇi prāpyante tatra etadapi
yathā anya- prāye likhitaḥ, agniriti gamyate |
nanu liṅgaṃ prāya- darśanam, kathamena siddhiriti |
yathā prāya- darśanena sidhyati tathā varṇayitavyam |
kathaṃ ca prāyadarśanaṃ hetuḥ ? na yāvataḥ prāptī satyam |
kaḥ punarnyāyaḥ ? devatā- saṃbandhābhāvāt na yāgavacanaḥ |
vā- 'sūtreṇaiva hi tatsarvaṃ yadvṛttau yacca vārtike |
sūtre yonirādhānāṃ sarvaṃ sūtre prati- ṣṭhitam |
' iti ye vadanti tān prati ucyate |
na kiṃcit sādhanaṃ apradarśitaviṣayaṃ svārthaṃ sādhayati |
na ca athakaraṇādibhirapi udā- haraṇapratijñāsaṃśayahetūnāṃ anyatamamupalabhyate |
tasmāt aga- make sūtre sati avaśyaṃ dopapratisamādhānārthaṃ vṛttikārādi- bhiryatitavyam |
sarvathā śiṣṭaprajñāsaṃskārādīnāṃ pravartamānānāṃ yenaiva tadanuguṇaṃ yat kṛtaṃ tadeva grahītavyam, nāsagrahaḥ kartavyaḥ |
idaṃ sūtrakāreṇa nopāttam, idaṃ vṛttikāreṇa etaddarśanārthaṃ etad varṇanīyam |
tadiha bhaga- vān upavarṇaḥ kiṃ agnihotre venudohādhikāre śrutamidaṃ vākyaṃ udāhṛtavān 'vatsamālabheta' iti |
kiṃ prākṛta eva ālabhame tatso vidhīyate, tathā ālambhamātraṃ athavā yajatametat karmeti |
tatra viśeṣābhāvāt prākṛta- pratyayo nāsti iti pūrvādhikaraṇasiddhameva iti nopanya- stam (bhāṣye) |
tatra bhoktṛsaṃyogapra- dāharaṇāt gātro'pi pūrvapakṣaḥ śrutudvaivicchinyāt kriyate |
yo nāma tārkikavāsanā samānyatodṛṣṭena vedārthamucchiniṣet tasya tannicchatiḥ apradarśitāhyā na chākyā kartu iti pradarśayate |
tatra keṣāṃcit putrādhi- karaṇe eva ālabhateḥ yajatiparyāyatvena prasiddhaḥ, anyeṣāṃ yajatyumāpakatvena, tadubhayaṃ atrāpi tathaiva manyante |
apūrvyāgavidhānam, prāpte vā vatsavidhānaṃ iti pūrvapakṣe dvaitam |
siddhāntastu dravyadevatāsaṃbandhānupapattyā pūrvamasmābhiḥ yajiḥ kalpitaḥ nādṛṣṭapūrvaśakyālabhya- midhānena vyabhicāryanumānābhāsena vā |
na ceha asau asti iti yāvaduktatā |
bhāṣyam- arthavādaśca bhavati 'vatsānkāntā hi paśavaḥ' iti (nitarāṃ kāntaḥ priyaḥ, vatsaḥ nikāntaḥ yeṣāṃ te vatsānkāntāḥ |
) yasmāt vatsapriyāḥ paśavaḥ, tasmāt vatsa ālabdhavya iti |
yadi gāṃ prasnāpayituṃ ālabhyate tatra etadvacanamakalpate |
atha saṃjñapayituṃ tatra evaṃjātīyakaṃ vacanaṃ nopapadyate |
vā- 'vatsānkāntā hi' iti prasāvanāt ca vasopacārasparśanavidhī hetutvanigadārthavāda upapadyate |
māraṇārthatve tu ālabhyamāne vatsapriyatvaṃ paśūnāmucyamānaṃ asaṃśraddhameva syāt |
yasmādasau mātuḥ priyo vatsaḥ; tasmāt saṃjñapanārthamālabdhavya ityasaṃśraddhameva syāt |
ita- ratra punaḥ vatsapriyā mātā putre cāṭukaraṇāt tena vā kṛta- cāṭunā saṃjuyamānā snehāt prasnaviṣyati ityupapadyate |
tatra asyāpi devatāsaṃyoge prāṇidravyakālambha- tvasāmānyāt atrāpi yāgavidhiṃ manyate |
tasyottaram, ālambho nāma sparśamātraṃ na tasya yāgamantareṇa anu- papattiḥ |
prayojanaṃ pūrvapakṣe agnihotrājñā kaścit paśuyāgaḥ anujñeyaḥ |
sūtrārthastu- yāgavidhiḥ saṃskāravidhirvā iti saṃśaye yāvaduktaṃ saṃskāramātrameva vidheyam, dohanādisaṃskāra- prāyapāṭhāt iti |
vi-- 'vatsālambho yajiḥ sparśo vā, vāyavyā- divad yajiḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- yatra tu na devatāśravaṇaṃ tatra na yāgakalpanā, apitu saṃskāramātravidhānam |
yathā agnihotre 'vatsa- mālabheta' itya ālambhamātraṃ vatsasaṃskāratvena vidhī- yate |
vatsayāgaguṇasya amiśritaviṣayatākasya bhedaprayojakatvam, saṃskāravidhi- prāyapāṭhātḥ iti ca (nyāyaśarīram) |
yathā vatsavibhraddhayarthaṃ acetanaṃ kṣīraṃ pravartate, tathā acetanā'pi prakṛtiḥ puruṣamokṣaṇāya pravartate iti sāṅkhyāḥ |
vatsatvak vāsaśrayalayoḥ samuccayaḥ; na vikalpe- nāpi vāsaso bādhaḥ; āṣṭratre |
vatsatvak uparivāsasaḥ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati, vāsastu adhovāsasaḥ |
bhā. 12|3| 11-2, vatsatvak viśvajiti ekāhe paridhānārtha- māmanātā 'avabhṛthādudetya vatsatvacaṃ paridhatte' iti |
'aṣṭrāgate viśvajiti vatsatvagahatavāsasoḥ samuccayaḥ' itya adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vatsaḥ nitarāṃ kāntaḥ priyo yeṣāṃ tādṛśāḥ paśavaḥ |
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ 'barhiṣā vai paurṇamāse vratamupayanti, vatseramāvāsyāyām' iti śrutam |
tasmin vatsasaṃyoge barhiḥsaṃyoge ca śrute sati vratacodanā barhissādhanakavratavidhiḥ syāt |
aupava- sadhye'hni rātrau barhiṣaḥ vatsasya ca bhakṣaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
bādhandena prathamaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ niṣidhya dvitīyaṃ pakṣamāha |

'barhiṣā vai paurṇamāse vratamupayanti vatseramāvāsyāyām' itya yathoktasya 'amāgamamāṃ saṃ bahusarpiṃkaṃ vrataṃ vratayati' iti vacanāntareṇa prāptasya vratasya kālo vidhīyate vratasya prāptatvāt kālasya cāprāptatvāt |
utpannasya vihitasya vratasya saṃyogo'yam, na tu utpattisaṃyogaḥ |
utpanna- saṃyogāt yathoktasya vratasya kāle'yaṃ vidhīyate iti |
tathā ca barhirāhaṇa- kāle paurṇamāse vratabhakṣaṇam, vatsākaraṇakāle tu amā- vāsyāyāṃ vratabhakṣaṇaṃ ityarthaḥ |
'barhiṣā vai paurṇamāse vratamupayanti, vatseramāvāsyā- yām' iti vākye vratabhakṣaṇe barhirāhaṇakālaḥ vatsā- pākaraṇakālaśca vidhīyate iti dvitīyapakṣavādī pakṣāntare doṣamāha |
barhiṣā vratamupayanti, vatsena vratamupayanti iti vidhāne svīkṛte arthasya aparimāṇāya arthaparimāṇā- bhāvāt arthaparicchedābhāvāt niścitārthajñānābhāvaprasa- ṅgādityarthaḥ |
kiṃ vatso'tra vratayityavyaḥ, kiṃ vatsena hastasthānīyena vratayityavyam, uta vatsaṃ saṃnidhāya anyadeva kiṃcit vratayityavyaṃ iti naivaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate śāstrārthaḥ |
'barhiṣā vai paurṇamāse vratamupaiti vatseramāvāsyām' ityatra vratabandhane vatse: barhiṣa vrataṃ syāt |
anyata: prāpte vrate adṛṣṭyā vatse vidhīyate |
tasmāt barhi: vatse vratājñatayā vidhīyate iti dvitīya: pakṣa: |

'barhiṣā vai paurṇamāse vratamupaiti vatseramāvāsyā- yām' ityatra na barhiṣastatsasādhanasya vatse vidhi:, nāpi kālasya vidhi:, nāpi barhiṣo vatsasya vā vratājña- tayā vidhi:, kiṃtu barhirāhaṇasya vatsāpākaraṇasya ca kāla: nirdiśyate iti siddhānta: |
(asti hi sarveṣu vaneṣu vanaṃ vanamiti pratyabhijñā |
hyatra ca asaṃ- yukteṣu api bahuṣu sāmānyasya vṛttirivyāha -) yathā ca bhramaṇatvādibhāñjiṣvavayaveṣvapi ||
vastu manyate, ekadeśasthamṛṣṭavṛkṣopādhikṛtaiveyaṃ vanamiti buddhiḥ ato nidhramāṇakaṃ vanatvamiti, taṃ prati pakṣāntara- māha -) yatraikakāryahetutvādekagośabdavadavaddhanam||

( yathā haikamarthapratipattilakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ saṃhala kurvanto gakārā- dayo varṇāḥ saṃvātavācinā gopadena abhīyante, saṃvāta- syāvaikyavatpadaṃ padamiti, tathā vṛkṣāḥ gaṃtavya svaviṣayaka- mekaṃ jñānāśrayaṃ kāryaṃ kurvantaḥ saṃvātavācinā vanaśabda- naikavacanāntena abhīyante, ekākathaihetutvaṃ ca upa- lakṣaṇārtham, ekakāryakaraṇa ekadeśakālālāyasthānena vā samudāyāmāpannāḥ samudāyavacanena vanatvādiṣadena ekavacana- nāntena abhīyante, asti hi samudāyiṣu eko- pādhiśrīkṛtatve ekabuddhayathārūpe samudāyo nāma vyāsa- jyavartī guṇaviśeṣa iti |
yuktaṃ naitadityāha -) 'nityaṃ ye vyastavijñātā vṛkṣā neṣṭā hi te vanam |
(ye vyastavijñātā anekākṣaṇahetavaḥ; nā'pyekasmin deśe kāle vā avasthitāḥ te vanamiti nocyante |

(pūrva samudāyavacanatvamātrīya tadekāvadekavacanaṃ samarthitam, idānīṃ samudāyivacanamaṅgīkṛtya teṣāṃ bahutve'pi yadeṣāṃ samudāyotyadhikāraṇaṃ deśakālakriyādikaṃ tatkṣataṃ tadekatvādekaṃ vanamityucyate, tenā'nyatareṇa dravyaikatvaṃ lakṣa- ṇaikatvaccanopapattiḥ |
tadevaṃ vanasya satyatvāt tadddaṣṭāntena ākṛtiḥ midhyātvamityuktam |
yadi paramevamucyate, vanabuddhicat gobuddhirapi piṇḍasamudāyālamvanā bhavantu, kiṃ jātyā ? iti, tannāha -) vṛkṣaṇāṃ samudāye ca vanadhīrjāyate yathā ||
(vanabuddhihetu apṛthagbhūteṣu vṛkṣeṣu sidhyantī yuktaṃ samu- dāyālamvanā bhavati, gobuddhistu naivamiti |
atha sākṣādisamudāyālamvanā ityucyate, ata āha -) na ca sākṣādisaṃghātastadbuddhyālamvanaṃ bhavet ||
(sāsnādayo hi samuditāḥ piṇḍa- buddhimeva janayanti, gobuddhistvanekapiṇḍānivṛttaṃ sāmānya- mevālamvate iti |

tena yatravastvaṃ samudāyālamvanatvaṃ vaktavyam, ataḥ piṇḍadvidvemāvadhibhya anyatve apahan- yatām, sāmānyaṃ tvanekasamudāyānugataṃ tato vyatiricyate evetyāha -) tenā''svayavabhāve'pi sāmānyaṃ vyati- ricyate ||
(paramārthatastu avayavapadma- napi na saṃbhavatītyāha -) 'pūrvoktādeva tu nyāyā- tsidvedravyatvavayapi |
(yathaiva bhinneṣu ekabuddhi- sadbhāvāt sāmānyaṃ sidhyati tathā avayaveṣu bhinneṣu 'deva- datto'yam, ghaṭo'yam' ityekadravyābhāsāddevatve'vayavebhyo bhinno'vayavīti |
kimatyantabhinno'vayavī ? netyāha -) tasyātyantabhinnatvaṃ na syādavayavaiḥ saha ||
(tantava eva hi saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa ekadravyatvamāpannāḥ 'paṭo'yaṃ' ityekākāryā buddhyā gṛhyante, ato'vasthāmātrādevāvayavebhyo'vayavino me na tvatya- ntamedaḥ |
ye ca ekāntikaṃ bhedamabhedaṃ vā avayavinaḥ samāśrayante tairevāyaṃ anekāntavādaḥ sādhita ityāha -) kaiścidvyatiricyatvaṃ kaiścit vyatiricyatā ||
dūṣitā sādhitā vā''pi na ca tatra balāva lam |
yataśca anyatvamananyatvaṃ ca dvayaṃ sadasattayā na śakyaṃ darśayitum, ataścitravadaneka rūpatvādvā''pyupagamo mṛṣaityāha -) 'tato''nyā''nanyate tasya sto nastaśceti kīyate |
(nanu evaṃ anyānyatvavādināṃ anyatamasya anavadhāraṇāt sthāṇurvā puruṣo vetisaṃdehāt na kiṃci- t syādataḥ -) vanāntareṣu yā buddhivanamevetyupa- jāyate ||
(asti hi asmākaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ bahutvasāmānyāt samudāyālamvanaṃ ca, ataḥ sarveṣu vaneṣu vṛkṣagatabahutvo- pādhikṛtā vṛkṣasamudāyatā vā vanabuddhiryukteti |

syādapyetaṃ vṛkṣasthitabahutvābhidhāne bahvāśrayaṃ vṛkṣābhidhāne tatsamu- dāyābhidhāne ca vanamityevavacanam, yadā hi vṛkṣāḥ (hi) vahavo vanamiti pakṣaḥ tadā kiṃ anupapannameva ekavacanam, netyāha -) ekatve''pyakṛtyairdvadruhatvaṃ vyaktya- pekṣayā ||
(yathā hi jātervyastatvamānā bahutvam, evaṃ vyaktīnāmapistit jātayā''tmanā ekatvam, jātigrahaṇaṃ deśādīnāmapi upalakṣaṇārthamiti |

(vrīhiṃśca anyeṣāmapi jātiśabdānāṃ vṛkṣādīnāmupalakṣaṇārthaḥ, patnīśabde''pi aupādhiko yajñasāminyāṃ pravartamāno vyaktivacanaḥ, sa ca ākṛti- saṃkhyayā vyaktimavacchinnati, 'patnīḥ saṃjñapa' iti asminme dvayorbahutvaikavacanasyaiva prayogān ākṛtisaṃkhyā- vācinā śabdena dravyanimittaṃ yajñāsāmitvamevocyate, na hi patnītvaṃ nāma ākṛtirasti
tathāpi jātibhyādīti kṛtvā jāti dravyadvayasyaivatyā vaktītyukmiti |
ye caite trīhyādiśabdāḥ te prayogabhedena yathāruci saṃkhyāntaraṃ bhajante ityāha-) ‘tatra trīhyādi-śabdānāṃ saṃyogāyogo yathāruci |
(etadeva dṛṣṭāntena upapādayati-) ‘jajñame sthāvare cārthe yathā yūthavanādayaḥ |
(kīdṛśī punardārādiśabdānāṃ vyavasthā ? tāṃ darśayati-) tatra vyaktau ca jātau ca dārādiśabde-tryujyate ||
(dārādiśabdo hi sarvadā bahuvacanantaḥ san yadā ekavyaktyabhiprāyeṇa prayujyate tadā avayavasaṃsthayā vyakte-rbhedamādhatte, yadā tu avivakṣitavyakteibhedo dāramātraparaḥ tadā vyakteibheda iti |
' tasyai iḍāyai vaniṣṭum ' iti śravaṇāt upastaraṇaditvat iḍāsaṃskārārthatvameva |
ataśca tasya bhakṣārthatve pramāṇā- bhāvāt aprāptameva vaniṣṭusaṃskārārthaṃ amītsaṃpradānakaṃ prākṛtaṃ haraṇaṃ iti tasyāpi prākṛteḍābhakṣanivṛttiḥ |
ata eva vaniṣṭu prākṛtavadarthādidharmāpattiḥ ityapi bodhyam |
abhiprete ' vaniṣṭumsya mā rāviṣṭa urukaṃ manya- mānāḥ ' iti paṭhyate |
tatra urukaṃ urukasadṛśaṃ manyamānāḥ vaniṣṭu mā rāviṣṭa chinnaṃ kuruta iti vā arthaḥ kiṃvā urukaṃ vapāṃ manyamānāḥ vaniṣṭu mā rāviṣṭa ityarthaḥ iti vicāre siddhāntamāha |
urukaṃ uruka- śabdena vapā'bhidhānaṃ vapāyā abhidhānaṃ syāt |
mānaniṣṭavyāpārasya vidheyatvena anyakartṛkyāpārasya vacanāt ṛtvijāmapi bhavanti 'hiraṇyamālinaḥ ṛtvijaḥ |
na svatra parasmaipadāt soma-pūrvavadhayena pratyavasthānāt saṅgatiḥ |
sūtrā- anyakartṛkatvaniyamaḥ, snādhātoḥ svaritatvenābhyena tada- rthastu- saṃskārāḥ karmavat tattaddeśasamayāvyāpya vyavati- bhāvāt |
saṃskārāstu hiraṇyamālitvādayaḥ sāmānyavihitāḥ sarveṣā- vi-- 'saṃskārā vapanādyāḥ kimadhvaryoḥ svāmino- meva |
, samākhyā niyamaḥ, tasyāḥ niyāmakamātratvena prāpaka- saṃskāraryoyatāṃ prāpya svakāryaṃ kartṛmṛtivijaḥ |
' bhāṭṭa-- vapanādayaḥ : phalisaṃskārāḥ samākhyānāt śaṃkara- 'puṃsaṃskārā yājamānāḥ |
tena adhvaryuṇā kṣuraṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ jalaṃ ttalijāmapi |
ca gṛhītvā yajamānasya keśavapanādi dantadhāvanaṃ snānaṃ vapanārthānāṃ adhūnanāyānāṃ ca cayanaprakaraṇa- ca karaṇīyaṃ añjanābhyañjanavat |
asti ca tasyāpi chedanarupavapanādhāratvena vapanādayaḥ : yajamānasaṃskārāḥ pradhānopakārakāḥ 'sthālī pacati' itivat tatkartṛtvam, tadādāyaiva nājñopakārakāḥ |
vi. 3|7|2, vapanādayaḥ : saṃskārāḥ 'tasmāt keśān vapāmyaham' iti prayogaḥ |
vacanāt hiraṇyamālino ṛtvijaḥ : sarve 'nāpito vapati' ityādiprayogaḥ, sa chedanātkulakṣura- vājapeye, lohitoṣṇīṣatvaṃ syena sarveṣāṃ ṛtvijām |
tatprayojakakartṛtvādāyaiva 'nāpito 3|8|15, vapanādayaḥ : saṃskārāḥ yajamānagatamālinya- yajamānaṃ vāpayati' ityādiprayogaḥ |
3|8|3, ityātmanepadasya ādhāratvāmādāya kartṛtvopapattau kṣura- vapanādayaḥ : saṃskārāḥ yajurvede samāmnātāḥ |
grahaṇakartṛtve'pi tātparyakalpane pramāṇābhāvaḥ ! tena arthā- vapanādisaṃskārāṇāṃ lopo'sthiyasya mutādhi- śisasya tasya yajamānakartṛkatvaniyame eva pramāṇābhāve, kāripakṣaḥ |
mīko. pṛ. 760 (4) adhvaryukartṛkatvaniyamasya kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ : iti nāpitakartṛka- 'asthiyasya mutādhikāripakṣe japa- saṃskāra- iṣṭānāṃ mapi tat |
some tu 'pravapati devabhyaḥ' iti parasmai- lopaḥ |
sa ca yaja- prayacchati' iti vidhānāt tatkartṛtvameva tat |
evamanya- mānasya haste kartṛtvākāre nāsti kintu bhoktṛtvākāre adṛṣṭa trāpi ātmanepadukte draṣṭavyam |
bhyanti' ; 'śareyīkaḍāḍankti' ; 'daṇḍena dīkṣayati' vapanakhanikṛntantyoḥ : niśaṃtātanāpitakartṛkatvena ityādau parasmaipadanirdeśaḥ adhikaḥ śrutaḥ, tata satyāpi kartananākāṅkṣā |
ādhāratvamādāya ātmanepadopapattyā yajamānakartṛkatve, vapananiṣedhaḥ : āghāne- apurvakamegata- saṃnipatyo- vyāpārāntarasyāpi vidheyatvāt adhvaryukartṛkatvamiṣṭameva |
sthāne tu khaniṣṭavyāpāra eva, snāvīti parasmaipadasyāpi vapanapayotatapasāṃ amīpomīyādivikāreṣu prayogāt anyakartṛke ca snāpayatītyeva prayogāt, yaja- agamanaṃ siddhānte |
vapāśrapaṇī tantraṃ na nānājātīyeṣu paśuṣu, keṣu ahīneṣu trilādiviśiṣṭena ekekena padārthena padārthānu- yathā sautrāmaṇyām |
vapāśrapaṇī tantraṃ vājapeye caturavattī yajamānaḥ pañcāvattaiva vapā kāryā |
mīko. pṛ. 1|64, vapapā prātaḥ savane caranti abhiṣome 1935 'tantraṃ kummīśūlavapāśrapaṇīṇāṃ |
savane caranti, puroḍāśena mādhyaṃdine sabane, aṅgaistṛtīya- vapāśrapaṇī-kummīśūlānāṃ vājapeye prājāpatya- savane' iti vakṣyanti trīṇi savanāni kartavyāni paśuṣu aṅgādipraṇārtha tantram |
vaidikasomavamane somendraśvaraḥ prātaḥsavane caranti, puroḍāśena mādhyaṃdine, aṅgaistṛtīya- prāyaścittam |
vapāyāḥ śrapaṇaṃ āhavanīye vihitam, bhāṣyam-- idaṃ samāmananti 'somendraṃ caruṃ nirva- tasyāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ yo'yaṃ māṃsapākapratiṣedhaḥ vaidike'gnī |
vapānāṃ vājapeyavapānāṃ prayāja- laukikasya somapānasya vamane somendraśvaraḥ uta vaidika- śeṣeṇāmidhāraṇaṃ nāsti |
kiṃ laukikaṃ somapānam, kiṃca vaidikam ? pṛ. 2785 'prayājaśepāmidhāraṇanyāyaḥ' ityatra draṣṭavyam |
saṃkarṣa. laukikaṃ somapānaṃ yat satsatrātreṣu daśarātreṣu ca dhātusāmarthyāt 2|1|16 |
mīko. pṛ. 653 'avadānaṃ prākṛtaṃ eka- āsedhyamāne some |
kiṃ tāvat prāptam ? pānavyāpaca kapāle0' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
mīko. pṛ. 344 'agtripraṇaipagatena urūkaśabdena gena śravaṇāt laukike aśakyapratīme ityuktam, evamihāpi vapābhidhānam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
doṣasaṃyogena śravaṇaṃ bhavati 'indriyeṇa vā eṣa vīryeṇa vapotkhananasya ātmarakṣaṇaśāstravirodhaḥ |
su. vyudhyate, yaḥ somaṃ vamati' iti |
māsevitte vamane vinaṣṭaṃ dhātusāmyavyāpadā indriyeṇa vapācārādṛṣṭaṃ paśupuroḍāśasya kālaḥ |
śeṣaḥ pāṭhyaḥ : iti śabdāccodite nivṛtte nāsti doṣaḥ |
vapāvat hṛdayādyeva pañcāvattatvameva jyoti- yadyapi vamyate, tathāpi pānakriyā tatra nirvartitā, kuto ṣṭome amīpomīye paśau |
mīko. vacanārtha iti na doṣaḥ syāt |
tasmāt laukikasya pṛ. 120 'agnipomīye paśau vapāyāmiva sarveṣvaṅgeṣu somapānasya vyāpade somendraḥ syāt |
tatrāpi pūrvavadeva vapāśrapaṇī tantraṃ aikādaśineṣu paśuṣu |
mīko. pṛ. 1306 'aikādaśineṣu paśuṣu yarthaṃ kṛte vamane vyāpanne somendrayāgaḥ, uta vaidike, kummīśūlavapāśrapaṇīṇāṃ tantram' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ uta ubhayatrāpi |
athavā adhikaraṇadvayamapi siddhāntarūpeṇa adhikaraṇadvaye- 'pi atidiśyate ? kenacidviśeṣeṇa pūrvapakṣavattvā |
tatraiva tāvat vaidikena pānena dravyapratipādanasya kṛtatvāt na kadā- cit ape pe punaḥ pratisamādhānāpekṣā'sti ityarthakaṃ iṣṭi- vidhānam |
laukike tu vamanena vyāpanne rasāyanaguṇā- bhāvāt indriyeṇa vīryeṇa ca vyuddhiḥ saṃbhāvyate |
tatsaṃyoge ca śrayamāṇā iṣṭiḥ tasmādatharva vijñāyate |
doṣāt vaidikā syādarthād laukike na doṣaḥ syāt |
bhāṣyam- vaidikasya pānasya vyāpadi bhavitu- marhati, na laukikasya |
doṣasaṃ- ndho'tra śrūyate 'indriyeṇa vā eṣa vīryeṇa vyudhyate' iti |
laukike punaḥ dhātusāmyārthe kriyamāṇe na kiṃcit duṣyati |
athāpi ayamarthavādaḥ, tathāpi phalakalpanāparihārāya vaidika eva iti kalpanā nyāyyā |
vā- tairaiva vaidikatvasāmānyādibhiḥ (hetubhiḥ) vaidike bhavata iti kasmāducyate ? na hi vamane vaidika- tvaṃ saṃbhavati, acoditatvāt |
ato ya eva doṣo laukikagāmite hetuḥ sa eva hi vaidikaviṣayatve syāt, tathāhi, 'samyagjaraṇarūpāntā pratipattirvidhīyate |
tadvyāpadi pradhānasya na bhavet pūrvavat phalam |
' na ca tāvat laukikapānavyāpadi doṣo'sti, vamanārtha- meva pānāt |
athāpi bhavati, tathāpi vaidyakena tasya pratisamādhānaṃ iti na vaidikāpekṣā |
vaidike tu pāne samyagjaraṇapāṭhāt jaraṇāntā pratipattiradhāretā |
atha tu ayaṃ phalārthatvātḥ tataḥ sutarāṃ phalakalpanāmātrāt laukikāt nivṛttirgamyate |
vaidike tu vamanena pānaṃ pratyāyitam (pratyayāyitam), tena ṛtusthasya iṣṭiriti sukaraḥ saṃcaravaḥ |
'loke hi vama- nāyeva pānāt doṣo na vidyate |
tena ṛtusaṅgameveṣṭiḥ phalaṃ caivaṃ na kalpyate |
soma--sūtrārthastu-somapānasya vyāpattirapi aśva- pratigrahedyadhikaraṇapūrvapakṣavat laukikī eva nimitta- miti |
, adoṣo vamanāyaiva loke pānaṃ śrutau punaḥ |

bhāṭṭa-- anārabhyaiva 'ci vā eṣa indriyeṇa vīryeṇa- dhatte (somapīthanadhatte) yaḥ somaṃ vamiti, yaḥ somavāmī syāt tasmā etaṃ saumendraṃ dvāmākaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti śrutā iṣṭirapi vaidikasya somasya vamane bhavet, na tu laukikasya |
na ca aśva- pratigraheṣṭivat dopanidhārtātvakalpanā laukikamātra- viṣayatvāccā, vamanajanyasya ārthavādikasya indriya- vīryanāśatvāt ; tannirvātārthatvasya pratyakṣatvāt |
vaidyake vamanārthatathaiva somapānavidhānāt, tasya indriyā- dināśātkatvānupapatteśca |
ataḥ indriyavīryavyuddhipedena lakṣaṇayā ṛtuvaiguṇyasyaiva upādānāt tannirghātārthatva- meva asyā iṣṭeḥ yuktam |
jāyate ca 'mā meḍavāk nābhi ati gāḥ' ityādimantravarṇānt samyagjaraṇāntasyaiva bhakṣaṇasya śeṣapratipatyarthatvāt vamane ṛtuvaiguṇyam |
ataśca aśvadānavat vamanasya vaidhatvābhāve'pi iṣṭeḥ abhimatakratuviśeṣapājñatvaṃ aviruddham |
✱ vamaneṣṭiḥ (314|2|32-33) 'saumendraṃ caruṃ nirvapet yaḥ somaṃ vamiti' iti yacchabdena iṣṭiyamanoḥ samānakartṛkatvanirdeśāt yajamānavamane eveṣṭiḥ |

saumendraṃ karma vamanopasthāpita- karmāṅgatāṃ anubhavadeva somavāmina upakaroti, yajamānasyaiva ca tathā upakartuṃ śaknoti nirvajam, tataśca yajamā- nārthatvena saumendrasya karmaṇaḥ yajamānakartṛkatvāt tasya ca vamanasamānakartṛkatvanirdeśāt ( nirvapet yaḥ somaṃ vamiti) yajamānavamane eva saumendraṃ karma |
kāryāpaṇaṃ nāma rājataparimita- rūpakasya 'rupaiyā' iti khyātātsyeti |
⚑ varaḥ nāma - 'gaurvai varo'tivaraḥ, anyo dhenuvaro- 'tivaraḥ, anyo'naḍvān varo'tivaraḥ' ityapastambhā- cāryokto varaśabdārtho draṣṭavyaḥ |
goṣṭhī gāvo'nekā vāca- stiṣṭhantyatra 'goṣṭhī sabhā' ityamaraḥ |

dvāvimau samānaviṣayau samānārthako spaṣṭau hi aniṣṭāntarapātādi- saṃbhāvanāyāṃ abhīṣṭeṣṭatvapi vastu na varaṇīyamityevaṃ tātparyaṃ pravartate |
'ya etāṃ iṣṭakāmūpadadhyāt, sa trīn varān dadyāt' iti |
✱ varakāḥ nāma dhānyaṃ ayaśiyaṃ tatra pratinidhāta- vyam |
vā. 3|7|1|24, varaṇaṃ ādhānavat karmāpayikān tān (ṛtvijaḥ) utpādayet dṛṣṭārtha bhaviṣyati |
'ṛtutraipādibhiriṣyate' iti yeṣāṃ śāstrāyāṃ vacanam, teṣāṃ tairaiva mantrairvaraṇam |
mīko. pṛ. 1243 " ṛtutraipādi- bhirbhūyate" iti yeṣāṃ |
dvādaśāhado satre ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ na syāt |

satre sarve yajamānāḥ sarve ṛtvijaḥ iti satrakarma sarveṣāṃ svakarmaiva bhavati na parakīyam |
pūrṇamāsādo tu ṛtvijāṃ na svakarma iti tatra varaṇaṃ ānamanārtha iti yuktam |
tasmāt satre varaṇaṃ nāsti iti siddhāntaḥ |
adhvaryādayo dīkṣāvākye anucyante iti varaṇabharaṇe kartavye syātām, tatra 'varaṇamṛtvijāṃ' |

tathā sati avicchedena kartuḥ karma nirva- rtyate |
dupu. varaṇaṃ ṛtvijāṃ prakṛtau (jyotiṣṭome) ānamanārthaṃ dṛṣṭaprayojanam |
su. 3|7 pṛ. 36. varaṇaṃ ca prāk karma- pravṛtte |
vārtikamataṃ tu varaṇaṃ vaidikaṃ pratikarma pṛthak kartavyam, laukikaṃ tu varaṇaṃ tantraṃ syāt iti |
