sarvatra svodde- śyasya apūrvavyabhicāre apūrvasādhanatvalakṣaṇārtha prakaraṇa- praveśaḥ |
prakṛte tu yajñapadenainya abhya- caritāpūrvasādhanalopasthitau tadarthe prakaraṇātpraveśābhāvāt pradhānasaṃbandhasyaiva aprasaktau ca tadajñāvatāraḥ ? evaṃ
satyāpi yadi pavamāneṣṭisaṃnidhau pātrāṇi śrayeran tadā anuvādasya sati saṃbhave saṃnihitagāmitvāt 'vrīhibhi- ryajeta' ityādivat bhavet prakṛtamātraviṣayatvam, na tveta- dasti |
prayojanam— pavamāneṣṭyanantaraṃ pātrāṇāṃ nāśe darśārthe aniyatānāmutpattiḥ pūrvapakṣe, siddhānte tu vāruṇādīnāmeveti |
maṇi. pṛ. 140. vāravantīyaṃ sāma ādhane gāyati |
bhā. 3|2|10. prakṛtau jyotiṣṭome yajñāvadhīyasya abhi- ṣṭomastomastotrāśabdena agniṣṭomasāmaśabdavācyatvāt tatkāryāpattiḥ vāravantīyasya |
vāravantīyasaṃskāraḥ : yadi kacit vidhīyeta tataḥ kathaṃcit vrīhiprokṣaṇādiṣu iva prakṛtapratyayo bhavet iti pūrvādhikaraṇavārtikoktanyāyena upādīyamānatve prakṛtagrahaṇā- yogāśaṅkā |
su. pṛ. 881. 'vārāhī upānahau upamuhyate' iti śrūyate |
tatra varāhaśabdena āryaprasiddhā sūkara eva grāhyo na kṛṣṇa- śakuniḥ agnicyane |
vi. 1|2|18. kṛṣṇaḥ ekādaśineṣu ekādaśa paśuḥ aśvamedhe jyotiṣṭome ca |
bahūnāṃsthānāṃ pratigrahe aśvapratigraheṣṭyām, tatra pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣkabhedaḥ ' ityatra ityanyam |
1|4|18|13-16. mīko. pṛ. 736 'aśvaprati- graheṣṭau pratipuroḍāśaṃ kapālacatuṣkabhedaḥ ' ityatra ityanyam |

śrūyate vāruṇe loke dehāḥ svacchāṅgalakṣaṇāḥ !!' vā. 3|1|613 pṛ. 702. vāruṇepu catuṣpāleṣu bahuśvapratigrahasāreṇa bahuṣu kṛteṣu kāṇḍānusamayameva puroḍāśadharmāḥ kartavyāḥ; anyathā puroḍāśanāśaprasaṅgaḥ |
ekadeśaḥ asyāḥ āvāpasthāne (ājyabhāgasiṣṭakṛtā- rantarā) ekadeśaḥ samidhayajurvarum |
śā. 11|2|14. vāruṇā āmiṣāyāḥ iyartha iti kecit |
piṣṭamayameṣa āmiṣāsaṃskāra- śarthatayā pradhānahaviṣvābhāvāt puroḍāśādi lakṣaṇapradhāna- haviryānāṃ gupaiḥ ityanye |
vākyārthaḥ. pṛ. 20. vāruṇyāḥ niṣkāsena puroḍāśo vādhyate avabhṛthe |
3|4|10|28-29. mīko. pṛ. 730 'aśvapratigraheṣṭiḥ vaidike aśvadāne' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
astu vāruṇādhikaraṇapāpāditarītyā kutrāpi yogarūḍhavandhīkārāt samāmnāyā yaugikatvam, tathāpi nāsyāḥ svātantryena mānatvam |
paraṃtu vārtike tantraratne ca 'vacanāntarameṣāṃ sāhityapratipādakaṃ draṣṭavyam' ityuktaṃ aśvapratigrahe |
7|1|5|23. mīko. pṛ. 229 'atideśaḥ sākamedhīyaikakapāle vāruṇaprādhāsikakapāla- dharmāṇām' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vā. 2|1|13 pṛ. 475. vāruṇī paurṇamāsyāmanūyate, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' ayaṃ vyavasthāvidhiḥ ṛtvarthaḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 17. vāruṇī paurṇamāsyāmanūyate vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti kālārthaḥ saṃyogaḥ |

nyāyyaḥ: pūrvapratītatvāt kālo hi duratikramaḥ !!' vā. 3|1|13 pṛ. 480. vāruṇī paurṇamāsyām, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' ityatra mantra- liṅgaviniyogasya vākyagamyatayā, vākyasya ca liṅgāpekṣayā durbalatvena, tadbalato liṅgaṃ bādhitvā mantralakṣaṇaāśraya- syānyāyatam |
paurṇamāse vāruṇīyugalaṃ amāvāsyāyāṃ vṛdhanvatīyugalaṃ ca ājyabhāgābhyām |
bhāṣyam— darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrūyate 'vāruṇī paurṇa- māsyāmanūyate, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti |
tatra sandehaḥ: kimanuvākyātvena pradhānaṃ niveśyaḥ; uta
pradhānaṃ paurṇamāsī ca amāvāsyā ca, nā''jya- bhāgau |
mithaḥ saha hyābhyāmanuvākyābhyāṃ na pradhā- nasya kāryamasti |
yatra tu dve anuvākye, tatra tayorvyarvata vṛdhanavattvā ca vidhīyate |
tatra dvitvaṃ vātryavattvā ca vṛdhanavattvā ca vibhyeta |
tatra vātryavattvā vṛdhanavattvā (ca) kevalāṃ dāsyati vidhātum |
nanu pradhāna- gāmitve'pi dvayoḥ pradhānayordve anuvākye āgneyyā''- pomīyasya ceti |
tatra yā āgneyī sā vidhī- yamānā saṃva
vā. 1|3|13 pṛ. 181. vāsasi anvāharyākhyānāpanne abhi- ghāraṇasya bādha: |
10|3|10|38. mīko. pṛ. 855 ‘ āmrayaṇe vāsaso'nya: anvāharyāsthānā- payopari abhighāraṇasya bādha:’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
10|3|13|37. mīko. pṛ. 853 ‘ āmrayaṇe anvā- hāryasthānāpanne'pi vāsasi pākasya bādha:’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
10|6|17|7. mīko. pṛ. 1831 ‘jyotiṣṭome somasya mānamupāvaharaṇaṃ ca vāsasā kartavye’ ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
brūyāt nainaṃ surā pītā hinasti, ya evaṃ vidvān surāṃ pibati' iti (kāṭhakasaṃ. 12|34 akṣarabhedastu bhṛyāna) |
yattu mātuladuhitṛpariṇayanaṃ tayostat mātṛbhvalīyādi- sambandhavacane'pi ātrādivyavahārān aviruddham |

yadyapi vāsudevasakhā subhadrā khyātā, tathāpi utpattī brahma- devavāsudevayoḥ ekānaṃśāyāśca nijatvāmnāyāt mātṛ- bhvalīyā subhadrā tasya, mātṛpitṛbhvalīyā duhitā vā' iti pariṇayanābhyanujñānāt vijñāyate |
' yena hi anyatraivamuktam 'mama vartmānuvarte- ran manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ |
sa yat pramāṇaṃ kurute loka- stadanu vartate |
somadhāreṇa tu nirapekṣasādhanatvamapi hetustataḥ sa ca na yuktaḥ |
ekena kārye kṛte yadi dvitīyaḥ upā- dīyate, āvṛttiḥ pradhānasya bhavet |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? pradhānaṃ hi phalāya vā kriyate, phalavadupakārāya vā, nājñāya |
dvādaśe eva (1|3|15|16) darśapūrṇamāsātyayajadopanidhārtārthānāṃ pathikṛtavaiśvānarīyā- dīnāṃ vikalpa uktaḥ, tāni cādyarthāni iti hastārthatva- hetuḥ |
tatrāpyamaḥ 'pareṇāvedanātita syāt' ityadhikaraṇe (5|3|11|19-31) kāmyā- nāmekārthānāṃ karmaṇāṃ vikalpaḥ tantraratne uktaḥ, tatrāpi adhyāpakaḥ adṛṣṭārthatvahetuḥ |
ataḥ aikārthyaṃ sūtre hetu uktaḥ, tatrāpi śrutaṃ bhāṣyaṃ gṛhītvā aikārthyaṃ bodhyam, na tu aśrutamanavāntarakāryaṃ gṛhītvā, kāmyāmekaphalānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tadabhāvāt |

nirapekṣasādhanatvamapi vikalpe hetuḥ, 'samarthaḥ padavidhiḥ' iti hi smṛtyā padasaṃbandhividhimātre sāmarthyāpekṣateḥ samāso yathā padayorvidhiḥ iti kṛtvā padavidhiḥ, evaṃ padatvasaṃpādakaḥ suvibhirapi padavidhiḥ iti tṛtīyādividhivākye sāmarthya pratīyate, tacca vyapekṣā rūpam |
āgneyādīnāṃ tu phalākāṅkṣa upāyatvāt yajatitveṣṭaśabdo- pādānāt dvaṃdvavaśācca sāhāyyavivakṣayā nirapekṣasādhanatvā- bhāvāt na vikalpāpattiḥ iti |
pañcame hi 'pareṇāvedanātita syāt' ityatra 'daṇḍena dīkṣayati' 'mekhalayā dīkṣayati' iti tṛtīyāyā dīkṣādīnāṃ samuccaya uktaḥ, so'nu- papannaḥ syāt tṛtīyāyā nirapekṣasādhanatvāvagamāt |
na ca yathā mama ekasminnapi kraye nirapekṣasādhanatvena ekahāyanī- jādīnāṃ samuccayaḥ, tathā daṇdādīnāmapi iti vācyam |

ajādīnāṃ hi ekahāyanīsiddhāntya- tirekarūpadṛṣṭārthatvāt naikahāyanīmātre krayo nirākāṅkṣo bhavati iti yuktaḥ samuccayaḥ; daṇdādīnāṃ tu dīkṣābhivya- ñjakatvam, iṣṭestu tadutpādakatvam, dīkṣā cādṛṣṭarūpā, ataḥ tadutpādakena nāmibhyañjakākāṅkṣānivṛttiḥ |
tairhi 'pareṇāvedanāta' ityatra tantraratne uktam- aikārthyavat samuccayapramāṇā- bhāvo'pi vikalpahetuḥ |
sa ca āgneyādiṣu ekaśabdopādānadvaṃdvamoṃ''sti iti na samuccayapramāṇa- bhāvaḥ |
brīhyādau tu hastārthatve anyatareṇa tatasiddheḥ nāsau samuccayena gṛhṇāti iti samuccayapramāṇābhāvaḥ |
kāmyānāṃ tu ekārthānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ekaprayogavacanā- bhāvādeva samuccayapramāṇābhāvaḥ |
evaṃ dvādaśe darśapūrṇa- māsātyayajadoṣanidhārtārthānāṃ pathikṛtavaiśvānarīyādīnāṃ eka- prayogavacanābhāvādeva samuccayapramāṇābhāvaḥ |
daṇdādiṣu tu ekaprayogavacanasattvāt adṛṣṭārthatvena ca brīhyanyanyāyā- bhāvāt (12|3|14|10-16) samuccayapramāṇamevāsti, iti yuktaḥ samuccayaḥ, iti sarve sustham |
tatra prathamaṃ tāvat vikalpaḥ sarvo'pi trividhaḥ : nyāyagamyaḥ, vācanikaḥ, aicchikaśruti |
tatrādyaḥ aṣṭavidhaḥ- jātyoḥ, dravyayoḥ, guṇayoḥ, kriyayoḥ, jātidravyayoḥ, dravyatadabhāvayoḥ, guṇatadabhāvayoḥ, kriyātadabhāvayośceti |
iha ca yadyapi dravyavikalpo'pyasti, tathāpi dravyapariccheda rūpa- vyāpāravattve'karaṇatvasya jātau saṃbhavāt dravyalakṣaṇāṃ vinā jātyoreva karaṇatvopadeśe tayoreva ādyau vikalpo bhavati |
jāteḥ karaṇatvānyathā'nupapattyā dravyakaraṇatvaṃ jātivikalpatvānna upapadyate dravyavikalpaḥ prasṛto bhavan na svātantryeṇa vyapadiśyate iti |
[2] dravyayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ abhīṣomīye- kādaśadvādaśakapālayoḥ āgneyādenāmnātyorvikalpyaḥ śāstrā- ntarādhikaraṇe (2|4|18-33) uktaḥ |
yaugikānāṃ hi dravyavācitā uktā 'sarvaṃ yaugikaiḥ śabdairarthameva mīyate' (vā. pṛ. 677) iti |
[3] guṇayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- 'kṛṣṇāsāraḥ abhīṣomīyaḥ' ; 'lohitasāraḥ abhīṣomīyaḥ' iti |

[4] kriyayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- jyotiṣṭome vahiṣpavamānaṃ prasarpatāṃ anyonyacchandvāraṇe 'yadi prastotā'pacchindāt brahmaṇe varaṃ dadyāt, yadi pratihartā sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt, yajuddātā adakṣiṇo yajñaḥ parisamāpya tena punaryajeta yat pūrvasmin dāsyan syāt tad dadyāt' iti viśiṣṭa- dānādinaimittikavidhīnāṃ yugapacchede vikalpaḥ iti panne (6|5|17-20) uktam |

[5, 6] jātidravyabhāvayoḥ dravyatadabhāvayośca vikalpayoḥ kartavyayoḥ udāharaṇe yathā- vājasaneyinām 'ṛtu-nakṣatra-saṃbhāra- cātuḥprādya-jāgaraṇa- idhma-pūrvādhrdhānvārambhaṇa-sārparājñīne vā kuryāt' ityādhāne śrutam |
saṃbhāra-cātuḥ- prādyaśabdebhyaśca yaugikatvena dravyavācitvāt dravya- tadabhāvayorvikalpaḥ |
kiṃtu vidhiniṣedhatvāt nyāyata eva iti vādyanto'nuvādaḥ |
[7] guṇatadabhāvayo- vikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- dāśikavedikāne vājasaneyinā- meva vediparimāṇaviśeṣatadabhāvayoḥ, 'dhyāmamātrā paścāt syādityāhuḥ' iti 'nātra mātrā'sti' iti ca śatapathāt |
[8] kriyātadabhāvayorvikalpaḥ kartavyo yathā- 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' ; 'nāti- rātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti |
so'yaṃ nyāya- gamyo vikalpaḥ kartavyapuruṣārthabhedena dvividhaḥ |
eva sa ca aṣṭa- vidha eva jātidravyayoḥ, jātiguṇayoḥ, jātikriyayoḥ, dravyaguṇayoḥ, dravyakriyayoḥ, guṇakriyayoḥ iti dik- viṣayāḥ ṣaṭ |
tathā jātidravyaguṇānāṃ jātidravya- kriyāṇāṃ jātiguṇānāṃ dravyaguṇānāṃ ceti trika- viṣayatvāt medāḥ, tathā catuṣṭayaviṣaya ekaḥ |
puruṣā- rthasya tu ete'pi ekādaśa saṃbhavanti |
[1] tatra nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthavikalpo yathā- 'vānaspatyena brahmavarcasakāmasya praṇayet' iti vājasaneyināmuktam |
'kāṃsyena brahmavarcasakāmasya praṇayet' iti tu caturthe udāhṛtam (4|3|14 mādhye) |

yathā hi 'audumbare yūpo bhavati' ityatra atideśena 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati' ityatra 'juhvā juhoti' ityanena dravyaprāpteḥ jātimātraṃ ṛtavarthatvena vidhīyate, tathā kāṃsyavānaspatyayorapyapi 'vamasenāpaḥ praṇayet' ityanena ākāraviśiṣṭadravyaprāpteḥ jātireva phale vidhīyate |
ata eva vānaspatyakāṃsya- maye camasākāre eva pātre kartavye |
śakyate hi kāṃsyenāpi tadākṛtikaṃ pātraṃ saṃpādayitum, sāmānyavihitaṃ homārdhe vāraṇameva tena virudhyate' iti granthena |
tasmāt jātyorevātra ekasmin phale vihitayoḥ : nyāyagamyo vikalpaḥ iti |
[2] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthadravyavikalpo yathā- 'godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet' itivat yaugi- kena śabdena dravyāntarasya paśuphalārthatvena vihitasya vikalpo bhavati |

[3] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthaguṇavikalpo yathā- 'yadi kāmayīta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt' iti dṛṣṭārthyavihitanaimittikānāṃ guṇena saha dṛṣṭārthyavihitaguṇānāṃ parasparasya vikalpaḥ iti |
[5-7] nyāyagamyasya puruṣārthajāti- tadabhāvayoḥ, dravyatadabhāvayoḥ, guṇatadabhāvayorvikalpasya udāharaṇāṇi mṛgyāṇi |

[8] puruṣāthau hi jātidravyaguṇāḥ guṇaphalasaṃbandhaveveva saṃbhavanti, teṣāṃ ca vikalpasiddhayarthaṃ niṣedhāḥ yadyapi abhāgāpratiṣedheṣu (1|2|15) vārtika- kṛtā vaiyarthyātpratiṣedhāḥ, tathāpi yatra tadviṣayāḥ guṇaphala- saṃbandhavidhayaḥ sāmānyataḥ pravṛttāḥ, sāmānya eva ca tanniṣedhāḥ, 'abhicāramahīnaṃ ca kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret' iti kāmyāniṣedhavata tatra puruṣārthasyāpi jātidravyasya vikalpaḥ saṃbhavati |
tasya tu doṣārthatvāt vastuto na vaiyarthyam |
niṣedhābhāvaṃ hi kāmyasya kāmanā- mī. ko. 440

yāmati satyāṃ aicchikānanuṣṭhānasiddhāvapi kāmyānuṣṭhāne doṣo na sidhyate iti tadanuṣṭhāne doṣabodhanena arthavān niṣedhaḥ, yathā 'abhicāramahīnaṃ ca kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret' iti kāmyānāmahīnānāṃ niṣedhaḥ |
[8] nyāyagamyaḥ puruṣārthakriyātadabhāvayostu vikalpo yathā- ahīnavikalpa evoktaḥ |
udāharaṇāntaramapi yathā- piṇḍapitṛyajñe 'jīvapitṛkasya homāntaṃ jīvapitṛnārambho vā' iti piṇḍapitṛyajñe vihito niṣedhaśca |
na cātra vāca- niko vikalpo vāśabdāt iti bhramitavyam, vihitaprati- ṣiddhasya nyāyadeva vikalpo bhavati ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇayo- riva iti vāśabdyasya anuvādtvāditi |
evaṃ jātidravyādīnāṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpabhedāḥ teṣā- mapi udāharaṇāni anveṣyāṇi |
evaṃ nyāyagamyaḥ eko- naviṃśatividho vikalpo nirūpitaḥ |
evameva vācanika- syāpi vikalpasya ekonaviṃśatibhedā jñeyāḥ |
tatra tu ṛtvarthajātivikalpe vācanike udāharaṇaṃ mṛgyam |
ṛtvarthadravyavikalpasya vācaniko yathā- 'ya iṣṭyā paśunā somena vā yajeta somāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇa- māsyāṃ vā' iti |
na cātra nyāyagamyaḥ 'homāntaṃ jīva- pitṛnārambho vā' itivat vāśabdyastu anuvādaḥ iti vācyam |
tatra hi ekavākyopādānāt samuccayā- saṃbhavācca nyāyādikalpaḥ |

iha tu iṣṭipaśusomānāṃ uddeśyānāṃ bhedāt ekavākyānarthakyasaṃbhave'pi iṣṭyuddeśena kāladvayavidhaiva paśūddeśena somoddeśena ca kāladvaya- vidheḥ prayogavicchittena 'dvādaśāhrena prajākāmaṃ yājayet' ityanekarūpaphalānanyavidhivat anutpattividhitve api anekaguṇavidhinimittakavākyabhedābhāvāt ekavākyo- pādānena samuccayaprasaktau vāśabdena vācanika eva vikalpaḥ |

ata eva vāśabdepādānābhāve dṛṣṭārthayopi guṇayoḥ ekavākyopādānāt samuccaya atroktavaiśāradī- karaṇe vārtikakṛtā (pṛ. 392) 'yadi caikaṃ vākyaṃ bhavet tataḥ sarvavidhihekabhāvanāvidhānāt na vikalpaḥ syāt' iti |
paurṇamāsyamātrāsyāpādābhyāṃ parva lakṣyate, tataśca aicchiko vikalpaḥ 'paśunā yajeta' ityatra 'ayaṃ vā paśurya vā paśuḥ' itivat ityabhidhānaṃ mūrkhasya upeyam |
vāca- nikaḥ ṛtvarthaguṇavikalpo yathā- 'guggulu aguggulu muṣṭī- luṃnāti' iti |
ihāpi na nyāyāt vikalpasiddhiḥ, yujāṃ cātujāṃ ca muṣṭīnāṃ ekavākyopādānena samuccayaprasaktau vāśabdena vācanikatvādeva vikalpaḥ |
atra hi 'barhirlunāti' iti vihite'pi lavane kālādiprayoga- vidhicihnābhāve'pi ca yugayukpadalakṣitobhayaviśiṣṭa- vikalpavidhānāt vākyabhedaḥ yathā 'rathaṃtaraṃ vā' ityatra vakṣyate |

vācanikaḥ ṛtvarthakriyayoḥ vikalpo yathā- 'rathaṃtaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti vākyadvayavihitapṛṣṭhastutyoḥ vikalpamāpannaṃ rathaṃtaraṃ vā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati, bṛhadvā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati iti vāśabdalakṣitai- kavikalpavidhiḥ |

naktaṃ vivakṣitam, na dvitvam, kiṃtu pṛṣṭhamātramuddiśya vikalpavidhī vidheyavikalpasāmyādeva pṛṣṭhadravyalābhāditi ṛtvarthayostu jātitadabhāvayoḥ dravyatadabhāvayoḥ guṇatadabhā- vayoḥ kriśatadabhāvayośca ye vācanikā vikalpaḥ, tadudāha- raṇānāṃ evaṃvidho viṣayaḥ- yatra vikṛtī ātideśika- jātyādicatuṣṭayasya niṣedhā vāśabdyuktaḥ śrutāḥ, prākṛta- jātyādyeva vā vāśabdyuktaṃ śrutam, tatrāsau caturvidho'pi vikalpaḥ saṃbhavataḥ |
na ca tatra nyāyādikalpasiddhiḥ, nāthyādarthavidhabhāve hi aupadeśikena niṣedhena 'na tau dadhau karoti' itivat prākṛtasya jātyādervādha eva syāt, ato nyāyādisidhyan vācaniko vikalpa iti |
evaṃ jāti- dravyādīnāṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpāḥ teṣāmapi vācanikānāṃ udāharaṇāni anveṣyāṇi |
yathā 'payasā pāyasena vā śrāddhaṃ kurvīta' ityādīni |
puruṣārthajātyoḥ, puruṣārtha- dravyayoḥ, puruṣārthaguṇayoḥ, puruṣārthakriyayorvikalpe udāhara- ṇāni |
dattena māsaṃ prīyante vidhivat pitaro nṛṇām' iti |
puṣyārthadravyavikalpo vācaniko yathā- manuḥ- 'kusuladhānyako vā syāt
hyaihiko vā'pi bhavedathasta- nika eva vā |
[3] ṛtvarthaviṣayayorguṇayorecchiko vikalpo yathā- 'gauranubandhaḥ' ityādi nirguṇopādānā- yogāt yāṃtrikaviduguṇāpādāne prasakte 'śveto vā, raklo vā' ityaicchika eva guṇavikalpaḥ |
tathā ahīne anekayajamānake yena kenacidyajamānena śukrapātrārambhaḥ, audumbarīsamānaṃ ca kāryaṃ iti dvādaśe uktaṃ (12|1|12|13) |

[4] ṛtvarthaviṣayaḥ kriyayorecchiko vikalpo yathā- 'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhyāt' iti atraivarṇikasya ādhāne vihite sati jñānaṃ vinā tadanuṣṭhānāyogāt jñāne'pi ākṣipte pustakapāṭhādijyānāṃ jñānānāṃ aicchiko vikalpaḥ |
[5] ṛtvarthasya tu jātyādestadabhāvasya ca aicchiko vikalpaḥ nityakarmaṇi śaktāśaktaviṣayatvena vyavasthitaḥ saṃbhavati |
evaṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpabhedāḥ teṣā- mapi puruṣārthaviṣayāṇāṃ vācanikānāṃ udāharaṇāni anve- ṣyāṇi, yathā 'payasā pāyasena vā śrāddhaṃ dattena māsaṃ tṛptiḥ pitṛṇām' ityādīni |
aicchiko'pi vikalpaḥ ṛtvarthaviṣayaḥ ekonaviṃśati- vidhaḥ puruṣārthanyāyagamyatvavat tvanyat ṛtvarthavācanikavikalpa- vat puruṣārthavācanikavikalpavacca |
tatra [1] ṛtvartha- viṣayayorjātyoḥ aicchiko vikalpo yathā 'brahmaṇe brāhmaṇa- mālabheta' ityādī kauṇḍinyajātyoḥ |
iha yadyapi brāhmaṇatvādijāteraicchatvaṃ na kauṇḍinyatvādijāteḥ, tathāpi ṛtvakārakatvamātreṇa ṛtvarthatvavyavahāraḥ |
santi hi īdṛśā api asmin śāstre vyavahārāḥ; taduktaṃ vallabhā- dhikaraṇavārtike 'paśukāmaprayoge ca krameṇa camasādhvanā |

[2] ṛtvartha- viṣayayo dravyayoḥ aicchiko vikalpo yathā- 'paśunā yajeta' ityatra upādeyaviśeṣaṇasya ekatvasya vivakṣita- tvāt mantravarṇana chāgāgnaye'pi 'ayaṃ vā chāgaḥ, ayaṃ vā' ityaicchiko dravyavikalpaḥ |
evaṃ 'āgneyyā āgnīdhramupattiṣṭhate' ityatra prakṛtā āgneyī grāhyā iti tārtīyanyāyena (3|8|121-24) siddhe'pi 'iyaṃ vā
ṛtvarthaviṣayayorguṇayorecchiko vikalpo yathā- 'gauranubandhaḥ' ityādi nirguṇopādānā- yogāt yāṃtrikaviduguṇāpādāne prasakte 'śveto vā, raklo vā' ityaicchika eva guṇavikalpaḥ |
tathā ahīne anekayajamānake yena kenacidyajamānena śukrapātrārambhaḥ, audumbarīsamānaṃ ca kāryaṃ iti dvādaśe uktaṃ (12|1|12|13) |

[4] ṛtvarthaviṣayaḥ kriyayorecchiko vikalpo yathā- 'varṣāsu rathakāra ādadhyāt' iti atraivarṇikasya ādhāne vihite sati jñānaṃ vinā tadanuṣṭhānāyogāt jñāne'pi ākṣipte pustakapāṭhādijyānāṃ jñānānāṃ aicchiko vikalpaḥ |
[5] ṛtvarthasya tu jātyādestadabhāvasya ca aicchiko vikalpaḥ nityakarmaṇi śaktāśaktaviṣayatvena vyavasthitaḥ saṃbhavati |
evaṃ ekādaśa ye vikalpabhedāḥ teṣā- mapi puruṣārthaviṣayāṇāṃ vācanikānāṃ udāharaṇāni anve- ṣyāṇi, yathā 'payasā pāyasena vā śrāddhaṃ dattena māsaṃ tṛptiḥ pitṛṇāma' ityādīni |
evaṃ ekādaśa ye jātidravyaviṣayā vikalpāḥ, teṣā- mapi ṛtvarthaviṣayāṇāmānaicchikānāṃ udāharaṇāni anve- ṣyāṇi |

śrāddhe hi payaḥpāsādi bhinnavākyevihitam, tatra lokto bhojane samuccayenāpi klṛptaṃ vikalpenāpi yathāprāptaṃ ca vidhīyate iti na nityaṃ samuccayaḥ, nāpi nityaṃ vikalpaḥ iti hemādrau uktaṃ yuktaṃ ca |
tatra yadyapi tulyaphalanāṃ jātyādīnāṃ nyāyagamyo vikalpo na tu aicchikaḥ, tathāpi bhinna- phalanāṃ anyataraphalakāmanāyāṃ aicchiko vikalpo bhavati |
teṣāṃ nabhyaphalakāmanāyāṃ samuccaya'pi bhavati, ato vakṣyamāṇāni tadvipayāṇi samuccayodāharaṇā- nyeva anyataraphalakāmanāyāṃ vikalpāni jñeyāni |
puruṣārthajātidravyavādināṃ tā catvāri udāharaṇāni samucca- yena sambhavanti vikalpavidhayāṇi, tānyucyante |
[3] tathā 'godohanena paśukāmaḥ praṇayet' iti payarthavihita- godohanadravyatadabhāvayoḥ aicchiko vikalpaḥ |
[4] tathā 'yadi kāmayīta parjanyaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt' iti pṛṣṭārthavihitanīcaistvatadabhāvayoḥ aicchiko
vikalpa: [ 4 ] tathā 'citrayā yajeta paśukāma:' iti pārthevihitacitreṣṭikriyātadabhāvayo: aicchiko vikalpa: iti |

evaṃ aicchikavikalpasya ekonaviṃśati: kṛtyarthaviṣayā: ekonaviṃśatiśca puruṣārthaviṣayā: ityevaṃ aṣṭatriṃśat aicchikavikalpabhedā: , pūrvoktāśca saptaviṃśati: nyāya- gamyavikalpabhedā: , aṣṭatriṃśacca yācanakavikalpabhedā: iti sarve militvā tryadhikaṃ śataṃ ( 103 ) vikalpa- bhedā: siddhā: |
punarapi dvividho vikalpa: pūrvokto yathāsaṃbhavaṃ avyava- sthito vyavasthitaśca |

dvitīyo yathā- 'vrīhibhiriṣvā vrīhibhireva yajeta ā yavebhya: yavaireva yavaireva yajeta ā vrīhibhya:' iti śrīdhāyamyottaraṃ vrīhibhireva darśapūrṇamāsau kāryāṃ yavā- graṇāvadhi, yavāgraṇyottaraṃ ca yathaiva darśapūrṇamāsau kāryā vrīhyagrayaṇa
vikalpe'pi aṣṭau doṣā na santi, kasyāpi śāstrasya pratītaprāmāṇyatyāgābhāvāt |
'paśunā yajeta' iti hi ekameva śāstram, tatra ca ekatvaviva- kṣāvaśena kadācit kasyāścit puṃstvarūpadāne'pi sakalastacchāstrārthaḥ anuṣṭhīyate evaitat kasya tat śāstrasya prāmāṇyatyāgādi |
evameva vācanike'pi vikalpe aṣṭau doṣā na santi |

'rathaṃtaraṃ vā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' 'bṛhadvā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' ityādi hi ubhayoḥ pākṣikakartavyataiva pratīyate, na brīhivat sarvadā ubhayakartavyatā iti nānya- tarānuṣṭhāne'pi itaraśāstrāprāmāṇyaṃ kalpyamiti |
pūrvoktākṣa vikalpaḥ punaḥ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ bhāvābhāvaviṣayāḥ pañcadhā |

kecit prakṛtigatā eva, kecit vikṛtyu- padiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit aprakṛtivikṛtyātmaka- jñopadiṣṭapadārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtau upadiṣṭadiṣṭa- padārthaviṣayāḥ, kecit vikṛtau atidiṣṭamātraviṣayā iti |
tatra [1] prakṛtau upadiṣṭapadārthamātraviṣayo bhāva- vikalpo bhāvābhāvavikalpaśca yathā- māsāgnihotre prakṛtau nityāgnihotre payaādidaśadravyāṇāṃ vikalpaḥ |
'na dadhyāśrayet, adhi- śrayedityeke' iti bahuvacanān brāhmaṇam |

[2] vikṛtau upa- diṣṭayorbhāvayoḥ bhāvābhāvaviṣaya vikalpo yathā- vājapeye prājāpatyāṃ ṛtupaśubhiḥ sahālabdho brahmāsāmakatve vā ityādipadārthayoḥ kāryovikalpaḥ ; 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' 'nātirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti ṣoḍaśi- mahattadabhāvavikalpaḥ |

[3] aprakṛtivikṛtyātmakarma- padiṣṭayorbhāvayoḥ abhāvaviṣaya vikalpo yathā- āghāne patramāneṣṭīnāṃ pūrṇāhutyā saha vikalpaḥ; tatraiva vājapeyenayāṃ ṛtu-nakṣatra-saṃbhāra-cātuḥprāśya-jāgaraṇa-impūpūrvā- nvārambha-sāparāyaṇīṃ vā kuryāt' iti pūrvavadvāhatam |

[4] vikṛtau upadiṣṭayorbhāvayoḥ tādṛśayorbhāvābhāvayośca vikalpo yathā- 'iṣṭyā paśunā somena yajeta, somāvā- syāyāṃ paurṇamāsyā vā' ityatra iṣṭyadoṣapāttāyāṃ amāvāsyā- vikṛtau atidiṣṭāyā amāvāsyāyāḥ, upadiṣṭāyāḥ paurṇa- māsyāḥ vikalpaḥ; evaṃ iṣṭiśabdopāttāyāṃ paurṇamāsīvikṛtau atidiṣṭāyāḥ paurṇamāsyāḥ, upadiṣṭāyāḥ amāvāsyāyāḥ vikalpaḥ |
bhāvābhāvodāharaṇaṃ tu 'na tau paśau karoti' iti paśuyāga rūpāyāṃ vikṛtau atidiṣṭayoḥ ājyabhāgayoḥ, upadiṣṭasya ca tanniṣedhasya vikalpaḥ iti |
[5] vikṛtau atidiṣṭamātraviṣayastu bhāvayorvikalpo yathā- 'jāghanyā patnīḥ saṃyājayanti' iti |
tat patnīsaṃyājānāṃ jāghanyārthatvaṃ na bhavati, aprākṛtakāryatvāpatteḥ, kiṃtu prakṛtito vaikalpikāḥ prāptāyāḥ jāghanyāḥ niyamārtham |
tataśca paśugaṇe pratisaṃskārārthaṃ saṃskārāvṛttiḥ iti jāghanīsamuccayanyāyā- pravṛtteḥ (12|4|16-16) yā kācit jāghanī upādeyā iti vikalpaḥ |
idaṃ ca dvādaśe 'dravyavikāraṃ tu pūrvavadarthakarma syāt' ityadhikaraṇe uktaṃ (12|4|16) vikṛtau atidiṣṭasya bhāvasya anupāditena atidiṣṭanā- bhāvena vikalpe udāharaṇam |
atra na kaścidvācyaḥ prakṛtau avaikalpya eva, vikṛtau tu niṣedhopadeśe'pi padārtha- ntaravikalpatvāt arthāt svābhāvena saha vikalpaṃ bhajate, tādṛśadāhārthaṃ anye bhede |
tathyā- agnīṣomīye prayāja- śeṣāghāraṇaṃ vapāyā atraikalpikamevāsīt prājāpatya- paśurālambhe tu kāladvayaṃ vihitaṃ ṛtupaśubhalakāle brahma- sāmakāle veti |
tataśca prajāpateṣābhidhāraṇaṃ prājāpatya- vapānāṃ vaikalpikaṃ bhavati brahmasāmakālapakṣe prājāpatyapā- 'bhidhāraṇārthaṃ prayājaśeṣāpanasya caturthaṃ nirāsāt (4|14|13-35) iti |
tadayaṃ prakṛtivikṛtidubhayātmakarmaniṣṭhāḥ upadiṣṭā- tidiṣṭabhāvābhāvaviṣayā daśa vikalpabhedā nirūpitāḥ |
athedamapyucyate, ye kecit pūrva bhāvābhāvaviṣayā vikalpabhedā uktāḥ, te sarve yadvāvaviṣayāḥ |
kecittu yadvāvaviṣayāḥ, tatprati- yogikābhāvavyatiriktabhāvābhāvaviṣayā api santo bhāva- viṣayā api amāvāntaraviṣayā api vikalpāḥ saṃbha- vanti |
tathyā agnīṣomasyaiva nityā kratoraṅgam, anyā- kāmyāḥ |
tatra ṛtvarthayā abhihomasaṃsthayā puruṣārthānāṃ utkyādisaṃsthānāṃ aicchiko vikalpaḥ |
tathā puruṣārthānāmukyādisaṃsthānāṃ bhinnaphalanāmapi aicchiko vikalpaḥ anyonyam |
tathā saṃsthānāṃ svasamānaphalaiḥ jyotiṣṭomadaśāṅgaśritairjātibhāveḥ saha aikārthyāt nyāya- gamyo vikalpa iti |

atra ca kecidanye vikalpā dṛśyante, yathā upāṃ- śuyājādau vaiṣṇavādijyā'nuvākyāmantravikalpaḥ, yathā vā tathaiva devatāvikalpaḥ, yathā vā 'tantraṃ vā vaiśvadevikam' iti tantravikalpaḥ, yathā vā iṣṭipūrvatvādi kramavikalpaḥ ; yathā vā 'eko dvau vahavo vā'hīnena yajeran' ityādiḥ kartṛvikalpaḥ ; yathā vā tattvakārādi sahasrasāmaśākhāgatānāṃ gītiprakāra- bhedānāṃ vikalpaḥ ityādiḥ ; te yathāsaṃbhavaṃ jātyādi- vikalpeṣu eva antarbhavanti |
tantrakramādīnāmapi kriyādharmatvāt dharmadharmiṇoścābhedāt tadvikalpāḥ kriyā- vikalpabhede evāntarbhavanti |
tathā kacit vikalpasyāpi anyatarakoṭyā saha vikalpo bhavati, yathā asoma- yājinaḥ sāṃnāyyavikalpaḥ : 'nāsomayājī saṃnayet, tadu sameva nayet' iti vidhipratiṣedheṣucalāt |
'puroḍāśabhyāmevāsāṃyājinaṃ yājayet yāvet āgneyaścaindrāgnaśca, sāṃnāyyena tu somayājinam' iti vacanāt |
smārtodāharaṇatrayaṃ tu vijñāneśvareṇoktaṃ - 'śrutyā saha, bhartrā saha, pitrā saha' iti (1|253) sapiṇḍīkaraṇe vikalpaḥ smṛtibhedenoktaḥ |
sā mṛtā'pi hi tenaivaṃ gatā mantrāhutistataḥ ||
' uśanāḥ - 'pitṛḥ pitāmahe yadvat pūrṇa saṃvatsare sutaiḥ |
tatra aputrāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ bhartā svamātraiva sapiṇḍyaṃ kuryāt |
anvārohaṇe tu putraḥ svapitreva mātuḥ sapiṇḍyaṃ kuryāt |
brāhmadivā- hotvannaḥ pitāmahena pitāmahyā vā vikalpena kuryāt iti |
tathā mātuḥ piṇḍadānādau gotre vikalpaḥ : 'svagotrād bhraśyate nārī vivāhāta saptame pade |
' iti bhartṛgotraviparyāta, 'pitṛgotraṃ samutsṛjya na kuryāt bhartṛgotram ||
' iti janmayeva vipattau ca nārīṇāṃ paitṛkaṃ kulam ||
tatra āmurādidivāheṣu putrikākaraṇe ca pitṛgotrameva, brāhmadi- vāheṣu trīhiyavavat vṛhadrathaṃtaravat vikalpa eveti |
tathā kṣayāhaśrāddhe ekoddiṣṭaṃ pārvaṇaṃ veti vikalpaḥ |
tatra saṃnyāsinaḥ kṣayāhe sutena pārvaṇaṃ kāryaṃ 'ekoddiṣṭaṃ yatenāsti tridaṇḍagrahaṇādiha |
amāvāsyākṣaye tu pretapakṣakṣaye ca pārvaṇameva 'amāvāsyākṣaye yasya pretapakṣakṣaye tathā |
anyatra kṣayāhe asaṃnyāsinaḥ pārvaṇoddiṣṭayoḥ trīhiyavavat vikalpa eveti |
agatikā hoṣā gatiḥ yat kṛtasaṃyoge sati vikalpasamuccayau syātām |
satyāṃ hi gatau na tau āśrayaṇīyo staḥ |
bhā. 10|1|12|17. vikalpagataguṇāttaraśāsanasya arthavatvaṃ vakṣyati 'kālāntare arthavat syāt' (12|1|4|5) iti |
tatradhane yajña- mānapradhāne karmaṇi vikāraḥ yajamānapadasyaikavacane ūhaḥ 'yajamāno āyurāśāste', 'yajamānā āyurāśāste' iti yathāyathaṃ syāt |
yadi sūktavākaḥ prastarapraharaṇe tatsādhanaṃ tatphalaṃ vā prakāśayati |
praharaṇaphalaṃ ca āyurāśāsanaṃ yajamānasya iti yajamānasya prādhānyam |
tasmāt yatra aneke yajamānāḥ tatrohaḥ kartavyo bhavati vacanasya |
ke. vikāro na abhrigupraiṣatasya 'prāsmai' iti padasya abhrīgomīyasavanayoḥ samānavidhitvapakṣe |
viśvajit yāgaḥ jyotiṣṭomasya vikāraḥ, jyotiṣṭome ca dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā |
tena dvādaśaśatadhanena yajamānena jyotiṣṭomasya vikāraḥ san viśvajit kartuṃ śakyate eva |
atha dvādaśaśatāt dhanāt nyūnadhanena adhikadhanenāpi vā ubhayataḥ nyūnādhikobhayapakṣayorapi kartuṃ śakyeta |
yasya ca yāvat dhanaṃ tat sarvaṃ svam |
tacca parimāṇena dvādaśaśatāt nyūnaṃ vā syāt adhikaṃ vā syāt |
yāvat dhanaṃ tāvat sarvasmin datte sarvasvadānasya na viśeṣo'sti |
tasmāt dvādaśaśatāt nyūnadhanena adhikadhanena vā sarvasvaṃ dattvā viśvajit kartavyo bhavati iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
dvādaśaśatāt adhikadhanena nyūnadhanenāpi vā viśva- jit kartavyaḥ iti prāptaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ vāśabdena nirasya siddhāntamāha |
yasya dvādaśaśatāt adhikaṃ dhanaṃ ānama- nīyaṃ syāt tenaiva viśvajit kartavyaḥ, na tu tato nyūna- dhanena |
jyotiṣṭome tāvat sarvasvasya prati- prasava ucyate |
dvādaśaśataṃ vidhāya tata āha 'etāvatā vā ṛtvija ānamanīyā api vā sarveṇa' iti |
tatra yadi ṛtvijaḥ dvādaśadhikena śatena nānamanti, nānama- ntistato nyūna dhanena |
atra bhāṣyāt dvādaśa- śatadhanena tato'dhikadhanena vā viśvajit kartavya iti sidhyati |
sūtrakārasya tu dvādaśaśatādhikadhanenaiva viśvajit kartavyaḥ iti sidhyati iti viśeṣaḥ |
yasya dvādaśaśatādhikaṃ dhanaṃ tena viśvajit kartavyaḥ iti ukte siddhānte hetvantarasya anvācayaparaṃ sūtram |
adhike hi dīyamāne tadantargatatvāt dvādaśaśataṃ dattaṃ bhavati |
tatra sarvasvadāne adhikasya dhanasya anugraho bhavati |
pādavat yathā kāryāpaṇadāne pādadāne anugrahaḥ kriyate |
ke. vikārāstu kāmasaṃyoge sa nityasya sama- tvāt |
nityasyāśrayasya uktvādiḥ kāmyo guṇovikāraḥ iti nityatvasāmyena āśrayasya nitya- dharmānvayāvirodhāt iti vyākhyāntaram |
tatra nṛpakaraṇavipa- moktaṃ dravyā phalam, nūnamavaghātakāryaṃ vartate natvāvapana- miti |
guṇakālavikārāt na tantrabhedaḥ syāt satyapi tadikāre arthasya añjanopakārasya avi- kṛtatvāt ityarthaḥ |
yadi ca sarpapi prayojakatve kāryābhāvādananuṣṭhānaṃ tato varuṇapradhāseṣu uttaravaihārikerevāṅgīmālyaḥ kāryasiddheḥ |
satyapi deśabhede kartṛbhede ca 'vikārācca na bhedaḥ syādarthasyāviṣṭhu- tatvāt' ityanena nyāyena pṛthagjani na kriyeran |
'somavikārāṇāṃ darśapūrṇa- māsābhyāṃ prāk nānuṣṭhānam' ityadhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |

tatra pradhānājājyādhāraṇe yat upabhṛnnāma pātram, tadeva pṛṣadājyamapi dhārayet uta pṛṣadājya- dhāraṇe bhinnaṃ pātraṃ syāt iti vicāre ulkhalavat prakṛtāviha ekameva pātraṃ syāt iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte |
anuyājānāṃ vikāre prākṛnadravyāt kevalādājyāt anyadravyatve paśau pṛṣadājyadravyatve sati pṛṣadājyadhāraṇārthaṃ pātrabhedaḥ bhinnaṃ pātraṃ syāt |
arthabhedāt śuddhasya ājyasya prayājārthatvāt pṛṣadājyasya ca anuyājārthatvāt |
na hi dravyadvayaṃ bhinnaṃ ekapātre grahītuṃ śakyam |
vikārapakṣe tu jñāyate prākṛtasya pūrvataraṃ klṛptiḥ iti anyāvayye anyatarasmin karmaṇi vikrakṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ eva hānavyaṃ bhavati iti vādhaprasaṅgaḥ |
agnīṣomīyaḥ paśuḥ payovikāraḥ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vikṛtiḥ kāme vā nimitte vā utpanne āgacchanti |
sākamedhākhye tṛtīye parvaṇi prathamadine 'agme'nīka- vate prātarutpāpālaḥ, madhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyo madhyaṃdine caruḥ, marudbhyo gṛhemedhibhyaḥ |
sarvasāṃ tugge sāyamodanam' iti iṣṭyaṃ vihitam |
idaṃ grahakāla syakālaṃ veti vicāre pūrvapakṣamāha |
vikṛteḥ prakṛtidharmatvāt anīkavatyādi- vikṛtiḥ yathāśiṣṭaṃ tatkālā syāt |
prakṛtereva dharmā yasyāṃ sā prakṛtidharmā vikṛtiḥ |
tasmāt yathāśiṣṭaṃ codakena śiṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ prāptaṃ anatikramya dravyakālavamanatikramya tatkālā tasyāḥ prakṛteḥ kāla iva kālo yasyāḥ vikṛteḥ sā vikṛtiḥ tatkālā dravyakālā syāt |
tasmāt anīkavatīsāṃtapanī- yāgṛhemedhibhyāḥ dravyakālāḥ syuḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
apivā kramakālasaṃyuktā sadyaḥ kriyeta tatra vidheranumānāt prakṛtidharmalopaḥ syāt |
sākamedheṣu anīkavatīyādayaḥ dravyakālāḥ syuḥ iti pūrvapakṣyādyarthaḥ |
anīkavatī, sāṃta- panī, gṛhemedhibhyā ca iṣṭiḥ kramakālasaṃyuktā |
prātaḥ madhyaṃdine sāyaṃ iti tāsāṃ kālā uktāḥ |
tasmāt sā sā iṣṭiḥ sadya eva kriyeta |
tatra sadyaskālatve sākṣāt- vihite'pi 'sadyaḥ kāryāḥ' iti nidheḥ kramakālavidhānena anumānāt |
tasmāt prakṛteḥ darśaiṣṭeḥ yo dharmo dravyakālatvam, tasya lopaḥ syāt anīkavatyā- diṣu |
tathā ca etāḥ sadyaḥkālā na dravyakālāḥ |
iti pāṭhe tu uttarā iti viśeṣaṇa vyartha bhavet |
sāṃtapanīyāgṛhemedhīyā itya: krameṇa prāta:, madhyaṃdine, sāyaṃ |
pūrvadine prātarmadhyaṃdine sāyaṃ ceti iṣṭya: upakarṣante, |
uttarā vikṛti: syakāleva iti sūtreṇa siddhānte ukte |
viṣaya: samuccaya: 'saṃsave ume kuryāt', 'gosave ume kuryāt', 'apacito api ekāhe ume bṛhadrathaṃtare kuryāt' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 177. vikṛtau api uddeśyadevānāmeva upalakṣaṇaṃ nyāyyaṃ anubhavaṣṭakāre |
vikṛtau arthabhedekanāti- disyate, na śabdo vānaka ityetad vakṣyāma: |
ṭup. 5|1|2|139 varṇakaṃ 2. vikṛtau iṣṭānigade yajñapati- śabdasya na ūha: |
bhā. 9|1|14|40. mīko. pṛ. 3|193 'yajñapatyādhikaraṇam' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
su. pṛ. 855. vikṛtā- vupadiṣṭarṛtvedevatādibhi: prākṛtadravyadevatādīnāṃ bādha: |
10|7|15|18-60. mīko. pṛ. 1663 'kāmyāsu vikṛtiṣu upadiṣṭa:0' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vikṛtau upadiṣṭaśrutidiṣṭapadārthaviṣaya: samuccaya: yathā: ukthyādau kratupañcānāṃ samuccaya: prākṛtadhṛtadakṣiṇāsa- ccaya: |
dīkṣitādimantrāṇāṃ ākṛtamimaṃ prayuṃjaṃ mvāhā- ākṛtyai prayuje'maye svāhā iti ṣaṇṇāṃ paṇṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ samu- ccaya: |
bṛhaspatisave upa- diṣṭasya bārhaspatyagrahasya atidiṣṭagrahaṇāṃ ca samuccaya: |
mahā- vrate upagātrīṇāṃ patnīnāṃ atidiṣṭai: upagātṛ-ṛtvijāṃ ca samuccaya: |
ajñānāmyajñanīye gaugulavābhyañjanena navanīte- nāti diṣṭena samuccaya: |
paśugaṇe upayaṭ-home gudānāṃ samuccaya: pratipattitvāt iti |

bāla. pṛ. 177-178. vikṛtau upadiṣṭa- padārthaviṣaya: samuccaya: yathā- dadhopaye 'śataṃ brāhmaṇā: somān bhakṣayanti' iti brāhmaṇajāte: 'daśa daśā ekaikaṃ camasamanuprasarpanti' iti śatasaṃkhyāyāśca samuccaya: |
pṛ. 11, vikṛtau aupadeśikayo: mānayo: vādhyavādhakatvatā yathā-nyādirevavyūpayo: |
pṛ. 133, vikṛtau aupade- śikayo: bhāvābhāvayo: vādhyavādhakatvaṃ yathā- atirātre ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇe |
pṛ. 133. vikṛtau kathaṃbhāvā- kāṅkṣāyāṃ upakārasaṃpādānaṃ atidiśyate |
ci. 5|1|12, vikṛtau kacit 'bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati' iti śrūyate |
pṛṣṭhe bṛhat eva niyama: na vikalpa: iti siddhānta: |
dvipatnīke bahupatnīke ca vikṛtiprayoge 'patnī saṃnahya' iti mantra: ūhitavyo na veti vicāre vikṛtau cāpi prakṛtau iva nohitavya: |
dvipatnī- katvādāpi dvitvaṃ bahutvaṃ ekatvaṃ ca na vivakṣitam |
vikṛtau tvaniyama: syāt pṛṣadājyavat grahaṇasya guṇārthatvād ubhayośca pradiṣṭatvād guṇa- śāstraṃ yadeti syāt |
vikṛtau 'saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāma:' ityādī vikṛtihyavayo: aniyama: vikalpa: syāt |
grahaṇasya hinirdeśasya guṇārthatvāt śrīhinirdeśa: śuklatvādiguṇasaṃbandhāt na yāgasaṃbandhāt |
pṛṣadājyavat yathā 'pṛṣadājyenānuyājān yajati' ityatra ājyaṃ pṛṣatāsaṃbandhāt bhavati tasmāt vikalpa: |
ubhayośca vrīhiyavayo: noṭakena pradiṣṭatvāt prāpitatvāt vikalpa: |
guṇāstraṃ 'śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ' 'kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ' ityādi guṇaśāsanaṃ tu 'yadā iti syāt' ('yadīti syāt' iyapi pāṭha:) yadā vrīhya: tadā śuklā: iti vidhānārthaṃ syāt |
'saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahma- varcasakāma:' ityādi vikṛtau vrīhiyavayorvikalpa: |
vrīhigrahaṇaṃ tu śuklaguṇasaṃbandhāt iti pūrvapakṣe prāpte, siddhāntayati |
vrīhiyavayo: aikādhyāt havirjanana- rūpaikakāryakaratvāt ubhayo: prāptayo: śrutita: pratyakṣaśravaṇena viśiṣṭatvāt viśeṣato vihitatvāt niyamyeta vrīhidravyaṃ yavānāṃ nivṛtti: |
saumāraudrādicarau vrīhiyavayorvikalpo yavānāṃ bādha iti siddhānte sādhakāntaramāha |
vrīhyatvena ekakāryakarāṇāṃ parasparaṃ virodho bhavati, evaṃ vrīhiyavayorvirodhinvācca pratyakṣaśrutā vrīhayo yavān nivartayeyu: |
lokavat yathā 'matsthānaṃ na payasā samīyāt' iti matsyā: payo nivartayanti tadvat |

'saumāraudraṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapecchuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ brahmavarcasakāma:' ityādi vikṛtau yadi vrīhīṇāṃ yāgena saṃbandha: syāt tarhi śuklaguṇena saṃbandho na syāt iti cettatrāha siddhāntī krato: yāgasya, tadguṇatvāt tau yuktatvā ca vrīhiśca guṇo yasya sa tadguṇa: |
aśruka- hāyanīvat śuklatā vrīhiśca kratoreva guṇau |
saumāraudrādicarau vrīhīṇāṃ niyamo yavānāṃ nivṛtti: iti siddhānte hetvantaramāha |
virodhino madhye tacchruto tasya anyatarasya virodhina: pratyakṣa śravaṇe sati anyasya ca adrādavat śabdaśrutvāt kathaṃ vikalpa: syāt iti kāku: |
kiṃca vikalpa: anyāyāya: syāt ityādyā- hāra: |
tathā ca saumāraudrādicarau śuklādīnāṃ pratyakṣa- śravaṇāt yavānāṃ cāśravaṇāt vrīhīṇāṃ niyama: yavānāṃ bādha: |

saumāraudrādicarau 'śuklānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ' iti vrīhigrahaṇaṃ na yāgasaṃbandhārthaṃ kiṃtu śuklaguṇasaṃbandhārthe iti pūrvapakṣe pṛṣadājyecchanta ukta: 'vikṛtau tvaniyama:' iti sūtre (10|7|15|164) taṃ pṛṣadājyadṛṣṭāntaṃ veśyena vighaṭa- yati siddhāntī |
pṛṣadājye grahaṇasya ājyanirdeśasya guṇārthatvāt pṛṣattāguṇasaṃbandhasaṃbandhārthatvaṃ yuktam, dadhnā ājyasya samuccayāt, dadhnā pṛṣattāyā upādanīyatvāt |
tena na pārkṣikaṃ dadhi, ājyena ca samuccaya: saumāraudrādicarau tu vrīhiyavayorna samuccayasaṃbhava: |
subodhinyāṃ tu atannyāyatvāt ityakāraṃ prakṣipya nyāyasya aprasarāt iti vyākhyātam|
tasmāt saumāraudrādicarau brīhīṇāṃ niyamaḥ yavānāṃ vādhaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ|
ke. vikṛtau tu codakaprāptāḥ santaḥ (dharmāḥ) ānumānikāḥ bādhyeran (api) |
bhā. 3|3| 9|19. vikṛtau dakṣiṇāmnānaṃ codakena prāptaṃ bādhitvā niviśate, virodhāt|
ṭup. 10|1|12|18 pṛ. 1981. vikṛtau darśapūrṇamāsādiprakṛtitaḥ guṇa- kāmāḥ na pravartante|
vikṛtau dvipaśulīkāyā 'patnīṃ saṃnahya' ityatra vacanasya nohaḥ|
9|3|10-2. mīko. pṛ. 1228 'ūhaḥ na ekavacanasya-0' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
vikṛtau nirvāpamantre savitṛ-aśvi-pūṣa- śabdānāṃ na ūhaḥ|
mīmā. vikṛtau prakaraṇaṃ na pravartate (yataḥ) vikṛteḥ upakārākāṅkṣāyāṃ satyāmapi vikṛtau atidiṣṭānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ sādhyākāṅkṣāyāḥ prākṛtapramāṇasiddhena upa- kāreṇa nirvṛtteḥ|
su. pṛ. 1114. vikṛtau prakṛtigatāḥ kāryakrdadharmā eva atidiśyante|
ci. 3|8|17, vikṛtau prakṛti- gatānāṃ phala-niyama-kartṛ-pradhānayāgadharmānāṃ nātideśaḥ|
vikṛtau prākṛtasya vidhergrahaṇāt punaḥśruti- ranyārthikā syāt|
vikṛtau sākamedhagatagṛhemedhīye karmaṇi ājyabhāgau yajati iti codakaprāptāvapi punaḥśrutiḥ anarthikā|
prākṛtasya ājya- bhāgayorvidhereva anena grahaṇāt anuvādāt|
tasmāt codakena prāpto ājyabhāgayoḥ anuvādo'yaṃ ājya- bhāgau yajati iti prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ|
dvau vidhāyako śabdau yayoḥ tau dviśabdau tatro- bhāṃvaḥ dviśabdatvam|
yāvaiva ājyabhāgau codakaḥ prāpayati tāvaiva ājyabhāgau yajati iti śabdo'pi prāpayati|
yathā āgneye āvāhanaliṅge agnimma āgraha ityucyate|
atra dvau agniśabdau arthantu eka evāgniḥ|
atra yathā ekasya dviśabdatvaṃ tadvat ājyabhāgayorapi|
tasmāt ājya- bhāgau yajati ityanena codakena ca ekameva karma codyate iti|
dvitīyaṃ pakṣaṃ vāśabdena paryāvartaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pakṣaṃ sūcayati|
tasmādarthavādāthaṃ anuvādā'yaṃ ājyabhāgau yajati iti ājyabhāgau yajati yakṣyārtha iti|
tasmāt arthavādāthaṃ anuvādaḥ iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ|
adhikaṃ vā'rthavattvāt syādarthavādaguṇābhāve vacanādvikāre teṣu hi tādarthyaṃ syādapūrvatvāt|
arthavādaguṇābhāve avikāre ca sati vacanāt adhikaṃ syāt arthavattvāt ityanvayaḥ|
na ca ājyabhāgau guṇaḥ nāpi kathañcidvikāraḥ|
evaṃ arthavādaguṇayoḥ abhāve avikāre vikāratvābhāve ca sati ājyabhāgau yajati iti punaḥ-
vacanāt adhikameva ājyabhāgarūpaṃ karma codakaprāpta- prākṛtābhyāgānuṣṭhānottaraṃ kartavyaṃ syāt tatra arthavattvāt saphalatvakalpanāt|
teṣu stutiguṇāvidhāprākṛtadharmāveṣu hi satsu apūrvatvāt vacanasya apūrvārthatvāt tādarthyaṃ stutyādyarthatvaṃ syāt|
tasmāt prākṛtābhyāgābhyāṃ ājyabhāgarūpameva karmāntaraṃ idaṃ vidhīyate|
kutūhale tu- ājyabhāgakarmaṇi avikāre aprākṛte karmāntare pratyetavye|
arthavattvāt karmāntare sathaiva punaḥ śravaṇasya arthavattvāt|
te ca karmaṇī adhike pradhānayāgādupariṣṭhāt kārye pāṭhakamāt|

arthavāda- guṇābhāve vacanāt arthavādaguṇasya arthavādatvamapi- jakadharmasya vidhyekavākyatvasya abhāve asadbhāve vaca- nāt ājyabhāgayoḥ punarvacanāt vidhyekavākyatvābhāvena arthavādatvā'sambhavāt iti yāvat|
teṣu hi tādarthyaṃ, hi yataḥ teṣu 'apumantāvājyabhāgau' ityādivākyeṣu guṇa- vidhānaṃ yujyate- iti vyākhyātam|
ājyabhāgau iti taddharmakatve lakṣaṇāprasaṅgāt na karmā- ntaravacanam|
kintu parisaṃkhyayā ājyabhāgateṣāṃ ajñānāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ syāt|
nahi atra pratiṣedhāvici kiñcit padaṃ śrūyate|
atra ājyabhāgayoḥ svaśabdena grahaṇam, anyeṣāṃmajñānāṃ codakena grahaṇam|
tasmāt codakena agrahaṇāt ājyabhāgau yajatīti grahaṇam|
codako yathā apūrvadvārā itarayajñāni gṛhṇāti tathā ājyabhāgavapi|
tasmāt anyairaṅgaiḥ tulya- tvāt codakena agrahītayorājyabhāgayorgrahaṇaṃ iti vaktuṃ na yuktam|
nanu codakena ājyabhāgāveva gṛhītau tathā ca ājya- bhāgavākyena codakasya ājyabhāgayoḥ saṃkocaḥ iti matam|
tadgrahaṇe codakena ājya- bhāgayoreva grahaṇe tathā syāt agrahaṇe tulyaṃ syāt|
codako yathā ājyabhāgau gṛhṇāti tathā itarānapi aṅgāni gṛhṇīyāt codakasya ubhayatra tulyatvāt|
'ājyabhāgau yajati' iti vākyaṃ gṛhamedhīyasya apūrvatāṃ darśayet|
ke. vikṛtau prākṛtedeśagrahaṇe prāthamikāmeva grahaṇam, anyānāṃ lopaḥ|
8|1|14|23-29. mīko. pṛ. 652 'atideśo na vikṛtau prākṛtakāmya- guṇānām' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam|
vikṛtau prākṛtadharmātuvādena vidhīyamānayoḥ dharmayoḥ antarāle apūrvamapi aṅgaṃ pacyate, tadapi prakaraṇena viniyujyate yathā āmanahomeṣu|
vā. 3|1|7|4 pṛ. 855.. vikṛtau yatra prākṛtānuvādena vidhiḥ saṃdeśo vā tatraiva prakaraṇe viniyojakaṃ anyatra saṃnidhireva |
tāla. pṛ. 11. oṃ vikṛtau lumārthānāṃ prākṛtānāmajñānāṃ bādhaḥ |
bādho nāma yadevedamiti niścitaṃ vijñānaṃ kāraṇāṃtareṇa mithyeti kalpyate |
tathā abhyuccayo yadi- damiha bhavatīti viśyate'paramapi bhavatīti vijñānam |
tatrāyamarthaḥ prathamaṃ parīkṣyate kiṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ vikṛtau kartavyamuta kiṃcidvādhyate iti |
kiṃ tāvatprāptam ? vidheḥ prākṛtasya prakaraṇāntare vikṛtau yato bhavatyaviśeṣeṇātideśaḥ, ato yacca yāvat prākṛtaṃ dharmajātaṃ tatsarvaṃ vikṛtau kartavyam, yadapyarthaluptam |
kathaṃ vacanamiti gamyate ? sarvāsveva vaikṛtauṣu deśanāsu prākṛtaṃ dharma- jātamapekṣyate vākyaśeṣatvena |
tatraiva prākṛtāṃ deśanā- yāmanujñapyate, evaṃ vaikṛtyāmapi |
tatra yathā kṛṣṇalanāṃ pāko'prākṛto'pi vacanaprāmā- ṇyāt kriyate, evaṃ avahanyādi aprākṛtārthamepi sarvaṃ kartavyamiti |
kut etat ? abhi- dhānasaṃskāradravyaṃ hi prayojane sati kriyate, nāprayojanam |
anyasmai praya janāya tadāmnāyate, na svārtham |
na vaikṛtaṃ karma prākṛtairupadārthaiḥ sahaikrākyatāṃ yāti |
naivaṃ vijñāyate, yāgena phalaṃ kuryāt, katham ? prākṛtairiti |
kathaṃ tarhi ? yathā prākṛtena yāgena phalaṃ sādhitamabhūt tatheti |
kuta etat ? yāgagato hi vyāpāraviśeṣastena ape- kṣyate, na vyāpāramātram |
yāgataśca vyāpāraḥ prākṛte yāge prayogavacanena kalpitaḥ, saṃgṛhītaśca vidyate |
sa ca ākāṅkṣito nirākāṅkṣaṃ śaknoti kartumapi |
aneṣvapi apekṣyamāṇe na yāgato vikṛtau vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ kalpyaḥ syāt |
yathā daṇḍena yudhyate iti vacane na daṇḍarūpaṃ śabdenā- bhihitam |
yadi tu tena lakṣitena prayojanaṃ syāt, śakyate tena lakṣayitum |
evamihāpi aṅgatvaṃ yāgato viśeṣo nājñeyapekṣyamāṇo śabdābhihito bhavati |
atha śabdo mā bādhiteti yāgato viśeṣo naivāpekṣyeta, ajñānevāpekṣyate |
tataḥ-- kathamiti-- iti kartavyatā- viśeṣaṃ prati vaikṛtasya karmaṇaḥ śabdo'ninivṛttākāṅkṣa evātiṣṭhate |
prākṛtānāṃ cājñānāṃ prakaraṇe'rthavatā vaikṛtena karmaṇā ekavākya- bhāvo'pyupagamyate |
yathā prākṛtena yāgena phalaṃ sādhyate, tathaivenāpi |
prākṛtamajñānāṃ yasme prayojanāya prakṛtau bhavanti, nāsati tasmin prayojane vikṛtau noditāni bhavanti |
nanuktaṃ prakṛtau śāstrapadā- rthopakārā vidyante iti |
prakṛtau padārthā gṛhyante, na tu padārthāpekṣā |
ma eṣa kathaṃbhāvaḥ śrayopakārān gṛhṇāti, lakṣaṇayā padārthān |
bhāṣyam-- atha yaduktam, yathā kṛṣṇaleṣu lupta- prākṛtaprayojano'pi pāko vacanaprāmāṇyāt kriyate, eva- manyadapi kriyate |
na hi kṛṣṇaleṣu pāḥ śrutena prāpnoti |
pratyakṣaṃ hi tatra vacanam, 'ghṛte śrapayati' iti |
yadi ca tatra pratyakṣavacanaṃ nābhivyajyat, neṣāmapratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt pāko'pi nābhivya- deya |
kiṃ bhavati prayojanam ? phalarūpā vaikṛtamudāhriyate iti |
prathamaṃ tāvat idaṃ cintyate-- kiṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtaṃ vikṛtau kartavyaṃ uta lumaprākṛta- prayojanaṃ na kartavyamiti |
tadarthamidaṃ vicāryate-- kiṃ prākṛtamajñātamajñānāṃ vā svarūpeṇa anāhatya prayojanaṃ vikṛtau tadiśyate |
katham ? āgne- yasya yānjñānāni tāni kṛteti, uta padārthakāryāṇi yāni dṛṣṭadṛṣṭarūpāṇi tadvāsātpanāya yā āgneyā- digato vyāpāraḥ saḥ atidiśyate |
sāyena bhāvet, katham ? yathā āgneye tathaiti |

tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe atideśāvagatājñānānāṃ padārthānāṃ prākṛtaprayojanānā- dareṇa vikṛtāveva yathāsaṃbhavaṃ dṛṣṭadṛṣṭaprayojanakatvāt svayaṃ diteḍapi barhiṣi lavanaṃ adṛṣṭārthatayā kartavyamiti nāsti bādhaḥ |
uttaraṃ tu prākṛtasya lavanakāryasya dṛṣṭasya svayaṃ ditaṃ barhiṣi abhāvena anatideśāt lavanasvarūpasya ca anatideśāt na kartavyaṃ lavanamiti sidhyati bādhaḥ |
tatra upadeśavat atideśo'pi padārthapūrvaka eva yuktaḥ |
upadeśānurūpatāsyeti manvānaḥ, sarve kartavyaṃ na tu kiṃcit bādhitavyamityāha |
yatra vaikṛtena prākṛtasya bādhaprasaktau agrāhaḥ prati- pādyate so'bhyuccayaparyantaḥ |
yatra tu naivṛtaṃ kiṃcit kiṃtu prākṛtasyaiva lumadarātyādiśaṅkā bādhaprasaktau atrādho vyutpādyate saḥ kevalaḥ |
tatra prākṛtamātrasyaiva anuṣṭheyatvena abhyuccayā- bhāvāt, yathā khalevālīdau paryuhaṇāde |
evaṃ ca abhyu- ccayagrahaṇaṃ kevalādyavasthāyāmupalakṣaṇamiti uhani rūpaṇā |
sutrā- rthastu-- prakaraṇāntare vikṛtilakṣaṇe vidheḥ vidhīyamāna- padārthānāṃ vidhāyakāttvāt atideśāt sarvaṃ pāmanuṣṭhānaṃ syā
asti ca kuśānāṃ prakṛtisaṃbandhināṃ dvāreḥ pratyāmnānena kāryasiddhau atideśena vikṛtyuttvā- bhāvāttve|
atra vikṛtyudbhava- grāhakapramāṇābhāvasya ghaṭādāvapi sattvādātraṃ viśeṣaṇam|
nityaprayoge prasaṅgasthale cātideśasyaiva vikṛtyavagrāhaka- pramāṇasya sattvādanyam|

yadyapi na prasaṅgasthalemya eva 'kāralābhamātra tasmin prayoge prajājādipadārthasyāṅgatvam, tathāpi sarvatra prakṛtau vikṛtau vā padārthānāmanyata upa- kālābhame prajājādimistatpradhānopayogakyuta, upakāra- lābhe tu tatraiva karaṇapriyayogyatāṃ kurvādityevaṃvidhamyeva pramāṇasya kalpanācca vikṛtyavagrāhakapramāṇasattvam|

atra cānyasaṃbandhino'nyatatvagrāhakapramāṇābhāva ityuktau vikṛtisaṃbandhina upahomādeḥ prakṛtisaṃbandhinaḥ prajājā- dervā jyotiṣṭomādyatagrāhakapramāṇābhāvavattvāt prādhāpateḥ prakṛtivikṛtipadopādānam|
atra ca prakṛtiśabdo nātideśa- nirūpakaparaḥ, vikṛtiśabdo vā nātideśatatparaḥ|
tathātve gṛhamedhīyasya vastuto darśaprakṛtibhāvena tatra prajājā- dibhāve niruktalakṣaṇatvādyāmeḥ|

apitu darśādisaṃbandha- prakārakajñānaviśeṣasyaiva vikṛtitvadaḥ; prakṛtiśabdaścokta- viśeṣyatānirūpakaprakāraparaḥ, tacca jñānaṃ mauryādātideśa- vākyajanyaṃ pramāṇarūpam, gṛhamedhīye tu 'ājyabhāgau yajati' ityetadvākyābhāvātpramāṇaṃ tārkikam|
ata eva jyotiṣṭomādau doṣeṇa vikṛtitvabhrame prajājādibhāve nāti- vyāptiḥ|
astu vā gṛhamedhīyavṛttiprayājādibhāvādhyā- hananīyādibhāvavat svarūpeṇopyāyātvenābhāve'pi prasaṅga- gasyaiva daśamādhyāyānnirūpyatvam|
evaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇavitvasya yatprakṛti-saṃbandhitva- viśiṣṭasya yadvikṛtitvadasyagrāhakapramāṇaviṣayatvābhāvaḥ: tadabhāvāccittasya tatra bādhitatvamiti niṣkṛṣṭārthaḥ phalitaḥ|
yadi tu niruktavākyādhyāyāntare kvācitkaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ saṃbhāvyeta tathāpi dṛśye tasya prādhānyena nirūpaṇācca kācitkatvatiḥ|
iṣyata eva hi tantrāvāpanirū- paṇasya tṛtīye prāsaṅgikaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ sarvapṛṣṭhāyām, nāmadheya- tvādeśca dharmodāhaṇādevādyam|

ata eva bhāṣyakāgektamapi bādhakakṣaṇamatisaktamapi nātīvāsaṃgatam, tathāhi-yadviśeṣadarśane yasya śāstrasya yadviṣaye yādyaniśrayajanakatvaṃ tādyaniśrayasya tadviśeṣa- darśanenāprāmāṇyaniścaya eva tadviṣaye tasya śāstrasya bādhaḥ|
bhavati ca prāpadādirūpaviśeṣadarśane'tideśaśāstrasya kuśādanīyādiviṣaye, tattaduddeśyasaṃbandhiniścayaṃ tasya tadviśeṣadarśanenāprāmāṇyaniścaya iti tadviṣaye tasya śāstrasya bādhaḥ|
idaṃ ca yadyapi rāgaprāptānutavadanādi- bādhe'saṃbhavati, tathāpi tasya prāsaṅgikanirūpaṇīyatvādbī- kārāt na kṣatiḥ|
idaṃ hi bhāṣyasāmānyārtha adhyāyānta- rasthaśrutiliṅgādivādhāsādhāraṇamapi prādhānyenaiva nirūpaṇī- yatvāt yathā nāsaṃgataṃ tathā mamāpīti na kaściddoṣaḥ|
paraṃ tu atideśopajīvitvasya bhāṣyakāroktatvādevacchedā- gacchedenāsambhavāt tadanaṅgīkāraḥ|
anya ca bādhasyopajīvitvābhāve'pi uhasyāti- dipadārthadharmatvenātideśaprayāsānantatvāt taduttaraṃ nirūpaṇe kṛta evāsan iti uhenāpi saṃgatiḥ|
ayaṃ ca bādhastrividhaḥ arthalopāt, pratyāmnānāt, pratiṣedhācceti|
tatrānyabhinnabādhopadeśātvenāpi pratipāda- nīyam, yatprākṛtapadārthānāmupakārāntareṇa svarūpeṇaiva na vikṛtāvātideśaḥ|
yena prakṛtyadṛṣṭakāryāsaṃbhave vikṛtāvevā- dṛṣṭaṃ prayojanāntaraṃ kalpayitvā bādhabhāvaḥ śakyeta|

vikṛtestu phalānukūlayogyatājananāthamapyapekṣāsthitatvāt padārthānāṃ ca svataḥ kṣaṇikatvena yogyatājanane'yogyātvā- dupakāradvayaiva prakṛtau yogyatājananenopakārasyaiva tajjanane yogyatvavāsāyāt vikṛtibhāvanāyā ca mādyatvena prakṛti- bhāvanāpekṣeti tadvyavahitatvāccino'vāntaraupakārasyaiva saṃnihitatvāt tepāgevākāṅkṣā''sattiyogyatvaiḥ prathama- matideśo na tu padārthānām, teṣāṃ tu tattubhāvena|
tatra ca dvayī gatiḥ: tattadavāntaropakāraṇāmevāmeva- saṃbandhitvena rūpeṇa kroḍīkārāt āgneyopakārasyaivisamāna- jātīyopakāraiḥ gauryamyopakartavyaṃ ityevaṃvidhavākyakalpanāyo-
na caivaṃ vikṛtau tādṛśo- pakāratve'pi padārthānāmevopakārāntarakalpanāyā karaṇā- patteḥ|

upakārajanakāpekṣāyāmyeva padārthātideśasya kalpanena tadbhāve tasyaivākalpanāt, padārthātideśasyaiva prathamataḥ kalpane'pi vā vacanātideśa- nāmātideśayoreva nirūpitakapāṇāmeva padārthānāmati- deśāt prākṛtopakārābhāve upakārāntarakalpanānupapatteśca|
vastutastu upakārajanakāpekṣāyāmapi pṛthakapadāryāti- deśakalpane gauravāt padārthaviśeṣopakāranāmake evāti- deśāḥ|
śāstrasya tu pṛthakpṛṣṭhato vā'tideśakalpane naiva kiñcitpramāṇaṃ paśyāmaḥ|
padārthānāṃ tu tadākṣa- pādeva karaṇāmiti na teṣāṃ vikṛtyaṅgatvamityāpāstam, tathātve upakārastvasyātideśayatāyacchedakakoṭipraveśe gauravāpatteḥ|
upakārāṇāṃ prakṛtatvāpi karaṇaniṣṭayogyatāyāḥ pṛthakapadāryā- nuniṣṭatvānāmapi padārthākṣepakatatkalpane gauravāt|
codanāprabhūtatvāt codanāyāḥ ekādaśatvaviśiṣṭaprajātivadheḥ codakalope prabhutvāt samartha- syāt |
tathā ca prajādibhāgasya ekādaśatvasaṃkhyāyāśca vidhāne śabdasya samarthatvāt prākṛtītikartavyatā na prāpnoti |
pradhānaṃ tvaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ tathā bhūtamapūrva syāt tasya vidhupalakṣaṇatvāt sarvo hi pūrvavān vidhiviśeṣaṇāt pravartitaḥ |
amīṣomīye paśau 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati ekā- daśānuyājān' iti śrutam |
ekādaśatvasaṃviśiṣṭe prajādi karmāntarama vidhīyate, atra prākṛtī itikarta- vyatā na prāpnoti iti pūrvapakṣaṃ tuśabdena nivartayan siddhāntamāha |
prākṛtaṃ pradhānaṃ yathā aṅga- saṃyuktaṃ yādṛśāsaṃyuktam, tathābhūtaṃ tādṛśāsaṃyuktaṃ apūrva vikṛtisāmānyaṃ syāt |
kacit vikṛtau sauryādau 'prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti' iti tasya prākṛtāṅgasya vidhupalakṣaṇatvāt vidhānasya upalammāt sarvo hi sarva eva vidhiḥ |
pūrvavān prakṛtyuparka iti aviśeṣāt aviśeṣeṇa pravartitaḥ syāt |
tasmāt agnīṣomīye paśau api prakṛtitaḥ itikartavyatāṃ prāptāyāṃ ekādaśatvādi- guṇavidhaya eva iti siddhāntaḥ |
amīṣomīye paśau 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati ekādaśānuyājān' iti śrutam |
tatra prakṛtitaḥ prāptāyāṃ itikartavyatāyāṃ ekādaśatvādiguṇavidhiḥ iti siddhāntaṃ upohyati |
na ca anaṅge karmaṇi aṅgasya viśeṣavidhiḥ syāt |
nahi asati prasare āśvavālatvarūpo viśeṣaḥ śipyeta |
tasmāt vikṛtiṣu prakṛtitaḥ itikartavyatāṃ prāptāyāṃ viśeṣaguṇavidhayaḥ |
karmaṇaścaikaśatvāt saṃnidhāne vidherāsyāsaṃyoge guṇena tadvikāraḥ syācchabdasya vidhigāmitvāt guṇasya copadeyatvāt |
karmaṇaḥ pradhāna- karmaṇe guṇakarmaṇaśca aikaśśabdāt ekaḥ śabdo vidhāyako yasya tadekaśabdam, tasya bhāva aikaśśabdam, tasmāt |
evaṃ saṃnidhāne sati vidheḥ aṅgavidheḥ āsthayā nāmnā saṃyogo bhavati yaḥ prajājasaṃjñako yāgaḥ tatra ekādaśatvaguṇavidhiḥ iti |
evaṃ sarvatra yāge guṇena tadvikāraḥ syāt |
saṃkhyayā mantreṇa ca saṃkhyāntaraṃ mantrāntaraṃ ca vikriyeta |
guṇena vaikṛta- guṇena tadvikāraḥ prākṛtaguṇavikāraḥ syāt |
tathā ca śabdasya ekādaśādiśabdasya vidhigāmitvāt prayājādi- vidhigāmitvāt, guṇasya ca ekādaśatvādeḥ upadeśatvāt vidheyatvāt nānarthakaṃ punarvacanam |
tasmāt paśau prakṛtitaḥ itikartavyatā prāpyate, prāptāyāṃ ca guṇavidhayaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
prajājāḥ, anuyājāḥ iti nāmnaḥ akāryatvāt avi- dheyatvāt 'ekādaśa prayājān yajati' ityādinā na karmā- ntaravidhiḥ |
kintu agnīṣomīye paśau prakṛtitaḥ prāptānāṃ prayājānāṃ ekādaśatvasaṃkhyārūpaguṇa vidhiḥ, iti siddhāntaḥ |
tulyā ca prabhutā sāmarthyaṃ codakasya guṇe, guṇān prayājādīn prakṛtitaḥ prāpayitum |
ayathavā tulyā prabhutā sāmarthye ākhyāta- śabdānām |
ye hi śaknuvanti guṇavatsaṃjñinā guṇaṃ karma ca tridhātuṃ śaknuvanti tatra te kevalaṃ guṇaṃ vidhātum |
tasmāt agnīṣomīye paśau prāptānāṃ prayājānāṃ ekādaśatvasaṃkhyā- rūpaguṇasya vidhiḥ iti siddhāntasiddhiḥ |
yadi ākhyātaśabdo guṇamapi vidhāsyati, evaṃ sati sarvaṃ pradhānaṃ syāt agnīṣomīyaprayājeṣu pradhānatvaṃ syāt iti cet pūrvapakṣī brūyāt |
ākhyātaśabdavācyāt guṇasyāpi pradhānatvaṃ prasajyeta iti yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣiṇā sūtreṇa, tannirasyati siddhāntī |
tathābhūtena ākhyātaśabdabhūtatvena saṃyogatvāt, nahi pradhāna- bhūto guṇabhūto vābhavati |
ye arthāḥ yathā bhavanti pradhānabhūtā guṇabhūtā vā teṣāṃ yathārthanāmeva satāṃ vidhayaḥ syuḥ |
yat pradhānaṃ tat pradhānameva yat guṇabhūtam, tat guṇabhūtameveti |
vidhitvaṃ cāviśiṣṭamevaṃ prākṛtānāṃ vaikṛtaiḥ karmaṇā yogāt tasmāt sarvaṃ pradhānārtham |
vidhe upakaroti iti vidhiḥ tasya bhāvo vidhitvaṃ aṅgattvaṃ iti kutūhalam |
prākṛtānāṃ padārthānāṃ vaikṛtaiḥ padārthaiḥ saha vidhitvaṃ aṅgattvaṃ evaṃ aviśiṣṭaṃ tulyam |

'agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati, yajñasya pratiṣṭhe' iti prakṛtau ya evārthavādaḥ, sa evārthavādo vikṛtau bhavati 'agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati, yajñameva pratiṣṭhāpayati' iti tathā 'cakṣuṣī ete yajñasya yadājyabhāgī' iti prakṛtau, 'ājyabhāgī yajati cakṣuṣī eva nāntareti' iti vikṛtau |
tasmāt sarve etajātīyakaṃ pradhānārthe vikṛtau guṇabhūtam |
itaśca paśyāmo na sarve pradhānam, pradhānārthamapi kiñci- ditīti |
tadutpatteḥ tayoḥ prakṛtitvavikṛtyoḥ prakṛtau vikṛtau na utpatteḥ prayājānuyājānāṃ utpattiḥ kramasatvāt tulya- tvāt |
ādau prayājāḥ madhye pradhānaṃ tato'nuyājāḥ iti kramaḥ prakṛtau vikṛtau ca samāna eva |
tasmāt saṃskāraiḥ dṛṣṭadṛṣṭavighā upakāraiḥ sahitasya pradhānasya adhi- kāraḥ vikṛtiprayogavidhiḥ vidhāyakaḥ syāt |
adhikaraṇārthantu tasmāt prakṛteḥ prāsāyāmitikartavyatāyāṃ guṇavidhayaḥ paśau ekādaśaprayājānuyājāvākyāni iti |
10|1|18-63. mīko. pṛ. 1539 tadiratvasya prākṛtasya ' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
idaṃ samāmananti - 'yathāvarṇaṃ vai kāmyā iṣṭayaḥ tā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ' iti |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ aṅgapradhānārtha- mupāṃśutvam, uta pradhānārthamiti |

pūrve vikṛtauvedideśāt prāptānāṃ bahirājyadharmāṇāṃ aṅgapradhānārthatvaṃ prasaṅgāt sāpavādaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ vikṛtāvevopadiṣṭadharmāṇāṃ kiṃ aṅgapradhānārthatvamuta kevalapradhānārthatvaṃ iti prasaṅgā- nirūpyate |
na ca kāmyā iṣṭaya ityanena pradhāna- mātropādānamiti vaktavyam, sāṅgasyaiva pradhānasya kāma- sādhakatvāt |
ayamiprāyaḥ - bhavedevaṃ yadi prākṛtabarhirmevavidhi- tulyatvamasya bhavet |
tatra hi prakaraṇāt pradhānārthatve prāpte vatrīyastvadaṅgapradhānārthatvaṃ dharmāṇāmavadhāritam |
iha tu kāmyā iṣṭaya iti śravaṇādaṅgameva pradhānārthatvaṃ pratipāda- yati |
na ca sāṅgasya kāmopapattaye'ṅgānāmapi kāmyaśabda- vācyatvamiti vaktavyam |
yato'ṅgānāṃ laghu pradhānopakāra- dvāreṇa paramparā pradhānopāyatvam, pradhānasya tu sākṣādeva |
na tu sākṣātsaṃbhave paramparāśrayaṇamucitamiti pradhānedhīnā- meva mukhyakāmyaśabdavācyatvāt tāsāmeva upāṃśutvamiti siddham |
sūtraṃ tu-mukhyārthaṃ evāthamu- pāṃśutvavidhirastviti kṛte acoditatvāditi |
'yathāvarṇaṃ vai kāmyā iṣṭayastā upāṃśu kartavyāḥ' iti kāmyeṣṭiṣu āyavarṇavedoktayajñavat upāṃśuḥ svaraḥ uktaḥ |
sa śeṣaḥ śeṣabhūtaḥ upāṃśuḥ svaraḥ vikṛtau tasyāṃ tasyāṃ kāmyeṣṭau sarvārthaḥ pradhānārthaśca syāt, na
prakṛtau yathā vedi- dharmā ājyadharmāḥ sarvathā bhavanti tadvat|
'yathāvadhaṃ vai kāmyā iṣyaḥ tā upāṃśu kateyyāḥ' iti kāmyeṣṭiṣu ārṣavadhavedakayajñavata upāṃśuḥ svara uktaḥ|
sa vikṛtibhūtakāmyeṣṭiṣu pradhānārthaśca jñeya iti pūrvasūtreṇa pūrvapakṣe prāpta|
ukta upāṃśuḥ svaraḥ mukhyārthaḥ pradhānārtha eva syāt nājñārthaḥ|
aṅga- yāgāstu na kāmārthāḥ kintu pradhānārthāḥ|
tasmāt aṅgasya tena vākyena coditatvābhāvāt pradhānasyaiva ca coditatvāt upāṃśutvaṃ pradhānasyaiveti siddhāntaḥ|
tena vikrayajñānatvena prakṛtavikrayakartṛtvamiti bhavati prakṛtamebhyo'nya eva somavikrayī siddham |
sūtraṃ tu- somavikrayī punaḥ prakṛtebhyo'nya eva vikrayasya karmāṅgatvenācoditatvāditi |
jyotiṣṭome yaḥ somavikrayī somasya vikretā ṛtvikṣa eva anyatamaḥ syāt iti utsūtre pūrvapakṣe prāpte siddhānta- yati sūtram |
vikrayī yaḥ somaṃ vikrīṇāti sa tu anya eva ṛtvigbhyaḥ syāt |
yathā somasya krayo vihitaḥ na tathā vikrayo vihitaḥ |
vikrayābhāve krayo na setsyati ityataḥ vikrayo gamyate |
kutadeśo hi abhiṣekaḥ 'māhendrasya stotraṃ prati abhiṣicyate' iti |
ḍupa - abhiṣecanīyāt ūrdhvaṃ prāgu daśapeyāta 'paṣṭhīhī dīyati' ityevamādayaḥ paṭhyante |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ abhiṣekaḥ apakṛṣyamāṇaḥ itarān apakarṣati uta neti |
taya abhiṣekamātrasya apakarṣaḥ, yathā amāvāsyāyāṃ vedimātrasya |
prajāyānujñānānāṃ prakṛtau saṃbandhasya anavagatatvāt vikṛtau utkarṣāpakarṣau yujyate |
iha saṃbandhasya anavagatatvāt apūrvaḥ ayuktaḥ iti |
aśāṭhya pāṭhasya pratyakṣatvāt pūrvaiḥ padārthairasti saṃbandhaḥ |
na cāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ atra kṛtārthaḥ; yathā paurṇamāsyāṃ vedeḥ |
abhiṣecanīyai sāṅge vihite tata ete parā bhavanti |
tasya ca eteṣāṃ ca bhinnaprayogavacanaparigrahāt pāṭha eva nāsti |
bhāṭṭa -- rājasūye abhiṣecanīyasomāyāntaraṃ prāk daśapeyāt videdhanādayaḥ abhiṣekāntāḥ rājasūyadharmāḥ 'aśvaidīryati, rājanyaṃ jināti, caunaḥ śeṣamājñāpayati, abhipiccate' ityādibhiḥ vihitāḥ |
tatra abhiṣekastāvat vacanādeva 'māhendrasya stotraṃ prati abhiṣicyate' iti
tadapakarṣe'pi ca na tatpūrvapaṭhitānāmapi videdhanādīnāmapakarṣaḥ, vaidikaraṇanyāyena (5|1|166) apūrvāṇāmeṣāṃ baddhakramatvābhāvāt |
abhiṣecanīyottaramapi ca pāṭhasya sattvena pūrvavat prākṛtāṅgot- rameva karamam |

iti prāpte, pūrvaṃ prayājādiṣu baddha- kramatvāt kalmāvāpi idānīmeva pratyakṣapāṭhena ekarājya- sūyaprayogavidhiparigṛhītānāṃ videdhanābhiṣekāntānāṃ baddha- kramatvopapattau abhiṣecanīyapāṭena prākṛtāṅgānāṃ anumā- nikatvena taiḥ saha videdhanādīnāṃ bhinnaprayogavidhipari- yahītānāṃ kramakalpanānupapatteḥ abhiṣekapakarṣeṇa apakarṣa eva videdhanādīnām |
videdhanādayaḥ aṅgaṃ ayāgabhūtāḥ, yāgāstu pradhānaṃ anumatyayādayaḥ |
videdhanādayaḥ gajasthāṅgama, prakaraṇa sthānād bala- vattvāt |
videdhanādīnāṃ abhiṣeka- nīyaprayogamadhye devadananuṣṭhāne abhiṣecanīyaprayogasamā- pyanantaraṃ api kramaviparyāsaprāyaścittapūrvakaṃ tadanuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyam |
videdhanādīnāṃ rājasūye prāraṇaṃ na viniyojakaṃ rājasūyate'pyasuśomānāṃ taistaiḥ prākṛtairdharmairnirakāṅkṣatvāt |
vidyamānaṃ yat dakṣiṇakāle svīyaṃ tasyaiva deyatā viśvajiti |
vedāḥ sthānāni vidyānāṃ dharmasya ca caturdaśa |
arthaśāstraṃ caturthaṃ ca vidyā dvādaśaiva tu |
vidyādhigamaḥ : traivarṇikānāṃ niyataḥ na brāhmaṇānā- meva |
ye vede'pi mantrārthavāde śrūyante tadgraṇītānyeva vidyāsthānāni dharma- jñānāvaitvena saṃmatāni |
parimitānyeva hi caturdaśa aṣṭādaśa vā vidyāsthānāni ( purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstramiśritāḥ |
vedāśca, āyurvedaṃ dhanurvedaṃ gāndharvavedaṃ ca trayaḥ |
arthaśāstraṃ caturthaṃ ca ) dharmapramāṇatvena śiṣyaiḥ parigṛhītāni veda- upaveda - aṅga - upāṅgādyādaśasaṃhitāpurāṇatvādiśikṣā- daṇḍanītisaṃjñakāni ( upavedāḥ- āyurvedadhanurvedagāndharva- vedāḥ |
upāṅge- pūrvottaramīmāṃsā- dvayam ), na teṣāṃ madhye bauddhādigranthāḥ smṛtā gṛhītā vā |
paurṇamāsāmāvāsyāśabdo pradhānavācakī iti vidvadadhikaraṇe ( 2|1|2 ) vyavasthā- pitam |
'ya evaṃ vidvān paurṇamāsīṃ yajate', 'ya evaṃ vidvān amāvāsyāṃ yajate' iti vākya- dvayam |
mīmā. vidyātrī śrutiḥ- liṅ-loṭ-tavya-pañcamalakārāṇāṃ tu vidhisāmarthyam |
yāga- pañcakāmayoḥ saṃkrasya vidyātrī yajetetiparivarti vibhaktiṃ upalabhāāmahe liṅ |
vā. 1|2|129 pṛ. 141, na ca vidheyāntaro- pādāne sati atikrāntāvidhānaṃ avakalpate ityuktam ( 2|1|5|16 ityatra ) |
vā. 2|1|2|27 pṛ. 553, guṇopādānavaśena dhātvarthāduccārito vidhāyakaḥ; phalasya guṇaṃ vidadhat yadanyata ajñātaśeṣatvaṃ vidhatte |
na ca stāvakena (vākyena) brāhmaṇādi- saṃyuktasya vidhāyakatvaṃ nivāryate tadānuguṇyāt |
yatra hi anekavidhāyakaśravaṇaṃ tatra etasya vidhāyakatvaṃ anyasyānuvādakatvaṃ ityekavākya-
'vidhāyakavākye, kartari chandogādiviśeṣaṇa- viśiṣṭatvagrahakramābhāve sarvaviṣayatvameva tadākyasya ' iti hi nyāyaḥ |
'vidhāyiṣyate tu vede vacanena' ityanena nyāyena vidhvanumānam |
abhiprekaraṇe 'yat satsadaśavatī- mupadadhāti agneyevobhayato dadhāti, tasmādubhābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ parigṛha puruṣo'nnamati' ityatra |
tatra cānyatra ca prāpte parisaṃkhyeti kīrtyate |
sāmarthyabhedena caturvidhatvaparatvāt utsṛṣṭyādividhi- vākyabhedaḥ) tattadarthaṃ prāptapadaviśeṣasaṃbandhatvāt |
kvacit triparā yathā jyotiṣṭomavākye, utsannasyo lābhāt (somena yajeta ityataḥ) |
kvacit dviparā, yathā darśapūrṇamāsavākye, utpattiprayogayoḥ anyataḥ siddheḥ |
vi. 1|2| 5. vidhireva pradhānaṃ pravṛttikāraṇam, tasyaiva tu anu- grāhikā prāśastyāvagatiḥ |
pṛ. 6. vidhiḥ kaḥ ? yadākyamupalabhya puruṣaḥ kasmiṃścidarthe pravartate, kutaścidā nivartate, sa vidhiḥ |
yaḥ avi- ditamarthaṃ vedayati yathā- 'somena yajeta' iti |
kaṇikā. pṛ. 367. 'yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ' ityādī guṇaviśeṣakatvāt 'vidhijñānārthakaḥ kaścit' ityedumbarādyadhikaraṇasūtroktena nyāyena na guṇavidhiḥ |
vidhiḥ caturvidhaḥ- utpattividhiḥ, adhikāravidhiḥ, viniyogavidhiḥ, prayogavidhiḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 78, vidhiḥ codanā upadeśa ityeko'rthaḥ |

mṛtāmihotre mahāpitṛyajñe vā śrute 'adhastāt samidhaṃ dhārayannudbhavadevapuri hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti vākye hiṃśabdayogāt vartamānāpadeśāt vidhvantareṇa caikavākya- tvāt arthavādo'yaṃ na vidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ prāptaṃ tuśabdena pratyākhyānaḥ siddhāntāt |
sundadasya upari samidho dhāraṇe vidhirenāyaṃ nārthavādaḥ |
'adhastāt samidhaṃ dhārayannudbhava upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' ityatra satyamapi adhodharaṇe ekavākyatāpattau vidhīyate eva uparidhāraṇaṃ apūrva- tvāt |
adha- stāt ityādi mahāpitṛyajñe diṣṭagāmihotre ca śrūyate |
kalpataruḥ. vidhiḥ trividhaḥ- apūrvavidhiḥ niyamavidhiḥ parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
tatra cānyatra ca prāptau parisaṃkhyeti gīyate |
yathā 'vrīhīnavahanti' iti vrīhīṇāṃ puroḍāśadvārā yāga- sādhanatvasya tuṣavimokṣasādhanībhūtaghātāntalavadilābhya- tagaśoṣakatvāt avaghātasya pakṣaprāptatvāt |
ekasmin pradhāne niyataprāptasya aṅgadvayasya, eka- sminnaṅge niśrataprāptasya pradhānadvayasaṃbandhasya anyataranivṛtti- phalako vidhiḥ parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
atra atideśena ājyabhāgadatirājñayoḥ gṛhamedhīye, mantre ca mantra- liṅgena aśvagardabhaśanādānasaṃbandhayoḥ niyataprāptayā tadvidheḥ itaranivṛttiphalakatvāt |
na ca vidhīnāṃ ākṣepātideśaliṅgāpekṣapravṛttika- tayā aprāptatvādādiprāptatvena apūrvavidhitvaṃ iti vācyam |
na ca enamapi niyamaparisaṃkhyāvidhyoḥ itaranivṛtti- phalakatvasya ekakāreṇa vivaraṇasya ca tulyatayā bhedo na syāt iti vācyam |
aprāptāprāpteḥ vidheyatvāt taniṣṭha- tayā śīghraupasthitatvena lāghavena ca phalatvasaṃbhave liṅgo- pasthitikatayā niṣpāditāyāḥ nivṛtteḥ phalatvāt |
mantravidhau tu niyamasya phalatvāsaṃbhavāt itaranivṛttereva phalatvaṃ iti |
nanu evamapi apūrvavidhilakṣaṇaṃ 'agnihotraṃ juhuyāt svargakāmaḥ' 'athāto'gnimagnihotreṇānuyajati' iti vidhyoḥ; anyāyam |
na ca uddeśasaṃbandhitvena iti aprāpterviśeṣaṇaṃ iti vācyam |
na cāyaṃ praśno uttarayethā saha vikalpitasya ukthye atidiṣṭasya niyamaḥ añjanaparisaṃkhyā vā, gauravāt |
upāditaṃ ca aprākaraṇikasyāpi cayanasya vākyena prakṛtibhūtajyotiṣṭomāṅgatvama ukthyādyaṅgatvam, tasya cayanaśrutiguṇakāmaprāptiḥ phalaṃ iti daśame (10|8|
na ca uddeśasaṃbandhitvena vidhiviparyāsayati tadvidhā- tiphalako vidhiḥ apūrvavidhiḥ |
dvādaśāhika- gāvāmayanikasyanyakādividhivantargatayoḥ 'aindrāvāyavaṃ prathamamabharvati atha śukrāgram' iti vidhyoḥ anyāpteḥ |
rathaṃtaravṛhattvena aindrāvāyavāgrādiprāpteḥ sattvāt anaimittikatvabodhanadvārā tattadvikṛtau vāmadevapyavṛtti tanprāptiphalakatvena apūrvavidhitvāt |
na ca yatkiñcitsaṃbandhitvena yasya kasyacit aprāptasya prāptiphalako vidhiḥ apūrvavidhiḥ iti vācyam |
avaghāta- niyamasyāpi vikṛtau ājyadharmaprāptiphalakatvena ati- vyāpteḥ |
'tāvatarāmatīgramomo ājyasyaiva nau upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' ityupāṃśuyāje kālavidhau aprāpta- svargasaṃbandhaprāptiphalake apyāpteśca |

āparāmika- homavidhisaṃbandhapāṭhe 'dve āhavanīye juhoti' iti vidhau gārhapatyānyārthapyacanādhikaraṇacatuḥsaṃkhyākahe'māntara- svatantratvavyāptaprāptihotrahomābhyāsātsiddhyā teṣā- gamyamānā aprāptaphalasaṃbandhaprāptiphalakatvāt |
'vaiśvadevīṃ sāgrahaṇīṃ nirvaped grāmakāmaḥ' iti vidhau saṃnidhyāmnātānāṃ āmanahomānāṃ ārthavādika- grāmaphalasaṃbandhadhayā aprāptasiddhiphalake anyāpteḥ |
'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta' iti vidhau sarvathā apyāpteśca |
asti cedaṃ 'vrīhīnavahanti' ityu- pāthinaye niyamāvyāghātasya aniścitasvavirodhinakha- vidalapratiyuktavādhātāprāptyāṃśapūrakatvāt |
'yajjuhāṃ gṛhṇāti prayājebhyastat, yadupabhṛti prayājānyājeyastat' ityubhayaniyame, 'puroḍāśaṃ prathayati' iti niyame ca |
atra ca 'uddeśyavidhiviṣayayoḥ pākṣikatve sati' utthyau 'tamukthyena' iti vidhau 'rathaṃtare prastyamāne saṃmīlayet' ityatra ca ativyāptiḥ, tadāraṇārthe aprāptya- śapūraṇaphalaketi |
evamapi 'sarvaibhyo darśapūrṇamāsau' iti vidheḥ aprāpta- svargonmukhaśrāvaṇaphalakatvāt ativyāptiḥ, tadāraṇāya svavirodhividhātiprayuktatvaṃ aprāptiviśeṣaṇam |
autsargikau tatra cānyatra ca prāptiḥ, na tu sā'pi lakṣaṇaghaṭiketi dhyeyam |
ata eva ekasmin kārye anutasya satyena saha pākṣikaprāptāvapi 'nānṛtaṃ vadet' iti parisaṃkhyāveyam, na tu niyamavidhiḥ |
ata eva yasya śabdataḥ phalato vā pākṣikayogyāvṛttirūpo niyamaḥ dākhyaviṣayaḥ sa niyamavidhiḥ |
atra niyamasyaiva ayoga-vyāvṛttyarthakena evakāreṇa vidheyatvāt, ākṣepataḥ pūrva-pravṛttasyāvātavidherniyamaphalatvāt |
'vrīhīna-vahanti' 'uttare'han dvirātram gṛhyate' ityādī ādyaḥ, etadvidhyābhāve ākṣepata eva avahananasya ṣoḍaśigrahaṇasya ca pakṣaprāptatvāt |
'vrīhibhiryajeta' ityādī dvitīyaḥ, yavavidhyabhāvasahitadvidhyābhāve vrīhiṇā-mākṣepata eva pakṣaprāptatvāt |
etadvidhamevasye'pi ayoga-vyāvṛttyamātrasya lakṣaṇe praveśācca ko'pi doṣaḥ |
yattu dṛṣṭārthatvaṃ niyamavilakṣaṇaṃ kaiściduktaṃ tat 'uttare'han' ityādī asyātvādupetam, ṣoḍaśigrahaṇābhyāsasyā-dṛṣṭārthatvāt |
eteṣāṃ copādhīnāṃ kaścidudāharaṇe sārdhaṃ'pi na doṣaḥ iti na vidhisahāya-noktalakṣaṇadūṣaṇāvakāśaḥ |
kalpyo'pi (1) nānāsmṛtikalpyaḥ (2) ācārakalpyaḥ (3) vidhikalpyaḥ (4) arthavāda-kalpyaḥ (5) mantrakalpyaśca |
tatra phalārthavādakalpyo yathā - 'yasya parṇamayī juhū-rbhavati, na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' iti |
siddhavatkīrtanāyavādakalpyo yathā - 'vrīhi ha vai yajñasyodarāṇi gāyatrī bṛhatī anuṣṭup ca, atra hovāvapanti ata evodrapanti' iti |
indrasyedamapyupākhyānaṃ tasmādindro'tribha-diti upakramāt ityatra prāyacchaditi kriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena anupaṅgāt |
purākalpyo yathā 'tāvantrātārmīpomau ājyasyaiva no upāṃśu paurṇamāsyāṃ yajan' iti |
vidhya-ntaraśeṣārthavādakalpyo yathā - 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti |
yathā vā 'uccā di dakṣiṇavanto astyadhve adhvaḥ saha te sūryeṇa' ityadhavanaphalavidhiḥ |
te ca kecit smārtā api saṃbhavantaḥ pratyakṣabhedadarśanenaiva uttaprāyāḥ iti na pṛthagucyante |
kecit smārtā eva saṃbhavantīti tatratatra vakṣyante |
tatra dṛṣṭārthaṃ pratipattiryā - 'catvāle kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ prāsyati' iti |
apratipattirūpaṃ ubhayārthe guṇakarma yathā - paśupuroḍāśāyādi āśrayārtham |
vidhiḥ punarapi caturvidhaḥ - utpattividhiḥ, viniyo-gavidhiḥ, prayogavidhiḥ, adhikāravidhiśca |
tatra utpattyā-dividhiḥ caturvidho'pi pratyekaṃ dvividhaḥ - kratvarthaḥ
tatrāyo yathā - 'paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajeta' 'amāvāsyāyāmamāvāsyā yajeta' ityādi |
atra ca phalavākye karaṇatvena prayogacche-dena karmaṇye vidheyatvāt tasya karaṇatvākṣataṃ asyāhitya-manyonyamapi vivakṣitam |
[pṛ. 14] kratvarthaḥ adhikāravidhirapi dvividhaḥ - naimittikaḥ san, aṭopenanirdhāryate, anaimittikaḥ san, doṣanirghātārthato'pi ca |
tatrāyo yathā - 'yadi rakto yajña ātimintyā bhūḥ svāheti gārhapatye juhuyāt' ityādi |
dvitīyo yathā - 'yasyāhi-tāgnermṛgahan dahet kṣāmaveda'gnaye puroḍāśamaṣṭākapāle nirvapet' ityādi |
tatrāyo yathā - 'yo'māvāsyāṃ paurṇamārthā vātipātayeta amaye pathikṛte-'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet' ityādi |
niṣiddhācaraṇanimittako yathā - 'yadyekaṃ yūpamupaspṛśet epa te vāyo iti brūyāt' ityādi |
itaraphalasaṃvalito yathā - 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet putre jāte' ityārabhya 'yasmin jāte etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapati, pūta eva tejasvyannāda indriyāvī paśumān bhavati' ityanto jāteṣṭividhiḥ |

vidhiḥ punarapi ekādaśavidhaḥ - (1) sāmānyavidhiḥ, (2) viśeṣavidhiḥ, (3) pratiprasavavidhiḥ, (4) upasaṃhāravidhiḥ, (5) apavādavidhiḥ, (6) vyavasthāvidhiḥ, (7) paryudāsavidhiḥ, (8) abhāvavidhiḥ, (9) sādhāraṇavidhiḥ, (10) utkarṣavidhiḥ, (11) apakarṣavidhiśca |
iha ca abhyanujñāvidhividhaḥ pratiprasavavidhiro'pyasti, yathā - 'paṇyāṃ karmaṇāmasya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā |
yadyapi ca upasaṃhāravidhiḥ viśeṣa-vidhibheda eva, pratiprasavavidhirapi ca sāmānyavidhi-viśeṣavidhibhedau saṃbhavataḥ, tathāpi bhedaṃ vinā'pi sāmānya-saṃbhavāt govalīvardanyāyena pṛthagdṛṣṭaḥ |
puruṣārtho viśeṣavidhividharyā - 'yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeteti, sa caturhotāraṃ juhuyāt' iti |
vīraputra-kāmanāyāṃ hi caturhotrahomena bādhāt putrasāmānyātkāma-syaiva putreṣṭiḥ |
puruṣārthaḥ sa yathā - grahaṇe sūtake'pi śrāddhavidhiḥ smārtaḥ |

pratiprasavavidhiḥ punaḥ pañcavidhaḥ - luptārthapratiprasavaḥ, bhūtāniṣiddhapratiprasavaḥ, paryudastapratiprasavaḥ, niyama- vidhinā phalato vyāvartyaṃta yat tadviṣayaḥ pratiprasavaḥ, pari- saṃkhyayā vyāvartitaṃ yat tadviṣayaśceti |
dvitīyo yathā udāhṛtaḥ smārtaḥ, grahaṇe sūtake'pi śrāddhavidhiḥ |
'smārtakarmaparityāgo rāhoranyatra sūtake' iti rāhoranya nimitte yat smārtakarma śrāddhādi tasya mṛtake parityāgaḥ, na rāhunimittaka-smārtasya ityarthaḥ |
śaunako'pi 'na hiṃsyāt sarvā bhūtāni' iti niṣiddhasya pratiprasavaḥ 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabheta' 'vāyavyaṃ śveta- mālabheta' iti |
paryudastapratiprasavo yathā- bhaṭṭasomeśvaramate 'na prathamayajñe prayujyāt' ityasya paryudāmatvāt pratiprasavaḥ 'agniṣṭome prayukti' iti |
niyamavidhi vyāvartitapratiprasavo yathā- 'dvaitarevā- rtivatvaṃ kartavyam' iti varaṇaniyamena avṛtavyāvṛttau satyāṃ 'amṛtaḥ māmidhenīranvāha' iti honuraktasyāpi prati- prasavaḥ |
parisaṃkhyāvyāvartitapratiprasavo yathā- daśame paśo- rekahaviṣṭvamityatra uttare'dhikaraṇe 'hṛdayasyāgre'vadyati' ityādi parisaṃkhyā iti yathāsūtraṃ bhāṣyakṛto matam |
'ekādaśā vai paśoravadānāni' iti parisaṃkhyā iti someśvaraḥ |
ṛtvarthaḥ abhyanujñāvidhiryathā- 'yadi somavikrayī prativindeta pūrvatena vastrākāṇḍena avakṣaṇena vā nāśā- yeyuḥ, lakuṭairdhnanti ityeke, nityavadeke vadhaṃ pramāṇayanti' iti āpastambasūtre |
abhyanujñāvidhiḥ punardvividhaḥ - kuto'pi adhyāvṛttaṃ yat tadviṣayaḥ, kuto'pi vyāvṛttaṃ yat tadviṣayaśca |
tatrādyo yathā- 'ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇāmasya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā |
dvitīyaḥ pañcavidhaḥ - niṣiddhaviṣayaḥ, paryudastaviṣayaḥ, niyamāvyāvartitaviṣayaḥ, parisaṃkhyāvyāvartitaviṣayaḥ, upa- saṃhāravyāvartitaviṣayaśceti |
ādyo yathā- manūktaḥ 'na dīkṣitasyānna- maśnīyāt' iti niṣiddhe 'jīvitavyamayāpabho''nnamatti yastastataḥ |
ākāśa iva paṅkena na sa pāpena lipyate |
ubhayośca [pṛ. 17] prayojanaṃ alpadoṣatvaṃ nirdoṣatvaṃ cetyuktaṃ vārtike 'sāmānyābhyanujñānādviśeṣaśca viśiṣyate |
tatrādyo yathā- 'na dīkṣita- syānnamaśnīyāt' ityasya paryudastatvapakṣe 'agnīṣomīye saṃsthite yajamānasya gṛhe adhītavyam' iti |
dvitīyo yathā aitareyabrāhmaṇe 'aśitavyaṃ vapāyāṃ hutāyām' iti |
niyamavidhi vyāvartityābhyanujñā yathā- viprāderdhryājano- pāthiniyamavyāvartita kṣatriyādivṛttiḥ |
āpadi abhyanu- jñāyate 'ajīvaṃstu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā |
parisaṃkhyāvyāvartityābhya- nujñāvidhiryathā- pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' ityanena vyāvartitānāṃ mārjāradīnāṃ abhyanujñāvidhiḥ 'prāṇālaye' ityādiḥ |

upasaṃhāravyāvartitaviṣayaḥ abhyanujñāvidhiryathā- 'bhavatputro brāhmaṇo bhikṣeta' iti sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃhāriṇa 'brāhmaṇo cared bhaikṣam' ityanena vyāvartitasya kṣatriyāde- rabhyanujñāvidhiḥ 'cāturvarṇye caredbhaikṣam' iti |
puruṣārthaḥ sa yathā- 'brahmahā dvādaśābdāni' iti sāmānyaṃ pūrvayorvarṇayoḥ 'vedādhyāyinaṃ hatvā' iti viśeṣe upasaṃhiyate |
upasaṃhāraḥ punarapi dvividhaḥ - upasaṃhārasya upasaṃhāra- viṣaye niyamataḥ prāptau, aniyamataḥ prāptau veti |
vyavasthāvidhiḥ kratvartho yathā- 'vātraighnī paurṇamāsyā- manūyate, vṛdhanvatī amāvāsyāyām' iti |
vyavasthāvidhiḥ punaḥ trividhaḥ - ubhayaprāptau, anubhaya- prāptau, anyataraprāptau veti |
yathā vā 'yadagneye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' 'sūryāya ca prajāpataye ca prātaḥ' iti |
tṛtīyo yathā - vāsiṣṭhānāṃ nārāśaṃso dvitīyaḥ prajājaḥ tanūnapādanyeyām' iti |
atra hi vidhipāṭhakramāt tanūnapādeya dvitīyaḥ prātaḥ, na nārāśaṃsaḥ |
tathā 'yadi rathaṃtarasāma somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān mahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrā- grān' iti |
atrāpi hi pāṭhata aindravāyavāgrataiva prāptā, na śukrāgratā iti |
vyavasthāyāḥ dvividhatvāt punarapi dvividho vyavasthāvidhiḥ - nyāyagamyā vyavasthā vācanikī ca |

vācanikī tu vyavasthā sattathā, tena saptavidhasta- trividhiḥ - deśato vyavasthā, kālato vyavasthā, kartṛto vyavasthā, saṃkhyāyata vyavasthā, karmato vyavasthā, phalato vyavasthā, nimittato vyavasthā iti |
(1) deśato vyavasthā yathā- 'varuṇapraghāseṣu uttare vihāre adhvaryurhaviṣpādyādati, mārutīmeva pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇasmin' iti |
(2) kālato vyavasthā yathā- 'vasante brāhmaṇo'gnimādadhīta' 'grīṣme rājanyaḥ' 'varṣāmu rathakāra ādadhīta' iti |
(3) kartṛto vyavasthā yathā- 'payovrataṃ brāhmaṇasya, yavāgū rājanyasya, āmikṣā vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā - 'cārha- dviguṃrājñāmanyaḥ' [pṛ. 19] brahmasāma kuryāt, pāthuradhamaṃ rājanyasya, gayovājīyaṃ vaiśyasya' iti |
tathā - 'yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī iti dvayoryajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt, ete asugramindvaḥ iti bahubhyo yajamānebhyaḥ' iti |
(5) karmato vyavasthā yathā- 'rathaṃtare prasūnamāne saṃmīlayet, bṛhati samudaṃ manasā dhyāyet' iti |
smārtaudāharaṇaṃ tu 'iṣṭiśrāddhe kṛtajñaḥ, satyo nāndīmukhe vasuḥ |
'pinye svadita- mityevaṃ vācyaṃ goṣṭhe tu suśrutam |
(6) phalato vyavasthā yathā- 'mṛnmayena pratiṣṭhākāmasya prayayet, kāmyena brahmavarcasakāmasya' iti |
smārtaudāharaṇaṃ tu, brahmayajñe eva phalaviśeṣārthe ṛgyajuḥsāmyādhyayana- vidhiḥ |
(7) nimittato vyavasthā yathā- 'yadi rathaṃtarasāmā somaḥ syāt aindravāyavāgrān mahān gṛhṇīyāt, yadi bṛhatsāmā śukrāgrān' iti |
tathā anyatarakoṭivyavasthā yā koṭyantarasya ārthikī vyavasthā bhavati sā'pi bhāvaviṣayā abhāvaviṣayā ceti dvividhā |

tatrādya yathā- 'āgneyo vai brāhmaṇo devatā, sa somenendrāgnīṣomīyo bhavati, yadevādeḥ paurṇamāsaṃ haviḥ tat tarhi anunirvepat, tarhi sa ubhayadevato bhavati' iti agnīṣomīyapuroḍāśe kṛtasomayāgapuṃvipa- yatvena vyavasthāpite arthāt tadabhāvaḥ akṛtasomayāga-
‘pūrvedyuramāvāsyāyāṃ vediṃ karoti’ iti amāvāsyāyāṃ pūrvedyuḥ vedikaraṇe vyapa- sthāpite arthāt havirbhāsasonattaraṃ vedikaraṇaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vyavasthitaṃ bhavati |
paryudāsavidhiḥ ṛtvartho yathā- ‘yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti, nānūyājeṣu’ iti |
vidheyaviśeṣaṇatvāccathā- ‘nāparyeyaṃ brūṇīte, na hotāṃ brūṇīte’ iti |
tathāhi, prakṛtau vikṛtau prakṛtivikṛtyā- tmake aprakṛtivikṛtyātmake ca karmaṇi samānavidhānaḥ paryudāsavidhiḥ: ‘nānūyājeṣu yeyajāmahaṃ’ iti |
atra hi ātideśikadvārā pratīkṣaṇāt ‘saptadaśo vai prajāpati- ryajñe'nye'nyataḥ’ ityatra kārtikadṛktasya dviruktatānnyāyā- pavādasya sāmyāt |

prakṛtigata-pratipatticariktasaṃnipātidṛṣṭārthaparyudāsaḥ, prakṛtigata- pratipārparyudāsaḥ; vikṛtigatopadiṣṭasya pūrvavat trividhasya saṃnipātinaḥ paryudāsāḥ trayaḥ, vikṛtigatārādupa- kāraparyudāsaḥ pūrvavat trividhasya saṃnipātinaḥ paryudāsāḥ trayaḥ: iti dvādaśa |
abhāve ṛtvartho vidhiryathā svitkṛdarthāvacanāt ājyavidhiḥ ‘yā vai kāṃcit devatāmantarāyāt tasyā ādyucyate ājyanaitā devatāḥ parisaṃkhyāya yajeta’ iti |
puruṣārthaḥ abhāve vidhiyathā- ‘satrāyāgaṃ viśvajitā yajeta’ iti |
tatra ādyo yathā- ‘yadā- tidhyāyāṃ vahiḥ tadupasadāṃ tadabhīpomīyasya’ iti |
yathā vā bahiṣo vardhidhamānāṃ ca vedyā vedidharmāṇāṃ ca vidhiḥ aṅgapradhānasādhāraṇaḥ |
[pṛ. 26] dvitīyo yathā- upadeśena abhīpomīye, atideśena ca savanīyā'nuktravyayoḥ aṅga- bhūtasya yupasya anuṣṭhānasādhāraṇyathā: ‘dīkṣāsu yūpaṃ chinatti’ iti apakarṣavidhiḥ iti |
utkarṣavidhiḥ yathā-- ‘āgnimārutāddhvaṃmanuyāje- śaranti’ ‘sa eṣa aupavasathye'han dvevalayaḥ paśūnā- labhyate’ ityagrīpomīyasya krayasaṃnidhau utkarṣaḥ utkarṣa- vidhiḥ |
punarapi sāmānyādividheyakādaśakaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ dvivi- dham- dṛṣṭārthamadṛṣṭārthaṃ ca |
tatra adṛṣṭārthau sāmānyaviśeṣa- vidhī yathā udāhṛtāveva āhavanīyapadavidhi |
abhyanujñāvidhistu sarvo'pi dṛṣṭārtha eva, na tu adṛṣṭārtho'pi iti |
yadyapi vārtanīdhradhanvayoḥ ājyabhāgadevatābhūtāmaprakāśānātha- tvāt dṛṣṭārthaiva tathāpi tulyārthayordvayoḥ vyavasthāvidhiḥ adṛṣṭārtha eva |
dṛṣṭārthau vyavasthāvidhirathā āpastambā- śilādhyādyasyavidhiḥ tatsaṃsthāparyupagotrajñānarūpadṛṣṭārthaḥ ityuktaṃ smṛtyādhikaraṇanyāyamudāhṛtam |
paryudāsavidhisu prāgukto dvividho'pi puruṣārthaḥ adṛ- ṣṭārtha eva |
dṛṣṭārthastu paryudāsaḥ ‘yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti nānūyājeṣu’ iti atra yadyapi anūyājeṣvati- riktaṣu ityeṣo na dṛṣṭārthaḥ tathāpi vidheyayeyajāmahaṃhā
abhāvavidhistu pūrvodāhṛtayormadhye ṛtvartho yaḥ saḥ dṛṣṭārthaḥ: puruṣārthastu adṛṣṭārthaḥ |
sāmānyādividheyakādaśakaṃ punarapi jāti-dravya-guṇa- kriyā-viṣayatvena yathāsaṃbhavaṃ caturdhā |
jātidyādipa- yatvamapi uddeśye, vidheyārthe, ubhayāṃśe ceti jātyādi- viṣayamapi trivyekādaśakaṃ pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ iti dvāviṃśa- duttaraṃ śataṃ bhedā bhavanti |

[pṛ. 22] vidhiḥ punarapi aṣṭavidhaḥ- (1) dhātvarthamātravidhiḥ (2) saguṇādhātvarthavidhiḥ (3) kiñciduddidya dhātvarthavidhiḥ (4) tatraiva viśiṣṭadhātvarthavidhiḥ (5) dhātvarthoddeśena anyavidhiḥ (6) dhātvarthe anyayoḥ saṃbandhavidhiḥ (8) dhātvarthāṃnuraktena pratyayena anyayoḥ saṃbandhavidhiḥ (8) muktvā dhātvarthe anyayoreva saṃbandhavidhiḥ |
vidhiḥ punarapi trividhaḥ- apūrvavidhiḥ, niyamavidhiḥ, parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ |
trividho'pyasau caturvidhaḥ- jāti- vidhiḥ, dravyavidhiḥ, guṇavidhiḥ kriyāvidhiśceti |
tatra jāterapūrvavidhiyathā- ‘khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya yūpaṃ kuryāt’ iti |
dravyasyāpūrvavidhiyathā- ‘godohena paśukāmasya praṇayet’ iti godohanadravyasya yaugikatvena dravyatvāt |
guṇasyāpūrvavidhiyathā- ‘yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syāt nīcaiḥ sado minuyāt’ iti |
āhavanīyadāvidheya adhikaraṇatvena dṛṣṭārthave'pi homavidhanā anākṣitatvena adṛṣṭārthatvasya ādhārāmihotrādhikaraṇavārtike uktatvāt |
niyamavidhisu trividhaḥ- pratinidhiniyamaḥ, prati- pattividhiḥ, tadubhayavyatiriktaśceti |
pratinidhiniyamo- 'pi tāvat apūrvavidhivadeva jāti-dravya-guṇa-kriyā- viṣayatvena caturvidhaḥ |
dravyapratiniyamo yathā- ‘yadi satrāyā dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyeta yo'sya tasya sthāne dīkṣitā syāt’ iti |
‘yadyupakṛtaḥ paśuḥ palāyeta anyaṃ tadrayasam’ iti tu kātīyamānāṃ |
guṇapratiniyamo yathā- kātīyamānāṃ kṛṣṇasāraṅgābhāve lohitasāraṅgāvidhiḥ amīpomīye paśau ‘yadi kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ na vindedatho lohitasāraṅgaḥ syāt’ iti |
kriyāpratiniyamo yathā- āpastambaḥ- ‘yadi yajamānaḥ prasavet prajā- patervibhānāma lokaḥ’ iti dhruvāyā yajamānabhāga- mavadhāya samidhupayā saha juhuyāt’ iti |
tathā āhitāgniprāpta- pratipatteḥ ‘dakṣiṇe haste juhumāsādayāti’ ityādyāyāḥ pratinidhiḥ patitāhitāgniprāptaye anyaḥ samayeta ‘pātrāṇi tu dadedathau yajamāne vṛthā mṛte’ iti |
tathā dvijā- bhāve śrāddhabhojanasya pratinidhiḥ smaryate |
nirdiṣṭayāpyatha- mudadhuṣya yatra pātraṃ tato gatiḥ |
pratinidhiniyamaḥ sarvaḥ ṛtvartha eva, na puruṣārthaḥ: api iti na dvividhaḥ |
tathā prati- nidhiniyamaḥ sarvo'pi dṛṣṭārtha eva, nāhadṛṣṭārtho'pi iti na dvividhaścidho veti |
pratipattividhiḥ kriyāvidhivareva, na jātidravyaguṇa- vidhiḥ iti na caturvidhaḥ |
tathā pratipattividhiḥ dravyo- ddeśyaka eva, na jātiguṇakriyoddeśyakaḥ iti na uddeśya- cāturvidhyādapi caturvidhaḥ |
pratipattiḥ punaḥ ṛtvarthaiva [pṛ. 24] na puruṣārtha iti na dvividhataddhiḥ |
pattividhiḥ punaḥ dṛṣṭārthaḥ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthyatha, nādṛṣṭamātrārthaḥ iti na trividhaḥ |
pratipattiḥ punaśca dvividhā- sākṣādagniyuktaprati- pādyaviṣayā sākṣādagniyuktopādānānuṣṭhānasiddha- pratipādya- viṣayā ca |
pratinidhipratipattiniyama- vyatireko'pi niyamavidhiḥ pratipattividhivat jñāyā- diviṣayatvena tāvaccaturvidhaḥ |
gopadeva eva kraya- vākyaṃ ākṛtyadhikaraṇavārtike 'adravyatvādvāt' iti sūtre ananyathāsiddhamanye udāhṛtam |
guṇasya yathā - 'aruṇā' iti (aruṇā ekahāyanā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti) |
rucyadhyāhāro'pi yuktaḥ, hetuhetumalliṅgasambhave vyava- pṛ. 797. vidhi: nyāyyaḥ |

na ca samīhitasādhyādanya cetanaḥ pravartayituṃ śakyate iti vidhiḥ svasya pravartanātsiddhayartha svabhāvayāthāḥ bhāvanāyāḥ samīhitabhābhyatvaṃ gamyan bhāvanā- karaṇasya samīhitoddeśapravṛttavyāpāragocaratvaṃ gamyati |
uktaṃ ca nyāya ratnamālāyāṃ 'kartuḥ samīhitaṃ yena sidhya- tyaṅgaṃ taducyate |
bhāṭa. 8|1|9. vidhi: pravartamāno hi śreyaḥsiddhayai pravartate |
bāla. pṛ. 75. vidhi: phalāśasya na praya- jakaḥ |
anenaiva vākyena yūpasaṃbandhakaraṇe ca vākyabheda iti |
ucyate- yūpasaṃbandhopasthityā yūpetvataḥ paśuniyojanaṃ vā āśrayaḥ |
prakaraṇaśrutenaiva āśrayeṇa bhavitavyam, nātidiṣṭeneti kimiyaṃ rājājñā buddhiparipravṛttiścātraiva kāraṇam |
sā ca prakaraṇavihitasyaiva codakaprāptasyāpi na viśiṣyate |
tena yatra godohanādī prakaraṇavihitameva labhyate, tatra tathābhūtasyaiva āśrayatvam |
yataḥ, yadi viśeṣeṇa prakṛtakatvapūrvaṃ yūpasaṃbandho nāvagataḥ, tadā godohanasyāpi prakṛtapūrvayūpasaṃbandhasaṃbandhaḥ pūrve nāvagata eva |
atha tatra sāmarthyataḥ sāmānyena pūrvamevagataḥ, tadā alaukikatve'pi yūpasya kā
śama- yitrībhiḥ adriḥ asya avakānāṃ ca saṃnno'yaṃ yajamānasya kathaṃ śamayati iti |
prakaraṇe saṃbandhaprakarṣo na kalpayeta, vidhyāna- rthakyaṃ hi taṃ prati |

darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇānte 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ, yo'dutaḥ sa raudraḥ, yaḥ śrutaḥ sa sadaivaḥ, tasmādvidahatā dṛtakṛtyaḥ sadaivatvāyaṃ' ityetadvākye 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ' ityādiḥ 'avidahatā' ityādividhiśeṣatayā arthavādarūpaṃ cet prakaraṇe svīye darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe evaṃ saṃbhavan san niveśeta, apakarṣaḥ prakaraṇādanya niveśaśca na kalpayeta |
nairaṃtayānumānena vidvadhatva- vidhāne hi tatra svīkriyamāṇe apakarṣaḥ syādeva |

hi yataḥ taṃ prati prakaraṇasaṃnihitaṃ darśapūrṇamāsamuddiśya vidhyānarthakyaṃ vidvadhatvavidheḥ asaṃbhavatvakathaṃ syāt prakṛtayoge nirṛtidevatāviraheṇa nairaṃtapadena prakṛta- karmānuvādāsaṃbhavāt |
kevalastutivādāt satyeva vidvadhasya nairaṃtatvanindayā 'tasmādvidahatā dṛtakṛtyaḥ' iti vidheḥ śeṣībhavan 'yo vidvadhaḥ' iti vākyaśeṣaḥ darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ prakaraṇe iti |
tena yākāṅkṣākṣaṇe saṃbhavan labhyaniṣedhāḥ san apakarṣaṃ, karmaṇi ghañ, apakṛtyamānaḥ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ vikṛtiṣu nivi- śamāno bhavituṃ na kalpeta (kalpyeta ityasya sthāne) na samartho bhavet |
vidhitvakatve tu vikṛtiṣu apakarṣaḥ prasajyeta iti yāvat |
kutaḥ ? hi yasmāt taṃ prati darśapūrṇamāsa- karmaviśeṣaṃ prati darśapūrṇamāsayoriti yāvat |
vidhyā- narthakyaṃ 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ' iti vidheḥ asaṃbha- vitvetvam, 'tasmādvidahatā dṛtakṛtyaḥ' iti avi- dāhavidhānena 'yo vidvadhaḥ' ityanuvādasyāsaṃbhavāt |
nanu 'yo vidvadhaḥ sa nairaṃtaḥ' ityatra yo nirṛti- yāgaḥ tamuddiśya vidadhadravyavidhisaṃbhave arthavādatva- kalpamananyāyyaṃ ata āha |
prakaraṇe darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe saṃbhavanu niścitamānaḥ arthavādarūpeṇa apakarṣaḥ |
prakaraṇa- viyogaḥ na kalpeta, vidhiprāptaṃ muktvā prakaraṇasaṃbandha- kalpānapakṣo na saṃbhavati |
tathā saṃbhavaprakarṣo na kalpayeta (apakarṣakalpanāprasaṅgo na syāt) |
vidhipakṣe tu yatra nairaṃtaḥ tatra vidadhatā nīyeta (apakarṣaḥ syāt) |
darśapūrṇamāsakarma prati (tanetyarthaḥ) nairaṃtatābhāvāt vidadhavidhānaṃ anarthakaṃ syāt |
'audumbaro yūpo bhavati' iti vidhī (yūpasya vidhau) āśrīyamāṇe 'ūrjasvadarudadhai' ityetasmiṃśca (phalasya vidhau āśrīyamāṇe) vākyaṃ bhidyeta |
itthaṃ audumbaro yūpaḥ praśastaḥ (ityekaṃ), sa ūrjaḥ ava- ruddhaye (iti dvitīyamiti) |
tasmāt vidhivicchinnā- mapi śrutireva kārye arthavādānāṃ iti |
ke. 'vidhiyāṃ syādapūrvatvādādyamātraṃ anarthakam' (1|2| 2|9) ityanenaiva tāvat vidhiḥ |
ityaudumbarādhikaraṇarūpasūtranyāyena vaikalpiko yajamānaḥ sādhanatvena vidhīyate prastarakalpāla- kārye, iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
