vidhiḥ vidheyāntararahitaḥ anyaparaḥ karmasvarūpameva vidadhat pūrvavihitadravyameva karmāntaraṃ karoti (iti prathamādhyāye) - vidhitvanirṇayaphalopajīvanam |
na ca saphalaceṣṭānuṣṭhānasaṃbhave viphalānuṣṭhāne vidhiḥ puruṣaṃ |
na hi vidhivaikaḥ prayojanavān iti kaścinniyamahetu- |
mīmāṃsāstu vidheḥ pravartanāyāṃ śaktiḥ śabdajanya- rasti |
pravartanājñānasya pravṛtti- 3|3 pṛ. 479, puruṣo yena pravartayate sa vidhiḥ |
aniṣṭasādhane'pi 'ānāyapravartito'haṃ 31. yatra kadācidapi prāpnoti sa vidhiḥ, yathā 'agni- |
pravṛttijanakatvaṃ ca pravṛttividha- hotraṃ juhuyāt' iti |
yeṣṭasādhanatājñānajananādvārā iti ākṣiptaṣṭasādhanatābodha- vidhvantaraśeṣārthavādakalpyo vidhivyathā- 'upari hi |
'vidhinā tvekavākyatvāt stutyarthena yadaṃśe aprāptasiddhaṃ eva vidhikalpyam |
bhāvanājñāpratipādakatve'pi tadanuṣṭhāpakānāṃ vidhīnāṃ aṅgaṃ 'samāpyate vidhiḥ kaścit, kadācinnāprarocitaḥ' |
kenopakāreṇa ityapekṣite stutyarthena vā. 1|4|1|24 pṛ. 367, sarvatraiva viśiṣṭavighā- |
vidhinā anuṣṭhānasiddhayarthaṃ stuterupakārakatve nottarakālaṃ kiṃ prāptaṃ kiṃ na prāptaṃ ityevaṇāyāṃ aprāpta- |
śaṅkānirākaraṇārthaṃ arthavādānāṃ dharmopayogitvasiddhau mātraviṣayopasaṃhārāt vidhiḥ : bhāvanādhātvarthayoranuvādaḥ |
na tu ādita eva tu anuya guṇo dravyaṃ |
iti nyāyāt arthavādapadānāṃ sarveṣāṃ lākṣaṇikatve'pi vidhivyathā 'yadagneya'ṣṭākapāle'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ |
(1|2|17) iti sūtramapi dharmapramāṇatvābhimata- vidhinā aniścitataḥ prava
1|2|12 pṛ. 50 brasū. vidhinā svavidheye ihasādhanatvakṣepaḥ kriyate |
bhāṭṭa. 1|4|8 nāvidhīyamāne arthavādaḥ saṃbhavati vidhinā tvekākyavādatvāt iti nyāyāt avi- dhiśeṣasya ānarthakyāt |
śā. 7|1|5 pṛ 538. yat vidhinā tvekākyavādatvāt (1|2|17) iti ajñapradhānavākyānāmiha paścāt saṃbandhastatrā- bhiprāyeṇa iti kecit |
vā 1|4|12|2 pṛ 366. vidheḥ anodhakatvāt na dharme prāmāṇyaṃ iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
abodhakatva-sāpekṣatvayoḥ prāmāṇyākāraṇayoḥ abhāvāt vidheḥ svataḥ siddhaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ci. 1|1|5. vidheḥ arthavādaśūnyasya arthāt patyā arthavādatva- katvam |
su. pṛ. 84. vidheḥ upapattivi- yogaprayorūpāḥ dvitīyatṛtīyācaturthādhyāyeḥ nirūpitāḥ |

pramāṇopayalakṣaṇanidhānāviśeṣāt saṃnikarṣa-viprakarṣa- nādareṇa pradhānānvayavāgataiḥ, aniṣṭāṃtopāyaparamāṇatvena ca pradhānopakārakūpeṇa arthena sarveṣāṃ apekṣinatvāt yugapat prāpteḥ, yathāprāpte ca svaśabdārthe vikalpayogāt, 'nivītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' iti sarvairvijāṃ nīvītavat yathāprāptasya aṅgasamūhasya sarvasya svapradhānaprayogavidhāthi- śabdaviṣayatvāgataiḥ sarvāṅgaprayoge phalasiddhiḥ syāt iti samastāṅgaprayogopapādanāya ekakāṇḍagamananimittaikavākya- tvābhāve'pi aṅgapradhānānāṃ anyonyāpekṣāvattvāt sarvāṃ- ṅgānugṛhītena pradhānena phalaṃ bhāvayet ityevaṃ vākyaikavākya- tvakalpanā saṃnikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭānāma sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ pradhāna- prayogavidhiprayojyatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt vedāntarīyāṇāmapi aṅgānāṃ pradhānavidhiprayojyatvopapattiḥ |
vidheḥ prakaraṇāntare vikṛtau atideśāt sarvakarma prākṛtaṃ sarvaṃ dharmajāta artha- luptamapi kartavyaṃ syāt |
yathā 'prajāpatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapetkṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' ityatra caruśabdāt pākaḥ kartavyaḥ |
dvitīyavarṇake tu pākavat avaghāte'pi kartavyaḥ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |

'vaśvadevaṃ caruṃ nirvaped bhrātṛvyavān taṃ barhiṣadaṃ kṛtvā śāmyā rūpyeṇa vyūhet idamahamamuṃ cāmuṃ ca vyūhāmi iti, yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhyāyet, yadapo'vamṛyet yacca sphya ālipset tad viṣṇava urukramāyāvayet' iti śrūyate |
sattvaṃ prākṛtaṃ vikṛtau kartavyaṃ uta kiṃcit prādhyamapi iti vicāre sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ iti pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ |
abhidhāna- saṃskārābhyāṃ yuktaṃ dravyaṃ abhidhānasaṃskāradravyaṃ iti uttarapada- lopaḥ |
'svayaṃ ditaṃ barhirbhavati' iti abhidhānayuktaṃ barhirādi dravyam, 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave |
ādade ' iti ādānasaṃskārayuktaṃ asidrūpaṃ dravyam, arthe uktaṃ- dravyasya prayojane sati kriyeta kartavyam |
arthalope tu dravya- syāpi vikṛtau lopa eva |
dvitīya varṇake tu kṛṣṇaleṣu avaghātāvādhaḥ kartavyaḥ |
tṛtīya varṇake tu abhidhānasaṃskāro nivartate, prayoja- nābhāvāt |
yaduktaṃ pūrvapakṣaṇā yathā kṛṣṇaleṣu luptaprākṛtaprayojano- 'pi pākaḥ vacanaprāmāṇyāt kriyate evaṃ prākṛtaṃ luptārtha- mapi vikṛtau kriyate iti |
pratyakṣaṃ hi 'vṛte śrapayati' iti vacanena śrapaṇaṃ śiṣṭaṃ vihitam |
svayaṃditabarhirādiṣu teṣāṃ abhidhāna- saṃskāradravyāṇāṃ apratyakṣaśiṣṭatvāt pratyakṣavidhānābhāvāt codakasya ca prakṛtopakārābhāvāt apravṛttiḥ |
tasmāt vikṛtau arthaluptaṃ prākṛtaṃ na pravartate iti siddhāntaḥ |
yathā 'svayaṃ ditaṃ barhirbhavati' ityukte prākṛtaṃ chinnaṃ barhinivartate, evaṃ 'svayaṃ kṛtā vedirabhavati' ityatra
'svayaṃ śīrṣā śālā bhavati' ityatra asidravyaṃ nivartate |
dvitīyavarṇake tu kṛṣṇaleṣu avaghātāsa vādhaḥ sādhanīyaḥ sūtrākṣarārthastu na bhinnaḥ |
tṛtīyavarṇake tu viṣṇuḥ urukramaḥ nāvāhayitavyaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
prayojanaṃ khalu iha vidheḥ vedaprāmāṇyasiddhirarvā, padārthasaṃgrahapratītirvā, hitāhitasādhanatā'vagamo vā pravṛttinivṛttinimittam |
na tāvat prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ, antareṇāpi vidhiṃ tatsaṃbhavāt |
syādetat, vidhivirahe kāryyatayatā bhūtārthava- gāhino bhūtasya ca mānāntaraviṣayatayā tadapekṣatvādedasya prāmāṇyaṃ vihanyeta, puruṣavākyavat |
atredaṃ tu bhavān pṛṣṭo dhyācakṣvā, yadetat puruṣavacasā- mānāntarāpekṣatvam, tat kiṃ bhūtārthatayā, āhosvit puruṣabuddhiprabhavatayā, na tāvat bhūtārthatayā pratyakṣādīnāma- prāmāṇyaprasakteḥ |
caityavandanā- divākyasya ca kāryārthābhidhāyino nirapekṣatayā prāmāṇya- prasaṅgāt |
viniyogamātraparametat, na kāryaparaṃ iti ca svatantrasiddhāntaśraddhāmātravijṛmbhitam, na prāmāṇikaṃ iti nivedayiṣyate |
tasmāt vastubhūtaprabhavameva sāpe- kṣatve hetuḥ, tacca bhūtāyai'pi vaidike nāsti iti nāsti sāpekṣatā |
nāpi padārthasaṃgrahapratītiḥ, vinā'pi vidhinā 'syālyāmodanaṃ pacati caitraḥ' iti padārthasaṃgrahapratīte- rupapatteḥ |

yadi manyeta 'vivakṣā'dhīnatvenāni paṃso vacanāni, vivakṣā ca mānāntarādhārādhīnā, mānāntaraṃ ca padārthasaṃsargagocaram, na padārthamātragocaram, iti tatprabhava- tayā puṃvākyānipi padārthasaṃsargameva gocarayanti, na svayaṃvaṃ vedavākyāni apauruṣeyāṇi, iti padārthasaṃsargasiddhayartha vidhireśitavyaḥ' iti, tadyuktam |
'tasmin sati tadākāṅkṣānvayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ- padārthānāṃ' iti cet, tadākāṅkṣaiva kutaḥ |
'tadaparyava- sānāt' iti cet, na kriyādiṣvapi sāmyāt |

yathā hi śabdābhihito vidhiḥ viṣayaviniyojyādibhirvinā na paryavasyati, tathā kriyādyo'pi padārthaḥ kārakādi- bhirvinā iti te eva padairupāttāḥ ākāṅkṣāyogyatā- saṃnidhisacīnāśca saṃsargaṃ gamayiṣyanti iti kṛtaṃ vidhinā |
viśiṣṭārthapratītiprayuktatvena ca padānāṃ samabhi- vyāhārasya loke viditatvāt tatsādhayatvācca vaidikārtha- pratīteḥ |
tasya prayojanaṃ saṃbhavati, 'saṃtāpamapanayati ca tatasya salilāsekaḥ,' 'dahati ca jvalanajvālākalāpāliṅganaṃ' iti vartamānāpa- deśādapi hitāhitasādhanatā'vagamāt |
tataśca īpsā- jihāsābhyāṃ pramāṇāntarādeva pravṛttinivṛttyorupapatteḥ vyartho vidhiḥ iti |
(atrocyate) mā bhuvan anyāni prayojanāni vidheḥ, puruṣārthasādhanatā'vabodhastu vidhinirbandhanaḥ |
na hi 'svargaṃ- kāmo yajeta' iti vidhau asati svargo bhāvanāyā bhāvyaḥ saṃbhavati |
bhavitā ca bhāvyaḥ, yāgādyaśca bhavitāraḥ, iti samānapadopādānatayā prakṛtyartha- tayā ca tadanurūpatayā eva bhāvanāyāḥ pratīteḥ |
svargasya ca padāntaropādānatayā puruṣaviśeṣaṇatayā ca vyavasthānāt tamapahāya yāgādīneva bhāvayatā bhāvanā gṛhyate |
kartavye- kṣitopāyatārūpavidhipyupahitamaryādā punarayaṃ bhāvanā samāna- padopādānamapi prathamāvagatamapi duḥkhākaratayā kartavyape- kṣitamapahāya svargameva bhāgyamavalambate |
samāsā- ditatathāvidhabhāvyatayā ca yāgādīn karaṇatayā svīkaroti iti puruṣārthasādhanatā teṣāṃ siddhā bhavati |
kathaṃ tarhi varta- mānāpadeśyo loke puruṣārthasādhanatā'vagatiḥ ? (uttaraṃ-) pramāṇāntarāvaśāt, na śabdasāmarthyāt |
yathā caitat tathā 'dravyasaṃskārakarmasu' iti ca, 'asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt' iti ca vyākhyāna upapādayiṣyati svayamevācāryaḥ |
kaṇikā, pṛ. 2-4. vidhe: procanānapekṣasya pravṛttau asāmarthyāt arthavādasaṃvidhāne ca svayaṃ aparokṣatvāt arthavāda-

prayatna eva bhavitavye prarocanānapekṣatve vidheḥ svaviṣayecchāsādhanatvajñāpana- apūrve prayojakabhūtasya bhāvayitugārama no vyāpāra iti mātreṇa pravartakatvopapatteḥ arthavādābhāve'pi vidhāyakatvā- bhāvanādāvedenocyate |
... arthavādādinepekṣasya vidhaumātrasya pravṛtti- dadhatāṃ liḍādīnāmupapadyate iti kṛtimpyabhidadhati |
apūrva dāktau api arthavādānarthakyaparihārāmātrārthaṃ arthavādā- ca |
na ca yugapadanekābhidhānaṃ doṣaḥ, tathā avagamāt nyapratītiḥ |
avagato hi pramāṇena liḍādīnāṃ kāryā- sāmarthyena arthavādānanyāt prāgeva vidhyuddeśārthanirṇayāt |
kṛterguṇabhūtā pradhānapadavartitva- ...prarocanānapekṣasya asāmarthye'pi arthavādābhāve vidhereva pūrvātmani kārye, avivādā ca kartrādisaṃkhyāvācitā prarocanāśaktyāvirbhāvaḥ |
... bhāvanāyā eva vākyārthatvaṃ bhāvyaṃ apūrve prati guṇāve- arthavādasadbhāvakṛtatvāt prarocanāśaktyapagamasya |
vidheḥ pravṛttijanakasvarūpa- bhāṣyakārasya tatratatra vyavahāraḥ puruṣaprayatnaḥ |
prakaraṇato- yogyatvasya vācyatvena phalopadhānanaiyatyābhāvāt pravṛtti- 'pūrvasya nocyate |
tasya tathāvidhasya kāryasya nūnaṃ virahe'pi araṇyasthadaṇḍavat vidheḥ pravṛttijanakatvopapatteḥ |
bhāṭṭa. 6|1|6 pṛ. śrayati, tena vinā tadabhāvāt |
avacche- vidhermantrānusāreṇa paryavasānaniyamābhyupagame'pi na dakatvasya viṣayabhāvam |
yatraiva hi yo bhavati nānyatra tadupasaṃhāraprābalyam |
parākramaḥ : 4312. vidherviśeṣa sa tasya viṣaya iti viṣayavidaḥ, ananyaprabhāvo ekavākyatā nahi bhavati, vacananyaktibhedāt |
tena kāryābhidhāvibhiḥ vidheḥ viṣayakaraṇayorvicāraḥ : ( viṣayakaraṇī- saha viṣayabodhakathaya bhāvārthaḥ karmadaṇḍaḥ samabhivyāhāraṃ yam) |
pratītasya ca kāryasya sādhanā- svargakāmo yajeta' ityādiṣu svargakāmādiniyojyatvena 'saṅkhyā |
tena na jaghanyatayā sādhanatayā bhāvārthānā- saṃbadhyamāno nāsargasādhane kāryaṃ bhavyatayā netumalama |
kintu pratītyupāyatāmeva manyamāno kriyā kṣaṇabhāvanī na kālāntarabhāvinaḥ svargādeḥ sādhanā- bhagavānevaṃ brūte |
nahyaviṣayabhūtatvāt niyogajñāna- yopapatte iti kālāntaravasthāpi kriyāyāṃ bhinnaṃ kāryam- mutpadyate iti |
sa ca viṣayabhūtabhāvāthavicchinno pūrva liḍādayo bodhayantīti sthitam |
kāryaṃ ca kṛtīpti- viṣayarthaḥ kāryātmā pratīta: karaṇaṃ kṛtikartavyatā ca samucyate iti |
cetanaśra ātmā kāryaṃ bodhayatyā bhāvārtho viṣayabhūtaḥ karaṇamityaniyatatve |
vo hi yathā kṛtyā'rthapravṛttyā viṣayī- tayā kāryatvena saṃvedayitumalamiyātmano mānasapratyakṣa- kriyate sa eva tatra karaṇam |
mānastayoreva dvidhābhavanalakṣaṇaphalavacchedalabdhaidhīkaraṇa- karaṇāni tasya śrūyante iti tathaiva tasya siddhiḥ |
aneka- vyapadeśayoḥ dvidhātvāt vācyayoḥ karaṇam, tayehāpi apū- karaṇasaṃpādyatā'pi ekasya dṛṣṭā |
yathā gamanasya aśvena vārthaprayuktapuruṣaprayatnavyāpyamāno bhāvārthaḥ tasminneva prayatne dvicakrayā vā gacchatīti |
atrāpyutpannapūrvyāvantyavyāpārabhūtāni bhāvāthaṃ bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇam, ādhyamānatayā hi karmaiva bhinnāni saṃgirāāmahe eva |
tatra na karma tāvadapūrvārthakṛtitvividha- kāraṇabhāvasya paramāpūrveṇayuktā'pi ājyauṣadhājñādya- tvāt |
sarvasyaiva hi kārakāṇi kartṛvyatiriktāni tadyāpā- dharmānāmasaṃkaraḥ |
apūrvasādhananiveśitatvād dharmāṇāṃ ravyāpyāna, na caitāvatā tāni karmatāṃ pratibhajante |
karaṇaṃ tu yadyapi svarūpa- anyāpārarūpatvād apūrvasya, vyāpārasaṃvanaprasavatatvācca karaṇa- nivṛttau na saṃbhavati |
udyamanipatano- gauṇaṃ ca na karaṇam, nahi gauṇo mukhyadharmaḥ saṃbhavati dvīkaraṇabhavatvenarūpatayāḥ tadadhītatvāt |
paraśusaṃbandhaprabhā- ye'pi sarvājñatātveva bhāvanābhidhānāmāhuḥ, teṣāmapi veṇa hyudyamananipatane dvedhābhavanaphalaniṣṭhādakatvā devā- matamasmabhyaṃ na rocate |
nahi kāryānabhidhāyiṣu liḍādiṣu bhavane kāraṇatāṃ bhajete |
evaṃ cāpūrvaphalatvorikaiva bhāvanā, viśeṣaprabho hi karotīti tatra pacatītyuttararaṇāpi tadeva ekatvātpuruṣaprayatnasya ekameva ca kāraṇaṃ tadbhāvanāyāya- nirdiṣyate |
yanu vyāpāramātrāvidhānoccāraṇamātraṃ na tvāt ekā eva bhāvyatā iti |
ata eva ca sādhyavi- kriyate, tatra tāvanmātrāpyathaṃśāt pratyayāntaroccāraṇaṃ ddhiriti prābhākaraḥ |
yadi vipayībhūtasya karaṇatā, ca praśnaṃ sahasracandram |
ata evācyate vyāpāre vartamā- hanta tarhi darguṇamāsābhyāmimya tantrābhihitātāṃ tantreṇaiva nāpadeśādīnāṃ prayogaḥ |
liḍādayastu cetanamevādhikṛtya pratipatyanubandhatvāt viṣayabhāvasyaikatvādekameva kāraṇaṃ prayujyante |
dhātūnāmeva kriyāvācitvāt prathamapa- yadeva viṣayībhūtaṃ tadeva karaṇaṃ nānyadāti |
jaghanyau saṃśogāvibhāgau pratīyanubandhatayā ca viṣayabhāvaḥ sa yathābhidhānamavakṣyate kijñānekarttā''pyapyate |
atastantrābhidhānāt saṃyoge'pi saṃyoge'ccha gacchatītyaprayogadibhāge'pi sahitānāṃ viṣayabhāvaḥ karaṇaṃ siddhayanubandho niyogasya vibhāge prayogānupalabdheḥ |
svabhāvadhīnā hi sādhakānāṃ gamivācyatveti kimanena manīṣikānirmitena jālajalpitena sādhakatā iti svabhāvabhede hi bhinnā sādhakatā |
katve ca kṛtiviṣayatvāt kāraṇatvebhedena kāraṇa- 'dālikanāyena kṛtaṃ kṛtināmapukārasiddhaye samyak |
nanvevaṃ pratyekaṃ kāraṇabhāvāśrayaṇe kāraṇāntaranira- saṇudītha vā gurumataṃ samyaggriyakaraṇītidam ||
' tatra prakaraṇa- pekṣaṇā kimiti niyogasiddhiritu na bhavati |
'aktā: śarkarā upadadhāti' atra añjanadravyaṃ kimiti saṃśaya: |
'tejo vai ghṛtaṃ' iti arthavādāt ghṛtaṃ añjanadravyaṃ iti nirṇaya: |
tatra tasya sarvadharmatvasya utpādako nyāya: vidhe: sarvaviṣayatvaṃ yasmin kalpe vidhāne vidhāyaka vākye asti tat tannyāyam |
su. pṛ. 245-246, vidhe: sāmānyamātre pūrva- vasitasya arthavādavirodhāt viṣayasaṃkocatvāt bādho- 'bhyupagamyate |
su. pṛ. 525, vidhe: stutyā avinā- bhāvāt anyataradarśanena anyataradanāya vākyaṃ pūrva- tatyam |
pṛ. 41. vidhe: stuteścaikavākyatvaṃ bhavati padānāṃ sākṣāttvāt |
bhā. 1|2|17 pṛ. 1|7. vidhe: svata: prāmāṇyam, ayogakatvasāpekṣatvoraprāmāṇya- kāraṇayorabhāvāt |
vā. 2|2|15|6 pṛ. 507. na ca vidhervidhinā ekavākyabhāvo bhavati, vacanavyakti- bhedāt |

bhā. 6|2|15. paśumālabheta iti sāmānyaparyavasitasyāpi vidhe: 'chāgasya vapāyā medo'nu- brūhi' iti mantravarṇānurodhena saṃkoca: , vidhimantrayoreka- viṣayatvāt, sāmānyasya ca kṛtsnasya chāge'pi vibhāve- nāvirodhāt, niyamasaṃbhave ca aniyamamanupapatte: padyānye vakṣyate |
su. pṛ. 525. na ca dvayo: vidhayo: ekavākyabhāvo'sti |
bhā. 6|1|2|130. vidhīnāṃ anyena atyantāprāptaviṣayatvena śrutānyāyatvakalpanā- pramāṇakatvam |
maṇi. pṛ. 5. niyogārthanivṛtte: kimiyat prayojanaṃ sarvavidhīnām |
vā. 3|6|1|2. sarvavidhīnāṃ puruṣārthaphala- tvāt prayojanākāṅkṣā svargadinā nivartyate |
3|4|4|3 pṛ. 911, vidhau arthavādāvagataviṣaye ṛgādi- śabdānāṃ anuvādakatvāt lakṣaṇāyāmapyadoṣa: |
8| 1|313-10. vidhyantaḥ nāma itthambhāvasūpa iti itikarta- vyatāvādharaṇam |
tasya ca anekāṅgavākyatadarthatadaprayojanā- locanamadhyasya kathaṃbhāvaḥ ādiḥ ityācāryāṇāṃ vidhyādi- tvena prasiddhiḥ |
vā. 3|3|7|14 pṛ. 852. vidhyantaḥ nikāyinaḥ prathamasya uttaranikāyiṣu |
dup. 12|1|1|1 pṛ. 2216. vidhyantaḥ paśupuroḍāśe dākṣapaurṇamāsikāt agnīṣomīyāt puroḍā- śāt |
yathā kauṇḍapāyanāmayane agnihotra ityabhidhānaṃ karmaṇo vācakam |
teṣu asatsu etat abhidhānaṃ iha na yujyate iti teṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ tatra bhāvo vijñāyate |
evamihāpi prayā- jādīnāṃ darśanaṃ asatyāṃ vaidikyāṃ na yujyate iti tasyā api iha bhāvo vijñāyate |
satyamevam, uktaṃ tu nyāyaḥ bhāgitvāt iti |
yattu dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ laukikī iti, tatra brūmaḥ |
yadyapi dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ syāt, tathāpi vaidikī eva niya- myeta |
yadyapi dhenuśabdo godhenvāṃ dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ, tathāpi abhidhānasāmānyāt aśvadhenvāmapi bhāgi iti kiśorina liṅgena aśvadhenvāṃ vijñāyate |
evamihāpi yadyapi laukikī dṛṣṭapravṛttiḥ, tathāpi itikartavyatā- sāmānthena bhāgitvāt liṅgena vaidikī vijñeyā |
bhāṣyam— athavā naiva liṅgena niyama iti |
kimataḥ ? yadi prayājādīnāṃ anugrājādayaḥ aṅgāni syuḥ ; tato 'yatra pradhānaṃ tatrāṅgāni' iti prayāja- darśanaina anugrājādayaḥ anumīyeran |
yadā tu sama- pradhānā ete, tadā prayājadarśanena kāmaṃ prayājā anumīye- ran prayājadharmā vā, na tu anugrājādayaḥ |
yatra hi paraśabdaḥ paratra prayuktaḥ san taddharmā- natidiśati ityuktam |
tenātra prayājādīnāmeva nāsti prāptiḥ, kutaḥ anugrājādīnām |
ato yathādhikāraṃ bhāvaḥ syāt, ye dharmā yasyāpūrvasya adhikāre āmnātāḥ te tatraiva bhaveyuḥ |
bhāṣyam— evaṃ tarhi 'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' ityanena ākhyātena pradhānasya vidhānotpattiḥ |
kathaṃ kṛtvā ? nāntraṃ pradhānamucyate kasmai cit prayojanāya kalpate iti |
tena ca prāpitānāmajñānāṃ etebhyo liṅgebhyaḥ viśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |
ekasmin śabde pradhānasya utpattiḥ, ajñānāṃ ca vacanaṃ na saṃbhavati |
kiṃ kāraṇam ? utpannaṃ hi pradhānaṃ aṅgāni apekṣate |
yadi ca 'nirvapet' ityanena śabdena aṅgānyapi vidhīyeran tataḥ teṣāmapi phalasaṃbandhaḥ syāt, tathā aṅgatvameva vyāhanyeta |
vidhyanto vā prakṛtivaccodanāyāṃ pravartata tathāhi liṅgadarśanam |
bhāṣyam— vidhyanto vā sauryādikāyāṃ codanāyāṃ pravartata, na dharmā laukikāḥ |
kaḥ punarayaṃ vidhyanto nāma ? vidheranto vidhyantaḥ |
atha vidhiḥ kaḥ ? yadvākya- mupalabhya puruṣaḥ kasiddhidhre pravartate, kutaścidvā nivartate sa vidhiḥ |
vidhya- nto'pi pradhānavidhivarjitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ pauroḍāśikaṃ brāhma- ṇam |
eteṣu ca sauryādiṣu vidhyādirasti vidhyanto nāsti |
kathaṃ kṛtvā ? apari- pūrṇaṃ yat vākyaṃ tat adhyāhāreṇa vā pūrvaita, vyavahita- kalpatayā vā |
tasmāt vyavahito brāhmaṇāvayavaḥ asya paripūrakaḥ kalpyate |
nanu yadi tat brāhmaṇaṃ asya antaḥ kalpyate, tatra na bhavati |
tadyathā, mayūrasya nṛtyataḥ anyapātriyate anyat saṃtriyate |
tadetaduktaṃ 'vidhyanto vā prakṛti- vaccodanāyāṃ pravartata' iti (10 sa.) |
prakṛtivaditi kim ? āha, asme prakṛtiniyamaṃ kari- ṣyati, ithamasya prakṛtiriti |
yo yasya karmaṇaḥ prakṛtiriti, yasya āgneyaḥ prakṛtiḥ, tasya āgneyādeva |
atha kasmāt na laukiko vidhyantaḥ kalpyate ? ucyate |
laukikasya vidheḥ abhāvāt vidhyanta eva nāsti, kutaḥ tatkalpaneti |
āha, laukikī itikartavyatā prāpyatāṃ kiṃ vidhyantakalpaneti |
vaidikī hi atra iti- kartavyatā, na laukikī |
kasmāt ? tathāhi liṅgadarśanaṃ prayājādi samarthanaṃ bhavati |
dup-- kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ yatra itikartavyatā āmnāyate, tatra kathaṃbhāvasya avyāvṛttatvāt codanā sadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ buddhau upasthāpayati |
sādṛśyaṃ ca vaidikenaiva bhavati, na laukikeneti |
bhāṣyam-- yadi liṅgāt vaidiko'bhyupāyo bhavati, tena tarhi ? aliṅge laukikaṃ syāt |
yatra karmaṇi kiṃcidliṅgaṃ nāsti, tatra laukikaṃ syādihānam, yathā 'aindrāgmekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet yasya sañjātā vīyuḥ' iti |
liṅgasya pūrvavaccodanāśādasāmānyādenāpi nirūpyeta yathā sthālī pulākena |
syādetadevaṃ yadi liṅga- hetuko vaidika upāyaḥ syāt |
sa ca nyāyastulyaḥ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ vaikṛtānāṃ liṅgavatāṃ aliṅgavatāṃ ca |
tulyasya apekṣāyā anyatra śrutena vidhyantena saṃbandhaḥ |
tadetat nyāyapūrvakaṃ liṅgaṃ ekatrāpi dṛśyamānaṃ tulyanyāyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dharma- vaktāṃ jñāpayati |
yathā sthālīṃ tulyapākānāṃ pulākānāṃ ekaṃ upamañca anyeṣāmapi siddhatāṃ jānāti |
tulyo hetustasya ca anyeṣāṃ ca siddhatveti |
sāmānyato dṛṣṭaṃ ca yadyavyabhicāri tat pramāṇam |
yattu vaidikī bhāgitvāt tatpūrva- kāṇi liṅgāni bhaviṣyantīti |
tāvadena ca darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ asau iti jñāyate, na sarvatreti |
atha kasmādetāni vaikṛtāni vākyāni nūnānyeva nānumanyante, kimebhiḥ pūritāḥ ? nūnāni anarthakāni bhavantīti |
bhavantu, ko doṣaḥ ? śiṣṭairāpāṃ saṃparigraho na yujyate |
nāstyakṣare mātrāyāṃ vā pramādaḥ, kuta etāvati granthe bhaviṣyati ? katham ? 'tulyaṃ ca sāṃpradāyikam' (1|2|18) ityuktam |
śā— evaṃ sthite iha cintyate laukikī vaidikī veti |
' tasmāt vaidikaṃ itthaṃbhāvaḥ sauryādiṣu ati- diśyate |
soma— pūrvasminneva viṣaye viśeṣavicārarūpatvāt uttaravicārasya saṃgatiḥ |
' bhāṭṭamanthastu 'atideśaḥ sauryādiṣu itikartavya- tāyāḥ ' iti vindau (mīko. pṛ. 231) eva gṛhīta: |
' vidhyantādhikaraṇe sauryādiṣu ānumānikavacanena vaidikītikartavyatā asti ityuktam, tasyedānīṃ viśeṣa ucyate |
nanu vidhyantādhikaraṇe eva laukikavaidikasamuccayamāhātmyaka ekenaiva itthaṃbhāva- pūraṇācca dvayoḥ sahapravṛttiḥ ityuktam, tena gatametat |
samuccayatastana nirākṛtaḥ, iha tu vikalpo nirasyate |
'sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet' iti vidhyadivākyaṃ sākāṅkṣaṃ vidhyantavākyaiḥ dāṣṭīpī- māsikāḥ nirākāṅkṣīkriyate vidhyantādhikaraṇanyāyāt |
bhā. 4|3|1|4 pṛ. 829, vidhyantāpekṣāyāṃ anekavidhyantasaṃnipāte asādhāraṇena liṅgena vidhyanto niyamyate |

vidhyantarāvihitasya prakṛtavidheyavyatiriktasya nindādvārā prakṛtavidheyapradarśanāt rūpaḥ arthavādaḥ yathā - 'yattvā snuvate tadasurā anvayāyan, yatsāmā snuvate tadasurā nānvayāyan, ya evaṃ vidvān sāmnā stuvīta' iti |
vidhyantaravihitasya prakṛtavyatiriktasya nindā- dvārā prakṛtavidheyapradarśanāt arthavādaḥ yathā - 'prātaḥ- prātarṛtaṃ te vadanti puroḍāśajuhuti ye'mihotram |
divākīrtyamadivākīrtyantaḥ sūryo jyotirna tadā jyoti- reṣām |
vidhyantaraśeṣārthavādakalpyaḥ pratiṣedho yathā- 'tasmādāraṇyamevāśrīyāt' iti trividhaviśeṣeṇa 'na vā ete mādhān havirgṛhṇanti' iyanena māpaniveṣaḥ kalpyate |
bāla, pṛ. 30, vidhyantaraśeṣārthavādakalpyaḥ vidhiḥ yathā- 'upari hi devebhyo dhārayati' iti |
vidhyaparādhe ca prāyaścittāni vidhīyante, nimitte karmāṅgabhūtāni |
vidhyarthaḥ: api pravartanā janakatāvacchedena bhāvanā- nvayī |
nanu karaṇatvabodhaka- śabdābhāvāt 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityādau kathaṃ yāgagata- śreyaḥsādhanatvasya vedabodhakatvam, kaśca vā vidhiḥ ? yadavodhayat śreyaḥsādhanatvasya iti cet |
liḍādiśravottaraṃ pravṛttirdvaināt pravṛttisāmagrījanadvārā liḍādijñānasya pravṛttau upayogaḥ iti tāvadvivādam |
tasyāśca svarūpataḥ kāraṇatvāt tatra liḍādijñānasya anuyoge'pi cikīrṣākāraṇabhūtajñāne tadupayogaḥ kalpyate |
anyatābhāve itaratraśce'pi madhuviṣapañcabhojane, candrasparśe, maṇḍalīkaraṇādau ca pravṛttidarśanāt |
ato liḍādijñānena tritayajñānajananāt liḍādeḥ balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitve, kṛtisādhyatve, iṣṭasādhanatve ca śaktiḥ |
puṣya- vacchabdaśca dhṛṣṭatticaitratvāt sugata arthatrayasyāpi bodhaḥ |
'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityādau ca natrarthe abhāve |
so'pi na tritayasyāpi, kalañjabhakṣaṇasya kṛtisādhanatvāt iṣṭasādhanatvācca |
ata eva tasmin balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvābhāvaḥ bala- vadaniṣṭānanubandhitvaṃ niṣedhena bodhyate iti kāraṇābhāvāt tatrāpravṛttiḥ |

iyenādau ca kṛtisādhyatveṣṭasādhanatvayoreva anvayaḥ, na tu balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvasya, pramāṇāntareṇa taphalasya abhi- cārasya narakasādhanatvāvagamanena tasya narakaprayojakatvalapa- vadaniṣṭānanubandhitvāt |
balavadaniṣṭānanubandha- jñānābhāve'pi balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvajñānābhāvena iṣṭasādhanatājñānādeva pravṛtteḥ ānubhavikatvāt |
ataśca tatra icchādeva liḍāde- ranuyogāt na tasya tadvācyatvam |

kiṃca evaṃ nañsama- bhihyāttādiśyabalavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvaracakādavabodhe nañpadasyeṣṭopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, nañsamabhivyāhṛtalavada- niṣṭānanubandhitvatiriktāliḍādarthādavabodhe dhātupada- janyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, nañsamabhivyāhṛtaliḍādarthakāra- katvāvabodhe dhātujanyopasthitiḥ prathamāntapadajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, liḍasamabhivyāhṛtanañarthakatvāt śabdavodhe dhātu- janyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, nañsamabhivyāhṛtadhātvarthātāyārthakṛti- prakārakaśābdabodhe prathamāntapadajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, nañsamabhivyāhatākhyātāthakṛtiprakārakaśābdabodhe nañpada- janyopasthitiḥ kāraṇam, iti sapta kāryakāraṇabhāvāḥ |
tadvicchaliḍādarthasya tu sarvatra dhātvarthe eva, nañaḥ asattve dhātvarthe iti gurubhūtānekasamabhivyā- hāraśānakāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanāpattiḥ |

evaṃ 'yaṭo nāsti' 'na pacati caitraḥ' ityādau liḍādisamabhivyāhārābhāve nañarthasya abhāvasya āśraye prathamāntapadasyāpye anvayaḥ, liḍādisamabhivyāhārasattve 'tu dhātvarthe eva iti dhyutpannenatvam |
tathā ākhyātāthasya kṛtyādeḥ nañaḥ asattve ākhyātasaṃbandhena prathamāntapadasyāpye, tattvale tadarthe pratiyogitāvattvasaṃbandhena iti gurubhūtāḥ kāryakāraṇa- bhāvāḥ |

asamanmate tu vakṣyamāṇarītyā vidhyarthasya nañaḥ asattve (nañsattve) svaprayojyābhāvapratiyogitvasaṃbandhena (ākhyātāthakṛtau), nañarthasya sarvatra pratiyogitāsaṃbandhena (ākhyātāthakṛtau), prathamāntārthasya ca ādheyatvasaṃbandhena ākhyātāthai kṛtau, iti catvāraḥ |

kiṃca 'na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayet' ityatra bhakṣaṇe bala- vadaniṣṭānanubandhitvabodhe'pi iṣṭasādhanatvasyāpi vidhinā bodhitatvāt tasya ca lokāvagatatulisādhanatvamādāya nirvāhahe vaiyarthyāpatteḥ bhavanmate viśvajinnyāyena svarga- kalpanāpattiḥ |
ata eva yatra kṛti- sādhyatvabodhe na kathaṃcidapi vaiyarthyaparihāraḥ tatra lokasiddhānanuvādakatvamapi nānupapannam |

kiṃca yadi tritayamapi liḍarthaḥ tadā iyene balavada- niṣṭānanubandhitvasya kuto na bodhaḥ ? vādhāditi cet, ko'yaṃ bādho nāma ? iyenaphalasya abhicārasya hiṃsātvena 'na hiṃsyāt' iti niṣedhaviṣayatvameva bādhaka miti cet, tasya sāmānyaśāstreṇa rāgaprāptahiṃsopajīvanatvenāpi cari- tārthatayā yāgīyapaśuhiṃsāmātre iyene balavadaniṣṭānanubandha- tasya vicchidya vidhipramitatvena tannidhārhatvena iyene'pi apravṛtteḥ |
kiṃca balavadaniṣṭānanubandhitvaṃ na tāvat iṣṭopattinānta- rīyakaduḥkhajanakatvam, vidhitaḥ tajjñānasattve'pi
svadravyavyayadveṣavataḥ alasasya yāgādau pravṛttyadarśanena tajjñānasya pravṛtti prati akāraṇatvāt |
kaljajña- bhakṣaṇādau jñāne'pi rāgiṇaḥ pravṛttidarśanena tajjñā- nasya na pravṛttipratibandhakatvamapi |
ataśca yāgādiṣvanye'pi duḥkhe yadā prācīnakarmavaśāt utkaṭo dveṣaḥ |
yadā tu śubhakarmavaśāt tatra notkaṭo dveṣaḥ tadā tasya balavadaniṣṭānubandhitvajñānābhā- satvāt pratibandhakābhāvena tatra pravṛttiḥ |
evaṃ kaljabhakṣa- ṇādau syene ca prācīnakarmavaśāt pravṛttyapravṛttī kādācitke upapādanīya |
ataśca yāgādau naiyatyena balavadaniṣṭānu- bandhitvasya vidhinā bodhayitumaśa
saṃbhavati hi tatra rājapreraṇāmādāyāpi prayogaḥ anyadīya- |
ataḥ siddhaṃ na tārkikarītyā iṣṭasādhanatvadeḥ liṅādya- |
rthatvam, api tu pūrvoktarītyā pravartakecchāyā eva |
eva vidhisthale iva agrimayorapi ca lāghavāt iṣṭasādhana- |
preraṇam ; eteṣu caturṣu pravartanāvatvasya ekasya anugata- |
evaṃ ‘yadi gālīn bhuñjīta narha dadhi upamiñjet’ |
śālīn bhoktumicchet’ iti nimittatvameva saṃsarge jñāna |
ityādau loke tāvat śābdabodhottaraṃ saṃsargasya tatvena |
prayojakatāvacchedakatayā siddho vyāpārasvarūpaḥ akhaṇḍadharma eva anatiprasaktaḥ liṅādidaśakatāvacchedakaḥ |
athavā 'ayameva prarvatatām' ityākārakatvarūpasya lokevedasādhāraṇasya viṣayitāviśeṣasya pūrvamuktatvāt sa eva liṅādidaśakatāvacchedakaḥ |
etacca ayameva prakāraḥ dvāndravatvāvacchinnaṃ prati lakṣaṇādijanyaśābdabodhatvāva- cchinnaṃ prati vā lokevedasādhāraṇyena tātparyajñānasya bhaṭṭa- mate kāraṇatvanirāhāryam |
nahi 'asmāt padāt aya- martho boddhavyaḥ' ityākārakatvecchārūpaṃ tātparyaṃ vede saṃbhavati |
atastatra atiriktaḥ śabdaniṣṭho dharmaviśeṣa eva tātparyaṃ bhaṭṭamate vācyam |
na ca tajjñānasya kāraṇatvaṃ loke klṛptam |
ataḥ viṣayitāviśeṣasya anugatavyavahārāt ubhayādhāraṇatvaṃ aṅgīkṛtya kāraṇatāvacchedakaṃ vācyam |
tadvat ihāpi viṣayitāviśeṣasya pravṛttiprayojakatāvacche- dakatvaṃ liṅādidaśakatāvacchedakatvaṃ ca |
yatra 'kalañjabhakṣaṇaṃ atisādhanam' iti vākyāt aniṣṭasādhanatvādidhāvabodhaḥ tatra tajjanya- anumitirjanayati nāśāviśeṣaṇam |
ataḥ svaviṣayakajñānam svadhvaṃsasamānakālīnasvajñānopadheyameva viśiṣya tattadvyaktitvena praviṣṭaṃ iti jñānāya viśeṣapadam |
atra prathamaṃ svapadaṃ pravṛttikāraṇatāvacchedakībhūtatatsambandha- vyaktiparam, dvitīyaṃ svapadaṃ tu pūrvavat liṅgādisattadvyakti- param |
evaṃ ca anumititvasya viśiṣṭāpatterapi na kṣatiḥ |
tat siddhaṃ nivāraṇarūpasya liṅgatvasya anena sambandhena ā
dvividhā'pi bhāvanā niyamataḥ karmakaraṇetikartavyatā- rūpāṃgātrayasākāṅkṣā tatritayasākāṅkṣatvameva ubhayānugataṃ bhāvanāpadapravṛttinimittam |
nanu iṣṭasādhanatājñānaṃ pravṛttimātre hetuḥ, tathā ca taddinā pravartanāmātrājñāne'pi kathaṃ pravṛttiḥ iti cet |
'svargakāmo yajeta' ityādī prathamataḥ liṅ- padārthayoḥ arthabhāvanā'rthabhāvanayoḥ anvayanodhaḥ pravartanāviṣayakṛtiḥ ityākārako jāyate |
taduktaṃ 'vidhi- bhāvanayoḥ śrutyā saṃgatiḥ pūrvamīmaṃsate' iti |
pravartanātva- viśiṣṭasya ca viṣayatayā arthabhāvanānvaye iṣṭa- bhāvanātvaṃ iṣṭaṃ bhāvayan utpādayana iti vyutpattyā iṣṭa sādhanatvarūpam |
kriyāgata- miṣṭasādhanatvaṃ na vidhyartha iti etanmate viśeṣaḥ |
artha- bhāvanāyā iṣṭasādhanatvaṃ kriyāgateṣṭasādhanatvaṃ vinā na iti ākṣimakriyeṣṭasādhanatvadhīripi iti pravṛttīnāṃ- nupapanneti |
yadvākyamupalabhya puruṣaḥ kasmi- ściddharme pravartate, kutaśśraddhā nivartate sa vidhiḥ |
pṛ. 852. vidhyuttaraniṣedhe sarvatra vidhipramiteṣṭasādhanatvā- bhāvasyaiva bodhanāt dvayorvaidikatve prayogabhedena prāmāṇyopa- pattiḥ |
na tāvat sarve vidhyuddeśāḥ arthavādā- pekṣaḥ, śuddhasyāpi 'vasantāya kapiñjalānalabhate' ityādi- darśanāt |
tasyāpi vidhividheyasaṃgharūpāvāntara- vākyārthe arthavādapadanirapekṣasya stutitvesaṃgharūpātmake- mahāvākyārtharūpe arthāntare eva tadapekṣā |
arthavādāprāmāṇyena mahā- vākyārthevidhakṣayāyāmapi avāntaravākyārthevidhakṣā durni- vārā |
su. pṛ. 7. phalānto vidhyuddeśaḥ iti bhāṣya- kāralakṣitaḥ vidhiḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 4. bhūtikāmaḥ ( 'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ' ) ityevamanto vidhyuddeśaḥ |
bhā. 1|2|17 pṛ. 117, yo'sau vidhyuddeśaḥ sa śaknoti nirapekṣaḥ arthe vidhātum |
1|2|17. yatra vidhyuddeśaḥ saṃdigdhaḥ, tatra vākyaśeṣāṇirṇayo na virudhyate |
yatra tu asaṃdigdhaḥ, tatra tadvalīyastvāt va kyaśeṣavādhenaiva bhavitavyam |
vā. 3|4|12|13 pṛ. 163. vidhyuddeśāt parastāt ye hi arthavādāḥ śrūyante teṣāmapi daurbalyam |
ye purastāt śrūyante te mukhyatvāt balīyāṃso bhavanti |

3|3|12 pṛ. 406. vidhyuddeśamya arthavādaṃ vinā pravartanā- śaktatvena ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt arthavādākṣatvāpattiḥ iti āśaṅkya, arthavādābhāve tasyaiva pravartanāśaktatvavidhena arthavādaṃ vinā'pi pravartanāsyasvārthasiddhiḥ |
su. pṛ. 1497. vidhyuddeśasya pradhānatve'pi arthavādānusāreṇaiva lakṣaṇamasya upakramavidheyarthāpekṣatvāt |
1|2. vidhyuddeśasya prādhānye'prāptaviṣaya- tvābhyāṃ avagataṃ prābalyaṃ atrāhataṃ pūrvapakṣe uktam |
5|2. yatra caite stutirhyate tatra vidhyuddeśasya prarocanā- śaktirupagacchati anyatra tu avitahatatvinā vidhā- nam |
vā. 1|4|12|14 pṛ. 367 vidhyuddeśe sāmānyaśravaṇe sati anuṣṭhānasya yatra viśeṣāpekṣā 'aktāḥ' ityādau, tatraiva vākyaśeṣagataviśeṣaṇasya vidhyuddeśagata- sāmānyaśabdasya |
yatra tu sāmānyevānuṣṭhānasiddherna viśeṣāpekṣā tatra na saṃkocaḥ iti pakṣaḥ |
ṛgādi śabdāḥ svārthataḥ santaḥ na saṃbadhyante iti balāt lakṣaṇaṃ pratipadyan |
vā. 3|3|12 pṛ. 406. vidhikalpakaḥ arthavādaḥ - 'yajamānasaṃmitī- dumbarī bhavati' iti |
bāla. pṛ. 5. vidhikalpakaḥ vidhiḥ yathā - viśeṣaṇavidhiḥ |
vāla. pṛ. 12. vidhikāṇḍasya sārthavādasya atideśaḥ sāka- medhīyaindrāgnaikakapālayoḥ |
7|2|4|22 mīko. pṛ. 230 'atideśaḥ sākamedhīyaindrāgnaikakapālayoḥ' ityatra adhi- karaṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
vidhikāṇḍasya sārthavādasya vaiśva- devikasya varuṇapraghāsādipañcaparvasu atideśaḥ |
avaghātājñatvena haviṣkṛnmantropadeśe sati 'atra rakṣo divaḥ sapatnaṃ vadhyāsaṃ ityadibhirmantrāntara- vidhibhiḥ 'haviṣkṛdehi' iti haviṣkṛnmantravidhiḥ pākṣi- katā syāt iti |
su. pṛ. 1056. vidhikopādhikaraṇanyāyasya svarūpaṃ 'pravala- pramāṇavirodhe sati vidhāvapi lakṣaṇā' iti |
vā. 3|4| 11|30 pṛ. 164. vidhigato'svanaspatiśabdābhyāmeva anuvandhyā- vanaspatiyāgayonimeṣu dravyadevatābhidhānam |
10|4| 16|32-33. mīko. pṛ. 389 'anuvandhyāvana- spatiyāgayonimeṣu' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
10|4|12|35 mīko. pṛ. 2129 'devatānāṃ vidhigataśabdenaiva' ityatra adhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
asyādibhi- rūpanītāśraye paścādvidhiriti vadatā prayogavidhivaiko vidhirityuktaṃ bhavati |
abhyupeta- pravartakasvarūpasya vidherdhā tasyedhayartha karmasvarūpaparatvaṃ bhavati tadā vidhyanvayapratipattivādeva tadviṣayasya karmaṇaḥ pramāṇāntarāprāptiparikalpanāt uttpādakatvasiddhiḥ |
tadaśeṣeṇa ca tadviṣayasya phalasādhanatvaṃ vā phalavadupakārakatvaṃ vā kalpyate iti viniyogakalpam |
phalasādhane ca karmaṇi puruṣasyā- dhikāraḥ svāmitaṃ sthityadhikāro'pi vidhividheyameva eva |
svarūpeṇa ca prayogatvamiti yuktaṃ prameyacātu- vidhyāt vidhyeśāturvidhyam, vidhiśabdo hi pravartakasyaiva vidyātmānamabhipatte tadvyavānupapattevetaratra kalpa- yatīti prameyatvetyapi |
āha ca-- 'vidhāyatrī ca tṛtīyoktā prayogo yannibandhanaḥ |
ekaṃ dravyaṃ trayaṃ vā'pi kvacitkvāpi catuṣṭayam ||
'agnihotraṃ juhoti' ityutpattyaikarūpam, 'samidho yajati' ityu- tpattiviniyogaparatvaṃ asati vidhye prakaraṇaviniyogā- siddheriti prāgeva gatam |
ekasyāpyanyo'tideśeḥ yathā ca viniyogarūpe'pi vidheḥ śrutyādīnāṃ vini- yojakatvaṃ sidhyati tathā prāgevābhihitam |
soma. 6|2|2, yatra sādhyatvavāci dvitīyādikaṃ nāsti tatra sādhyatvaṃ uddeśyatvaṃ ca dravyamapi vidhitaḥ eva svargadeśagamyane |
bhāṭṭa. 1|1|6. vidhitvaṃ ayamatra pravartatāṃ ityākārakaḥ preraṇākhyo vyāpāra- viśeṣaḥ |
bāla. pṛ. 144. vidhitvaṃ śrotamātraṃ ca bhāvanākāra- śramam |
su. pṛ 573. yadā hi bhāvanālaḍhaṃ vidhitvaṃ bhāvanā yattvenaiva gṛhyate, tadā arthātu viśeṣavidhau sati avā- kyabhedaṃ kathaṃ syāt |
kintu evaṃ sati suduḥkhaparihāraniriteṣu tatsādhanatva pravṛttikāraṇamaṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt |
tataśca 'gāmānaya' ityatra gavānayanasya suduḥkhaprāptiparihāratvābhāvāt pravṛtti- hetubhūtāṃ kāryatāmabhidadhāno vidhiśabdaḥ samīhita- sādhanatāmabhidhāyī syāt |
tena kāryaṃ gavānayanaṃ kyahaṃ yathāvidhe puruṣāṇāṃ kṛtiḥ pravartate tathāvidhamityarthaḥ |
tathā- vidhatā tāvacca svayaṃ samīhitatayā saṃbhavatīti tatsādhanataiva pariśeṣyāt kāryavācinā śabdenābhihitā bhavati |

tathā ca vede'pi apūrvasya svayaṃ suduḥkhaparihārarūpatvā- bhāvāt tatsādhanataiva kalpyetati kāryarūpamabhidadhāno liṅ satīhitasādhanatāmevābhidadhyāditi naimittikaniṣedhā- dhikārayorapi sādhanarūpāpūrvābhidhānāt tadvailenāśvatamapi phalaṃ kalpanīyaṃ syāt |
nanu na sutralaṃ kāryatvam, tatsā- dhane'pi bhāvāt |
tadubhayānugataṃ kāryabuddhyāvalambanaṃ kāryatvaṃ nāma pravṛttikāraṇa- miti |
na hi sādhane kāryatvaṃ nāma kiñcit pravṛttivelāyāmuttarakāle vā pratyakṣaṇāvagamyate ityuktam |
kartavyaśabdastu ayamekopādhivaśāt ubhayatra pravartate, nad dravyamapi sādhyamānaṃ stoddeśena puruṣaṃ pravartayatīti anenaivopādhinā kāryaśabdapravṛttiḥ |
tasmāt kāryatā- nagatiḥ kriyāyāṃ pravṛttikāraṇam, api tu samīhitasādha- natvajñānam |
satyaṃ loke kriyaiva kāryatayā śabdena pratipādyate, vede tu phalakāminiyojyānuyānuguṇyāttviṣyarega kārya liḍā- dibhirabhidhīyate iti cenmaivam, kriyāyāmapi kāminaḥ kāryatāvagamavirodhāt |
nāsti phalasādhanībhavituṃ samarthā bhaṅguratvāt, iti cenna, apūrvadvāreṇopapatteḥ |
avā- ntaravyāpāre vā śaktirvā sādhanatvamupapādyate nāpu- rvam |

tathā śaktimati vyāpāravati vā'tīte śakti- vyāpārayoḥ sthityanupapatteriti cet, kimidānīṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ pākasādhanatvaṃ nāsti tatrāpi hi kāṣṭhebhyastejasāḥ paramāṇavaḥ samudbhūtāḥ sthālyudaramanupraviśantaḥ taṇḍulān vikledayanti |
na ca teṣāṃ dravyarūpāṇāṃ kāṣṭhāvāntaravyāpāratvaṃ tacchaktitvaṃ vā samastīti na tadvāreṇa kāṣṭhādīnāṃ sādhanabhāvaḥ syāt |
tasmāt yadeva yena samīhitaphalahetvāpannaṃ tadupāyatvabhūtamanantarā sādhyate tadeva tasyāvāntarasyāpāratvena abhidhīyate |
yadi caivaṃ neṣyate tato'pūrva prapya sādhanatvaṃ karmaṇo na syāt |
tadapi na karmāntaraṃ jāyate svecchayāyuttaratannānuṣṭhānapratī- kṣaṇāt |
utpatyapūrvāṇyeva kāraṇānāni, na yāgādīni, iti cet, na, asiddhatvācchabdādarthatvāt |
prākta lokavagatakriyābhidhāyitvameva teṣu saṃbhavatītya- siddhatvādyutpatyapūrvāṇāṃ na paramāpūrvasādhana-vena anvaya- saṃbhavaḥ |
na ca yajaterapyabhidhāyitvam, yenāvā- ntarapūrvāṇāṃ pratyayārthaparamāpūrve prati kāraṇatvaṃ syāt |
kiñca kāryatvamevā- pūrvasyopapadyate kṛtisādhyaṃ hi kāryamucyate |
na ca prayatnasādhyatā apūrvasya saṃbhavati, ciravinaṣṭe prayatne tadutpādāt |
prayatnena hi yāgaḥ, tato'vāntaravyāpāratvaṃ, tataḥ paścāt adhikārāpūrvam, tasmāt kāryatvānupapatterna kāryābhidhāyitvavācatā apūrvasya saṃbhavati |

tadat yāgasyāpi phala- sādhanatvamapūrvadvāre kimiti neṣyate ? mā vā bhūt phalasādhanaṃ kriyāpūrva sādhanaṃ tāvadatraiva, tāvatāpi kāryatayā tāmavagantumarhatyeva puruṣaḥ, yasmin akṛte samīhitaṃ na prāpyate, kṛte ca prāpyate sākṣādapāḍyā vā tadeva kāryatayā budhyate, na tu sākṣāt bhāvaviśeṣa- statropayogī |
avaśyaṃ ca kāminaḥ kriyāmapi kāryā- vagatiriṣyate |
satyam, asyeva tatrāpi kāryavagatiḥ, na tu śābdī kintarhi
tāmapi kāryatayā kāmī pratipadyate, iti cenna, vikalpasahatvāt |
yadi hi vidhinibandhanā kāryāvagatiḥ kriyāyāḥ syāt, tato vidhiśiktānuṣṭhānatayā karaṇāśrasyāpi vidheyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
phalaprasūtatvamapi bhavaduktyā nītyā na sidhyati, na hi phala- kāmaḥ puruṣaḥ kṣaṇikaṃ karma kāryatayā avagantumalam |
tasyāḥ sākṣātsādhanatvāyogyāt apūrvasya cāvāntaravyāpāratvā- bhāvāt tadvāreṇāpyasādhanatvāt |
tasmāt kriyāyāḥ kāryatāvagatiḥ na phalāyattā, nāpi vidhyāyattatā saṃbhava- tītyananuṣṭhānameva tasyāḥ prasajyeta |
tasmādvidhiprasūtaṃ kāmyānuṣṭhānaṃ phalāyattamicchatā avaśyaṃ kriyāyāḥ phala- sādhanatā vā sādhanasādhane'pi vā sādhyārthinaḥ kāryāva- gatiriveṣitā |
tataśca śabdenāpi śakyate eva phala- kāmasya kāryatayā kriyā pratipādayitumiti nāpūrvābhidhāna- siddhiḥ |
satyam, sā tu utpannā pravṛttikāraṇa nāvagatā |
śabdasya ca pramāṇatvādagatijananāddāraṇa pravṛttikāraṇatvamiti necchābhi- dhāyitvasaṃbhavaḥ |

icchā hi suduḥkhaprāptiparihārayoranyata- ratvadupāyādi cādhikṛtya samutpadyate, tena liṅśabdavadantara- pravartamānasya prayojyavṛddhasya pravṛttihetubhūtecchāsaṃpādakatvena samīhitasādhanatvātireva kriyāyāṃ vyutpattinā kalpyate |
tasyāṃ ca śabdāntarvāt śabdasya tadabhidhāyitvaṃ nirṇī- yate |
nanu madirāsvādasya samīhitasādhanatvadanuṣṭhānaṃ syāt ! na, prayatanena dūṣaṇa niruddhatvāt |
yathaiva hi icchā pravṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ tathaiva dveṣo'pi nivṛtteḥ |

surāpānaṃ ca mahānarthasādhanatvena niṣedhena pratipāditaṃ dveṣagocaratayā nānuṣṭhānamarhati ! yastu saṃnihitenā- lpīyasā'pi sukhenakrāntasvānto mahātmanyai nālocayati na vā ādiyate sa prayatanena rāgeṇa pratiṣikṣyamāṇacittaḥ pravartate eva surāpāne |
tasmāt samīhitasādhanatvena bhāvanā vidhinā sāmānyena bodhitā padāntarasamarpitena svargādinā nirākāṅkṣībhavatītyetaḥsvargakāmādhikaraṇe (6| 1|8) vyutpadyate |
yatra phalaviśeṣasaṃparkaṃ padāntaraṃ samāna- vākye nāsti tatra prakaraṇādinā phalaṃ bhavatīti praka- raṇādhikaraṇe (3|1|4) vyutpadyate |
prakaraṇādīnāmapyabhāve arthādādyotena phalena samanveya iti rātrisatrādhikaraṇe (8| 1|8) sthitam |
tasyāpyabhāve adhyāhṛtena phalenānvaya iti viśvajidādhikaraṇe (4|1|7) siddham |
dhātvarthastu sarvatra samānapadopāttatvā'pi valīyastayā sādhyā- śāt pratyāyitaḥ pratyāsattyā karaṇatvena niveśyate iti bhāvārthādhikaraṇārthaḥ (2|1|1) |
tasmāt iṣṭasādhanatveva vidhiliṅgābhyieyate tayuktāyā bhāvanāyāḥ phalameva bhāvārthatvestviti karaṇamiti |

kiṃ puna- staducyate ? idaṃ tāvat siddhaṃ yathā samīhitasādhanatvāva- gamitantaraṃ cetanasya svatantrā pravṛttirghaṭate iti liṅ- śabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ pravartamānasya puruṣasya samīhitasādhanatvā- vagatiḥ śabdāt saṃjāteti kalpanīyam |
tat samīhita- sādhanatvaṃ kimibhidhānata eva evāpāttaṃ kiṃ vā'rthāntaratvābhi- dhāyinā vidhiśabdena tadanupapatyā bodhanīyamiti cintanī- yam |
na hi yāgānurakto vyāpāraḥ ityarthyatetityāśayateyasmādeva śabdāt tulyā'vagatiḥ sahaprayogācca |
loke hi samīhita- sādhanatvavacano vidhiśabdaśca yugapatprayujyamānau dṛśye |
mānañca saṃkhyāmupāsīneṣu te'bhyudayo bhavitvā, tasmā- tsaṃdhyāmupāsteti |
na ca paryārthayoḥ saha prayogo bhavati |
lokepramāṇakaśca śabdārthavagama iti neṣṭasādhanatvābhi- dhāyitvaṃ liḍādīnām |
nanu etadayuktaṃ kāryamiti yadi kṛtiṃ prati |
tajjanito vā saṃskārastadyogī hi śabdo'rthamatīti jana- |
hetā ca na suladaḥ parihāratadupāyatvetikīrṇā kā |
tathā'smin pakṣe pratya- kṣāvagataliṅgaśabdādibhyaḥ pravartanāgataḥ na śabdasvarūpavi- śiṣṭābhidhāvyāpārābhidhānādiṣa iti|
nyāyavidāṃ tvida- sādhanamevābhimatam, na ca saṃvidvirodhaḥ tena rūpeṇābhi- dhānātvāt|
pravartanārūpeṇa tu śabdo'bhidhatte pravṛtti- hetuśca dharmaḥ pravartanā|

sā cāpauruṣeye vede praiṣādīnāma- saṃbhavāt pāriśeṣyādiṣṭābhyupāyatātve niścīyate tena abhidhāvyāpārapravartanābhidhānavat pravartanārūpeṇasādhanatāṃ śabdo'bhidhatte na svarūpeṇati na pratipattivirodhaḥ|
i- dameva bhagavato maṇḍanamiśrasyāpi 'puṃsāṃ neṣṭābhyupā- yatvātkriyāsya pravartakaḥ|
pravṛttihetuṃ dharmaṃ ca prava- danti pratyayānām|
evaṃ cāne- kāryatvaṃ kalpitaṃ na bhavati itarathā hi preṣaṇa
bhāṭṭa. 2182, sarvatra prātītike viśiṣṭabhāvanā- vidhine'pi phalamādyeva paṭ vidhiprakārāḥ|
vidhipratiṣedhau arthabhāvanāmeva sākṣāt viṣayī- kurutaḥ; taddvārā tu taddeśeṣaṇāni kārakāni |
vāla. pṛ. 74. vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ eva (dharme) prāmāṇyaṃ pratipāditam, na ca tadavyatiriktaśabdyamaṃ dharmā- dharmayoḥ |
yena ca nāma prāpte yaducyate tat tasya bādhakaṃ bhavati |
su. pṛ. 1012. yatra punaḥ svaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭā kriyā vidhīyate, vākyāntaraprāptasya kriyāntarasya viśeṣaṇam
brāhmaṇe yadi vidhāyakaḥ tato mantre'pi vidhāyakaḥ syāt |
mantralo bhāvaśabdaḥ vidhāyakaḥ brāhmaṇasya iti pūrvapakṣe abhidhāśabdo vyāvartyatan |
prayoga- sāmarthyāt vidhāne sāmarthyābhāvāt mantro na vidhāyakaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
ke. na ca vidhinantrayoḥ pūrvāparabhāvanīyamo'sti, ataḥ mantrasya vidhupasaṃhāratvābhāvaḥ |
bhāṣyam-- idaṃ samāmnāyate 'na tā naśanti, na dabhāti taskaro, nainā amitro vyadhirādadharṣati |
devāśca yāmiryajate dadāti ca jyogiśvābhiḥ sacate gopataḥ saha |
kiṃ yadvat brāhmaṇe bhāvaśabdo vidhāyakastanmantre'pi, uta mantre avidhāyaka iti |
tat prāptam ? vidhau mantre cā''syānamasya bhāvaśabdasya eṣa evārthaḥ syāt |
sa evā- yamekaḥ śabdo brāhmaṇato vidhāsyati, mantragato na śaknoti vidhātumiyanupapannam |
kiṃ tadvatā bhāvanā- vacanā brāhmaṇavadvidhati nena saṃdeha śabdādidhāyāḥ |
ityādahya mantratvāt prātārthattveva vidhitvātsambhavena prayogakalpi brāhmaṇavihitatāmanāyānāṃ smārakā ityuttara- pakṣa ukta |
na copātto guṇaḥ kaścinna ca vākyāntare stutiḥ |
vidhayarthavādī syātām, tadiha svarūpaṃ tāvadanyataḥ kriyāyāḥ prāptaṃ guṇaphalanimittāni tu naitaupāttāni yāni vidhīyeran |
na ca vākyāntare paryavasitaprayojane vidhau stutirūpapadyate |
tasmāt prakāśakā mantrā iti yadvyākhyāyate tatra vadāmaḥ |
kiṃ punaḥ kāraṇaṃ mantratvenā''khyātaviśeṣāṇāṃ vidhi- śaktistirodhīyate, kathaṃ na brāhmaṇavenāsāvāvirbhā- vyate |
dṛṣṭāśca mantragatā api vidhayakāḥ 'vasantāya kapiñjalānalabhate' ityādayaḥ |
tathā brāhmaṇagatā apyavi- dhāyakā yathā 'yasyobhayaṃ havirgātimāchena' ityādayaḥ |
tadeva vihitaṃ karmāntra smāra- yati codanā |
' na hyatra viśeṣe'sti kiṃ brāhmaṇa- vihitamāsādyopatavidhiśaktimantraḥ smārako bhavatyatha vā viparyaya iti |
tatrobhayoḥ anuvādāttvasambhavāt agraha- māṇavidhotvācca dvayorapi vidhāyakatvam |
brāhmaṇena niyujyante tadvatte na vidhā- yakāḥ |
' na hi viniyuktena na viṣātavyamiti kiñcinpramāṇaṃ yadi svato vidhāyakatvestva |
atha tvasau prathamameva nāsti vyathau viniyogopanyāsaḥ |
' ye ca vacanenāviniyuktāste na svarakṣe nirākaraṇahetava- bhāvādidhāyakāḥ prāpnuvantītyetadapyakāraṇam |
athedānīṃ prastūyate kiṃ tāveva dvau prakārāvutāntho- 'nyastīti |
tatra na tṛtīyaḥ prakāro'stīti matvā pūrva- pakṣavādī vadayatyarthamiti |
prayoge kriyamāṇe'sya sāmarthyaṃ vidhīyate, godāmaṃ goyāgaṃ ca pratyāyayitum, na vidhātum |
śrutyarthakalpanāyāmapyanarthakam, parimamāptena sārthavādakena vākyena vihitatvāt yāgasya |
tasmānna mantragato bhāvaśabdaḥ evaṃjātīyako vidhāyaka iti |
vā -- asti tṛtīyaḥ prakāro yadabhidhāyakatvaṃ nāma |
' mantragatānāṃ brāhmaṇagatānāṃ cā''syāna- śabdānāṃ yeṣāṃ śabdāntareṇa vidhiśaktirupagacchati teṣā- mabhidhāyakatvam |
tatra 'na naśanti' ityatra tāva- dyacchabdopahito'nuvādata prārthyate |
te naivamādayaḥ prāyeṇa mantreṣviti mantrā udāharaṇam |
brāhmaṇe tu bhūyāṃsaḥ pratyayā vidhāyakastena tadvidhā- yakamiti prasiddham |
vidhāyakatvāvidhāyakatve tu tathotheyatvameva kāraṇamiāta na mantrastvatrā''syānaṃ-vetyāpāraḥ |
na hi teṣāṃ rūpaṃ karmaṇi prayogārham |
mantragatānāṃ tu rūpamevopalabhya dāmi gṛhṇāmi nirvapāmi idamidaṃ ca karomyītyevam, bahiḥ stuṇīhi, idamidaṃ ca kuru ityādibhiḥ śakyateḥ karma samīmeti vini- yogabuddhirbhavati |

' na tāvadanuṣṭhānavelāyāmasmṛtaḥ kaści- tvadādiḥ śakyaḥ kartumityavadhāryante smṛtyā yogya- sādhanamāpekṣaṇātkiñcid brāhmaṇapadārthānusaṃdhānaṃ vā pūrvapadārthapratyavekṣaṇaṃ vā sūtragrantho vā ātmīyagrahaṇavākyāni vā upadraṣṭādi vā sādhanaṃ grahītumārabhyate |

tatrānanyaprayojanān mantrān prakaraṇe paṭhyamānān sāmānyena kimapyebhiḥ kartavyamityevaṃ prayogavacanena yadā- māṇamupalabhya yādṛśena vākyena smṛtaḥ : kartumākāṅkṣyate tadrūpā ete iha vidivā liṅgaprakaraṇānumitayā śrutyā viniyoge satyabhidhānārthatā vijñāyate |
niyamadṛṣṭasiddhiśca mantraireva smṛtyā kṛtaṃ karma abhyudayakāri bhavatītyavadhāryate |
kintu yacchabdopabandhatvādeva mantrākhyātāsyānyataḥ prāptamahaṃ bravīmītyevarūpaṃ prāyāt |
dātṛtto'pi kṣetramādicaryāyām : khasā mantraireva nāpūrva- prayatnaṃ karoti tata eva pūrvaprāptabuddhyātpādāt |
śā -- dvividhaṃ ākhyātam uktam- pradhāna+meṇāṃ vidhāyakaṃ guṇakarmaṇāṃ ca |
soma-- sūtrārthastu-- vidhagatānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ ākhyātānāṃ ca vidhāyakatayā aikārthyam, ekajātīya- śabdatvāt iti |
vi-- 'devāśca yāmiryajate ityākhyātaṃ tu mantra- gam |
' bhāṭṭa-- guṇakarmapradhānakarmavidhāyakatvākhyātādvaye nirū- pite mantragatābhidhāyakaṃ tṛtīyaṃ prakārāntaraṃ nirūpyate |
mantra- gatānāṃ brāhmaṇagatānāṃ ca yacchabdādinamabhidhāyakatvanāmapi vidhāyakatvam |
satyapi ca pramāṇāntareṇa prāta abhyā- sāt karmabhedaḥ |
iti prāpte, 'devāśca yāmiryajate' 'yasyobhayaṃ havirgātimāchena' ityādau yacchabdasya prāsi- yonakatvena svaviṣaye ajñānarūpavidhividhivattvaṃ spaṣṭam |
bodhaṃ vidhau sāmyamataḥ sa pravici- cyate ||
sa khalu śabdabhedo vā (kaṇikā- śabdā- ntarādriyate iti bhedaḥ |

tasya khalu liṅgādeḥ ayaskānta- maṇeriva vastusvabhāvajo'tiśayaḥ, yena lohamiva cetanaṃ pravartayati ), tadapāpātarātiśayo vā ( pravṛttihetutvetyete ), arthabhedā vā, yadabhidhānāt śabdo'pi tathā vyapadeśyaḥ |
( tatra śabdasvarūpasya tāvat vibhāvaṃ nipadhati- ) ' pramāṇatvadāneyamānaḥ pravṛtteḥ saṃvidāśrayāt |
tatra pravṛttihetuṃ canārthatātiśayabhavagamayan śabdaḥ codanā- tvena pramāṇatāmaśnute |
svayameva tu pravṛtteḥ kārakaḥ tāṃ pramāṇatāmapajahyāt |
na hi kārako hetuḥ pramāṇam ( mā bhūt bījādīnāmaṅkurādikārakāṇāṃ prāmāṇyam ), api tu jñāpakaḥ ( indriyādau tathā bhāvāt ) |
viṣayavattvodbhavanāca doṣa iti cenna, tanmātrasya anyatrāpi tulyatvāt ( varta- mānāpadeśe'pi ' caitraḥ pacati ' ityādī ) |
( tasmāt yena rūpeṇa prāmāṇyam, na tena codanā, yena codanā, na tena prāmāṇyaṃ tasya pravṛtti prati kārakatvāditiḥ |
pramāṇatvādite hetuṃ vyākhyāya ' aniyamāt pravṛtteḥ ' iti vyācaṣṭe - ) śabdasyātaścanya ca niyogato'vaśyaṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt |
tathā ca ' akurvan vihitaṃ karma ' iti niviṣayaṃ syāt |
nahi tadānīṃ balavadaniṣṭasalileva- nuyamānasya icchā'pi tantraṃ pravṛtti prati puruṣasya ( saṃvidāśrayāt iti vyācaṣṭe - ) jñāpakaṃ svarūpakarma- saṃplavaviṣayajñānaṃ apekṣate ( na tu kārakaḥ ) |
liṅgādi- svarūpaṃ ca pravṛtteḥ kārakaṃ ityanupayuktasvarūpatvasaṃmandha- viṣayasaṃvido'pi puṃsaḥ pravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ |
vidhiyuktavākyāntarakalpanāt mantrakalpyaḥ vidhiyathā- upāṃśuyājādau yājyānuvākyā-sūktavākādi-mantrakalpyaḥ devatāvidhiḥ |
yathā vā - ' uccādivi dakṣiṇāvanto asuryai adhvadāḥ saha te nūyaina ' iti aśvādanaphalavidhiḥ |
yathā hi ' śabdva- śabdāt pravartitavyam ' ityupayuktasvarūpasaṃbandhavida eva pravartante, netare |
na ca śabdavattvataḥ pracurabhidhāyakaḥ, anyacca vā kasyacit pravṛttihetoḥ, yena jñāpakaḥ syāt |
pravṛttiṃkāraṇaṃ ' śabdavattvāt pravartitavyam ' iti, api- tu pravartitavyaṃ iti |
prakṛtyātirikte pratyayārthe ca vidheyasya puṃsaḥ abhiprāyamede kṛtasaṃketaḥ tadanusāra- yati ( tamabhiprāyaviśeṣaṃ upalakṣaṇīkṛtya anumātumuddiśya sārayati saṃkradham ) |
tataḥ tadanuvidhāyinaḥ pravartante ( tataḥ kṛtasaṃjñasmaraṇasahakāriṇaḥ śaṅkadhvaneḥ :) |
' avi- ditaviṣayatā na anavigatasamayāḥ ( pumāṃso liṅgādibhyaḥ pravṛttiprakārake'pi ) pravartante ' ityapi mithyā, tanmātra- ( tadviṣayamātra - ) saṃgatisyāpi tatprasaṅgāt |
( dūṣaṇā- ntaramāha - ) apratyayapravṛttyāṃ ca śabdaparatantrasya pravṛttī viṣayavedanā'nupayogāt |
pralapyanerityasya iva andha- paṅguvādeḥ na vedanaṃ prayatavyam |
( codayati - ) kāraka'pi prāmāṇyaḥ ahivedanāḥ jñānamapekṣate, naivam |
nahi yaugapadyena vidhānaṃ śakyate, lakṣaṇatvena cocārayitum |
na ca avahitaḥ evaṃjātīyakaḥ śabdavāgamyaḥ prasiddhasaṃbandho bhavati |
yo'pyāha, ' abhiyeyaviṣayaṃ prati kārakahetvapi śabdo yathā śaktijñānamapekṣate tathā pravṛttiśaktisaṃvida- mapi ' iti |
tenāpi na jñāpakadamya jñānepekṣā pradaryate, jñānakārakasyaiva ' jñāpakaḥ ' ityākhyānāt ( tathā ca na sapakṣeṇa vyabhicāraḥ : iti bhāvaḥ ) |
vidhivigradasya arthavādasya ' audumbaro yūpo bhavati, ūrdhvā udumbaraḥ ' ityādiḥ kiṃ vidhiḥ kārya uta stutiḥ iti saṃdehaḥ stutireva kārya iti siddhāntaḥ |
nanu jñānakārako'pi cakṣurādiḥ na śaktijñānaṃ ape- kṣate |
kiṃmataḥ ? ( pārśvastha āha - jñānaṃ prati ) śabdasya akārakatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
( pārśvastha āha - ) kutastarhi arthabodhaḥ ? ( codaka āha - ) abhyāsāt phalāṅkurādivat |
uktaṃ ca ' abhyāsāt pratibhāhetuḥ : sarvaḥ śabdaḥ samāstaḥ |
nābhinānādhārnaḥ arthabodhaḥ śabdāt, api tu abhyāsā- dhīnaḥ |

yathā hi klṛpta kaṅkurābhighātādayaḥ anabhi- ghyāpakā api yājyājādīnāṃ abhyāsāt svataḥ pravṛttiḥ nivṛttihetu arthapratibhāsāṃ pratibhāṃ bhāvayantaḥ pravartakā nivartakāśca, tathā saṃkṣepataḥ sarve śabdāḥ vyutpannānāṃ abhyā- sānneha janmani |
abhyāsāt iti anyānajanitāṃ bhāvanāṃ abhyāsāt iti kāraṇopacārāt |
1|2|1|19-25. mīko. pṛ. 1336 ' audumbarādhikaraṇam ' ityana dhikaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam |
evaṃ sahatvavya vaktā prayogavacano'nu- grahīṣyate, ' dvādaśāhana prajākāmaṃ yājayet ' iti |
yathā yatra yajamāno guṇa- bhato vidhīyate, tatra yena kenacit yajamānena sa |
yathā ' yajamānasaṃmitaudumbarī bhavati ' ' śukraṃ yajamāno'nvārabhate ' iti |
mā. 1|1|13|40; vidhivat ' ( ' vidhivat prakaraṇavibhāge prayogaṃ bādarā- yaṇaḥ ' 1|1|16|46 ) |
yathā vidhau tulyatvāt prakaraṇastha sarvāthānyajñāni vijñāyante, na yasya saṃnidhau tadyathāni |
svārthatayā vidhermukhyatvam, prathamaśrutatvāt asaṃjātavirodhitvam, anadhigatārthabodhakatvādāptārthatvaṃ ceti vidheḥ prābalyam |
cidheḥ saṃdeha- janakatve tu arthavādo'pi nirṇayahetuḥ |
vidhivākyānāṃ phalaparyantagame kramaḥ savistāraṃ artha- vādādhikaraṇe mīko. pṛ. 610. vārtike draṣṭavyaḥ |
vidhivākye devatāyāḥ saguṇatve nigamamevapi saguṇāyā eva devatāyā abhidhānam |
' agniṃ pavamānaṃ yaja ' iti vaktavyam, na tu ' agniṃ yaja ' |
' indrāya vaimṛdhāya ' iti vidhau sati ' indraṃ vaimṛdhaṃ yaja ' iti vaktavyam, na tu ' indraṃ yaja ' iti kevalam |
vidhivākye yāvanti padāni, tāvanti pratyekaṃ mantraṃ pratipādayanti iti pūrvapakṣaḥ |
vidhivākye ekameva padaṃ apūrvapratipādakaṃ itarāṇi tu padāni taccheṣaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ |
' akṣatāḥ śarkarāḥ upadadhāti ' iti vidhivākye śarkarāḥ kena dravyeṇa acyantāḥ iti saṃśayaḥ |
' tejo vai ghṛtaṃ ' ityarthavādāt ghṛtena akṣatāḥ |
vidhivākyasaṃnidhau arthavādasattve stavanena pro- canā, yadā nārthavādaḥ tadā vidhiśabdenaiva procanā |
vidhiviparivṛttiḥ sākṣāt utpattaḥ prati- pedhikā, nānyadvārā |
ca prāgbhavīyo'bhyāsaḥ avaśyābhyupeyaḥ ityatra dṛṣṭāntamāha- brālānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ ceti |
avidyamāna āgamo yasmin asau anāgamaḥ anādirityarthaḥ |
naiyāyikādayo hi īśvara- nirmāṇaṃ śabdārthasaṃbandhaṃ samaya ityuktaḥ |
sa cābhyāsasya bhāvanāyā viṣayaḥ ityabhyāsa uktaḥ |
iti (atha pūrva- pakṣī codakamāha-) na ca brūmaḥ sarvo jñāpako jñāpakaḥ, kiṃtu sa eva netaraḥ bījādiṣvadarśanāt (sa eva jñāpaka eva |
kutaḥ ? bījādiṣu aṅkurādi- kārakeṣu adarśanāt jñāpekṣāyāḥ) |
na ca dṛṣṭaviparīta- svabhāvakalpanā liṅgādīnāṃ anupapattā, tādṛśyānu- sāreṇāpi upapatte |
pratyakṣa sahabhānāt prakṛtyā, tadanuvādāt, tadyotanādā, tatsaṃbandhārthābhidhānādā tathā samabhyāhāramarhati |

(prakṛtipratyayoḥ sahābhi- dhānaṃ tadanuvādāt prakṛtyarthānuvādā yathā eko dvau vahavaḥ iti, tadyotanāt prakṛtyarthadyotanādā yathā ‘kumārī’ iti īpratyayaḥ strītvaṃ dyotayati, tatsaṃbandha- rthābhidhānāt |
yathā ‘pacati, pācakaḥ’, ‘daṇḍī’ iti tip-aka-inayaḥ prakṛtivyatirekabhāvanāḥ kartṛsaṃbandhārthāḥ) |
avācakasya tu (liṅgādeḥ) pravṛtteḥ kārakasya sa na yuktaḥ (samabhyāhāraḥ) |
viśeṣastu na sidhyati- tyāha-) pravṛttestu pratyayena apratipāmanāyāḥ kathaṃ prakṛtyarthasaṃbandhaḥ ? |
abhidheya pratyayasya prakṛtyarthānuraktā pravṛttiḥ iti cet (pravṛttirbhāvanā) ? (nirākaroti-) na tāvat bhāvanā kāryarūpā liṅgādibhevā iti śabda- vidhivādibhiḥ śakyaṃ vaktum |
tasyāṃ tarhi tādṛśyāṃ (kartavyatākārāyāṃ pravṛttau) liṅgādeḥ kārakatvena saṃgatiḥ |
samabhyāhātistu tasyāḥ vācyaṃ lakṣyaṃ vā tathātvena (vācyena lakṣyena vā) saṃbandhaṃ udāharate, apratītayoḥ ghaṭanā'yogāt |

kāryāyāṃ tu pravṛttau na niyamanamitisaṃ samasti anabhidheyasya pravṛttihetoḥ (viśiṣṭasamabhyāhāranimitta avidyamānaviśiṣṭābhi- dheyasya śabdasvarūpavidhivādino mate pravṛttihetoḥ liṅgādeḥ ityarthaḥ :) (kāryakalpanāt iti vivṛṇoti-) api ca aśrutaphaleṣu (piṇḍapitṛyajñādiṣu) phalāvyahāraḥ, kacit (samidādau) kratupakārakatvanā, śrutānāmapi svargā- dīnāṃ phalatvādhyavasāyaḥ iti sarva eva mahimā vidheḥ |
nahi tadā śabdādanavagamyamānaṃ anyathā (phalaṃ kratupakāraṃ vinā) gamyate |
pravartakasya iti cet (pravartakatvānupapatyā phalādikalpanā, iti śaṅkā) na, tasyāpi (pravartaka- tvasya) panādirvātata ityopapatteḥ phalirūpaṃ kārakaṃ vinā |
abhidheye eva tu liṅgādiśabdānāṃ puruṣaṃ prati (prayojyaṃ pravartamānaṃ prati) prayojakavyāpāra ātmīyaḥ pravartanā |
evaṃ uktaṃ ‘abhidhābhāvanāmāhuranyameva liṅgādayaḥ’ (vā. 2|2|1|9 pṛ. 378) (abhidhāyāḥ śabdasya bhāvanāṃ pravartanāmāhurityarthaḥ) tathā ca jñāpakatvāt prāmāṇyam |

(tathā ca saṃvidāśrayatvamapi upapannam), abhidheya- saṃbandhanīyamaśca abhidheyatvāt (abhidheyārthatvapratyayā- rthamavartanayoḥ saṃbandhanīyatvāt prakṛtipratyayayoḥ samabhi- vyāhāraviśeṣo'pi pravartanāyā abhidheyatvāt upapannaḥ ityarthaḥ :), pratītapravartanā'nyathā'nupapatyā kāryakalpanā (api upapannā) iti |
nahi preṣaṇā'- dyeṣaṇā''nyalakṣaṇaḥ śabdasya vyāpāro nirūpyate, tasya

(nanu yathā ṇipratyayaḥ kārīpādīnāṃ adhyayanapravṛttyanukalaṃ vyāpāramibhadhatte tathā liṅgādayaḥ svādhyāyāreya puruṣa- pravṛttyanukūlāṃ pravartanāmabhidhasyante iti cettvetyāha-) na ca ṇijvat preṣaṇādyatirite tatsamarthācaraṇamātre liṅgādayo nirūpitapravaṇāḥ |
nahi pravṛtti prati kārakatve śabdasya sadapi tadvyā- pārābhidhānamam |

anabhihitavyāpārasyāpi tasya kārakatvāt, kārakasya anapekṣitajñānatvāt (etena vaiyarthyāt, pūrvadoṣataḥ iti pade vivṛte) (apra- vṛtteḥ iti vivṛṇoti-) upeyāpi tu śabdasya prayogo brūmaḥ, na pravartata puruṣaḥ, pravartayato'pi śabdasya anurodhayatvāt |

(atha anu- vidheyaḥ śabdaḥ kasmātte na bhavati, iyata āha-) na ca arthāntarapratipādanādyanuvidhānakāraṇaṃ svādhyāyādiva śabde samasti (ādiśabdena karaṇādiḥ, stinorgrahaṇam), phalāt pravṛttau tadaivarthyam (śabdavyāpāravaiyarthyam) |
tata eva (śabdavyāpārāt) phalavagamāt athaivarthaṃ iti cet, tanna, phalayogāt |
āte hi saṃpratyaye hitakare eva pravartayati anyathā''nupapatyā phalāgamaḥ |
(pratyayaḥ upadiṣṭasyārthasya mānāntareṇa saṃvādaḥ, tena saha vartate iti sapratyayā kriyā yasya upadeśarūpā, sā tathovedeṣṭuḥ, sa tathoktāḥ, tasmin sapratyayakriye |
