sādhyasādhanabhāvastu ayukteḥ ( svargayāgayoḥ ekaniyogasaṃbandhinorapi svarga- kāmayāgayoreva saṃbandho'vagamyate, na punaḥ svargayāgayoḥ |
) nanu na niyoge vipayaniyogasaṃbandhamakurvan ( svayaṃ ) kartavyatā'vagamāmāyāt ( tadsaṃbandhe ) rūpābhāvāt |
kaṃcit ( niyojyaṃ svargakāmādi ) kacit ( viṣaye yāgādau ) niyukte iti hi niyogasya rūpaṃ 'asyedaṃ kartavyaṃ' iti |
na ca ( svargasya yāgena - ) saṃbandho guṇapradhānabhāvādāte saṃbhavati, iti nehaṃ pariniṣpadyate, iti svargasya apārthatvāt yāgasya ( aniṣṭatvena ) tādarthyam ( svargārthatvam |
( viṣayaviniyogaviśeṣaṇasaṃbandhitastu kutaḥ ? ( yayorekaniyoga- saṃbandhaḥ tayorbhavatu parasparānvayanīyamaḥ svargakāmayāgayoḥ |
svargayāgayostu kimāyātām ? nahi svargo yāga iva niyogena saṃbadaḥ, api tu niyojyaviśeṣaṇa ityarthaḥ |
) codayati - ) viśiṣṭasaṃbandhāccet ( yadyapi na sākṣāt svargo niyogena saṃbadaḥ, tadviśiṣṭastu niyojyaḥ niyogasaṃbaddhaḥ |
iti svargo'pi niyogyamulena niyogasaṃbaddhaḥ : iti eka- niyogasaṃbandhāt yāgenāpi saṃbadhyate |
) dūyati - ) jīva- nāderapi prapañcaḥ ( jīvanāderapi nimittasya niyogadvāreṇa saṃbandhadvāreṇa niyogasaṃbandhe yāgādisaṃcaprasaṅgaḥ |
) codakaḥ pṛcchati - ) kimataḥ ? ( uttara - ) ahattvaṃ vā nimi- ttasya, ( niyogaviṣaye yāgādau ) prādhānyaṃ vā |
( tatra ) ahattve ( vikṛtau samidādivat ) atideśaprasaṅgo nimittasya ( prādhānyaṃ tu yāgaṃ prati sādhyatvalakṣaṇaṃ jīvanādeḥ nimittasya siddhasya na saṃbhavatyeva |
abhyu- petyocyate - ) prādhānye kāmyanaimittikādhikārayoḥ avi- śeṣaḥ, ubhayoḥ kāryanibhūtatvāt ( tataśca ) na naimittikaḥ prayoganiṣṭaḥ |
tathā cobhayamatra ( kāmye naimittike ca ) sarvāṅgopasaṃhāre na vā |
( codaka āha - ) niyogabhedasamarpaṇena kṛtārthasya jīvanādeḥ na viṣaya- saṃbandhaḥ syāt ( nahi asya viṣayasaṃbandhamantareṇa vaiya- rthyam, niyogyāvacchedakatvārthatvāt |

yadi niyojya- bhedasamarpaṇena jīvane na saṃbandhamarhati, hanta bhoḥ nimittanaimittikabhāvamapi na bhajeta iti cetta- grāha - niyogabhedasamarpaṇaparyasya jīvanādeḥ - ) āthattu nimittanaimittikabhāvaḥ |
( dūyati - ) 'svargakāmo yajeta' ityapi tarhi evaṃ syāt ( niyogyaviśeṣaṇaṃ kāmaḥ nimittatvena saṃbadhyate, na sādhyatayā |

nahi etāvatā niyogasaṃgatistayorna kalpyate iti ) ' yasyāmigṛhān dahet ' ( sa yajeta ) iti yathā ( yathā āhatāmegṛhedāhavataḥ iṣṭī niyoge nehegṛhe- dāhaṃ prati sādhanatāmavagamayati, tathā svargakāmasyāpi yāganiyogo na yāgasya tadviśeṣaṇaṃ prati sādhanabhāvama- gamayitumarhati |
nanu iṣṭisidhupādhau bhāvārthe niyogān phalasiddhiḥ syāt |
na tu ayamevetyuktaṃ bhāvanāvibeke ( tādṛśaṃ cet karma niyogaviṣayaḥ, tarhi tanniyogānna prāgavagantavyam |
na khalu anavagatagocaro niyogaḥ tadgocaraṃ niyogama- gantumutsate |
na ca svargāttvadhiko yāgaḥ prāṅniyogava- gamāt mānāntareṇa pāka ityevanāviḥ śakyāvagamaḥ |
na ca niyogān tadavagamaḥ, parasparaśrayadoṣaprasakteḥ, sati niyogagavagame tannirūpaṇam, tasmiṃstu sati tadavagamaḥ iti |
yadyapi yāgattvaṃ pramāṇāntarasiddham, tathāpi bhāvā- tmanā na vattu siddham |
tena ca tadiyaḥ, na punā rūpa- mātreṇa |
tanmātreṇa vā tripayatvasambhavene nāsya svargasaṃbandhaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ ) naimittike ca phala- ( kalpanā- prasaṅgaḥ, iṣṭopāyaiḥ bhāvārthasya kāmyatvat tatrāpyaviśeṣataḥ |
na cāpūrvamicchāgocaraḥ ) yathā ca asmin darśane na prakārāntareṇāpi karmaphalasaṃbandhaḥ, tathoktaṃ bhāvanāvibeke |
ataḥ svargayāgotsarvattvāt na puruṣārthasādhanajñānam, puruṣārthasādhanaṃ ca jijñāsāte prekṣāvantaḥ |
( tadanena prabandhena caturdaśakārikāvivaraṇena gatena svargayāgayoḥ parasparasaṃgatiprasaṅgāt niyogasya kāryatā pratiṣiddhā |

punastāmeva prakārāntareṇa niṣedhati - ) lokācca śrutyārthāva- gamāt na niyogapradhānatā ( niyogaprakṛti prati ) tatsiddhau aniyogāt ( niyoktureva tatsiddheḥ ) nāpi pratipattā pratyeti tām, ( niyogasiddhi niyogotkarṣāt ) viṣaya- siddhāvapi ananuṣṭhānāt ( niyogasya pratipatteḥ ) nahi ' sāmānya ' iti niyogasiddhiviviktitā vaktuḥ, api tu viṣayasiddhiḥ ( nahi anyenānītāyā garva itarastadāna- yanamāramate |
tasmāt viṣayasiddhau niyoktuniyogayoḥ saṃpratipatteḥ saṃvadaviprayasametra sādhanatāmavyavasyati, na tu niyogaparām |
codayati - ) anyaloke śabdavṛttau anyedede, vivakṣāparo hi samanavyo loke śābdānāṃ ( arthānāṃ ), niyogaparo vede |

yadi khalu vivakṣāpare anvaye śabdasāmarthya lokato'vagamyate ( tataḥ ) na ( vivakṣitāt ) anyaparatvaṃ ( vedasya ) ananyapramāṇa- katvāt ( lokapramāṇakatvāt ) śabdasāmarthyasya, ( nopā- yāntaraṃ tadavagamāya vede saṃbhavati |
śaṅkate - ) vaktu- ramāvāt ( na vivakṣāsaṃbhavo vede ) iti cet ( nirā- karoti - ) ayameva vivakṣāparo'nvayaḥ tamanumāpayet iti prāptaṃ pauruṣeyatvam |
( so'yaṃ asmin pakṣe lokavirodha- lakṣaṇasya ganḍasyopari pauruṣeyatvaprasaṅgalakṣṇaḥ sphoṭaḥ |
atha tadataramapauruṣeyatvam, tataḥ ) pratipayamāvo vā ( sphoṭaḥ, tadapāyābhāvāt |

atha svānubhavasiddhā veda- vākyaśravaṇasamanantarā pratītiḥ nāpahavamarhati, tatrāha - ) bhavantī vā pratipattiḥ na śabdanimitā sāmāyikī syāt ( svataḥ siddheve vedavākyeṣu puruṣakṛtasaṃketanibandhanā taduccāraṇāt arthapratītiḥ |
yadi tu saṃbandhabhāvāt na saṃketakriyāsaṃbhavaḥ, tataḥ ) sāmānyatodṛṣṭyā vā ( gatvādi- padyuktaṃ hi vākyaṃ arthaviśeṣapratyayanimittamupalabhyam |

vaidikaṃ ca tathā iti tadapi pratyayakram, iti sāmānyato hyat arthapratyayo vaidikādapi vākyāt ) tasmāt lākṣa- ṇikaprayogaja eva ( prayogaprabhava eva ) iti kaṇikāpāṭhaḥ ) tatrabhavato vibhramo ' niyogaḥ kāryaḥ ' iti |
( etā- vatā caturdaśakārikāyāḥ pūrvārdhe ' niyogaśabdena svābhidheyaviṣayārthatvān ' iti vyākhyātam |
atha paścārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ) api ca na loke niyogamātraṃ pravṛttihetuḥ marvasya niyogamādapravṛtteḥ, anuvidheyaniyāgācca tadbhāvāt ( tadatra- vṛttibhāvāt |
tasmāt - ) anuvidheyaṃ niyoktuḥ anya- niyogān pravṛttihetuḥ |
na ca vede ( apītyeveti ) niyoktā'pi ( dṛśyate ) |
ca nyāsati prathamameva ' pramāṇatvāt ' - kārikā 2 - ityādinā |
( abhyupagamyāha - ) bhavatu nāma niyoktā, na tu anuvidheyaḥ ( anuvidhāna - ) hetvābhāvāt |
niyoga iti cet ( śabdānuvidhāne sati anuvidhātuḥ puruṣasya hitaprāptiḥ ahitanivṛttirvā bhavati ityatra niyogaḥ pramāṇamiti cet ) na |
tasya ( niyogasya ) prameyatvāt ( na khalu prameya prameyatvena pramāṇaṃ bhavati ) niyogajñānaṃ tarhi ( niyogasya prameyatayā pramāṇabhāve pramāṇamastu ) na |
tasya niyogaviṣayatvāt, tasya ca tāmyāmanyatvāt ( niyogasya arthānarthaprātipari- hārābhyāṃ bhinnatvāt |

nanu mā nāma bhūt niyogaḥ arthā- narthaprātiparihārayoḥ pramāṇam, śabdāvagatastu artha cetana- pravṛtti vinā anupapadyamānaḥ tasyāśca arthānarthaprāti- parihāramantareṇa asaṃbhavat pravṛttiṃ arthānarthaprātipari- hāraprayojanaṃ ākṣipyate, ākṣipyate ca tadapekṣayā prameya- mapi pramāṇatām, kārakaśabdānāṃ āpekṣikapravṛttitvāt ityata āha - ) na cārthatākṣepaḥ, anarthaniyogadarśanāt ( apameva supyanyanāthāyā tatra pravartayati anātaḥ - ) ' kṣemyo'yaṃ panthāḥ, gacchatu bhavānanena ' iti yathā |

( codayati - ) padārthānvayanidhaḥ ( arthānarthaprātipari- hārāpāyalakṣaṇasamanvayanidhaḥ ) niyogaḥ ( lidādiḥ - ) niyujyate aneneti vyutpattyā loke, tasya ca ( sādhya- sādhanabhāvasya ) pramāṇāntaraviṣayatvāt tadapekṣatvāt ( pramāṇāntarāpekṣatvāt ) tanniścayanā pravṛttirloke ( anātaḥ- vākye ca niyogasya mānāntareṇa bādhitatvātpravṛttiḥ |
mānāntarāgocara - ) niyoganiṣṭastu ( padārthānvayaḥ ) vede, ato nānyapekṣā |
api ca ( laukiko bhavatu alaukiko vā, sarvathā niyoga ityeva - ) na niyogamātraṃ pravṛttihetuḥ |
( codayati - na cet pravarta- yati - ) mithyā tarhi niyogajñānam |
( pariharati - ) na vayaṃ niyoga- mavajānīmahe yena mithyātvaṃ syāt ( vedasya ) |
satyapi tasmin puruṣaḥ pravartate loke iha yasya kasyacinni- yogāt, nahi tatra niyogo nāsti |
( atha na tanni- yogaparaṃ laukikaṃ api tu viniyogaparaṃ ityata āha - ) atatparatve ( aniyogaparatve laukikasya lokādhīnāba- dhāraṇāsya vaidikasya ) tātparyaṃ pramāṇakaṃ ityuktam |
( nanu na vayaṃ niyuktikamātraṃ niyogaṃ brūmahe, api tu kartavyatām |
sā ca nirapekṣā pravṛtteḥ heturvedadava- gamyate iti śaṅkate - ) nanu kartavyatā'vagamāt pravṛttiḥ |
avagacchati ca niyuktaḥ ' idaṃ mama kartavyam ' iti |
yastu avagacchannapi anuṣṭheyaṃ nānutiṣṭhati, sa satte'pi arthānarthaprātiparihārayoḥ ananuṣṭhānna daṇḍyate |
( dūṣayati - ) tadetat avimṛṣṭaniyogarūpam ( vacaḥ, ) tathāhi ( lokānusārāt ājñādirūpita ) pravartanāmātraṃ niyogaḥ |
( na punaḥ pravṛttihetuḥ kartta- vyatā ) iti ' pravartito'hamaham ' iti pratipattiḥ śabdāt ( pravṛttihetuḥ ) kartavyatā'vagamastu niyoktuḥ anuvidheya- tvāt |
( ( atraiva jaradbhābhākoraitīyaiḥ guroḥ vacaḥ saṃgacchate ityāha - ) uktaṃ ca ' kartavyatāviṣayo niyogaḥ, na niyogaḥ kartavyatāmāha ' |
( kartavyatāviṣayo niyogaḥ pravartanā niyogakurdhamaḥ, tamabhidadhāti liṅ, na niyogasya dharme kartavyatvaṃ pravartanāyā viṣayamāha, viṣayasya viga- yiṇaḥ anyatvāt |

navīnāstu ujayanti, ' anirūpita- niyogavyāpārasyetthaṃ codyaṃ ' ityupakramya ityuktaṃ ' kartavya- tāviṣayo hi niyogaḥ, na [ punaḥ ] kartavyatāmāha ' [ iti vṛhatī 1|1|2 pṛ. 29-30 ] yāgakartavyatā anuṣṭhānaṃ viṣayo yasya niyogasya sa tathā |
tena hi niyogaḥ sādhyate, na punaḥ niyogo yāgasyānuṣṭhānaṃ jñāpa- yati |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, sākṣānniyoga eva kartavyatayā avagamyate liḍādibhyaḥ |
sa tu yāgaviṣayaḥ : tadanuṣṭhāna- mantareṇa kartavyatayā aparyavasānāt tadanuṣṭhānamākṣipyati |
so'yaṃ ākṣepaparanāmā upādānavyāpāraḥ : niyogasya āsthī- yate iti |
tadetat apūrvātmani kāryarūpe niyoge sati upapadyate |
codayati - niyogasya ) tadviṣayatvādeva hi tarhi kartavyatā'vagamaḥ ( viṣayiṇo viṣayanāntarīyakatvāt |
nirākaroti-) na tāvadayaṃ śabdaḥ, śabdena niyoga- mātrāsyābhidhānāt |
(yattu nāntrīyakādivāditā, tathā-) - nāpi ārthaḥ, sarvairniyoge'bhāvāt (kartavyatā'va- gamasya |
upasaṃharati-) tasmādidamapi darśitaṃ avimṛśya- mānasundaraṃ iti nādriyante vṛddhāḥ |
prathitā gururvaidyādau nitye'pi na na kalpate |
yadyapi ājñā'bhyarthanā'nujñā vede'nupapannā (tasyāpauruṣe- yatvena cetanasya niyokturabhāvāt) upadeśastu yujyate (tasyāpauruṣeye'pi saṃbhavāt) |
so'pi tadeva (ājñā- divadeva) preraṇātmakaśrutau loke prajñāyate |
tathāhi, ājñā'bhyarthane hi niyoktrarthaṃ anāhataniyojakaṃ karma gocarayataḥ |
anujñā tu yadyapi evaṃ kaścit tathāpi pravṛttapuruṣaviṣayatvāt nopadeśaḥ |
aprasthitasya apravṛttasya puṃsaḥ prasthāpanā codanā ityarthayojanā) |
na hi ‘gāṃ abhyāja’ (ityājñāyāṃ) ‘māṇavakaṃ adhyāpaya’ (ityabhyarthanāyāṃ) ‘kuru yathā'mimataṃ’ (ityanujñāyāṃ) ityupadeśapratītiḥ |
nāpi ‘bhaiṣajyaṃ caret’ ‘jvaritaḥ pathyaṃ aśnīyāt’ iti pratītiḥ (ājñādirūpā) |

bhūyasā cakṣa (prakāreṇa) pauruṣeyeṣu kāmārthyājñātrādiṣu ājñādibhiranākarūpito loke prajñāyate (na kevalaṃ śāstreṣu, nikṣiptadvivacaneṣvapi iti prasiddhataratvāt-) gopālādicavaḥ sa mārgākhyānapareṣu ‘anena pathā gaccha’ iti |
ata eva copadeśaḥ iti ājñādibhyo bhedena tasya pratītatvāt ‘tasya jñāna- mupadeśaḥ’ - |
1215- iti tato bhinna upadeśa- śabdena darśitaḥ (sūtrakāreṇa) |
bhavantu tato bhinnaḥ, kaḥ punarasau (namānāsamāna- jātīyavyavacchedakasya vācyamityathaḥ) ? nanu uktaṃ (bhāṣyakṛtā) ‘upadeśa iti viśeṣyasya śabdasyocā- raṇam’ (iti śabdasya rūpagato viśeṣa uktaḥ) |
puruṣārthopāyaṃ anavagatamavagamayan utkarṣādiśiṣaḥ (arthagatana viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭaḥ) śabda uktaḥ, anyathā sarva eva śabdaḥ śabdā- ntarādinnaḥ iti aviśeṣaṇameva syāt |
ato nāvidi- tārthasya (prathamaśraviṇaḥ puruṣasya upadeśāt) pravṛttiḥ |
pradarśanāyeṃ cedam, ataḥ artha-śabda-abhidhā-uccāraṇā- dijñānaṃ ca karma-kartṛ-karaṇa-bhāvanāsādhanena upadeśa- śabdenocyate preṣaṇādivat |
(pariharati-) satyam, dābdo'pi (pravartakaḥ) tatpratipādanāt (etena kārikāyāḥ pūrvārdha vyākhyātam |
nanu yadi puruṣārthopāyamidhāyī śabda upa- deśaḥ -) kathaṃ tarhi ajñopadeśaḥ ? (na khalu ajñāni puruṣāyāni api tu kṛtyarthīni |
pariharati-) ape- kṣito hi arthaḥ puruṣārthaḥ; anyathā grāmādirāpi na tathā syāt (tasyāpi svayaṃ asukhatvāt) |
nanu liḍādibhyaḥ pravartanā'vagamyate (na punaḥ puru- pārthopāyatā) parāhataṃ cedaṃ ‘upadeśo niyojyārthakarmā- prasthitacodanā’ iti |
(nanu tathāpi iṣṭasādhanatāmātraṃ śabdena pratipāditam, kutaḥ punaḥ pravartanāpratyayaḥ ? tatrāha-) pravṛttihetuṃ dharma ca pravadanti pravartanām |
nahi tathālaṃ (apekṣito- pāyatvaṃ) apratipadya tatra (kriyāsu) pravartate kaścit |
vantaḥ iti kathaṃ apekṣitopāyataiva pravṛttihetuḥ, ityata āha-) vā'pi ājñādibhyaḥ pravṛttiḥ, sā'pi kathaṃcit apekṣitaniścayatvamapāśritya, anyathā abhāvāt (tadupāyatve pravṛtteḥ abhāvāt) |
(atra kecit āmnāyaṃ prati śraddhāmānāḥ prāhuḥ-) - nanu ‘kartavye’ iti pratipatteḥ pravṛttiḥ |
kathaṃ hi tathā pratipadyamāno na pravartate ? yo hi svarnamupalabhya mṛttikā ityāha, kastasya uttaraṃ dadyāt |
(siddhāntī pṛcchati-) kaḥ punararthaḥ kartavyamiti ? (pūrvapakṣyeka- deśī prāha-) na kaścit |

(siddhāntī pṛcchati-) kā punariyama ? (ekadeśī āha-) niyatasādhanāvācchinnakriyāpratipattivanukūlā prajñā (sādhyasādhanetikartavyatā'vacchinnā) kriyāyāḥ prati- pattī anukūlyam, tatpratipatyā kārye anuṣṭhāna- lakṣaṇe kartavye sahakāriṇīm, ‘kartavyaṃ’ iti prajñā pratibhā ) pratibhākriyāviṣayatve hi kriyāpratītiḥ syāt |
saṃśayaviṣayatve hi tathā (pratibhā punaḥ- tābhyāmanyatra vyavahāraṃ pravartayati eva |
tatra vyatireka- māha-) nāhi ‘idamitya anena kartavyam’ ityanupajāta- pratibhābhedaḥ pravartate pratyakṣavagatadevapyatha |
(anvayamāha-) pratibhāneno hi lokaḥ itikartavyatāsu samīhate (kāyavacanaceṣṭāsu pravartate ityarthaḥ) |
(siddhāntī śaṅkate-) kiṃ punarasyā nimittam ? (pūrvapakṣyekadeśī uttaramāha) śabdaḥ |
(tatra ye janā vyutpannāsteṣāṃ) vyutpannānāṃ sākṣāt bhāvanāmūlatvena vā, aprasiddhaśabdanibandhanavyavahārāṇāṃ bālādīnāṃ anādiśabda- bhāvanā (aśrupetyathā), anyathā ādyakaraṇavināśāt- saṃbhavāt |
(jātamātraḥ khalvayaṃ bālakaḥ pitrā muhurmuhu- sarpiṇī jihvayā leḍhi, so'yamādyaḥ śravaṇavinyāsaḥ |
prāṇā- śrordhaṃ samīrayati yat śasitītyucyate, api codīritaṃ vāyunā hṛdayādīni sthānāni abhihanti, yataḥ śabdabheda āvirsti, tadetat sarvaṃ prāgbhavīyaśabdabhāvanāvi- bhitam |
) vicchinnaprapattināmapi ca padārthānāṃ kiṃ kathamanusaṃdhīyate (iti) vicāravikala'pratyayamupa- śaktiḥ samāviṣṭhapūrvaśaktapratibhāsena udyamānā upaśleṣaṃ viddhāti |
(atra ‘kiṃ kathamanusaṃdhīyate’ ‘vicāra- vikalatā’ iti anumānabījatvaṃ dharmasvarūpadarśana- tadgarbhasaṃdehajijñāsāpaṅkehetubhūtadharmapramāṇāntarāvādhānāṃ- bhāvaṃ sūcayati |
seyamevavijñā pratibhā bhāvanābhyupaśleṣaṃ viddhāti) tādarthyāt (pravṛttyarthatvāt asyāḥ pratibhāyāḥ) |

durjñānopāyeṣu ca prājñepi svara- viśeṣāśrayabhedeṣu pakṣiṇāṃ pūrvaśraddhabhāvanā'nugamāt pratyutpannaśabdavyāpārā (viprakṛṣṭaśabdavyāpārā) pratibhā pravṛttinibandhanam, nopāyaśānaṃ (pravṛttinibandhanam ) upadeśā'sakṛddarśanorbhāvāt |
āhāraviśeṣapratipattiśca (asmābhiratadāraṇīya iti pratibhā) tajjātīyānāṃ aviditapratipatyatvena prathamajñānanibandhanā (vinā pūrva- bhāvanāṃ) na bhavet |

jātibhedā'bhimukhyapratibhābhedānāṃ plavanādikkriyāyāṃ pravṛttaśca (jātamātrāṇāṃ cakravākādīnāṃ na bhavet ) ajñātapāyāṃ ekajātīyānāṃ ca (pārāvatoramādīnāṃ) rāgādimayī pravṛttiḥ (na bhavet ) śāstrātivirodhānāṃ (ahinakuladīnāṃ) dveṣapravṛttiḥ (na bhavet ) |
ato neṣṭābhyupāyamātraṃ pravṛttihetuḥ; api tu pratibhā ityādarthana vṛddhāḥ |
pramāṇatvena tāṃ lokaḥ sarvaḥ sammanu- gacchati |
’ (atha siddhāntī pūrvapakṣadeśinam, anantaratayā nirākaroti-) ucyate ‘na nirālambanaṃ jñānaṃ

sā khalu pratibhā ālambanavatī na vā ? ( thayapi pratibhā nirviṣayā ityuktam, tathāpi kadācididaṃ abhyupagamasiddhāntamātraṃ syānna tācchikaṃ iti matvā dūṣaṇābhidhatsamā vikalpya- tam ) ālambanavatī cet tadevavāvadavadaṃ pravṛttinibandha- nam |
( kaścidāha-- ) nanu kārakasaṃgasargīṇī kriyā ālambana- mihaiva |
tasyā apavartakavacanajamma- nyapi pratyayāyāṃ ( kāṣṭhaiḥ pacet ' ityādi ) sāmyāt liṅādiyuktebhyo vacanebhyaḥ pratibhābhedāt apravṛttiprasa- ṅgāt |
( kaścideva śaṅkate-- ) nanu nāpravartakamnivartakaṃ vā vacaḥ samasta, vaiyarthyāt |
( paraḥ śaṅkate-- ) kathaṃ tarhi bhūtānvā- gyāyino vedāntāḥ laukikavacāṃsi ca |
( uttara- māha kaścit-- ) kartavyatābhedāt pravṛttinivṛttiprati- pattiviṣayatvāt |
sarvā hi kartavyatā bhedyatī, vedānteṣu tāvat ātmatattvapratipattirkartavyatā |
loke ca 'ida- miha mithyādi pratipattavyam' iti vākyarthavasānam |
tatra śrutamayī adhikṛtya āha-- ) śabdāt pratipatteratyanteḥ punastatrāpyapārāt karmaphalasaṃbandhabodhavat ( yathā karmavidhi- vākyaṃ na karmaphalasaṃbandhabodhe vidhītaradapekṣate tadvat ) |
niścayo'pi ( ātmani ) yadi śabdāt, saṃjāta eva, anyathetat tadā'prāmāṇyam ( śabdasya ) |

arthaparatā'pi na ( vidheḥ prayojanaṃ ) dṛṣṭārthatvāt svādhyāyādhyayanavidheḥ karmavat ( upaniṣadāṃ karmavidhivat ) 'aviśiṣṭasya vākyārthaḥ' iti nyāyāt ( 314|136 ), anyathā savidhipakṣe'pyaviśitārthatvaprasaṅgāt |
na ca puruṣārthatvāya vidhiḥ prārthyate, jñānasya jñeyābhidhattikaphalatvāt, phalā- ntarānabhyupagamāt ( 'apunarāvṛttiḥ' iti hi mokṣa ucyate, na cāsau sādhyaḥ ) kriyāparatvācca vidheḥ
atha sākṣātkāravatīmāśritya codayati-- ) nanu anya- devedaṃ śabdaprabhavāt ( vijñānāt ) ātmatattvagocaraṃ jñānaṃ vidhīyate |

padārthasaṃsargārthā ca tadarthaḥ; pratyastamitākhilabhedaprapañcaṃ cātmatattvam, tat kathaṃ asya gocaraḥ ? tasmāt pralīnasakalāvacchedo'yaṃ advaitasvabhāvabhāsātmakaṃ jñānamanyadeva śabdāt vidhīyate |
na khalu phalāṃśo vidhi- gocaraḥ, niṣpannātmatattvābhāsaśca phalameva, na tato'- nyadabhīpsyate |
mokṣaḥ ( tato'nya'mīpsyate ) iti cet, na, tato'nyatirekāt |
( avicchedaḥ kasmāt na bhavati ? āha-- ) brahmadvaitaśca kargādiprapañcaḥ avidyā, taducchedaśca yathaiva ( iti avicchede'pi na pravṛttiviṣayaḥ |
dūṣaṇāntaramāha-- ) yadi ca na kathaṃ- cidapi śabdajñānaviṣayo brahma, kathaṃ tajjñānavidhiḥ vākya- pratipattiḥ, viṣayatvaśca jñānanirūpaṇam, siddhaśca ( viṣayaḥ ) tat ( jñānaṃ ) nirūpayati |
tasyāpi cedaviṣayaḥ ; tadasiddheḥ ( viṣayā- siddheḥ ) jñānaviśeṣāprāptirapyapratipattiḥ |
atha kathaṃci- tadviṣayaḥ ( bhedaprapañcavivaraṇena ) na tarhi śabdajñānā- napekṣatā ( 0 jñānāparicchedyatā ) |
pratipattikkartavyatāpara- tvācca vacanasya, ihaikā nāgamādhaiḥ syādityuktam |
kāryatvanvarahitabhūtārthatvamapi avagamayitumalamamānyaḥ iti 'codanā hi' itibhāṣya- granthasya nibandhanakṛto vyākhyānaṃ-- asambandhasametat |
( tadeva vyākhyānamudāharati 'gamayati' ityantena granthena-- ) 'yadi kāryarūpa eva vedārthaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi mantrārthādāḥ sopa- niṣkāḥ ? yasmādbhūtādikamarthaṃ codaneva gamayati |
katham ? kārya artha evamavagamyantī bhūtādikamapi gamayati' |
( saṃprati cintāmayī pratipatti nirācikīrṣustāmupa- nyasyati-- ) anye tu śabdajñānavidhānasaṃtānavidhāna- micchanti |
tasya saṃhṛtanikhilabhedolekhaviśuddhaviśada- jñānaphalatvāt ( tatra dūṣaṇamāha-- ) atrāpi nātmarūpāya- gatiḥ, jñānaprakarṣaśca asyātmanibandhanaḥ prathita iti na codanā'rthatā |
nanu ( nāpravartakaṃ vacaḥ, yataḥ-- ) vaiyarthya atro- ktam |
( coda- yati-- ) astu tarhi pravṛttinivṛttiparyavasāyitvameva sarvavacasāṃ bhūto'pyathaḥ kathyate |
tenānyatra pravṛtti kartṛ tatraiva vā, anyathā'rthābhāvāt |
aṭavīvarṇanādyaśca pravṛttinivṛttiśūnyāḥ bhāratā- diṣu bhūtārthavasāyino rūpādeva prītihetavaḥ ; prītyutpatyarthaṃ ca iṣṭasyānāni, na pravṛttaye nivṛttaye vā śrotṛḥ, itya- lamapratipadena |

śiṣyadhuktāntādīnā yathā viprakṛṣṭaḥ śabdo nimittaṃ bhāvanā''nugamāt pratibhāyāḥ, tathā tasyamevo- pāyajñānaṃ pravṛttinivṛttimukhena kiṃ neṣyate ? jātiviśeṣā- dasya śabdabhāvanāyā iva upāyajñānabhāvanāyāḥ prayo- jyāḥ |
( codayati-- ) nanu pratibhā''lambhanasya ( samī- hitopāyasya kriyāviśeṣasya ) svarūpato'niṣpatteḥ śabda- jñānātkāraṇaiva nirūpaṇā |
atīto varṇasamāhāratmako nekaḥ samasta, 'bhedadarśanā- bhāvāt abhedadarśanācca' ityuktam |
(codayati-) nanu evajātīyakameva (0 yatkeṣveva iti vici. pāṭaḥ) abhedavastubuddheḥ ekaśabdātmakamupāgaman (dhīrāḥ) |
nahi avastuṣu saṃsargasamuhālayāntasādādiṣu saṃsargo vā nānātmasu ekasvastṛpratibhāsaḥ saṃbhavati, vinā ekasya śabdātmanaḥ prayāsāt (adhyāsāt) pariṇāmāt vivartā- deti |
śaśaviṣāṇādau'pi jātyantaraparicchedavastupeṇopeyamānatvāt prakā- śāntya, anyathā (ekasya śabdātmanaḥ pratyāsanna bhinneṣva- bhedakalpanāyāṃ) ekavākyagamyena ekavākyatā syāt |
arthabhedāt bheda iti cet (uttaraṃ-) kathamanthathā (ekatvena) pratīta: anyā (nānā) |
(uttaraṃ-) prāk tarhi arthabhedamedī abhagamyate, paścācchabdabhedamedī iti na śabdaprayāsasanninimittaḥ artheṣu ekatā'vabhāsaḥ |
aviditasamūhaśabdasya ca tatvadavabhāso na dūrataḥ syāt |
abhāve śabda iti ca bhāvaśabdapratīteḥ vivakṣitārthahāniḥ |
(śakyate) atha tulye'pi śabdavivarte anyanibandhanaḥ (anādyavidyāvāsanāvaicitrya- nibandhanaḥ) ayaṃ vibhāgaḥ |
(uttaraṃ-) na, śabda- vivartanibandhanaḥ daśavidhāpālāttattvādiṣu vastvakāra- nirūpaṇā |
parākrāntameva ca bahudhā svayūthyaiḥ (bhāṣyakāravārtika- kārādibhiḥ) ityalamatiprasaṅgena |
(evaṃ pūrvapakṣaikadeśini nirukte saṃprati paramapūrvapakṣī brūte-) nanu kartavyatā'vagamāt pravartate, saiva tathā astu |
(vidvānti pṛcchati-) kena pramāṇenāvagamyate ? (siddhāntī evāha-) nendriyai- radhyakṣamīkṣyate, tatpuraḥsattvānaitaraiḥ (pramāṇaiḥ) |
(siddhāntī-) nanu śabdo'pi saṃvidapekṣayā (itarena kartavya- tāyāḥ siddhiṃ) apekṣate |
(pūrvapakṣī-) nanu niyogataḥ (pramāṇāntarādeva siddhiṃ arthasyāpekṣate) śabde'pi tatsaṃbhavāt (śabdataḥ siddhe'pi saṃbandhajñānasaṃbhavāt |
siddhāntī-) nanu itaretarāśrayaḥ syāt (śabdataḥ siddhau saṃbandhavijñānam, saṃbandhavijñāne ca śabdataḥ siddhi- riti |
na khalu sākṣādeva kartavyatāpratibhāsamāvirbhāvayati viprakṛṣṭaḥ, api tu bhāvanānugamamukhena |
tatra viprakṛṣṭaśabda- bhāvanādvārāsiddheḥ kartavyatātmani (svajñānena pravṛttyite) patra pravṛttisabhavo'tītapratyaye nāsakṛt pratyutpannaśabda- saṃvid (vartamānasya śabdasya jñānam) |
uktaṃ ca 'sākṣā- cchabdena janitā (tāṃ) bhāvanānugamane vā |
iti- kartavyatā yā, tāṃ na kaścidativartate |
kartavyatā'vagamādeva pravṛttiḥ, na īpsitopāyatāyāḥ, nityeṣu api agravṛtti- pramaṅgata, īpsitopāyatve vā nityatvānyāyāt |
bhavedihaśeṣahetuḥ ko bīja- marthena tu śrutau ||
(pūrvapakṣī śaṅkate-) kā punarye śabdabhāvanā, śabdaviṣayā (vācakatvaviśiṣṭa- viṣayā) śabda - (vācakatva -) jñānabījam, uta śabdāmihitā arthajñānabījam |
yadi śabdaviṣayā taireva anaṣṭasmṛtisaṃskāraiḥ prāgabhavīyaiḥ śabdairdharmācāraḥ syāt (tathā ca prathamaśrāviṇe'pi arthapratyayāprasaṅgaḥ |
tadidamucyataṃ pūrvaśabdarvyahṛtiḥ, dhyutpatteranapekṣaṃ bhavet idānīṃ iti) |
śabdā- mihitā (arthaviṣayā) cet tathāpi pūrvasyāṃ satyāṃ sa eva prasaṅgaḥ |
(yena) tulye'pi pratyayapāṭavābhyāsāreṣu śabdārthasaṃbandha- viṣayeṣu artha eva bhāvanābījam, na śabdasaṃbandhayoḥ |
(tadidamuktaṃ viśeṣahetuḥ ko bījamarthe, na tu śrutau api arthasaṃbandho bījaṃ iti) |
prāyaṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ vocchettu jātyantaravyavadhānaṃ vā śabdasaṃbandhabhāvanābījānām, nārtheṣu (iti viśeṣaheturvaktavyaḥ) |
teṣvapi ca bhāvanā- 'nugamaśca jātyandhavadhirāḥ tajjanamānubhūtāni rūpa- śabdaprakārān janmāntarānubhūtānākṣīran ||
(codayati-) athāpi pūrvābhyastasmṛtyanubandhāt jātasya harṣabhayaśokāsaṃpratipatteḥ kāsāñcidbhāvanānāṃ na sarvāṃsām, vyutpannavadavyavahārāt bālasya |
(siddhāntī dūṣyati-) bhavatu, kiṃtu 'pūrvasiddhivyapekṣatvānmānaṃ tatra na kiṃcana |
na tāvat liṅgadidaṃ jñānaṃ tatra pramāṇam (na padaṃ pratyayo vā kartavyatāyāṃ pramāṇam) |

tayoḥ sāmānyarūpasiddheḥ viśiṣṭāvahitatvena aprasiddhapadārtha- vākyārthapratītyanupapattyā (padārthasyaiva itarapadārthaviśiṣṭasya vākyārthatvāt) sāmānyarūpasiddhinirdhanapramāṇāpekṣāyāṃ tadabhāve prāmāṇyābhāvaḥ (sāmānyarūpasiddhinirdhanasya ca kartavyatāṃ pramāṇatvābhāvāt liṅgavākyayoḥ |
yathā ceha janmani, tathā pūrvasmin, pūrvatairapi sā (bhāvanā) apekṣitati pramāṇābhāvaḥ |
tatra ki vikalpamātramevedaṃ anādiśabdavāsanānibandhanaṃ syāt, tacca purastāt pratya- kam |
yaḥ khalu pratyayo yamarthaṃneti sa tasya viṣayaḥ- śuru iva śuddhapratyayasya |
apekṣitopāyatāṃ tadviparītatāṃ cānuyāt kathaṃmakartavyamiti pramitapratyayo laukikā- nām |
tasmāt kartavyatā'pi nānyat kartuḥ samīhito- pāyatāyāḥ |
(codayati-) kathaṃ tarhi nityeṣu nityatā, kartavyatā vā, yathāśakti cājñopasaṃhāraḥ (katham) |
tathāhi- yadi tāvat putrādi īpsitam, tatropayanīyatā vihanyeta, tadicchāyā anityatvāt |
nāpi adhikāraviśeṣaṇatā arthavat, arthasiddheḥ (vyavacchedābhāvāt anarthakatva- mityarthaḥ) |
atha mataṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadā sarvamīhitaṃ phalaṃ bhaviṣyati upāttaduritanivarhaṇam |
tathāhi, phalasya nitya- samīhitatvāt taddeśanādakartavyatā vāstavvī |
tatrāsati śabda- vyāpāre tato nirhatyaikacchidāt sarvājñopasaṃhāraprasaṅgaḥ, anyathā phalābhāvāt |
śabde hi nitye paripūrṇāṅgaṃ saṃbaṃdā ca ityasaṃbhavāt 'yathā śaknuyāt' ityupapadyate |
itarathā (vāstave nityatve) ajñānapramāṇatvāt 'yo yadā' iti viśiṣṭādidavat syāt |
nahi sarveṣāṃ samī- hitopāye viśiṣṭi pañcāvadātaḥ adhikāriṇaḥ |
smṛtitvātkathameṣāṃ ca tatkalpa- nāyā eva (akaraṇe pratyayavikalpanāyā eva) yukta- tvāt |
tathā ca yāvadī pravṛttiḥ, na tādṛśīṃ abhyudayāya (parapakṣe virodha- mādarśayati-) nityeṣvapi tannityatvaphalavattvethāśakya- nuṣṭheyānāṃ cāsaṃgataḥ akaraṇe pratyayavikalpanā (jyāyasī) |
praṣṭa- tistu teṣu akaraṇe pratyayavikalpanāt, duḥkhamātmakāt karmaṇaḥ |
(parihārā- ntaraṃ) agnihotrādimat nirdeśyatvāt viparītyavyāpi saṃbhavāt tutīyanirdaśavirodhaḥ (agnihotreti) |
( 'atha mataṃ' ityādinā prāpta pakṣaṃ nirā- karoti - ) vartametat |
ajñāntyo yathā- śakti na vā sarvāṇi cānyathā |
na tāvat ihasādhanatve'pi nityatvavihitaḥ, nityasyaiva sādhyatvakalpanāt duritaniharaṇasya |

mukhe tadeto vā kadā- cit mādhyasthyameveti (ālyādibhyaḥ), du.tatadenubhyāṃ nu sarvodvijamānasya tanni vṛttau sarvadā kāmaḥ, hitamapi ca prepatastasya pratibandhasya samīhā'styeva, tasmāt iṣṭanibandhanaḥ pāpamnaḥ kṣayaḥ sadā samīheta |
nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalanirvatvādeva 'yāvajjīvaṃ' iti śabdava- gatāt iti na nityatvavirodhaḥ, aniye sādhye sā vihanyate |
na cedaṃ vāstavaṃ nityatvam, nahi phalayādinā yāvajjīvaśabdaṃ nāmananti phalaviśeṣaścā- vā''dhīyate, kiṃtu yāvajjīvaśruteragatanityatāḥ tata e
( atatkālajīvinaḥ ) tadviśiṣṭakarmopasaṃhārasāmarthyāt, anyathā anyadā'pi ( pañcamyādī ) akurvataḥ abhi- kārātikrāntiḥ |
paścime tu ( kalpe ) nāṅgaśaktiḥ adhikāraṃ viśinaṣṭi iti sātyalaprasaṅgaḥ |

( ekadeśī- ) na brūmaḥ aṅgaśaktiradhikāraṃ viśinaṣṭi, kiṃtu aṅga- śaktyapekṣa evādhikāra iti, tādṛśasyaiva ta kasyacida- ṅgasyāsaṃbhave na prayogo nivartate iti, vaiguṇyāccāpi phale adhikārahetureva nāstītyuktam |
( ekadeśinaṃ dūṣayati- ) ko'yamasaṃbhavaḥ ? ( yadi- ) tadupasaṃhārasāmarthyam, na tarhi adhikṛtaḥ tadviśeṣaṇatvātsya |
( ekadeśī- ) kādācitkamapi sāmarthya asaṃbhavaḥ, na tenādhikāratāt paryudāsaḥ, dravyāprāptisamā- peyāṅgavaikalyavat |
( ekadeśinaṃ dūṣayati- ) satyam, na śūdravat ekāntaḥ, na tvadhikārahetuvigame adhikāre na nivartate vītāyāmiṣa phalecchāyāṃ kāminaḥ |
anyathā adhikṛtasya samarthasya svargakāmasya kādācitkāṅgaśakti- vaikalye phalānupattāvapi adhikārātikrāntiḥ syāt aprata- kālaṃ cākurvata: |
athādhikṛto'pi jātaputravat kālaśauce ( kālaṃ daśāhottarāmāvāsyādirūpaṃ śaucaṃ ca ) upasaṃhṛtya kurvan ( jāteṣṭi, ) nādhikāramatikrāmati nimittāntarya- syāśandārthatvāt |
( uttaraṃ- ) kālasaṃpattāvapi anyāṅga- saṃpattimapekṣya kurvan tathā syāt ( nādhikāramatikramate |
) atha aṅgabhūtakālāvacchinnameva jīvanaṃ adhikārahetuḥ ( tarhi- ) anyāṅgebhyapi tuhyam |
api ca paripūrṇā- ṅgyo'dhikṛtaḥ kimaṅgavikalaṃ prayuṅkte |
asaṃbhavāt ( vikalaṃ prayuṅkte ) iti cet, na, kalpanātrayapari- pluteḥ ( pariṣkṛtirupapattiḥ |

) tathāhi, karmaṇyapekṣā- tvādvā nirupāṅgatvādhikāranibandhanaprayogaḥ ( viniyogā- dānāvalagataśeṣabhāvaṃ padārthāvagame śabdābhihitaṃ ca tatkrama- manahyamāpi upekṣāmataḥ svataḥpattī niyogaḥ yāvajjīviko nāṅgahānau upatulyamarhati iti |

sarvathā prayogābhāvaḥ asaṃbhavaśabdāt: ), adhikāravaśādvā yathāsaṃbhavaṃ ( yadyapi ayaṃ paripūrṇāṅgo'pi adhikṛtaḥ tathāpi tadadhikāra- pratītisāmarthyāt tanmattvau hīnāṅgamapi samāpayati, kacidaṅgakaraṇe sāmarthyābhāve saṃpūrṇaprayogakaraṇāditi, moḍayaṃ asaṃbhavaḥ ( ), adhikāṅgopadeśānurodhāt ca yadā tādātmya saṃbhavaḥ ( ) adhikaṃ tatkālaśakyāpekṣayā yada- śakyamaṅgaṃ taducyate |

yadā sāṅgaṃ upasaṃhartuṃ śakyate tadā tasya saṃbhavaḥ ( ) tatra ubhayānugrahāt ānantaryasya aśabdārthatvāt jāteṣṭivat ' yadā ' iti yuktam ( adhikārapratīteḥ adhikāṅgopadeśasya cānugrahāt yadeti yuktam ) |
na caika eva vidhiḥ teṣāmeva prayojakatvā- prayojakaśca |
api ca kimarthaṃ vikalāṅge pravartate ? ( ekadeśī āha- ) adhikāranivṛttaye iti brūmaḥ |
sāpekṣa cet yathā'ḍa- mnātāṅgādayeva iti vaikalye vṛthā ceṣṭā syāt |
atha yathāśaktyaṅgasādhyeti ( nirākaroti- ) na kāryanigratā viśeṣāyalam |

( evaṃ puruṣapravṛtti paryanuyujya adhi- kārotyati paryanuyukti- ) api cādhikārāt phalanivṛttiḥ, tatra yathāśaktyaṅgopete adhikṛtasya tādṛśādeva ( yathā- śaktyaṅgopetādeva ) adhikāranivṛttimukhena ( taphalaṃ saṃpa- dyate ) tannimittamiva |
tarhi kāmyanaimittike'pi vikalāṅge ) adhikāranivṛttirapi na syāt paripūrṇāṅge'dhikṛtasya vikalāṅgaprayoge karmāntaraprayoge iva |
satyapi ( aṅgapradhānabhāve naimittike- kasyānbaste asya prayoge ) codanānirmittatvethā ceṣṭā- prasaṅga ityuktam |
kaścāyamadhikāro yasya nivṛttiḥ ( eka- deśinā ucyate ) ? niyogaścet, na nirvattirvicāritā |
svāmitā cet, na tanmuktaṃ kiṃcidamujñānaṃ : svāmī ityabhāvāpi adhikāro kāryaniṣṭho syātām |
tasmācca kāryanivṛtta- prayoganiṣṭhatvābhyāṃ kāmyanaimittikādhikārobhedaḥ śakyaḥ samādhātum |
yastāvat prayogatāya ekā- ntato'samarthaḥ ( śudrapañcādi- ) sa dūrapūrvadatta evādhi- kārāt |
na tvasau tādṛśo niyojyatā pratyetaṃ pāyate |
tena śakyatvopadeśau apekṣya samarthasya tāvadadhikāra- pratītiḥ |
sā cethamadhikārapratītiḥ ( naimittike ) neti paryavasitā aniyatatvāt sāmarthyasya ( anaimittikasya cāvaśyakakāryatvāt ) |
anyathā adhikṛtasya sarvāṅgopa- saṃhārābhāve ( sati ) nānuṣṭhānaṃ yathāsaṃbhavamanyathā, anyā- daṣṭo'dhikārāt tādṛprayogasya ( nyūnāṅgasya ) aśāstrīya- tvāt nānuṣṭhānamanadhikārāt |
śaktirhi pramāṇadeśa ityuktam ( śaktiśrutiḥ codanābhedasa ityuktamācāryaiḥ ) |
yadi tu na codanādeśaḥ syāt- ) na prayoganiśrayāya ( kalpyeta ) anyapramāṇakatvāttasya |
( pūrvapakṣī- ) sā kālataḥ aṅgagato vā āśriyeta, tatra aṅgagataḥ saṃśraye śabdāvagatānāmajñānāntarāṇāṃ hānācchabdacchedavirodhaḥ |
kālatastu kālāntarāṇāmaśabdārthatvāt na kaścidvirodhaḥ ( iti kāmye naimittike ca yadetyeva yuktam |
siddhāntī- ) sa ca nāya- mavirodho nirnimitte'dhikāre idam, anena, īdṛśena ( bhāṣyaṃ, karaṇena, iti kartavyatāviśeṣeṇa ) ityetāvanmātrasya śabdārthatvāt |
sanimitte tu nimittaśrutivirodhaḥ, saṃpāpte ca tasmin kāryasya tannimittatvavyāghātāt |
( samarthamasamarthaṃ cārthi- mātraṃ prati asaṃkucitatvāt śrutiḥ samartha prati niyamya- mānā pīḍyeta ) iti cet |
na ca sātyavena prayogaḥ ( prāpnoti ), nimitte kālaviśeṣavat : kartavyatā''vagamāt |
taduktaṃ ( ācāryeṇa ) ‘ na kālo guṇo, nimittaṃ tvetat ’ iti |
na guṇa eve- tyarthaḥ, na tvajñāntarāpyavaṃ ( nimittena- ) asāmyāt vacanavyaktibhedāt, upādeyāni hi ( kālataḥ- ) aṅgāntaraṇi, anupādeyaṃ nimittam |
' ebhiḥ etāni vā kuryāt ’ ityeva vacanavyaktiḥ ; ' asmin sati ’ iti nimitte |
kālastvanupādeyaḥ ( nimittena ) samānavacanavyaktiḥ aṅgamāpi san nimittamanupraviśatīti yuktam |
( śaṅkate- ) atha nimittopasaṃhāra eva kiṃ neṣyate ? ( kaścit pari- harati- ) kāmye'pi tatkālatvecchayā |
prakaraṇe'pi aṅgā- rthatvaṃ ca ( tasmāt kālavidhividhāyakaṃ prakaraṇasahāyaṃ kālasyāṅgatāyāṃ pramāṇam, na nimittatāyāma ) |
tadevaṃ avirodhāt animitte kālataḥ śakyāśrayo ' yadā ' iti, nimittavati tu nimittavirodhāt jhalavat : evā- ''gato yatheti |

( evaṃ kārikāpūrve vyākhyāya paścārdhe vyākhyātuṃ ākṣipatti- ) kiṃ punaridaṃ ( nimittaṃ ) yadihṛddhi ! kālataḥ śakyāśrayaṃ ( iti svarūpākṣepaḥ ), kasya ceti ( iti saṃbandhākṣepaḥ ), kuto gamyate nimittanaimi- ttikabhāvaḥ ( iti pramāṇākṣepaḥ ), kathaṃ cāsya naimittika- saṃbandhaḥ |
( svarūpākṣepaṃ vibhajate- ) yadi tāvat ' yasmin sati ' ko virodhaḥ ( kālataḥ śakyāśrayeṇa ) nahi kālato'pi śakyāśraye tasminsati tatkriyā ( kiṃtu- ) satyeva, atha tasmin sati kriyate eva |
( dūṣayati- ) syādirodhaḥ na tvīṭadṛśo nimittārthaḥ ( nimitta- śabdārtheḥ ) |
hetvarhi nimittam, na cāvaśyaṃ hetavaḥ ( kasyatyākṣepaṃ vibhajate- ) yadi karmaṇe nimittam, tata evaṃ karmapravṛttervidhirvaiyarthyam, anirūpitādapi nimittāt nimittavadarthāt puruṣakārabhāvāt |
tasya tasmin sati na bodho vākyādeva tatsiddheḥ |
( atha phalasya nimittaṃ tarhi ) karmaṇyeva sati ( nimitte phalaṃ ) bhavatīti |
satyeva tasmin ( nimitte ) karmaṇaḥ phalamiti cet, virodhābhāvaḥ sarvāṅgopasaṃhāreṇa |
athādhikārasya ( nimitta iti cet ) na, ( nimittāt kiṃtu ) niyogādhikāraḥ |
( dūṣayati- ) yadi tarhi tannimittako niyogaḥ, na niyogāgrimi-
( mā bhūt ko doṣaḥ ? ityata āha ) prāk- siddhanimittāpekṣaḥ sa śabdenocyate iti sāpekṣatvam |
atha niyojyaviśeṣaṇasya arthān nimittabhāvaḥ tasmin satyadhikāratvāt ( arthāccinimittaṃ svargakāmanāmā api saṃbha- vati |
na ca sarvāṅgopasaṃhāreṇa virodhaḥ tathā yāvajjīva- mityādinā syādityarthaḥ |
kuto veti vibhajate-) na cātra ( nimittabhāve jīvanādeḥ ) pratyakṣādi kramate, nāpi śabdaḥ, vidhipradhānatvāt, tasya ca ( vidheḥ ) bhāva- vidhyavatvāt, tasya cāśaktyatirekāt |
( kathaṃ cāsyate vibhajate-) tatra ( nimitte ) vidhīyamānasya karmaṇaḥ phale vidhānāt, tatra ( phale ) vidhau nimitte ( vidhā- nāt ) ubhayavidhau ( phale nimitte ca karmavidhau ) vākya- bhedaḥ iti |
yatra jāte karmaṇaḥ avaśyakartavyatā tanni- mittam |
śrutireva tviha viniyojikā prakaraṇetyā (yadyapi śrutitvenabhedaḥ tathāpi pratyakṣaśrutiḥ atiriteya- bhīyate, prakaraṇetyādiśrutau tanmūlatvāt prakaraṇaṃ vini- yojakamucyate iti bhedaḥ |
) nanu śrutyādayaśca (cakāraḥ evakārārthaḥ) viniyojakāḥ, kimatra vidhinā ? naitat, tādarthyaṃ hi viniyogaḥ, tacca vidhaiḥ |
saṃvandhaśca āśrayāśrayibhāvādireva- vidhaḥ, pārārthyaṃ tu (saptatvalakṣaṇastu saṃvandhaḥ) vidhaiḥ |
(praśnaḥ -) kathaṃ tarhi śrutyādayo viniyojakāḥ ? (uttaraṃ -) vidhinā pratipādyamānapārārthyaḥ (avaghātādiḥ) yasya śrutyādibhiḥ saṃvandhitayā'vagamyate, tadarthaḥ (trīhyā- dyarthaḥ) iti pratyāyāt |
yā ca svarūpaparatā sā bhedalakṣaṇe cintitā tadāyata- tvādbhedasya, svarūpaparo hi vidhirbhavati karmabhāvanām |

tatparatā ca ekaśabdopādāne'pi bhāvanāmni prakṛti- pratyayayoḥ paurvāparyyamāt prakṛtyarthākṣepeṇa pratyayena artha- syāmidhāyāḥ kṛtānuvandha (pratyayārthe) pratīyamāne śabdā- ntaratvāt śuddhe (bhāvanātmani) alabhyamāne dhārtvartha- viniyogaparatvānupapatteḥ ekasyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ nānādhātvartha- viniyogaparatvānupapattau naikasyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ nānādhātvartha- viniyogakābhāvāt kṛtsno veda ekaṃ vākyaṃ ekaṃ cāpūrva- miti |
saṃbhyāto bhedamāha -) 'tisra āhutīḥ' 'samadaśa' iti tu svarūpapatve'pi saṃbhyāto bhedaḥ (bhāṣyakāreṇa tu 'samadaśa prājāpatyān paśūn' ityādāha iti tadapyupapadyatam |
(pūrvakarmāsaṃbhāno guṇādapi bheda ityāha -) guṇo'pi pūrvasaṃyogāt viniyogamātraparā nivāryyastatpa- tāmeva āvahati |
saṃbhyāpi pūrvavṛddhicchedena sahava- dakṣiṇatvādiguṇaviniyogamātraviśeṣeṇa apūrvabuddhiprasṛtā ca tadevaṃnayati |
saṃnidhau tu tadavicchedāt (pratya- bhijñānācchidāt) na tātparyya (na svarūpaparatvaṃ) ityeva- vicchedaḥ (viniyogamātraparatvam |
) evaṃ ca karmaṇo vidheyatvaṃ tadadva upoddhātaḥ |
(uttaraṃ -) satyam, ( 'paurṇamāsyā paurṇamāsyā yajeta' ityādi -) prayogaviceṣṭasiddheḥ (anuṣṭhānasiddheḥ) viniyogamātraparametat (avahanyādi- vākyam |
) yathoktaṃ 'evaṃ sati aṅgavidhiranuvādaḥ' : 'na cāvihitamaṃ bhavati ityaṅgatvāya vidhātavyaṃ' iti |
tatra śrutyādinivandhanatvādinīyogasya pravartanamātratvādidheḥ dravyādideva śapalaṃ iti vidhiviniyojakaḥ |
iti pūrva- pakṣayitvā pravartanāmātramapi aviniyojakatve durlabhamiti 'asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyān' (6|1|12) iti vakṣya- mānarītyā viniyogaśaktiruktā (vidheḥ |
vidhi- śreviniyojakaḥ akāraṇaṃ śrutyādīni ityāśaṅkya uttaratra śrutyādisaṃpakṣatvamabhihitam |

tatra kasya kratuvidhito'nuṣṭhānam, kiyati (ajñātāṃta) anuṣṭhānapathāpāraḥ kratuvidhaiḥ, kasya vā'na- pekṣitatadvidhinirgātāraḥ puruṣasya (anapekṣitatā) iti prayojakāprayojakacintā'pi kratvanuṣṭhānavidhivyāpārapara- māṇamavadhāryate |
tathāhi, āmiṣātvena cāgnāma- prayogavidhividhānyaṃ anuṣṭhāyati, na vājināthatathā, tadarthā- (āmiṣāṇāṃ -) tu niṣṭhapranasya tadanupraveśi- tvāt (vājinasya |
tathā puroḍāśaśeṣasyaiva kapālasya tṛpoṣa- vāpamukhena tatsaṃpattyā (nopavāpāthaṃ pṛthagnuṣṭhānaṃ iti pareṇa saṃvandhaḥ) |
uttarārthasya ca (sviṣkṛdarthasya) eka- deśatvāt upāttaikadeśapādayasyaiva tatsaṃbandhāt na pṛtha- ganuṣṭhānamiti |
satyapi ca vidhyadhīnānuṣṭhānatve parṇamayītvasya kratuprayogavidhiva- viṣayatvāt puruṣārthatvam |
pradhāne tu yadyapi vidhitaḥ pravṛttiviśeṣarūpā, sāmānyarūpā tu puruṣe sā ityetatā puruṣārthaḥ |
ajñāpekṣā tu karaṇājñātā parācīnā tajjñānaṃ ca vice- iti sāmānyato'pi (na kevalaṃ viśeṣataḥ) pravṛttestadā- yattatvāt ajñe kratvarthaḥ |
(śaṅkate -) idaṃ tarhi kathaṃ (bhāṣyoktaṃ -) 'prayojakaḥ kaścit puruṣārthaḥ ; aprayo- jakaḥ kratvarthaḥ' iti |
(pṛcchati -) kimatra katham ? (codakaḥ -) prayojye hi atra kratvarthapuruṣādyuktāt, tathaiva vaktavyaṃ 'prayojyaḥ kaścit puruṣārthaḥ ; kaścit kratvarthaḥ' iti |
(pariharati -) naiṣa doṣaḥ, puruṣārthaḥ kratvarthaḥ iti samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ, puruṣaḥ arthaḥ (viṣayaḥ āśrayaḥ kāmanimittayoḥ ; kratuḥ arthaḥ viṣayaḥ kratuvidheḥ :) iti vigrahāt |
etaduktaṃ bhavati, kasyacit kaścit puruṣaḥ kiṃcit prayojyamityarthaḥ |
(kasyacit karmaṇaḥ kāmyasya naimittikasya vā kaścit puruṣaḥ kāmi nimitta- vān vā prayojakaḥ, kiṃcit karma kāmyaṃ naimittikaṃ vā kasyacit kāmino nimittavato vā prayojyamityarthaḥ |
kratuvidherapi kiṃcit prayojyam, kiṃcit aprayojyaṃ yathā āmiṣāvājinādyaṃ dravyayānam |
) sūtre tu puruṣecchādhīnapravṛttiḥ puruṣārthaḥ ; kratuvidhedhīnapravṛttiśca kratvartha iti |
) tatra 'yasmin prītiḥ' (6|1|12) iti phalāṃśa anuṣṭhānaṃ na vidhita iti darśitam |
punaḥ kratva- naṅgatvena tadaṅgatvena ca kratuprayogavidhivyāpyatvāvipaye śeṣalakṣaṇena (diśite bhavataḥ |
ata eva (sāmya- naipamyavicārakam bhāṣyakāraṇaṃ -) uktaṃ atikrānta- stutīyavigraha iti |
pañcame tu kiṃ cintyate ? nanu kramaḥ (cintyate,) kena pramāṇena ? (uttaraṃ -) śrutyādibhiḥ |
'codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ' ; sa ca caturlakṣaṇa eva (vidhicāturvidhyāt) ityuktam |
na hyeṣa prayogavidhiṣeviṣayaḥ ; anuṣṭheya- tvāt, aśābdatvāt, kramavadvyatirekeṇa idamanvādi- rūpatvāt |
padārthā hi krameṇa anuṣṭhīyante na tu kramaḥ |
syācca tāvat śrute kramaniyame taparo vidhiḥ |
tathā ca prayogavidhiviṣayatvāt na codanālakṣaṇatvamantarte kramaḥ |

(evaṃ prameya pari- śodhya vintrātsvarūpamādarśayati -) tatra prathamaṃ kramavadvyati- rekeṇa idantā'nirūpitatvāt aprayojyatāmaviniyojyatā- manupātyāt ca matvā vidhiviṣayatvamāsādyakrama prayogavidhi- viṣayatā darśitā |
uttaravarṇakena tu udāharaṇaśuddhiḥ kṛtā dīkṣāpadārthasya prāpteḥ |
anabhivyeṣyāpi kathaṃcitpratīya- mānasya viśiṣṭakramānuṣṭhānasya vidhyarthatvāt kartṛviśeṣavidhī adhvaryusaṃvandhasya ānarthakyāt anekārthavidhito vākya- bhedāt |
dīkṣāpadārthasya tu pratipradhānānuvṛtteḥ anuṣṭhānaviśeṣa- viśeṣaḥ kramaḥ |
) 'tadvidhau' 'na gataḥ pāvayati' iti prati- ṣedhāt (nanu adhvaryupuruṣā vahavaḥ iti teṣāṃ pratipratyā- vidheya vacanaṃ bhaviṣyati ityata āha -) itaramanyasteṣāṃ yato viśeṣaḥ syāt (3|8|10|22) iti |

arthādiṣu tu yadyapi padārthaparo vidhisyāpi tadrūpaprayojanāpekṣau (anu- ṣṭhānaviśeṣaṃ kramaṃ pratipādayati iti pareṇa saṃvandhaḥ -) svādhyāyavidhi-pratyāyita-pāṭhakramaniyama-prayojanāpekṣaṃ (svādhyāyavidhiprayāyito yaḥ pāṭhakramaniyamaḥ tadaprayojanaṃ ca tadapekṣaḥ prayogavidhiḥ ityarthaḥ |
pravṛttikramamāha- ) niśītaṃ ca kramamanurudhyamāna: svāgataṃ ca sahabhāvamatvanmatvābha- māna: anuṣṭhānaviśeṣaṃ pratipādayati iti prayogāṅkameva |
( uttaraṃ- ) satyam, prayojyattā (prayojyā ye padārthāsteṣāmityātsarūpa: ) prayogāṅkaścintitā: |
kramastu na tathā- ) aprayojyastu krama: prayogaviśeṣa eva |
ata: pūrveṇasiddhe: anuṣṭhānaviśeṣacintayeti iti bhidyate lakṣaṇārtha: |
paṣṭhe tu adhikāraśo nirūpyate sarvāṅgopasaṃhārasamarthasya utetarasyāpīti, śakte: śāstrīyatvāt śālīyāśāstrīyatvā- bhyām |
( pūrvapakṣamāha- ) tatra yathaiva apekṣitasādhanatvaṃ pravṛttiheturnaitarat tathā śakyatvamapi ( lokata evānvaya- vyatirekābhyāmavagatamiti ) |

śakyaṃ ca śāstrāt pratītaṃ karma pramāṇāntaravirodhena yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vyavasthitte ( yo yāvanta dākrotpapasaṃhataṃmajñāni tasya tāvadviredādvai: tat pradhānaṃ śakyamamitatasādhanamiti ) iti sarvādhikāra ukta: |

( siddhāntamupakramate- ) pramāṇāntaraviṣayatvāt ( tuśabda: pūrvapakṣaṃ vyāvartayati ) ścettarāṃśe: śāstrasyārthavattvāt vidhi- rūpāṃgatāyā api na śāstrārthatā ( prāptatvāt ) vidhivi mānāntaragamyādityapekṣa: śabdena pratīyate |
anyathā ( śāstrasya śaktiviṣayatve ) sarva: sarvā- ṅgopasaṃhārasamartha: syāt, kuto yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vyavasthā |
lakṣaṇapramāṇāntarasiddho ya: padārthasvarūpaviśeṣopāyapratipatti: ( padārthasvarūpaviśeṣa: śakyatālakṣaṇa: tadupāyapratipattirasya śāstraviṣayasya sa: ) ananyagocara: śāstraviṣayayo'nupamānīya: |
tathā ca ( śakyatāgrāhiṇi niyāmake pramāṇe sati ) nāśakatvasya pravṛttihetukartṛkatvāditi |
nāsamarthasya pravṛttau gamyate iti samaryādhikāra: ( sidhyati ) |
sati cādhikāre sa kasyeti sa eva purastāt pratipādita: |
kathaṃ punastasya abhāva: śaṅkita: ? iha kecet ' sādhyatvāt karturājñāyatevyāpārā: siddhasādhanā: |
kriyaiva hi ( sādhyarūpā ) bhādhyate, svabhāvasiddhaṃ ( tu ) dravyaṃ ( tāṃ prati ) guṇaṃ ( svargādi ) iti vadanta: phalasyāsamanvayaṃ vākye manyante |
tathā ca phalābhāvādhikārābhāva: , nahi aphaleṣu karmasu kaścidyojya: svāmī vā |
( noda- yati- ) kathaṃ punarasanvaya: phalasya ? ( samādhatte- ) karmaṇa: ( dhātvarthasya ) sādhyatveti: , dvayo: sādhyayo- rasamvāyāta |
tathāhi, yadi yāgādaya eva kriyā: te eva pūrvaparībhūtā: pradhānatamā gamyante ( na tadā bhādhyāntarāpekṣā'sti ) |
athāpi tadatirekī kriyā, sā ca sakarmikā bhādhyapradhānā, tathāpi tatra ( yāgādaya: , na tu phalam ) |

kuta: ? paurvāparyaniyamāt, pratyayasya prakṛtyarthāmisaṃvanadhisārthābhidhāyitvāt ( dhātvarthasya ca- ) sādhyatvena pratīte: , anyathā ( dhātvarthasyāsādhyatve ) dravya- guṇaśabdāviśeṣāt ( aviśeṣaprasaṅgāt ) |
anabhyupa- gamācca ' yepāmṛtyo ' iti ( 2|1|13 ) sākṣā- tkarmārthāisaṃvanadha: ( dhātvarthasya sādhyatvaṃ ) kāṣṭhe: pacati ' iti |
nanu karmāttarābhisaṃvanadhāt ( kāṣṭherodanaṃ pacatīti ) naivaṃ syāt |
na, karmaṇyapi kārakasmṛte: kārakatvena kriyā'nvayāt ( kha- ) śabdena bhūtayopā- dānāt, īpsitatamatvaṃ tu pramāṇāntaraviṣaya: |

tathā ca dṛṣṭaphaleṣu ( odanapākādiṣu ) astu phalavattā, yāgā- diṣu tu na phalaṃ svargādi:, tathā asamanvayāt mānā- ntarasya cābhāvāt, evaṃ ca ' tāni dve ' ityuktam ( 2| 1|16 ) ( keṣāṃcit karmaṇāṃ phalāgāṃ sādhyatvena pradhānatvaṃ jyotiṣṭomaprayājādīnām, keṣāṃcca mānāntarasiddhatvā- nāmabhavatāni phalaṃ prati guṇatveneti ) |
anyathā ( sarveṣāṃ phalavattve tu ) ekaivyameva syāt ( ekarūpataiva syāt |
prameyaṃ pariśodhya sūtramatra yojayati- ) evaṃ tāvat ' dravyāṇāṃ karmasaṃbandhe ( karmasaṃyoge ityanyatra pāṭha: )
vastutaśca na saṃvandhatvena ( saṃvandha: phalatvena ) puruṣaprayatnasya ( bhāvanāyā: ) yāgādiviṣayatvāt svargādya- saṃvandhāt |
( śakyate ca puruṣaniyogāt ' svargaṃ kuryāt ' ityanupapatte: , avadyaka- tavyatāprasaṅgācca, phalasya cāviyaitatvopamāt, yāgādeśca vivaiyatvaśravaṇāt |
pravṛttiviṣayo hi vidhi: ( pravartanā- rūpatvāt ) na sākṣāt yāge phale vā |
pravṛttiśca bhāvanā, yadviṣayāyāśca pravṛtterhetu: śabda: sa vidhirityucyate |
tatra ākhyātopādānā bhāvanā nāmnaiva yā vidhīyate ( dvitīyā ca bhāvanā nāstyeva yā phalaviṣayā vidhīyate ) |

satyāmapi bhinnabhāvanāyāṃ na bhāvanākarmaṇorgāphalyora- samavāya: , na vidhisāmarthyāt anyadapi phalaṃ tasyāpyevaṃ samavāyāt vairūpāt sāvanabhāvasya duravabodhatvāt ( tasmāt sādhanabhāvo duravabodha: mādhyatvena śratasya yāgasya ) |
nāthāpattista: ( yāgāde: phalasādhanatvāva- gati: ) codanālakṣaṇatvahāne: , tasyā: sādhyatvaparyava- sānāt |
aphalasya karmaṇo loke sādhyatvādṛṣṭe: , sādhana- tvasya ca sādhyatvapura: saratvāt arthāt tadākṣepayogāt |
ākṣe- pe'pi sidhyathaṃ karturūpasya ( setu: ) kāraṇatvābhāvāt |
kathaṃ tarhi idānīṃ vidhi: ? ( pūrvapakṣī- ) kimatra katham ? pravartanāmātrāṃ vidhi: na puruṣārthatā spṛśati |
kuta: ? pratīteravyabhicārāt ( pratīteriti citroṇati- ) tathā ca liṅādibhya: preraṇā'vagama: |
yadyapi ca iṣṭa- sādhanatā pravṛttihetu: , śabdastu anāmuṣṭatadrūpa: pravṛtti- hetumātramabhiniviśate tadākārāvabodhāt |
( anyabhi- cāraṃ citroṇati- ) maivādiṣu ca tadabhāvāt ( abhimata- sādhanatvābhāvāt ) pravartanāmātrācca nānyabhicārāt |
( yadyacet kvacit preraṇā, kvacidreraṇā, kvacidabhi- matasādhanatā liṅartho bhaviṣyati, ityata āha- ) anekārthatvadoṣāt ( na khalu pravartanāmātrātve saṃbhavati anekārthatā yuktā ) |
na ca tadrūpovādeva taddoṣā: ( na ca tatra avopādeva abhimatsādhanatā bodhaheturityartha: iti tu kaṇikā ) |

( mīmāṃsakaidadeśī āha- ) nanu evamapi pravartanāyā: pravartaviśeṣaviṣaya- tvāt tasyaiva pūrvamapekṣaṇāt svargakāmādipadānāṃ ca tatsamarpaṇābhyārthyāt sa eva ( pravarta eva ) tai: samapyate, na sādhanaviṣaya: |
( pūrvapakṣī- ) kimata: ? ( ekadeśī- ) kāmino'dhikāra: pratipadyo bhavati |
( abhyupagamāccyate- ) evaṃ nāma, na tu pravṛttisiddhe: |

evamapyatra puruṣa: svabhāvato rāgādyāviṣṭo dṛṣṭaphale- rūpārtheviyopārjanaṃ pravartamānastadādisamanā: tatpakṣapātā na vigalitaviṣayaprapañcamātmatatvamupadiṣṭaṃ pratyetuṃ ( niśretuṃ ) paribhāvayituṃ ( nidadhyātsyati ) vā alam |

karmopa- deśastu anuṣṭhe: kṛtakāminirbahaṇa: svābhāvikā: pravṛtte: nivṛttaḥ śāstrīyāyāṃ karmapravattau vyavasthito dānta: ( kāmitvādhimatana ) śaknoti tādṛśamapi ātma- tattvamupadiṣṭaṃ pratyetuṃ paribhāvayituṃ ca |
evaṃ ca śāstratvaṃ niyojyānāṃyojanānāṃ hitopadeśādvā ( ātmajñānādhi- kārasiddhaprayojanakatvaṃ jñānopadeśādityartha: ) |

kāme tu ( kāmyamāne svargādau ) sādhye rāgābhiniveśāyāṃ svābhā- vikyā pravṛttau upāyadarśanaṃ svahastadānāta śabda: śāstratā- mativartate, nahi tadā puruṣo'nutiṣṭhe: syāt, svacchanda- ceṣṭāyāṃ tvanujñāyeta |
athāpi hitamupadiṣṭacchāstraṃ tathāpi prakṛtyā du: khānutkeṣu kāmyeṣu upāyadarśanena pravartanaṃ na hitopadeśādau syāt |
nanu evaṃ jñānavidhirapi anuṣṭhānamātrameva syāt ; na jñānasya dṛṣṭārthatvāt svabhāvataśca guṇabhūtatvāt saṃmārgaṭi- vana |
imameva nārthamabhipretya ' kartavyaṃ sukhavān, akartavyo du: khavān ' ityādyuktam |
etadartha: ( ukta- bhāṣyasya- ) svargāde: kṣaṇikatvāditu: vānupāt tada- pātro yāgo du: khatathā na kartavya eva syāt, pralīnāśeṣa- du: khaprajñāvabhāsaprayojanam numvaphala: kartavya: |
na ca 'vāgaṃ kuryāt' ityevaṃ yathā'dhikārastathopapattirvā vakṣyate ||
( evaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā siddhāntamāha - ) atrocyate, 'viśeṣā eva śabdārthā dṛṣṭarūpānye'pi hi |
preṣaṇā'kṣepaṇā''kṣepa- deśānāṃ tu viśeṣāmeva loke pratīyate ; mohādibhedā- ntrāvagataśca |
anyathā ( tācchīlyavidyuccanā- bhāve ) kartṛprayogapratītiprasaṅgāt ( kartṛmāne prayoga- prasaṅgāt ) |
nāpyupādhayo na śabdārthāḥ ( upadeśādayaḥ ), apratītānāmabhedakatvāt, anyasya pratyayahetutvāt |
'tadantastattvādvācyaḥ samānaśabdo'yam' iti ca ( kātyā- yana - ) smaraṇāt |
tatra yaḥ samānaśabdaḥ sa samānādhikaraṇopādhiḥ sa tadantavācyaḥ pratyayāntavācyo hatihariṣvādiḥ |
na tu asamānaśabdaḥ asamānādhi- karaṇaḥ 'gārgikayā strāvate' ityādiḥ |
nahi 'gārgi- kayā' iti śvādhyādhikāravihite tuni tadantena asamānādhikaraṇaḥ ( ṇa - ) gārgikayā strāvatā abhi- dhīyate ityarthaḥ |
nanu tadasyā eṣopādhayaḥ na punarabhidhā- viniveśina ityataḥ āha - ) golyādīnāmapi upādhi- tvāt ( anyathā ) sat ityeva śabdārthatvaprasaṅgāt |
sāmānya- codanāyā viśeṣaparatvāt viśeṣa eva pratipādyaḥ |
sa ca yaḥ kaścit, sarvo vā, kaścideva vā, sarvathā tu viśeṣapratyayastamena sāmānyabodho'rthavān |
tatra iṣṭaccha- kṛtyanapekṣaṇāṃ abhiprāyamātravidhāvinā tadapekṣāṇāṃ ca tadānukūlyamapekṣamāṇānāṃ pravṛttihetaḥ preṣaṇā''kṣepaṇā- 'bhyupagamāḥ apuruṣabuddhiprabhavāḥ ( codanāyāḥ ) na prati- pādyāḥ |
te hi pratipadyamānā apravṛttihetava iti pravartanā'vabodho vihanyeta, viparyaya eva syāt |
neṣṭā ( iṣṭasādhanatā iti kaṇikāyām ) karmaṇi ( pravṛttihetuḥ ) pratyakṣaviro- dhāt |

tasya ca hetudvayābhāve ( kāraṇadoṣa- vācakapratyayābhāve ) anuktvāt, taduktaṃ 'asādhakaṃ tu tādarthyāt' iti ( 6|1|12 ), bhavedasādhakaṃ karma sādha- yitāraṃ nādhiyacchet anadhikāri syāt ityarthaḥ, tāda- rthyāt pravartanāmātrādyarthatvāt ( vidhi - ) śabdasya prīti- sādhanatvānavagamāt, prītyarthatvācca puruṣaprayatnānām |
sarvaviśeṣa- pratyayatvameva nāsādhakaṃ vākyaṃ syādabodhaka avidopārthatvāt sāmānyacodanāyāḥ ||
satyam, āśā- diko nopadeśaḥ ( prayoktṛdharmo vede ) |
nanu upadeśo'pi anugrahābhiprāyatmaka iti na prayoktṛdharmatānirvartate |
ājñā'bhyarthanayorhi karmaṇaḥ sāmarthya anapekṣamāṇaḥ tadiśeṣaṃ ( tasya karmaṇaḥ prayojanaviṣayaṃ viśeṣaṃ ) anādriyamāṇaḥ tadabhiprāyyānurodhedeva kiñcit samīhamānaḥ abhiprāyyānurodhe pravartate |
upadeśe tu satyapyanugrahābhiprāye vamenaḥ samīhitaśaktya- bhāve na pravartate |
karmaśakti svavabudhya ( upadeśeṣu ) apratārakamātreṇa vipralambhakanimittābhāvena satyārtha- vacanāt asatyapi anugrahābhiprāye vaktuḥ pravartate |
tasmā- dupadeśe tu satyapi anugrahābhiprāye : śabdārthaḥ, anu- matādhanatā tu karmaṇaḥ ( iti mūlapāṭhaḥ |
tasmādupadeśa- pravṛtteḥ pravṛttiviṣayasamīhitasādhanatvābhāvābhāvāt vidhānāt abhiprāyyānuvidhānācca nānugrahābhiprāyaḥ śabdārthaḥ, abhimatasādhanatā tu karmaṇaḥ śabdārthaḥ - iti tu kaṇikā ) |
( śaṅkate - ) tatpratipādanaṃ ( abhimatasādhanatā'prati- pādanaṃ ) nānugrahābhiprāyantareṇa iti cet ( nirā- karoti - ) na, madhyasthasyāpi prakṣādidarśanāt |
na caivaṃ tāvatā śabdārthatvaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ jñātārthatvaprasaṅgāt |
pravartanaiva nodeneti tasyāḥ śabdārthatvāt ) prameyaiva syāt codanā, pramāṇaṃ cepyate 'codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ' ityabhidhā- nāt |
tasmāt śabdena pramāṇāramanā abhidheyaḥ pravṛtti- pratipattikāvyebhyaḥ kriyāviṣayaḥ pratipannasyaḥ svasaṃbandhaḥ pravṛttihetutthaśraudanā |
pravṛtti- hetorvākyasya codanātvābhidhānāt 'codaneti kriyāyāḥ pravartakaṃ vacanaṃ' iti ( bhāṣya - 1|1|2|1 ) |
yatra cāsya prāmāṇyaṃ ( abhidheyasyeyate, ) śabdasyaiva tamāstu kima- nenāntargaḍunā ( pramāṇarahitena ), nahi tatra śabdasya kaścidvirodhaḥ |
padārthāntaratva prāmāṇyamastu vyartha viśe- ṣaṇā - ( viśeṣā - ) bhidhānam |
( saṃprati viṣayaṃ vicārayati - ) ka cāsya prāmā- ṇyam ? viṣaye ( yāgādau ) cet, na, pramāṇāntarasiddheḥ |
apūrvasyāpi ca saṃsargasya lokavat tadabhāve'pi pratipatteḥ |

anumānaṃ ca na svāyepratipatyā ( gṛhītasaṃbandham ), tasyāḥ ( pratīteḥ ) aliṅgatvāt liṅgaphalatvāt, anavasthā- nāt ( liṅgabhūtāyāḥ pratipatteḥ kāraṇāttarābhāvāt ) svātmapratipatyantarameva kāraṇaṃ vācyam, evaṃ ca tasyā apyātmapratipatyantaramityavasthā |
) na ca viṣayaprati- pattyā ( codanānāmānaṃ ) viṣayaśabdasyetyasiddheḥ ( bhāvārtha- rūpaviṣayapratipattisiddheḥ ) |
nimittābhāvena - ) tada- bhāvāt, ( codanā'nyanimittatve vā ) itaretarāśrayāt |

para- pravṛttyā anumitāt viditaśabdasaṃbandheḥ svayaṃ śabdadvaya- budhya pravartate iti nobhayavyarthya ( śabdasya ca pravṛtti- liṅgasyānumānasya ca ) iti cet, na, paraṃparayā pravṛttihetumātratvāt viśeṣānirdhāraṇāta tadabhidhāna- pratīteḥ ( tanmātrābhidhānapratīteḥ ) |
tanmātrapratipattyā pravṛttyogāt, nahi sarvaiḥ sarvasya pravṛttihetuḥ ( na khalu ājñādayo viśeṣāḥ sarvaiḥ sarva pravartayanti |
api ca saṃjñasaṃbandhahetunā'dhīnapravṛttitvācchabdasya mānāntareṇa ca saṃbandhagrahaṇamantareṇa tadanupapatteḥ ) |
( śaṅkate - ) śabdapūrvayaiva pravṛttyā anumānahetuka- miti cet ( śabdapūrvayaiva pravṛttyā anumānāt śabdahetuka iti cet |
( śabdapūrvayaiva pravṛttyā anumānāt śabdahetuka iti cet |
) nirākaroti - ) anumānapūrvameva śabdāt pratīteḥ kiṃ nānumānapramāṇa eva |
api ca na dṛṣṭā- tiriktaḥ ( pravṛttiheturanumīyate, tasya pūrvasiddhayapekṣatvāt pravṛtteḥ ) tasya śabdanibandhanapravṛttilakṣaṇasyānumānasya pravṛtteḥ ), hyairapi hetubhiratadupapatteḥ |
pratipannāśca yeḥ pratyayaviśeṣa āśritaḥ, tairātmanaḥ vācyaṃ anya- pramāṇakatvaṃ ca ( ananyapramāṇakatvaṃ ca ) samarthanīyam ( na ca vākyaṃ svasaṃvedanasiddhatvāt anumeyatvādvā ) |
arthānta- reṇamapi nintyameva sarvaiḥ sarvathā'dhikṛtaḥ syāt |
apramāṇakaṃ ca tatra ( pramāṇābhimatatvāt ) śabdāt kasyacit kacinniyogapratīteḥ |
nimittāt kāmādā utpattau ( nimittakārakā - ( ka - ) vinā'pi 'pi kāryavināśāt ) kṛtaprayogasyāpi prāgupa- prasaṅgaḥ |
yāvannimittamanuvṛttau kṛtaprayogasyāpi prāgupa- bhogāt pravṛttiḥ syāt |
tasmāt pūrva eva ( kartṛsamī- hitasādhanatve ) vidhiḥ ||
tatra ( ca sthite ) 'yāgānurakto vyāpāro dṛṣṭa- heturna yujyate |
tatparatvena śabdena yadā sa prati- pāditaḥ ||

yadi khalu yāgānurakte vyāpāre yāgaḥ sādhyātmanā bhāvānuraktatvena ( vāgaṃ kuryāt ityanena rūpeṇa ) gṛhyate tadā saṃnikṛṣṭasvaraḥ śabdena uktaḥ iti iṣṭahetutāmā na tatra viṣayatveḥ samaveyāt tasya ( yāgādeḥ ) aniṣṭatvāt ( duḥkhaṃ karma iti anumato labhya ) |
tatrāviśrite vidhau saphalasya niṣphalasya vā loke kathitam ( anuvidheyapuruṣāśraya- vaśāt ) pravṛttiḥ syāt, ( apīrupaye te vede puruṣārthayā .
(sūtramāha -) prītaryyata puruṣaprayatnānāṃ prītihetutā tu vidhisamavāye sādhakaṃ nādhigacchet iti |

athaivaṃ vidhisāmarthyāt iṣṭa- niṣṭhaḥ, tathā sati dhātvarthaḥ kathaṃ tanāntrīya- tāditaḥ (vidhivivakṣāyāmapi yāgasya sādhyatva- pratipattirupapadyate tasya prāgasiddheḥ sādhitasyaiva sādhana- tvena sādhyatvākṣepāt tadvātrasya tadāntarīyatvāt |
kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe -) yadi tu vidhivivakṣāhetubhāvāt nārthavyāpāraḥ (iṣṭāniṣṭaḥ) tadā yāgasyāniṭatvāt tadanyapare (vyāpāre) pradhānātmanā anavakāśo yāgaḥ |
[ atra 'pradhānāramanonavakāśo yāgaḥ' iti gule mudri- tam |
'pradhānāramanā yāgo'navakāśo na bhavati' iti kaṇikā mudritā |

] prakārāntareṇāpi sāvakāśatayā viśeṣānavakāśatayā (iṣṭa- paratvena vyāpārasya yuktā) sāmarthyāt (anavakāśavidhi- pratītisāmarthyāt) nāntrīyakatayā (vṛttyā) pratipādyamāno viṣayatvaṃ (yāga-) kathanātmaneti |
nahyaiparo vyāpāraḥ tatparaḥ (yāgaparaḥ) yāgaparo vā iṣṭaparaḥ |
yo hi yadicchati sa tat karoti iti bhāvanāyāḥ prārambha icchā |

tathā na tat (icchākarma) bhāvanāsādhaṃ iti siddho'pi svargādiḥ tatkarmatayā (icchākarmatayā) kami- saṃbandhāt (dvitīyādisaṃbandhāt -) odanādisat sādhyā- tmanaiva bhāvanāyāmanveti nānyathā, tadat 'pratyarthaṃ nāmi- mantravān' iti (6|1|13) |
(sūtraṃ vivṛṇoti -) arthyamānaṃ prati puruṣavyāpāraḥ ābhimukhyena saṃbadhyate ataḥ arthanayogāt svargādeḥ tatkarmatayā abhisaṃbandhaḥ; anyathā- 'nvayāt |
ato na kevalaṃ 'yajeta' iti phalāpekṣatvāna (vidhyupahitāyā bhāvanāyāḥ) api tu svargādeḥ (kami- yogāpāditasādhyabhāvasya) anyathāsaṃbandhāt |
tathā ca saṃbandhāt kathaṃ svarga prati sādhanatvena gamyate ||
(yaṅkate -) kathaṃ punaḥ svargasyānviśepaṇasya bhāvanābhisaṃbandhaḥ, tadsaṃnve vā anyaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ katham mamāno vā |
nahi tatbhisaṃbandharahitasya (puruṣasaṃbandha- rahitasya) anyasaṃbandhasyapekṣasya vā bhāvanāsaṃbandhaḥ, guṇabhūtasya nahi samāso yujyate (pradhānasya tu anya- saṃbandhasāpekṣasyāpi samāso dṛṣṭaḥ) |
na khalu svargakāmātvamirapekṣaḥ svargo bhāvanā- 'bhisaṃbandhī (yena tāntrī puruṣaviśeṣaṇapratītiḥ syāt- nyeta) kiṃtu sa eva viśeṣaṇapradhānaḥ saṃbandhamupādānate (bhāvanāyām) |

tathā 'daṇḍī paipānvayāha' iti daṇḍa pradhāno daṇḍī (yathā 'maitrāvaruṇaḥ paipānvayāha' iti paipānvayatvena maitrāvaruṇasya prāpte 'daṇḍī paipānvayāha' iti maitrāvaruṇasyaiva viśeṣavidhinānupapatteḥ viśeṣaṇamya daṇḍasya cāprāptervidheyatvān tatpare daṇḍidravyaḥ, tathaiha 'yajeta' iti bhāvanākṣepādeva bhāvayituḥ prāptervidheyatvāt bhāva- viśeṣapekṣatvācca bhāvanāyāḥ, svargasya ca puruṣaviśeṣaṇa- syāprāptatvāt kamikarmatvā ca bhāvayitvāt anya- tatrāprāpteḥ tatparā svargakāmaśrutiriti ), tadabhisaṃbandhī tu tatparaḥ (bhāvanāsaṃbandharaḥ) svātmanā avivakṣita eva |

svatantrasya hi anyasaṃbandhe tadasaṃbhavāt (puruṣasaṃbandhāsaṃbhavāt) sāpekṣatvāt samāso na syāt : tadabhisaṃbandhe tu (puruṣasaṃbandhena) taddvārā- anyasaṃbandhe nairbhāvyabhāvāparodhena iti yuktaḥ manāsaḥ |
yatra āmnāyārthe sādhyasādhanamanvayaḥ : (sādhyā- ntarasya svargāderasanmavāyaḥ) iti |
dhātvarthe'pi tasya tādarthyena bhāva- nāyāḥ (dhātvarthasya) sādhyatvaṃ tat vidhināpāstam |

na ca dṛṣṭameva prayojanaṃ dravyaguṇaśabdādarthasvarūpato'pi (dravyaguṇaśabdādarthaviśeṣatva dhātvarthasya rūpato'pi) niṣpādyasya sādhanatvāt (prāga- siddheḥ) siddhasyopādānābhāvāt (godohanādīnāṃ tu anyataḥ siddhārthānāṃ sattāmupādānāt) |
śrutyaiva bhāvanāmanurajyatā yāgādeḥ tadviśeṣaṇatva pratīteḥ (bhāvanāyā viśeṣaṇasya pratīteḥ : sādhyatvāvagamaḥ |
yadapi coditam, sarvābhimata- sādhanatvena karmaṇe guṇabhāvāt guṇapradhānabhāvena dvaividhyaṃ hīyeteti tatrāha -) dvividhatvaṃ tu apūrvabhāvābhāvakṛtam |
puruṣaprayatnasya yāgādiviṣayatvaṃ svarge (sādhye) api aviruddham, dṛṣṭe iva cchedye paraśuviṣayatvam |
( yathoktaṃ ' svargaṃ kuryāt ' ityaśakyopadeśa iti, tadupapannam, dvidhā hi bhavati kriyānarhatā atyanta- sattvāt gaganavat, atyantasattvādvā tatpuṇyavat |
na caita- dubhayamapi svargādau samastītyāha -) na ca svargo nityaḥ, atyantamasattvāt yenātraśakyaḥ |
upāyājñānāt iti cet (pariharati -) ata eva sa (upāyaḥ -) jñāpyate (vidhinā, ataśca jñātopāyaḥ śakyo bhaviṣyatīti) |
na cāvadyakartavyatāprasaṅgaḥ (svargādeḥ) phalaśiṣṭanuvādāt karaṇādoṣasaṃhārācca vibeḥ, ' dadhnā juhoti ' iti yathā |
(na vayamācakṣmahe na phalavidhayeti, kiṃtu taduddeśyatvāt ) phalavidhayāyā eva pravṛtteḥ yāgaviṣayatvena (aprāptatvāt |
nahi anyā puruṣasya karmaṇi pravṛttiḥ, anyā karaṇe, karaṇe eva pravṛttaḥ phalapravṛtto bhavati, karmaṇaiva (phale) pravartta- mānaḥ karaṇe pravarttate |
' svargakāmo yāgaṃ kuryāt ' iti yāganiṣṭhe śabde taruṇatvāt (tatraiva tātparyasamavāyāt) apramāṇatvāt (ātmajñānādhikārānapraveśasya |
tatparatve vā -) śruta- hānāt aśrutakalpanācca (śrutāgakartavyatāhānāt aśru- ātmapratipattiḥ, karmabhiḥ kṛtakāmanirvahaṇe dānatvena kāme- ranāgaditamanasā ātmatattvasya suprāpyatvāt |
yadi khalu kāmanirvahaṇāni karmāṇi, taiśca kṛtī na prayojanāntarama- pekṣate kāmī, tathā ca tatpara eva karmetividhiḥ iti nānyaparatve pramāṇam (kāmanānepekṣatvāt) |
na cā- śāstravam, śreyo'bhidhāyakatvāt śreyasaḥ prītirūpatvāt, prīteśca kāmeṣu prayātasaṃvaidyatvāt |
na ca bhogo nirvaha- ṇam, nahi kāmānāṃ tṛptirasti |

atha pravṛttyantaranivṛttyā, tatrāpi yadi kāmī yāgena kuryāt nānyenopāyena kāmam, ko viśeṣaḥ kāmapakṣe (kāmākṣepe iti kaṇikāyām) caitanaḥ kāmanivṛttyāyāṃ pravṛttau, kathaṃ ca pakṣe'pi aprāptavidhau anyanivṛttiḥ |
atha kāmī yāgaṃ kuryāt kāmam, (uttaraṃ -) durlabhamarthadvayaṃ avi- deṣataḥ śrautalakṣaṇikādikam |
(yāgaṃ kuryāditi śraute saṃbhavati, na kāmanivṛttilakṣaṇikī yuktā āśritu- miti ) yāgavidhiparatve na kāmaniṣedhaḥ, kāmaniṣedha- paratve na yāgavidhiḥ |
sarvadṛṣṭā- yeṣupravṛttitirodhe na karmavidhikte'pi apārthakāḥ syuḥḥ dṛṣṭopāyasādhyatvāt tadarthasya (yāgādeḥ) |
svābhāvika- tvācca phalopabhogasya svabhāvatvāt evāmnāyārthaḥ : chadmanā āśritaḥ syāt |
tasmāt mahadaṇḍapadamidaṃ ' dṛṣṭenaiva karmavidhayaḥ : ātmajñānādhikārārohanti ' iti |
niyojyā- nuśāsanaṃ śāstrasya iti jñānaniyogo'pi niyojyānu- śāsanamayaṃ iti na tata ātmapratipattiḥ |
